title: 3D Designer / Produktdesigner / Spatial Designer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über uns

NEW WAVE Kreativmanufaktur ist ein Berliner Design- und Produktionsstudio. Wir entwickeln und realisieren kreative Konzepte für Marken und Räume – von Schaufensterinstallationen und Retail-Design über Events und temporäre Inszenierungen bis hin zu individuellen Objekten und Sonderbauten, verbinden wir Design, Planung und Handwerk. Mit unserer hauseigenen Werkstätten begleiten wir Projekte von der ersten Idee bis zur fertigen Umsetzung.

Wir suchen eine gestaltungsstarke Persönlichkeit, die kreativ denkt, technisch versiert ist und Lust hat, eigenständig Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst kreative Ideen und Gestaltungslösungen für räumliche Installationen, Objekte, Displays und individuelle Markeninszenierungen.

  • Du arbeitest bestehende Entwürfe weiter aus und findest gestalterische wie konstruktive Lösungen für unterschiedliche Anforderungen.

  • Du machst Ideen sichtbar – mit 3D-Modellen, hochwertigen Renderings und aussagekräftigen Präsentationen.

  • Du überführst Entwürfe in technische Zeichnungen, Konstruktionsdetails und Fertigungsdaten, die als Grundlage für die Produktion dienen.

  • Du beschäftigst dich mit Materialien, Fertigungsverfahren und konstruktiven Möglichkeiten, um aus Ideen funktionierende Produkte und Installationen zu machen.

  • Du stehst im engen Austausch mit unserer Projektleitung und unseren Werkstätten und begleitest die Umsetzung deiner Entwürfe.

  • Du stimmst dich bei Bedarf direkt mit Kunden, Lieferanten und weiteren Projektbeteiligten ab.

  • Du behältst deine Aufgaben selbstständig im Blick, denkst voraus und bringst eigene Lösungsvorschläge ein.

Dein Profil

Wir suchen jemanden, der Gestaltung und Konstruktion gleichermaßen durchdenkt und ein gutes Gespür für kreative, funktionale und technisch sinnvolle Lösungen mitbringt. Du verstehst es, gestalterische Ideen und konstruktive Anforderungen so miteinander zu verbinden, dass die Ergebnisse sowohl dem jeweiligen Auftrag als auch den Ansprüchen unserer Kunden gerecht werden. Dabei behältst du die gestalterische Qualität, technische Machbarkeit und wirtschaftliche Umsetzbarkeit im Blick. Du arbeitest strukturiert, denkst vorausschauend und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Projekte – von der ersten Idee bis zur fertigen Umsetzung.

Das solltest du mitbringen:

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Produktdesign, 3D-Design, (Innen)Architektur, Spatial Design oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

  • Mindestens zwei Jahre praktische Berufserfahrung, vorzugsweise in der Gestaltung von Retail-Flächen, Markeninstallationen, Events oder Ausstellungen.

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Rhino und KeyShot sowie einen sicheren Umgang mit Adobe Illustrator, InDesign und Photoshop.

  • Ein gutes Auge für Formen, Proportionen, Materialien und Details.

  • Technisches Verständnis und Erfahrung darin, gestalterische Entwürfe konstruktiv und fertigungsgerecht auszuarbeiten.

  • Eine eigenständige und gut organisierte Arbeitsweise sowie die Fähigkeit, auch bei komplexeren Aufgaben den Überblick zu behalten.

  • Offenheit im Austausch mit anderen, klare Kommunikation und die Bereitschaft, eigene Entscheidungen zu treffen.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Anspruchsvolle, abwechslungsreiche Projekte für renommierte Marken mit großer Außenwirkung

title: (2027 PhD/ABD graduates) Senior Associate (Antitrust & Competition Economics) - United Kingdom
descriptionHtml:
About Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that offers economic, financial, and strategic expertise to major law firms, corporations, and governments around the world. Since 1965, CRA experts have combined rigorous cutting-edge research, state-of-the-art methodology, and proven experience to address our clients’ most complex challenges.

CRA's European Competition practice specialises in providing economic advice on matters of competition policy and regulation. We assist firms and their legal advisors in all types of competition proceedings before competition authorities and courts: mergers and acquisitions, abuse of dominance allegations, cartels, restrictive commercial agreements, market investigations, litigation and disputes, intellectual property or state aid. We also provide advice to regulatory authorities in similar matters.

Learn more about our work by reviewing our Services and Industries on our website.

Position Overview

Senior Associates are hired into our London, United Kingdom office and work closely with senior consultants on project teams, and will have the opportunity to immediately work on some of the largest, high profile and most significant competition cases in Europe, playing a key role in shaping the economic analysis and thinking of these cases. Successful candidates have a strong knowledge of economic concepts and a range of research and quantitative skills. A typical Senior Associate would:

  • Identify and conceptualise issues, specify rigorous economic models to analyse market issues and data, undertake statistical and econometric estimation, and manage the work of research associate staff and colleagues;
  • Supervise, train and mentor research associate staff;
  • Assist in the development and presentation of client deliverables, including expert reports and white papers summarising opinions, conclusions, and recommendations using market, industry or client-proprietary data;
  • Act as a primary point of contact for lawyers and other industry or government clients on a variety of practice-relevant issues;
  • Program, build models and/or perform regression analyses in statistical analysis programs (such as Stata, Python, R, SAS, Matlab, and Mathematica), including large data projects requiring use of cloud computing;
  • Ensure the integrity and accuracy of analyses and opinions; and
  • Contribute to practice-building activities (training, recruiting, publication, expertise sharing, etc.).

Explore how CRA can help you launch your career and learn why PhDs choose CRA.

Desired Qualifications

  • PhD degree in economics with a completion date of December 2026/Summer 2027 and an academic focus on Applied Microeconomics or Applied Microeconometrics, with specializations like industrial organization, labor, health, behavioural and public economics, or other quantitative areas;
  • Experience in Excel, Stata, Python, R, SQL, SAS, ArcGIS/ArcPy, or Cloud computing (Databricks/Spark, Google Cloud, Azure, AWS);
  • Demonstrated understanding of, and ability to explain, economic, financial and/or accounting concepts, and quantitative and qualitative analysis methods;
  • Curious and analytical thinkers who bring creative approaches to non-standard problems;
  • Effective written and oral communication skills;
  • Eagerness to learn new skills and programming languages;
  • Demonstrated high level of initiative and leadership;
  • Strong teamwork and collaboration capabilities;
  • Excellent time management and task prioritization skills; and
  • Clear and demonstrated interest in consulting through coursework, work experience, activities, or attendance at CRA recruiting events.

As much of our work occurs in our offices, minimal travel is required.

To Apply

To be considered for a position in London, United Kingdom, submit through this posting:

  • Resume/CV – please include current address, email and telephone number;
  • Covering letter – please describe your interest in CRA and how this role matches your goals.
  • Research/Job market paper – please submit your original research or dissertation;
  • Letters of Recommendation – please have three (3) LORs submitted directly to -----

To apply for one of our other global locations, please visit our Careers Site to view available jobs.

Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis. Candidates focusing their search on industry and consulting who need to be considered early should indicate that in the CRA online application and submit all materials as early as possible.

Career Growth and Benefits 

  • CRA’s robust skills development programs, including both formal and informal programs, encourage you to thrive as an individual and team member. Beginning with project management skills, training continues with team management/development, client presentation skills, internal seminars, and career mentoring and performance coaching from an assigned senior colleague. Additional leadership and collaboration opportunities exist through internal firm development activities.
  • We offer a comprehensive total rewards program including a competitive salary and superior benefits package (plus a sizeable performance bonus), wellness programming to support physical, mental, emotional and financial well-being, and in-house immigration support for foreign nationals and international business travelers.

Work Location Flexibility

CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognize that individuals realize a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently expect that individuals spend at least 3 to 4 days a week working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to client meetings), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.

Responsible AI Use in Recruiting

We believe that recruiting is fundamentally a human process, and we are committed to a hiring process that is consistent, transparent, and people-focused. While AI and other technology-enabled tools help our team operate more efficiently, we strive to provide every candidate with a personalized, thoughtful, and high-touch experience. As CRA invests significant human effort to find qualified members for our teams, we expect candidates to invest corresponding human effort to learn about CRA, prepare thoughtful application materials, and engage with our interviewers. Read more about appropriate hiring manager, recruiting team, and candidate AI at CRA on our website.  

Our Commitment to Diversity

Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer (Equality Act 2010). As part of our focus on equity and inclusion, we work to ensure a fair and consistent hiring process. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to an inclusive work environment.

title: Account Director,  Corporate - Life Sciences
descriptionHtml:
About AlphaSense: 

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

About the Team:

Our Customer Success team is made up of Account Directors  and Customer Success Managers who are passionate about helping our clients succeed. We partner with a diverse range of organizations, from Fortune 1000 companies to some of the largest financial institutions globally.

As a team, we are committed to providing value to our clients. We take a consultative approach to solve challenges through our product, ensuring our customers have the right data to make informed decisions. We focus on retaining customers, maximizing product usage, and collaborating with the sales team to uncover growth opportunities.

About the Role: 

We’re looking for a high-impact Account Director to own and expand relationships with our most complex and high-value accounts within the Corporate Life Sciences sector. You'll be the primary point of contact for a book of Fortune 1000 accounts—driving renewals, adoption, and growth. In this role, you'll be expected to collaborate with account executives, identifying new business opportunities to help expand our footprint within each client account.

While key performance indicators include retention rate and the identification of growth opportunities, the responsibilities of Account Directors go much deeper. The team also extracts a wealth of knowledge from our clients, bringing that internally to product, marketing and sales teams in order to maximize the effectiveness of our business' strategy and communication.

What You’ll Do: 

  • Forecast and maximize retention rate across your book of business
  • Increase and drive adoption of AlphaSense solutions into other business units of existing clients to uncover new opportunities, exceeding monthly, quarterly and annual revenue goals
  • Identify revenue at risk in order to best position the company to prevent churn
  • Collaborate with Account Executives to identify growth opportunities within the book of business
  • Understand the ins and outs of the business, roles, responsibilities, projects, performance metrics, etc. within our client base in order to more effectively: 1) communicate with users, 2) communicate with decision makers, 3) identify white space, 4) partner with AE to craft most compelling messaging to prospective users
  • Cultivate relationships with users and key stakeholders to ensure AlphaSense is viewed as a business partner rather than vendor
  • Hold Business Reviews with key stakeholders
  • Consistent proactive outreach with material and information that’s relevant for our user base
  • Serve as our boots on the ground and physical presence within each client (floor walks, lunch and learns, etc.)
  • Serve as both the advocate for AlphaSense to the client, and the client advocate within AlphaSense
  • Acquire value stories and product feedback from clients. Circulate internally to assist with product development, marketing, sales efforts

Who You Are:

  • Relationship-driven: You have a strong ability to develop instant rapport with new people and you’ve demonstrated success at managing and growing relationships within Fortune 1000 clients
  • A subject matter expert: You excel at what you do and know how to succeed within your role -- this includes both internal and external relationship management as well as strong business acumen and commitment to effective processes and tactics
  • Knowledgeable and experienced in Life Sciences: Experience working with clients in the Life Sciences industry, including Pharma, Biotech, Medical devices and diagnostics - additional bonus for familiarity with competitive intelligence, business development and clinical and commercial strategy workflows.
  • Energetic and creative: You possess a natural intellectual curiosity with the ability to learn and adapt quickly
  • You understand our business: We are a rapidly growing SaaS company and are incredibly passionate about our product. We are looking for individuals who understand best practices for client engagement within a SaaS environment;
  • Committed to delivering results: You set the example for grit, work ethic, initiative, enthusiasm and commitment amongst your peers.
  • A strong communicator: You’ll regularly be engaged with day-to-day users to C-level executives and that requires exceptional oral, written and presentation skills. You’ll need to distill and explain complex issues in simple terms.

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
  • All official communications will come from an @alpha-sense.com email address.
  • If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

title: Account Executive, Defence
descriptionHtml:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About the role

You will be the commercial lead for our major European partners and our UK Land programmes, and for new partner, prime and Land accounts across the UK and Europe. You will own these relationships, grow live pilots into multi-year programmes and partnerships, and coordinate our Growth, Solutions and Forward Deployed Engineering teams to deliver. You will be based in London and spend regular time with customers across the UK and with our partners in Europe.

At Applied Intuition, you will:

  • Own relationships with our major partners and UK Land customers end to end: engagement cadence, stakeholder map across business units, and a clear account plan

  • Grow live pilots into multi-year programmes and partnerships, shaping follow-on work across our Axion, Acuity and platform products

  • Coordinate internal teams around active pursuits, keep pipeline and account plans current, and align customer and partner priorities with what we can deliver

  • Drive continuity through award and delivery, manage escalations, and find follow-ons, renewals and adjacent programmes

  • Open new partner, prime and Land accounts across the UK and Europe, finding new budget lines, programmes and contacts

  • Shape the scope of technical deals with our Solutions Engineers rather than selling off a price sheet

  • Work within export-control, classification and data-sovereignty constraints in every engagement

We're looking for someone who has:

  • A track record of owning customer or partner relationships and driving deals to award in European defence, as an account executive, BD lead or ex-military acquisition or capability officer

  • Experience managing and growing a strategic partner, prime or OEM relationship, or selling into UK Land programmes

  • A consultative, solution-selling approach and enough technical literacy to be credible with engineers

  • A live network across UK Land and European defence primes and programmes

  • Strong organisational discipline: account plans, meeting notes, follow-up tracking and CRM (Salesforce) hygiene

  • High energy, a natural networking instinct, and comfort with ambiguity and rejection

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent military experience

Travel requirements

  • Regular travel to Europe and to customer sites across the UK.

Security requirements

  • Must have the ability to obtain UK Security Clearance (SC)

Nice to have

  • UK Land domain (British Army, DE&S) or European defence industry experience

  • Experience at a defence-tech start-up, autonomy company or prime

  • Knowledge of UK and European defence acquisition (MOD, DE&S, FMV)

  • Familiarity with structured sales qualification such as MEDDPICC

  • Service in the UK or allied armed forces

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Applied Intuition is an equal opportunity employer and federal contractor or subcontractor. Consequently, the parties agree that, as applicable, they will abide by the requirements of 41 CFR 60-1.4(a), 41 CFR 60-300.5(a) and 41 CFR 60-741.5(a) and that these laws are incorporated herein by reference. These regulations require that covered prime contractors and subcontractors take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status or disability. title: Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Executive based in France.

As an Account Executive – EMEA, you will drive new business development and strategic account growth across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, helping shape the future of AI-powered engineering and semiconductor design. You will introduce innovative physics simulation technology to leading semiconductor and electronics organizations, demonstrating its value in optimizing hardware development and manufacturing workflows. Combining new customer acquisition with strategic account expansion, you will build relationships with technical experts, business leaders, and C-level executives. You will lead complex enterprise sales cycles, develop regional partnerships, and create demand in an emerging technology market. Working closely with engineering, pre-sales, and product teams, you will ensure successful customer evaluations and long-term adoption. This is an exciting opportunity for an ambitious sales professional to influence an evolving industry while taking ownership of a strategic international territory.


Accountabilities

  • Strategic Account Management: Build and maintain strong relationships within key enterprise accounts across EMEA, identifying business units and opportunities where advanced physics simulation technology can deliver measurable business value.

  • New Business Development: Identify, prospect, and develop new strategic customers, generating demand and establishing relationships with technical, commercial, and executive stakeholders.

  • Account Expansion: Drive both new customer acquisition and growth within existing accounts, developing land-and-expand strategies across complex engineering organizations.

  • Partner Ecosystem Development: Build and manage relationships with resellers, service providers, distributors, and strategic channel partners to increase regional market reach, generate customer introductions, and accelerate adoption.

  • Full Sales Cycle Ownership: Manage the entire enterprise sales process, from prospecting and discovery to value proposition development, technical evaluations, contract negotiations, and closing high-value deals.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with pre-sales, forward-deployment, and engineering teams to coordinate customer test cases and pilot deployments, ensuring alignment with business objectives and technical requirements.

  • Pipeline Management and Forecasting: Maintain a strong and accurate sales pipeline, targeting at least four times quota coverage while providing clear forecasts and visibility into opportunity progression.

  • Market and Competitive Intelligence: Gather customer insights, partner feedback, regional market trends, and competitive intelligence to inform product development and commercial strategy.

  • Strategic Customer Engagement: Navigate complex organizational structures and engage effectively with technical individual contributors, domain experts, senior executives, and decision-makers.

  • Regional Market Development: Represent the business across EMEA, regularly traveling to strategic customer locations and partner organizations to develop relationships and advance commercial opportunities.

    • Requirements:

  • At least 7 years of experience in enterprise software sales, ideally as a major account manager or enterprise account executive within the semiconductor or electronics industry.

  • Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding annual sales quotas of $2 million or more and closing complex, high-value deals ranging from six to seven figures.

  • Strong understanding of the semiconductor ecosystem, including Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools, fabless and Integrated Device Manufacturer (IDM) business models, and advanced packaging technologies such as 2.5D and 3D IC.

  • Established network of senior decision-makers and industry contacts within major semiconductor, electronics, or engineering organizations across EMEA.

  • Excellent executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical and commercial value propositions to VP-level and C-suite stakeholders.

  • Strong technical aptitude and the ability to discuss physics simulation concepts and their applications in design, validation, and manufacturing workflows without relying on sales engineers for every customer interaction.

  • Demonstrated experience selling through and managing partner ecosystems, including resellers, distributors, service providers, or other channel relationships.

  • Strong strategic account planning, prospecting, negotiation, and closing skills.

  • Ability to operate autonomously, build relationships from the ground up, and create demand in markets where product categories and purchasing budgets may not yet be established.

  • Experience with consultative, challenger, and value-based selling methodologies, ideally supported by MEDDIC, MEDDPICC, or Force Management frameworks.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills, combined with a proactive, entrepreneurial, and results-driven mindset.

  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly throughout Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

    • Preferred Qualifications:

  • Academic or professional background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • Previous Account Executive or enterprise sales experience at a leading EDA or engineering software company, such as Cadence, Synopsys, or Ansys.

  • Experience working for a high-growth AI or deep-tech startup focused on engineering applications.

  • Existing relationships with senior executives and decision-makers at major semiconductor companies across EMEA.

  • Proven success implementing land-and-expand strategies within large, complex, and highly specialized engineering organizations.

  • Experience establishing and scaling strategic channel and partner ecosystems.

  • Strong evangelistic selling skills, with the ability to educate customers, challenge established practices, and introduce innovative technology solutions.

    • Benefits:

  • Opportunity to help define the future of AI-powered hardware design and engineering.

  • Ownership of commercial strategy and enterprise relationships with influential semiconductor organizations worldwide.

  • Exposure to cutting-edge technologies at the intersection of artificial intelligence, physics simulation, and advanced engineering.

  • Opportunity to develop and lead a strategic international sales territory across EMEA.

  • Close collaboration with highly skilled engineers, researchers, and commercial professionals.

  • Dynamic, fast-paced startup environment offering significant autonomy and professional responsibility.

  • Opportunity to influence product direction, market positioning, and the development of an emerging technology category.

  • Career development potential within an innovative and rapidly growing technology business.

title: Account Executive (x/f/m) im Außendienst / Köln & Bonn
descriptionHtml:
Großer Markt, perfektes Timing: Deine Verantwortung

Köln zählt zu den wirtschaftsstärksten Gesundheitsregionen Deutschlands – und zu den Märkten, die Digitalisierung am dringendsten brauchen. Wir bei Doctolib machen diesen Wandel möglich: mit einer KI-gestützten All-in-One-Lösung, die Healthcare Professionals entlastet und Patient:innen bessere Versorgung bringt – Praxis für Praxis.

Als Account Executive (x/f/m) führst Du Dein Territory wie ein eigenes Business: von der strategischen Marktbearbeitung bis zum kontinuierlichen Umsatzwachstum. Deine Mission: Ärzt:innen und Praxisteams in Franken für Doctolib zu begeistern, nachhaltiges Umsatzwachstum voranzutreiben und Deine Region zu einem der stärksten Märkte Deutschlands zu entwickeln. Die Chance, die vor uns liegt, ist noch weit größer als das, was wir bisher aufgebaut haben.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Territory Ownership vom ersten Tag an: Du trägst die vollständige Verantwortung für Dein Vertriebsgebiet – von der Marktanalyse über gezielte Akquise bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Du entscheidest, wie Du Deine Energie einsetzt, um maximalen Impact zu erzielen.

  • Nachhaltiges Umsatz- und Pipelinewachstum: Du verantwortest Deinen Erfolg, Deine Pipeline und Dein Netzwerk in der Region – und Du weißt, wie Du alle drei systematisch aufbaust und konsequent entwickelst.

  • Stärke im Neukundengeschäft: Du verstehst, was Ärzt:innen und Praxisteams bewegt – und machst dieses Verständnis zu Deinem stärksten Argument. Du akquirierst zielgerichtet, pitchst mit Überzeugung und bringst Deals konsequent zum Abschluss.

  • Datengetriebene Vertriebssteuerung: Du misst Deine Performance konsequent mit Salesforce, analysierst Deine Kennzahlen, erkennst Muster früh und steuerst gezielt nach.

 

Dein Profil

Wenn Du nicht jeden der folgenden Punkte erfüllst, aber überzeugt bist, dass diese Stelle zu Dir passt – bewirb Dich. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Perspektive!

  • Nachgewiesene Stärke im Field Sales: Du bringst Vertriebserfahrung im Außendienst mit – idealerweise im B2B-Umfeld. Die Dynamik komplexer Sales-Zyklen ist Dir vertraut; Entscheider:innen zu überzeugen ist Deine Stärke.

  • Neukundenakquise mit strategischem Blick: Du liebst es, neue Kund:innen zu gewinnen – und Du gehst dabei nicht nach Bauchgefühl vor. Du analysierst, priorisierst und pitchst mit Präzision.

  • Begeisterung für digitale Transformation im Gesundheitswesen: Du bist davon überzeugt, dass smarte Technologie den Praxisalltag wirklich verbessern kann – und Du machst diese Überzeugung im Gespräch spürbar. Für Ärzt:innen, für Praxisteams, für den Markt.

  • Kommunikation auf Top-Niveau: Du drückst Dich sehr gut mündlich und schriftlich auf Deutsch (C1-Niveau oder höher) aus; Deine Englischkenntnisse sind außerdem mindestens auf Konversationsniveau (B1).

  • Präsenz dort, wo es zählt: Du weißt, dass der größte Impact im direkten Kontakt entsteht – bei Ärzt:innen, in Praxen, in der Region. Ein Wohnort in Franken (oder die Bereitschaft, umzuziehen), Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deines Vertriebsgebiets sowie ein Führerschein Klasse B sind daher Voraussetzung.

 

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Die Teilnahme an unserem langfristigen Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm DoctoGrowth

  • Einen Firmenwagen mit Tankkarte – natürlich auch privat nutzbar

  • Erstklassige Fort- und Weiterbildungsangebote – maßgeschneidert auf Dich und Deine Karriereziele

title: Account Executive 🇫🇷 (Small Businesses)
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Disclaimer: We're open to hire Account Executives across our Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes and Biarritz offices.

⭐️ The Account Executive (Small Businesses) job

Your mission

Join our Small Businesses team targeting companies with 10-30 employees across tech, consulting, and business services, the market segment where Alan has the strongest product-market fit and brand recognition. You'll work in a high-velocity environment with strong conversion rates, and the opportunity to make an immediate impact on hundreds of growing French companies.

What you'll own

  • Full sales cycle: From prospection to closing

  • Strategic relationships: Drive deals and manage key customer relationships

  • Education & demos: Deliver inspiring product demonstrations and guide stakeholders through the evaluation process

The Alan way of selling

We've developed the Alan Smart & Soft selling method:

  • Smart: Leverage precise messaging and materials to educate and inspire

  • Soft: Create tailored, high-touch strategies for each prospect

  • Experience: Deliver a seamless journey that reflects Alan's customer-first approach

Beyond sales

As an Alan team member, you'll:

  • Shape our product evolution

  • Contribute to improving our methods and strategy

  • Participate in growth initiatives

  • Be part of a collaborative team that thinks big

Join us in revolutionizing healthcare through technology and human connection 🌟

Meet Estelle Berdugo one of our Account Executives.


⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit for the Small Businesses Team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 3 years of experience managing the whole Sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. Prospection is a key part of the role;

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above) and an advanced level in English.

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills;

  • Have empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems;

  • Can influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building;

  • Have a deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models;

  • Have a great attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team;

  • Are eager to learn fast and make an impact from day 1;

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the B1-C0 level range.

If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France.


Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential.Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

title: Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Megaport We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun. Our Team Culture We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do. We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

The Role

Reporting to the Regional Manager of Customer Success, the Customer Success Manager (CSM) will serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of high-value, strategic customers. This is a Sales role with a quota to achieve each quarter, focused on high-touch post-sales engagement, with particular emphasis on driving customer success, enabling upsell and cross-sell opportunities, managing renewals, supporting service performance, and enhancing the overall customer experience.

The CSM will be responsible for maintaining and expanding revenue by developing strong customer relationships, understanding strategic priorities, introducing new product developments and commercial initiatives, and showcasing the full value of the Megaport proposition. This is a quota-carrying role, with defined revenue targets and performance measured against attainment. Success will be evaluated based on your ability to grow and retain revenue within your customer base, contributing to both individual and team objectives.

This position is part of the wider Integrated Accounts Team, working closely with a Direct Sales Executive and Solutions Architect. The CSM will take a leading role in commercial engagement for existing strategic customers within the France portfolio, focused on growth, retention, adoption, and long-term customer satisfaction.

You will champion Megaport’s value proposition and help drive adoption across our ever-evolving portfolio of services, strengthening Megaport’s position as a trusted infrastructure partner.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Collaborate with Direct Sales Executives and Solution Architects to manage, grow, and retain revenue across a defined portfolio of strategic customers.

  • Build strong relationships across multiple levels of the customer organisation, including senior and executive stakeholders.

  • Develop and maintain account plans that capture customer objectives, priorities, risks, stakeholders, and growth opportunities.

  • Lead regular strategic customer engagements, including business reviews and success planning sessions.

  • Drive adoption and awareness of Megaport’s products, services, and broader partner ecosystem through proactive, tailored engagement.

  • Proactively manage the renewal process, identifying risk early and working to maximise retention and customer lifetime value.

  • Act as a trusted advisor from onboarding through to renewal and expansion, ensuring customers realise ongoing value from Megaport.

  • Identify upsell, cross-sell, and whitespace opportunities based on customer priorities, use cases, and future plans.

  • Represent the customer internally, coordinating commercial resolution of issues and identifying where Megaport can deliver greater value.

  • Track customer sentiment, account health, risks, and pipeline activity in Salesforce (SFDC) to support planning and forecasting.

  • Maintain strong product knowledge across Megaport’s solutions, confidently positioning their value within the customer’s broader technology environment.

  • Support revenue growth campaigns by partnering with Sales and Marketing on focused strategies.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Finance and Operations, to help resolve service-impacting challenges.

  • Continuously seek ways to improve customer experience and internal processes through customer feedback and commercial insight.


    • What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Strategic Account Management, Account Management, or equivalent roles within the enterprise software, internet, cloud, or telecommunications sectors.

  • Experience managing high-value or strategically important customers in a high-touch environment.

  • Strong commercial acumen and the ability to influence revenue outcomes through a consultative, value-driven sales approach.

  • Proven experience driving retention, adoption, upsell, and cross-sell within existing customer accounts.

  • Strong relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage confidently with senior and executive stakeholders.

  • Demonstrated strength in identifying customer pain points and proposing relevant solutions that drive tangible value.

  • Proven ability to thrive in fast-paced, technical environments with shifting priorities.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across global teams and customers.

  • Confident using CRM platforms such as Salesforce (SFDC) to maintain account records, opportunity pipelines, forecasting, and reporting.

  • Understanding of cloud, networking, and virtualised compute environments in the enterprise space is highly desirable.

  • Must be fluent in French and English, comfortable presenting to customers and internal company stakeholders in both languages.

  • Creative, fun, and contemporary workspaces

descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Dans un souci de clarté et d’accessibilité, nous avons choisi de ne pas utiliser l’écriture inclusive dans nos communications. WPP Media est fermement engagé en faveur de la diversité : nous valorisons l'inclusion et l'égalité, en considérant tous les candidats sans distinction d'identité de genre, d'origine ethnique ou de religion. Tous nos postes sont également ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

À propos de WPP Media :

WPP est le partenaire de confiance des plus grandes marques mondiales pour assurer leur croissance. Nous réunissons une intelligence média de pointe, une créativité de classe mondiale, une production de nouvelle génération, des solutions pour transformer le marketing à l’ère de l’IA et un conseil stratégique d’expert au sein d’une seule compagnie.

Propulsés par des talents exceptionnels et WPP Open, notre plateforme de marketing agentique, nous déployons l’IA à grande échelle pour aider nos clients à naviguer dans un monde en pleines mutations et à optimiser leurs investissements marketing.

Pour plus d’informations, visitez www.wpp.com.

WPP Media est le collectif média global de WPP. Dans un monde où les médias sont omniprésents, nous regroupons la meilleure plateforme, les meilleurs talents et les meilleurs partenaires pour développer les solutions les plus innovantes, offrant une croissance inégalée à nos clients. Pour plus d'informations, visitez wppmedia.com.

Chez WPP Media, nous croyons en la puissance de notre culture et de nos collaborateurs. C'est grâce à cette synergie que nous parvenons à créer des expériences véritablement exceptionnelles, tant pour nos clients que pour nos équipes internes.

Pour réussir dans ce poste, il est fondamental d'incarner les valeurs essentielles qui unissent WPP et WPP Media :

  • Être Extraordinaire en favorisant un leadership collectif qui inspire une créativité véritablement transformationnelle.
  • Créer un environnement Ouvert en trouvant l'équilibre parfait entre l'épanouissement de nos collaborateurs et la satisfaction de nos clients, le tout fondé sur une confiance mutuelle.
  • Diriger avec Optimisme en stimulant activement la croissance et le développement pour mobiliser l'ensemble de notre organisation.

Rôle et missions :

Rattaché au Head of Social Media et en coordination étroite avec le Head of Strategy, vous pilotez un portefeuille de clients clés et participez activement au développement de l’agence.

Vous concevez des stratégies de contenu innovantes pour les écosystèmes de nos marques clientes en intégrant les cibles, les nouveaux usages, les plateformes sociales et les enjeux de brand experience, tant sur le volet éditorial que sur l'influence marketing.

Vos responsabilités s'articulent autour de 3 grands axes :

  1. Conseil Stratégique & Relation Client
  • Stratégie & Recommandations : Écriture et pilotage des recommandations stratégiques Social Media & Influence (fil rouge et temps forts) pour les marques de votre portefeuille ; définition et suivi des KPI de performance.
  • Soutenance & Restitution : Présentation orale des recommandations et des bilans stratégiques auprès des annonceurs, en vous appuyant sur votre équipe et en synergie avec les pôles experts de l’agence (Content Strategy, Production, Événementiel, Média).
  • Delivery & Satisfaction : Suivi rigoureux de la relation client, garantie du bon déploiement opérationnel des campagnes, respect des plannings, gestion des budgets et rentabilité financière des projets.
  1. Développement Commercial & Offre
  • New Business & Croissance : Pilotage des briefs entrants (Inbizz et NewBizz) et participation active au développement du portefeuille clients et du chiffre d'affaires de la Business Unit Studio M.
  • Développement de l’offre Influence : Contribution à l’enrichissement des méthodologies et outils (GOAT, outils de veille/social listening) et développement des relations avec les créateurs de contenu, agences de management et maisons artistiques.
  1. Management & Synergies d’Équipe
  • Management d’équipe : Encadrement, formation et montée en compétences de 1 à 3 personnes.
  • Organisation & Process : Mise en place des process de collaboration pour accompagner la progression et la fidélisation des talents au sein de l'équipe.
  • Transversalité : Développement des synergies au quotidien avec les autres expertises de WPP Media.

Profil recherché :

  • Expérience : De formation supérieure (Bac+5 en marketing, communication, médias ou école de commerce), vous justifiez d’au moins 5 ans d’expérience en agence (Social Media, média ou globale) sur la gestion de comptes d'envergure.
  • Expertise Métier : Excellente culture des plateformes sociales, des tendances de contenu, des mécaniques d'activation d'influence et de l'écosystème des créateurs.
  • Sens Stratégique & Business : Fortes capacités d'analyse, d'écriture stratégique et aisance à l'oral pour pitcher devant des directions marketing. Sensibilité financière (gestion de marge, suivi de P&L projet).
  • Leadership : Expérience réussie en management ou tutorat d'équipe, esprit d’écoute, bienveillance et rigueur opérationnelle.
  • Langues : Maîtrise courante de l’anglais (écrit et oral), indispensable dans notre environnement international.

La vie chez WPP Media et ses avantages :

Notre engagement à façonner l'avenir des médias se manifeste par un soutien actif au développement professionnel de nos talents, les aidant à atteindre leur plein potentiel. Cette démarche s'accompagne d'une vision responsable dans nos stratégies d'investissement médiatique, reflétant ainsi notre double priorité : valoriser nos collaborateurs tout en adoptant des pratiques durables dans notre secteur.

Les collaborateurs de WPP Media ont un accès privilégié aux réseaux internationaux de WPP Media et WPP, leur permettant de développer leurs passions, d'étendre leur réseau professionnel et de rester à la pointe des innovations en marketing et publicité.

Nous disposons de ressources vastes et variées au service de nos collaborateurs, notre entreprise cultive activement l'inclusion des talents de tous horizons. Les réussites et expertises des équipes sont régulièrement mises en lumière lors d'événements fédérateurs qui ponctuent également les moments clés de l'année, renforçant ainsi notre culture d'entreprise collaborative et diversifiée.

Nos avantages comprennent :

  • Télétravail : jusqu'à 2 jours par semaine et 2 semaines complètes à prendre en deux fois dans l’année.
  • Congés offerts : 2 jours de repos supplémentaires offerts, dont le lundi de Pentecôte.
  • Ancienneté : Jours de congé additionnels par palier de 5 ans d’ancienneté.
  • Santé & Équité : 5 jours de télétravail additionnels par mois pour les collaboratrices souffrant d’endométriose.
  • Politique handicap : 3 jours d'absence autorisés payés par an, accès à des Chèques Emploi Service Universel (CESU), et accompagnements spécifiques pour les collaborateurs ayant une RQTH.
  • Engagement sociétal : Missions solidaires possibles via le programme We care and we act.
  • Tools & Innovation : Accès à des outils performants et à la pointe de la technologie pour la gestion des campagnes, l'écoute et le reporting (WPP Open).

Process de recrutement :

Nous nous engageons à rendre ce process aussi rapide et efficace que possible, et à maintenir une communication ouverte et transparente tout au long du process :

  1. Entretien avec l’équipe Recrutement : Un premier échange téléphonique ou par vidéoconférence avec l’équipe Talent pour aborder votre parcours et vos aspirations.
  2. Entretien Opérationnel : Un échange approfondi avec le manager du poste pour échanger sur vos expériences, la vision du pôle et les enjeux clients.
  3. Étude de cas : Une mise en situation concrète (cas pratique stratégique Social Media & Influence) suivie d’une restitution orale.

WPP Media garantit l'égalité des chances et considère tous les candidats sans discrimination ni considération de caractéristiques particulières. Nous nous engageons à cultiver un environnement de respect où chacun se sent à sa place et bénéficie des mêmes opportunités d'évolution professionnelle.

descriptionHtml:
What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 700 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. title: Agency Lead - Middle Mile
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

The Opportunity

Every morning before most of the country is awake, Relay's middle mile moves parcels in vans from our sort centres to thousands of local shops we call pitstops. A big share of those vans and drivers come from partner agencies, which makes them one of the most important partnerships in the business. When an agency doesn't show up, or we simply don't have enough, parcels don't move, couriers wait and customers feel it that same day. When a contract is wrong, it hits our P&L directly.

Right now our agency relationships run on ad hoc calls handled by our live support team. You'll be the person who changes that. You'll build proper account management from scratch, with clear standards, regular reviews and real consequences when standards slip. You'll make sure we always have enough reliable, compliant capacity at a price that works, and a bench of agencies ready to step in when one doesn't deliver. As we open new sort centres across the UK and expand internationally, you'll be the one finding and launching the agency partners that get each new region moving from day one. You won't just manage the process, you'll help rebuild it. You'll work side by side with our engineers to design a better experience for agencies and automate the manual work out of it.

As engineering automations go live and more of the middle mile runs itself, the role grows with it. The playbook you build here becomes the blueprint for every new market we enter. It can widen into a Marketplace Partnerships Lead across all our supply: van and moped rental deals, background check and onboarding suppliers, local partnerships in areas where we need more couriers, and courier benefits programmes.

Outcomes you own

  • Agency shift fill. Agencies reliably fill the shifts gave to them, including at short notice and through peak.

  • Agency driver attendance and quality. Agency drivers turn up for the shifts they accept, on time, trained and ready at the sort centre.

  • Agency cost per shift. Rates and bonuses stay within budget, and every pound of premium we pay an agency earns its place.

  • Agency supply pool. Each agency keeps enough onboarded drivers to ramp with us. An agency running the same four drivers every day has no flex.

  • A healthy agency bench. Every agency knows how it ranks against our standards and its peers, and we always have a replacement ready for one that persistently underperforms.

What you’ll do

  1. Own every agency relationship. Be the single point of contact for all our middle mile driver agencies. Run weekly account calls, step in fast when performance dips, and build relationships that hold up on the hardest peak mornings.

  2. Hold agencies to account. Track fill, attendance and driver quality for every agency and share it with them. When one falls short, find out why: separate what’s on us (route length, late shift release) from what’s on them (no-shows, hand-backs), and agree a fix with a target, a date and an owner. Fix the cause rather than paying more to cover it.

  3. Own contracts, rates and terms. Negotiate rates, bonuses and contract terms. Use data to compare agencies before every rate conversation, and know when to walk away from a deal that doesn’t work for us.

  4. Build the bench. Source, vet and contract new agencies in each region. Start them small, scale the ones that deliver and replace the ones that don’t, so we’re never dependent on one low performer.

  5. Be the escalation point. Live Ops handles day-to-day shift fill. When an agency misses its agreement, is unhappy with how we’re working with them, or sort centre teams see a pattern of problems with its drivers, you resolve it.

  6. Shape new ways of working. We’re automating how agencies receive and book shifts. Be the expert on what works for agencies, advise Product and Engineering on the designs, and move every agency onto the new process.

What you’ll need

  • Ownership. You run outcomes, not tasks. A good week is one where agency fill, attendance and cost move the right way.

  • Hands-on ops experience. You’ve worked in logistics, delivery, transport or a similar fast-moving operation, and can run the operational work yourself rather than hand it off.

  • Supplier or account management. You’ve managed agencies, subcontractors or a third-party workforce, ideally with commercial targets attached.

  • Comfort with hard conversations. You hold partners to what they agreed, challenge excuses and keep the relationship intact.

  • Ops judgement under pressure. At 05:30 with a van broken down, you work out what’s most at risk, make the call and tell the right people what happens next.

  • Comfort with data. You can turn a volume plan into shifts per day by site, read a dashboard and question a number. Spreadsheets are a must; SQL is a plus.

  • Comfort with ambiguity. This is a new role in a fast-growing network. You’ll shape how it works rather than inherit a playbook.

Fast and focused hiring process

  1. Talent Acquisition interview – 30 mins

  2. Hiring Manager interview – 45 mins

  3. Case interview: live role plays of real agency situations – 1 hour

Decision and offer within 48 hours. Our process mirrors our pace of work.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

title: AI Engineer - Large Scale Pre-Training
descriptionHtml:
About us

We are building a global leader in physical AI, anchored in Europe’s strongest robotics heritage. Founded by entrepreneurs with backgrounds in scaling digital products and advanced robotics, the team is bolstered by senior leadership from top-tier AI research labs and industrial tech companies.

Driven by a mission to create versatile and trustworthy embodied AI for physical labor, we fuse deep engineering mastery in AI and mechatronics with a rapid-execution culture. We are addressing the labor shortage by closing the gap to production-grade deployment. This means building the trusted alternative: robots that are safe, secure, and engineered to automotive standards of scale and durability.

We are well-capitalized and now assembling our team.

Our Locations: Vesoma has two main locations: Munich, Germany and Limassol, Cyprus. This pan-European setup represents our core ambition of building a European technology leader, gives us a great talent base and a strong corporate structure.

Your mission

The role
As an AI Engineer for Large-Scale Pre-Training, you enter as a key member of the early AI team. You will work directly with our AI leadership and researchers to define the infrastructure we use to train large-scale robot foundation models on petabyte-scale datasets across our GPU fleet. This infrastructure is a critical part of our research and development cycle: it must strike the right balance between stability and velocity, enabling fast research iterations based on reliable results. This is a full-time, permanent position.

Your profile

Key responsibilities

  • Scalable Training Infrastructure: Develop software infrastructure to train multi-billion-parameter robot foundation models efficiently on large video datasets across multi-node GPU clusters.

  • Data Pipelines: Build high-throughput, reliable data pipelines that stream, decode and preprocess petabyte-scale video datasets, keeping our GPUs fully utilized and supporting deterministic, resumable training.

  • Experiment Management: Build the tools to organize, monitor and optimize large training workloads and model sweeps. Remove bottlenecks in our training pipelines and make sure all our runs maintain the highest possible goodput.

Who we are looking for
We seek people who embrace the empirical nature of AI research and want to accelerate our research velocity with best-in-class tools - so that we can all make breakthroughs faster, together.

  • Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience training multi-billion-parameter models on multi-node GPU clusters, including supervising long-running experiments, in-flight debugging and optimizing goodput and MFU.

  • Core Skills: Deep expertise in distributed training and training efficiency at scale. In detail:

    • Distributed Training: Data parallelism and sharding (DDP, FSDP/FSDP2, ZeRO), tensor, pipeline and sequence parallelism, and frameworks such as Megatron-Core, DeepSpeed, TorchTitan or JAX/GSPMD.

    • Training Efficiency: BF16/FP8 mixed precision, activation checkpointing, FlashAttention, and profiling with PyTorch Profiler or Nsight Systems.

    • Fault Tolerance: Distributed and asynchronous checkpointing, automatic recovery, and diagnosing NCCL and hardware failures.

  • Core Stack: Python, PyTorch and/or JAX, CUDA, NCCL, and cluster orchestration with Slurm or Kubernetes.

  • A plus: High-throughput data pipelines for large video datasets (WebDataset, Mosaic Streaming, Ray Data, DALI/NVDEC); custom kernels in Triton or CUDA; familiarity with multimodal or robot foundation models (VLAs, video transformers, diffusion/flow-matching policies); experiment tracking and sweep infrastructure (Weights & Biases, MLflow, Hydra).

  • Mindset: You balance the agility of a startup with the professional rigor required for a global industrial player. You are a curious builder who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced research environment, and an engineer with a research mindset who understands the workflows of cutting-edge AI research and supports them with rigorous software engineering.

Why us?

  • The Team: Work alongside leadership with a proven track record of building unicorn-scale companies and defining global robotics standards.

  • Smart Strategy: We operate as disciplined fast followers. Capital is timed to the deployment inflection point, avoiding early-mover dead ends to scale fast on proven foundations.

  • Resources: We are substantially internally funded and attract top-tier investors to avoid any capital constraints for our mission.

  • Historic Opportunity: Join at the dawn of a new industry comparable to the rise of the automobile. Help shape the European champion in this trillion-dollar market.

We are an equal opportunity employer.

title: AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Do you thrive on complex problems and want to work at the forefront of AI? Join Cefetra Group’s new AI Innovation Hub as an AI Engineer and shape how AI creates value across our international trading business, from agents and workflows integrated with our core systems to the skills and ways of working that make them stick.

Who we are

Cefetra Group comprises several trading companies in the agricultural sector and the food ingredients industry, with leading brands in the ingredients market. Together, we employ approximately 800 people across 39 offices in 17 countries worldwide. We work closely together to provide our customers with the best possible service. Together with our suppliers, we develop strong supply chains and create value by sourcing raw materials and supplying them to the international food, animal feed and energy industries. Behind that sits real complexity: global commodity flows, volatile markets, intricate contracts and logistics, and data spread across many entities and systems. That is exactly where AI can make a decisive difference, and we are building the capability to make it happen.

The role

As an AI Engineer in the AI Innovation Hub, part of the Group Digital & Technology team, your goal is to build Cefetra Group’s AI capability and set the standard for how AI is designed and used across our entities. You’ll deliver AI solutions, from agents and workflows to knowledge bases, that teams across Cefetra Group can apply to augment their work, while helping colleagues build the skills to use them. You’ll work directly with process owners and business leaders to find where AI creates the most value. The AI Innovation Hub is just getting started, so together with the Group Digital & Technology team you’ll shape its direction from the ground up: which opportunities it pursues and how it delivers them. You’ll also work with Builders and Changemakers, colleagues in our entities who build AI solutions and drive adoption, to share what works and show business leaders what AI makes possible.

Your responsibilities include

  • Run discovery workshops to identify bottlenecks, value and exceptions. Assess use cases against readiness, team commitment, expected value and reuse potential.

  • Build AI workflows and agents using company data. Take prototypes all the way to robust, production-grade solutions that teams rely on in their daily work.

  • Integrate AI solutions with ERP, finance and operations systems, designing integrations that move safely from read-only access to controlled write-back.

  • Test solutions against real business scenarios. Set the deployment patterns, tool choices and safeguards that others across Cefetra Group build on.

  • Deliver hands-on workshops, from practical AI topics such as Claude Skills for non-technical colleagues to technical topics such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) for Builders and create materials Changemakers can use to train their peers.

  • Prepare demos of working use cases for leadership briefings.

Who you are

To succeed at Cefetra Group, you love complexity and combine deep technical curiosity with a pragmatic, collaborative approach. You work well both independently and with people at all levels of Cefetra Group. You take ownership end to end and move easily between governance, technical details and business priorities. You also meet the following requirements:

  • You have at least four years of experience in a technical, customer-facing, consulting or product role.

  • You’ve built and evaluated large language model (LLM) workflows, agents or applications in production.

  • You have hands-on experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector search, indexing, knowledge bases, context engineering and orchestration.

  • You follow AI developments closely, from new models to agentic patterns and protocols, and know how to turn new capabilities into practical value.

  • You have full-stack development experience with Python or TypeScript, including APIs, authentication, data transformation and enterprise integrations.

  • You’re fluent in English and have led workshops for non-technical audiences.

What we offer

A unique opportunity to help Cefetra Group grow and become part of a dynamic and entrepreneurial team within an established multinational. We’re always open to discussing your individual needs. Here’s what we offer.

  • Access to frontier AI models and the room to experiment with new tools, techniques and ways of working.

  • Flexible working hours and hybrid working, as well as opportunities to learn and develop.

  • An excellent remuneration and benefits package, including a competitive base salary, holiday allowance, an attractive bonus scheme and 28 days of annual leave.

  • An office in one of the finest locations in central Rotterdam, overlooking the Maas and the Erasmus Bridge, with plenty of social activities and excellent coffee.

title: AI Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Platform Engineer based in United Kingdom.

Join a forward-thinking technology team building the AI platform that powers intelligent agents across multiple business functions, including engineering, business development, compliance, support, and finance. In this hands-on individual contributor role, you will design, develop, and operate the infrastructure that enables AI agents to perform increasingly autonomous tasks safely and reliably. You will work across agent runtimes, integrations, identity management, security guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and observability. Collaborating closely with internal domain experts, you will turn operational challenges into scalable AI-powered solutions that deliver measurable business value. You will take ownership from initial design and implementation through production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. This remote-first opportunity is ideal for an experienced engineer who combines strong software fundamentals with practical expertise in deploying and scaling LLM-based systems.


Accountabilities

You will help build and evolve the organization's AI platform, enabling teams across the business to deploy reliable, secure, and increasingly autonomous agents. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Productionizing AI workflows: Transform prototypes into robust production systems with defined service-level agreements (SLAs), supporting use cases such as specification-to-pull-request agents, AI-powered code reviews, incident triage, and Know Your Business (KYB) reviews.

  • Building and managing MCP servers: Design, deploy, secure, and maintain Model Context Protocol servers, including authentication, per-user OAuth, scoped access, and integrations with tools such as Slack, GitHub, Jira, HubSpot, and internal services.

  • Developing autonomous agents: Build multi-step agents capable of planning and taking action across different tools, progressing through controlled trust stages from shadowing and suggesting to executing tasks autonomously.

  • Implementing security and governance: Establish platform-wide guardrails, including agent identities, scoped credentials, audit logs, CI checks, approval workflows, allowlists, and least-privilege access policies.

  • Creating evaluation frameworks: Develop test datasets, evaluation criteria, regression suites, and live production scoring systems to measure agent quality and connect performance metrics to business outcomes.

  • Improving observability: Instrument agents and workflows with tracing, logging, latency and cost metrics, drift detection, alerts, and dashboards that help internal Operators monitor performance.

  • Managing AI expenditure: Track usage and spending across AI providers, including Anthropic, OpenAI, and OpenRouter. Establish budgets, alerts, and cost attribution at the team, agent, and workflow levels.

  • Supporting internal stakeholders: Work directly with Operators across business functions to understand their needs, develop requested features, create documentation, deliver enablement sessions, and build self-service tools.

  • Developing reusable AI capabilities: Create and maintain shared skills, plugins, and knowledge resources covering company processes, standards, security requirements, and brand guidelines.

  • Driving process automation: Proactively identify repetitive manual workflows that could benefit from AI, implement automation solutions, measure their impact, and continuously improve them.

  • Taking end-to-end ownership: Write technical specifications, plan and deliver projects independently, communicate progress asynchronously, and remain accountable for monitoring and improving solutions after deployment.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building and operating production-ready AI systems. You should be comfortable working independently, communicating with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and applying sound judgment to complex automation and security challenges. Required qualifications include:

  • At least 5 years of experience as a software, platform, or infrastructure engineer, with a solid understanding of system design, data modeling, testing, debugging, and code review.

  • Between 6 and 12 months of experience shipping LLM-based systems to production and supporting agentic workflows used by real end users.

  • Daily, hands-on experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex to write, test, and review production code.

  • Experience developing autonomous or multi-step agents with tool integrations, using technologies such as the Claude Agent SDK, Anthropic APIs, OpenAI APIs, or similar frameworks.

  • Practical experience building MCP servers, including OAuth authentication flows, scoped tokens, and user-level access controls.

  • Knowledge of identity and access management systems such as Okta or similar identity providers, including SSO protocols (SAML/OIDC), SCIM provisioning, group-based access, and device policies.

  • Experience creating automated system identities, including GitHub Apps, service accounts, API keys, and managing secrets through tools such as 1Password.

  • Understanding of security guardrails and governance practices, including least-privilege access, audit logging, CI checks, approval gates, allowlists, and policy-as-code.

  • Experience designing evaluation systems for LLM applications, including test sets, evaluation rubrics, CI regression testing, release gates, and live production scoring.

  • Practical experience implementing production observability through tracing, metrics, alerting, and dashboards, using tools such as OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Datadog, Langfuse, LangSmith, or Braintrust.

  • Experience monitoring and controlling AI expenditure across providers through API key limits, cost centers, budgets, and actionable alerts.

  • Strong programming skills in at least one of TypeScript, Python, or Go, alongside working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure.

  • A demonstrated ability to independently identify and automate manual processes, supported by two or three concrete examples of previous work.

  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to produce clear technical specifications, runbooks, and RFCs.
