title: Customer Growth Account Executive - Commercial
descriptionHtml:
At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit klaviyo.com/careers to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.

The Customer Growth team in Northern Europe is responsible for selling our suite of products into our EMEA install base . The Commercial segment contains Klaviyo’s customers who each drive $2.5-30M in annual revenue, with each rep managing an average book of business of ~700 accounts spread across UK&I, Nordics and Benelux.

You’ll run the entire sales cycle from prospecting and discovery to demo, negotiation, contracting, and ultimately driving the buying process to close. This is an incredibly exciting time to join the Customer Growth sales team with a growing platform and several newer products to sell. 

How You Will Make a Difference

  • Self-prospect and advise existing Klaviyo customers on the value of Klaviyo and why our product is the best choice for their business
  • Partner with Customer Success Managers to effectively target your assigned customer segment/territory and create new opportunities
  • Collaborate with Partner Managers and Agency Partners to identify Channel sales opportunities and advise them how to effectively sell Klaviyo products to their clients
  • Participate in workshops, lunch and learns, and in-market networking events to educate your partners and customers on how to best leverage Klaviyo products to drive revenue and create long-lasting relationships
  • Provide feedback to our Product Team that impacts the product roadmap and what we build for our customers
  • Have a massive impact on revenue targets
  • Transform workflows by putting AI at the center, building smarter systems and ways of working from the ground up.
  • Continuously experiment with AI tools—testing, learning, and sharing insights to keep the team and organization ahead of the curve, as well as championing new applications that accelerate workflows and elevate quality responsibly.

Who You Are

  • Experience with software subscription & cloud sales models (SaaS), with 2-5 years of closing sales experience
  • Experience running both complex up-market and transactional sales motions with multiple stakeholders
  • Strong experience value-selling and winning against competitors with little to no discounting
  • Experience cross-selling products into an existing set of customers is a plus
  • Strong analytical and organization skills
  • Driven to create and maintain process in a fast-moving environment
  • Background in marketing automation is considered a plus
  • Team player, coachable with a growth mindset
  • Excellent technical, communication and presentation skills
  • A results oriented, highly motivated, enthusiastic attitude and the ability to work independently
  • Decisive, persistent, convincing
  • Resilient with the proven ability to leverage the resources at your disposal to figure things out
  • You’ve already experimented with AI in work or personal projects, and you’re excited to dive in and learn fast. You’re hungry to responsibly explore new AI tools and workflows, finding ways to make your work smarter and more efficient.

Our salary range reflects the cost of labour in the country where the job post is advertised. The base salary offered for this position is determined by several factors, including the applicant’s job-related skills, relevant experience, education or training, and work location.

In addition to base salary, our total compensation package may include participation in the company’s annual cash bonus plan, variable compensation (OTE) for sales and customer success roles, equity, sign-on payments, and a comprehensive range of health, welfare, and wellbeing benefits based on eligibility. 

Your recruiter can provide more details about the specific salary/OTE  range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

Base Pay Range in Local Currency:£65,000—£65,000 GBP

This role may require up to 10% travel for purposes such as new hire onboarding, client or partner work if applicable, team meetings, and industry events. Travel is coordinated in advance.

Get to Know Klaviyo

We’re Klaviyo (pronounced clay-vee-oh). We empower creators to own their destiny by making first-party data accessible and actionable like never before. We see limitless potential for the technology we’re developing to nurture personalized experiences in ecommerce and beyond. To reach our goals, we need our own crew of remarkable creators—ambitious and collaborative teammates who stay focused on our north star: delighting our customers. If you’re ready to do the best work of your career, where you’ll be welcomed as your whole self from day one and supported with generous benefits, we hope you’ll join us.

AI fluency at Klaviyo includes responsible use of AI (including privacy, security, bias awareness, and human-in-the-loop). We provide accommodations as needed. 

By participating in Klaviyo’s interview process, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and will adhere to our Guidelines for using AI in the Klaviyo interview Process. For more information about how we process your personal data, see our Job Applicant Privacy Notice.

Klaviyo is committed to a policy of equal opportunity and non-discrimination. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, citizenship, national origin, color, religion or religious creed, age, sex (including pregnancy), gender identity, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, veteran or active military status, marital status, criminal record, genetics, retaliation, sexual harassment or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

IMPORTANT NOTICE: Our company takes the security and privacy of job applicants very seriously. We will never ask for payment, bank details, or personal financial information as part of the application process. All our legitimate job postings can be found on our official career site. Please be cautious of job offers that come from non-company email addresses ----- instant messaging platforms, or unsolicited calls.   By clicking "Submit Application" you consent to Klaviyo processing your Personal Data in accordance with our Job Applicant Privacy Notice.  If you do not wish for Klaviyo to process your Personal Data, please do not submit an application.You can find our Job Applicant Privacy Notice here and here (FR).

title: Customer Success Account Manager, Mid-Market
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

You help customers adopt the platform, realise measurable value, and renew and expand with confidence. You pick up where Implementation leaves off, learn each customer's fleet and challenges, and advise on tailoring Samsara to them. You manage 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to extend your reach and focus your time where it counts. Your understanding of the value customers get earns you the right to lead the ROI conversation, negotiate terms and close renewals that work for both sides, minimising financial attrition. You work with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform's capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types, from field services and utilities to long-haul transportation and school buses.
  • Manage a portfolio of 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to accelerate your engagement, prioritize proactively, and drive efficiency and outcomes across your book of business.
  • Lead the ROI and value conversation into the renewal, negotiate favorable terms, and close renewals that are a win for both the customer and Samsara while minimizing financial attrition.
  • Demonstrate a willingness to understand and explain technical issues to a non-technical audience and to engage the right cross-functional partners to drive resolution.
  • Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to maximize the value of their Samsara products.
  • Work cross-functionally with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product to strategically solve problems and optimize customer experience and business outcomes.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Business fluency in French (spoken and written).
  • 2+ years in a customer-facing, quota-carrying role (renewals, customer success, account management or sales), ideally in SaaS, technology or logistics.
  • A record of consistent quota over-achievement.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication and presentation skills, and the ability to build trust with executives, users and internal teams.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Gainsight, Gong or similar GTM tools.
  • Comfort in a fast-changing, high-growth environment.
  • A bachelor's degree from a 4-year institution, or equivalent practical experience.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • A strong bias towards action, big-picture thinking and high standards.
  • An AI-first approach: you use AI tooling to drive efficiency and outcomes.
  • Technical depth across a suite of products, with a bonus for hardware-software integration.
  • Industry Knowledge: Experience with routing, navigation, commercial trucking fleets, and logistics.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Customer Success Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The Role

We're hiring a Customer Success Engineer to join the Technical Solutions team, the small team that keeps Omnea working for our customers every day. This role is based in London. This is a customer-facing role with a technical problem-solving heart: when an integration breaks, a workflow misbehaves, or a customer needs Omnea to do something it doesn't do yet, you help find the root cause and the right solution. We resolve around 95% of what comes to us ourselves, from straightforward fixes to changes in production code and small feature requests. You'll be trusted to work out what's really wrong and see it through, drawing on the team's support when you need it.

You'll go deep on the product and broad on the problems: an integration misbehaving with a customer's ERP in the morning, a feature a customer has been asking for after lunch, and helping a colleague through a tough customer conversation by the end of the day. You'll be a trusted voice customers can turn to, joining their calls, providing clear answers and working closely with the Account Management team to set them up for long-term success with Omnea. AI helps us investigate faster, tracing logs, drafting hypotheses and suggesting fixes, but people own the outcome. You'll use your judgment, and the team's expertise where needed, to make sure solutions are safe for a live enterprise environment, address the root cause and surface patterns Product needs to hear about.

The CSE team sits between Customer, Product and Engineering. It's a small, close-knit team with a lot of autonomy, and the scope of the role grows as Omnea does. There is room to lean into your strengths, whether that's guiding customers towards solutions or bringing their feedback into the product, while building your technical skills. You'll develop deep knowledge of Omnea, and your work will be felt by customers every day.

What You'll Do

  • Investigate the hard problems. One issue might be an integration failing with a customer's ERP, the next a workflow that isn't doing what anyone expected, the next a cross-system bug nobody else has cracked. You'll use AI to speed up the first pass, then confirm the cause and get it fixed.

  • Make solutions happen. Own issues through to resolution, whether that means guiding a customer through a solution, improving a workflow or working on a code change. You'll have opportunities to fix bugs and build small customer-requested features in the codebase, with support from the team as you grow. Depending on your strengths, you might lean further into customer guidance or into shaping and improving the product.

  • Back up our Implementation and Customer teams. When a colleague hits a tricky configuration, an edge case or a question they can't answer, they come to you. You'll help them think it through, step into live implementations when they get technical, and make sure the customer gets the right answer.

  • Stay close to customers. You'll have ongoing calls with some customers, join QBRs and escalation calls, get brought in on specialist projects, and represent the Technical Solutions Team when customers move from implementation to ongoing support.

  • Bring the customer's voice into Product. You'll hear what customers struggle with before anyone else does. Spot the patterns across the issues you resolve and turn them into clear, well-argued input for Product, so the same problem doesn't need solving twice.

  • Make it scale. As we grow, we can't just add people. You'll build the tooling, automation, playbooks and docs that help customers solve more on their own and let the team handle more without slowing down.

About You

  • You have at least 3 years of relevant experience, for example in technical support engineering, solutions engineering, implementation, software development or another technical, customer-facing role.

  • You're curious. You want to know how things work and why they broke, and every problem is a chance to learn something.

  • You solve problems analytically. You enjoy messy, ambiguous issues, and you don't stop at the symptom when you can find the root cause.

  • You're comfortable switching context. A bug fix, a customer call and a colleague's question can all land in the same hour, and you can move between them without losing the thread.

  • You want variety. You'd rather handle ten different problems than one big project.

  • You take ownership. You work independently, raise your hand for the hard problems, and see them through to resolution without needing the spotlight.

  • You care about customers, about getting it right, and about the team around you. You're inspired by the idea of unreasonable hospitality: going beyond the expected to make people feel genuinely looked after.

  • You explain technical issues clearly, whether you're talking to an engineer or a non-technical stakeholder.

  • You're not afraid of the technical side. You don't need a CS or STEM degree: technical aptitude can come from your work, side projects or things you've built yourself. title: Customer Success Manager (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Lumiform ist eine spezialisierte Software, mit der Frontline-Teams Inspektionen, Audits und Checklisten skalierbar über viele Standorte hinweg durchführen. Gegründet 2019 in Berlin, hauptsächlich für europäische Unternehmen gebaut. Unternehmen wie EDEKA, AmRest, Virgin Media und Nordsee sowie Prüf-, Inspektions- und Zertifizierungsgesellschaften setzen auf Lumiform (4,6 von 5 auf G2).

Jährlich laufen über unsere Plattform Millionen von Prüfungen. Jede einzelne macht einen Arbeitsplatz sicherer, einen Prozess effizienter oder ein Produkt oder einen Service besser. Wenn du mit deiner Arbeit einen Unterschied in der Gesellschaft machen möchtest, dann arbeitest du hier an einem Produkt, das genau das jeden Tag tut.

Über die Rolle

Das ist eine Rolle für jemanden, der den nächsten Schritt gehen will. Du bringst bereits 1 bis 2 Jahre Customer Success mit und willst jetzt echte Verantwortung: dein eigenes Portfolio aus namhaften Enterprise-Kunden, das dir gehört und das du weiterentwickelst.

Deine zentrale Kennzahl ist die Net Revenue Retention deines Portfolios. Das heißt, du denkst kommerziell und erkennst Wachstumspotenziale, kannst aber genauso souverän deeskalieren, kritische Situationen drehen und Churn verhindern, bevor er entsteht. Du bekommst kein „Startpaket" aus kalten Leads, sondern ein starkes Bestandsportfolio mit starken Marken, das nur darauf wartet, ausgebaut zu werden.

Aufgaben

  • Ownership deines Portfolios: Du verantwortest ein eigenes Book of Business aus namhaften Enterprise-Kunden, treibst es proaktiv statt auf Anfragen oder schlechte Health-Scores zu warten, und entwickelst es strategisch weiter.

  • Net Revenue Retention steigern: Du treibst Renewals, erkennst Expansion-Potenziale (zusätzliche Use Cases, Standorte, neue Buying Center) und machst aus zufriedenen Kunden wachsende Accounts.

  • Strategischer Sparringspartner auf Entscheider-Ebene: Du erarbeitest dir Zugang zu den relevanten Stakeholdern, führst strategische Account-Reviews und wirst zum Trusted Advisor deiner Kunden.

  • Deeskalation und Churn-Prävention: Du erkennst Risiken früh, führst kritische Gespräche souverän und drehst gefährdete Accounts, bevor sie kippen.

  • Onboarding, Aktivierung und Schulungen: Du führst neue Teams erfolgreich ein, leitest Workshops und sorgst dafür, dass deine Kunden das volle Potenzial der Software ausschöpfen.

  • Produkt und Zusammenarbeit: Du bündelst Kundenfeedback strukturiert fürs Produktteam und arbeitest eng mit Sales, Marketing und Produkt zusammen.

Qualifikation

  • Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau sowie verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

  • Du bringst 1 bis 2 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Customer-Success, Account Management oder Vertrieb mit, idealerweise im SaaS-Umfeld, und willst jetzt den nächsten Schritt mit mehr Verantwortung gehen.

  • Du hast ein kommerzielles Gespür: Du erkennst Expansions- und Wachstumschancen in deinem Portfolio und gehst aktiv auf sie zu.

  • Du kannst deeskalieren: Auch in kritischen Situationen bleibst du souverän, findest Lösungen und hältst Kunden.Kommunikation ist eine deiner Stärken. Du gehst selbstständig in Gespräche, auch auf Entscheider-Ebene, und bleibst dran, bis der Termin steht.

  • Du verstehst technische Konzepte und kannst sie verständlich erklären.

  • Du denkst strategisch, planst vorausschauend und arbeitest gerne im Team.

Benefits

  • Ein eigenes Bestandsportfolio aus etablierten Kunden, das du eigenverantwortlich weiterentwickelst, mit klarem Weg zu größeren und strategischeren Accounts.

  • Neben deinem Fixgehalt eine variable Komponente mit Umsatzbeteiligung, wenn du dein Portfolio in neue Buying Center hinein ausbaust (horizontale Expansion).

  • Eine internationale Kundenbasis und die Chance, mit starken Brands auf Enterprise-Niveau zu arbeiten.

  • Ein Produkt mit echtem Purpose: Millionen von Prüfungen pro Jahr, die Arbeitsplätze sicherer und effizienter und Produkte und Services besser machen.

  • Modernes Büro im Herzen von Berlin-Mitte (Chausseestraße).

  • Investition in deine Zukunft mit einem jährlichen Lernbudget von 500 €.

  • Zusätzliche finanzielle Anreize: monatlicher Sachbezug von 50 € oder Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft.

  • Flexibilität und Balance mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und Home-Office-Möglichkeiten.

  • Ein internationales Team mit flachen Hierarchien und offenem Feedback, in dem du viel Verantwortung übernehmen kannst.

Wenn das nach dir klingt, dann lass uns sprechen. Wenn du bereit bist, mehr Verantwortung zu übernehmen, dein eigenes Portfolio starker Kunden aufzubauen und an einem Produkt zu arbeiten, das täglich einen echten Unterschied macht, freuen wir uns auf dich.

Lebenslauf oder LinkedIn-Profil genügt, ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht.

  • Establish a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and customer obsession across the Customer Success organization.

What we're looking for

  • Experience partnering cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and other teams to drive customer outcomes.

Bonus taco if you have

  • (Tacos? If you need an ice-breaker, ask how we say thanks by giving tacos!)

  • Experience helping organizations adopt AI coding tools, AI agents, or other emerging AI technologies.

  • Experience working at a high-growth technology company and building Customer Success programs as the organization scales.

About Coder

Coder is the leading platform for AI development Infrastructure, enabling enterprises to securely run human and AI-driven development workflows in consistent, governed environments. Coder provides self-hosted, agent-ready workspaces that unify developer productivity and platform governance. With Coder, enterprises can confidently evolve from human-only development to AI-assisted and autonomous workflows, without sacrificing security, compliance, or performance. Learn more at coder.com.

Interview process 

We believe that the interview process should be transparent, consistent, and enjoyable. We value your time and hope to complete the interview process in two to four weeks, if schedules allow. Through your interviews, you will meet a mix of individual contributors, managers, and senior leaders.

AI use during the interview process

As an AI company, Coder embraces the use of AI tools, and we want to be transparent about our expectations as you navigate our interview process.

Not permitted: Using AI assistance during conversational interviews.

Permitted: Using AI tooling for take-home assessments. Please flag where and to what extent it was used in your take-home. Your submission will not be penalized for using AI as long as it is done honestly.

All hiring decisions are made by humans. Our team reviews applications, conducts interviews, and makes final selections. AI tools assist us but never replace human judgment, and these practices are conducted in compliance with applicable data protection, AI governance, and labor laws. Your data is not used to train AI models.

Customer Success Manager

Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, regardless of their involvement, to improve the industry for everybody by elevating UK Estate Agencies through world-class technology.


As our client base rapidly expands, particularly among enterprise estate agencies, we are entering a pivotal moment of growth, so we’re investing in dedicated expertise to support our largest and most complex accounts. We want to drive the adoption of our products, and unlock long-term value through strategic partnerships. This is a key role in helping to shape the future of customer success at Street Group.


Over the past six years, we've been working on Street.co.uk - our groundbreaking product that puts transparency, user experience, and beautiful design at the heart of the property industry. Joining our dynamic and ambitious Street.co.uk team, you will be a dedicated product specialist for our customers as they begin their journey with Street, driving client success while identifying opportunities for growth and long-term value across Street Group's ecosystem of products.


You will have the autonomy of planning your diary and workshops whilst making sure you are constantly going above and beyond for our customers in helping them find their way around the system, and the chance to make a genuine impact as we scale the business.


A bit about you…

  • You’ll have a background in Customer Success, ideally within the tech/SaaS space

  • You have excellent written and verbal communication skills (fluency in written and spoken English)

  • You're a dependable, motivated, self-starter, with the ability to work independently and the inner drive to grow a company that is in an exciting period of rapid growth

  • You're highly organised with exceptional attention to detail


Here’s what you can expect to be working on as a Customer Success Manager at Street Group

  • Immersing yourself in the company and building knowledge of our evolving product

  • Ensuring feedback flows from Customer Success to the relevant business and product teams

We’re an award-winning PropTech business based in Manchester, founded in 2015 by brother and sister duo, Tom & Heather Staff. Street.co.uk then launched back in 2020 and serves as our game-changing CRM, allowing agents to deliver a service that aligns seamlessly with the modern, 'on-demand' needs of customers and their busy lifestyles.

Our products, Street.co.uk and Spectre form a powerful duo, working harmoniously together to transform an agent’s job. title: Data Scientist - Measurement, Experimentation & Causal Inference
descriptionHtml:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Role Overview:

As a Data Scientist, you will help measure the impact of PlayStation's products, features and commercial initiatives through experimentation, causal inference and applied data science.

Working at the intersection of data science, machine learning, product and commercial strategy, you will apply robust analytical techniques to solve complex business problems, generate actionable insights and support evidence-based decision-making across PlayStation.

This role goes beyond traditional A/B testing. You will apply modern causal inference, statistical modelling and machine learning techniques to evaluate initiatives where controlled experiments are difficult or impossible, collaborating closely with product, engineering, analytics and business teams to deliver high-quality measurement and insights.

This is an opportunity to work on high-impact initiatives affecting millions of PlayStation players while developing your expertise in experimentation, causal inference and applied data science.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Apply measurement methodologies across experimentation, causal inference and advanced analytics to evaluate product and commercial initiatives.
  • Design and execute robust measurement approaches across randomised experiments, quasi-experimental methods and observational causal inference where controlled experimentation is impractical.
  • Apply statistical, machine learning and AI techniques to solve complex measurement challenges and generate actionable business insights.
  • Apply advanced data science and machine learning techniques where appropriate to complement experimentation and support complex business decisions.
  • Contribute to the development and adoption of best practices for experiment design, statistical analysis and causal measurement.
  • Partner closely with product managers, engineers, analysts and business stakeholders to identify high-impact measurement opportunities and ensure product and commercial decisions are supported by rigorous evidence.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams by providing feedback on experimentation and measurement capabilities to improve tooling and workflows.
  • Develop reusable analytical solutions, dashboards and code that improve the quality, consistency and efficiency of measurement.
  • Communicate analytical findings and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Stay current with emerging developments in statistics, machine learning and AI, identifying opportunities to improve measurement capabilities and analytical workflows.
  • Contribute to a culture of evidence-based decision-making by sharing knowledge, collaborating across teams and promoting analytical best practices.

What We're Looking For:

Required:

  • Master's degree (or equivalent industry experience) in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science or another quantitative discipline. PhD preferred.
  • 3+ years of industry experience applying experimentation, causal inference, statistical modelling, machine learning or related analytical techniques to solve business problems.
  • Good understanding of experimental design, A/B testing and modern causal inference methods, including quasi-experimental approaches.
  • Experience applying data science, machine learning and statistical modelling techniques to analyse complex datasets and generate actionable insights.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL for analytical workflows.
  • Experience developing robust analytical solutions using sound statistical principles and software engineering best practices.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Curiosity, creativity and a pragmatic approach to solving ambiguous business problems.
  • A collaborative mindset with a passion for continuous learning and improving analytical capabilities.

Preferred:

  • Experience working in gaming, digital products, consumer technology, e-commerce or subscription businesses.
  • Familiarity with modern data engineering and analytics tooling such as Databricks, Snowflake, Git and Airflow.
  • Experience with modern business intelligence and data visualisation tools such as Tableau, Domo or Power BI.
  • Experience applying AI tools, including large language models (LLMs), to improve data science workflows and analytical productivity.
  • Experience developing reusable analytical frameworks, libraries or internal tooling.
  • Experience presenting analytical findings and recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders.

What You'll Influence:

  • Measurement for PlayStation's product and commercial initiatives.
  • High-quality experimentation and causal inference across product and business teams.
  • Product and commercial decisions through rigorous analytical evidence.
  • The continued evolution of PlayStation's measurement and experimentation capabilities.

Why You'll Love This Role:

  • Help shape how PlayStation measures product and commercial success across a global business.
  • Work on challenging real-world problems using experimentation, causal inference and machine learning.
  • Collaborate with talented scientists, engineers and product teams on high-impact initiatives.
  • Learn from experienced data scientists while developing your expertise in modern measurement and experimentation.
  • Contribute to the adoption of evidence-based decision-making across PlayStation.
  • Continue growing your technical and business skills in a collaborative, supportive environment.

Benefits:

  • Hybrid Working (FlexModes)

title: Deployment Lead, Semiconductors - London
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team turns research breakthroughs into production-grade systems. We embed deeply with customers to solve high-leverage problems and act as the delivery engine for our most complex large-scale engagements. We move quickly from prototype to production and surface reusable patterns that shape our platform. We operate at the intersection of deployment and development – working closely with OpenAI Research, Product and Partnerships.

About the Role

As a Deployment Lead, you will define how OpenAI delivers complex systems to Semiconductor customers. You will own how solutions are scoped, built, shipped, and adopted across high-value engineering workflows such as RTL design, verification, and physical implementation. You’ll translate business outcomes into a technical plan, run day-to-day execution across FDEs, Researchers, and Customer Engineers, and partner with customer teams to ensure delivery supports their goals.

You will focus on the semiconductor vertical to deploy next-generation AI capabilities. You will own delivery end-to-end: embedding with customers to map workflows and success criteria, ensuring components ship on time, and leading readiness and change management for adoption. You’ll track progress, manage dependencies, make sequencing decisions, and drive 0→1 prototypes through MVP and scale. You will also share field insights with Product and Research to guide roadmap and priorities.

Success will be measured first and foremost by impact - deployments that deliver measurable value against customer goals, drive adoption, and become critical to their workflows. Additional measures of success include delivery reliability (milestones hit, low reopen/churn), operating leverage (patterns reused across deployments), judgment under pressure, and product impact (field signal that shifts roadmaps/architectures).

This is a high-trust, high-autonomy role. Success requires deep technical project management expertise, extreme ownership of outcomes, and an ability to immerse in customer workflows and partner with customer teams to solve complex engineering problems at pace.

This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel between 25-50% is required.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the technical delivery plan for multiple interdependent work streams, translating customer objectives into a roadmap with milestones, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.

  • Run day-to-day engineering execution by tracking and driving delivery across OpenAI FDE and customer teams. Keep progress unblocked and sequenced. Make real-time trade-offs on scope and priority to protect the critical path.

  • Embed with Semiconductor customer teams to land production deployments and drive adoption. Map workflows, shape tools/integrations, and translate requirements into a delivery plan.

  • Shape production deployments that integrate with customer infrastructure, data systems, and engineering toolchains, including export-controlled environments.

  • Partner with Product and Research so platform components and research work streams land in time to support deployment goals.

  • Codify solution patterns and evals. Extract reusable patterns and package field signals to improve product and models.

  • Own value cases and ROI. Set impact hypotheses, baselines, and KPIs; run pre-/post-deployment measurement and report to exec sponsors.

  • Help define how OpenAI engages Semiconductor customers.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Bring 7+ years of customer‑facing technical delivery leadership.

  • Have deep expertise in Semiconductor workflows, including RTL design, verification, EDA tooling, and physical implementation.

  • Track record of successfully leading large, complex, high-stakes customer engagements where customer outcomes depended on tight coordination and fast decision making, ideally involving AI.

  • Excel in high ambiguity environments. Know how to simplify complex and dynamic work.

  • Move fluidly between system level understanding and execution level detail; can dive into customer workflows/data, map constraints, sketch architectures and move ambiguous problems to shipped systems.

  • Think strategically and pattern-match. Able to step back from execution detail, recognize broader trends across deployments, and connect customer needs to scalable, reusable solutions.

  • Have strong technical fluency and sharp sequencing instincts. Confident discussing technical details, pressure-testing architectures, and making trade-offs.

  • Have shipped AI/LLM systems. You understand solution patterns, integration basics, and production pitfalls.

  • You’re a translator with executive presence. You make complex technical trade-offs legible to business leaders and convert strategy into day-to-day technical execution.

  • Enjoy being onsite with customers to accelerate delivery (often 25-50%, sometimes higher).

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

title: Digital Channel Manager (Kiosk)
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij werken voor een fantastisch merk waar je direct impact kunt maken? Ben jij een digital marketing professional met een passie voor food en retail, en voel jij je thuis in een internationale omgeving? Dan is dit jouw kans.

Wat is jouw bijdrage aan het succes van KFC?
Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor het commerciële succes en de continue optimalisatie van het kiosk-kanaal van KFC Nederland. Met behulp van data-analyse, klantinzichten en nauwe samenwerking met verschillende teams zorg je voor meer gebruik van de kiosken, hogere omzet, betere conversie en een hogere gemiddelde besteding per gast.

Jouw volgende uitdaging begint hier

Als Digital Channel Manager (Kiosk) maak je deel uit van het Digital Team van KFC en speel je een belangrijke rol in onze digitale toekomst. Jij bent de drijvende kracht achter de commerciële prestaties en voortdurende optimalisatie van onze self-service kiosken in de restaurants.

Je pakt nieuwe zaken snel op, bent nieuwsgierig van aard en weet klant- en prestatiegegevens moeiteloos te vertalen naar heldere acties en verbeteringen.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je bent eigenaar van één van KFC's belangrijkste digitale verkoopkanalen en hét aanspreekpunt voor alles rondom de kiosken. Je monitort en verbetert het gebruik, de omzet, conversie en de gemiddelde besteding per gast.

  • Je creëert een eenvoudige, snelle en intuïtieve klantreis, terwijl je tegelijkertijd zorgt voor gebruiksgemak voor onze restaurantteams.

  • Je stelt business requirements op, coördineert testtrajecten en ondersteunt de implementatie van verbeteringen aan de kiosken in samenwerking met het regionale productteam, IT, Operations en technologiepartners.

  • Je signaleert kansen om prestaties te verbeteren door dashboards te monitoren en nauw samen te werken met Commercial Finance. Inzichten vertaal je naar concrete acties.

  • Je verhoogt de conversie door middel van A/B-testen, analyses van klantgedrag en continue optimalisatie van de kiosk-ervaring en productpresentatie.

  • Je zorgt ervoor dat campagnes, producten en waardeproposities effectief worden gepresenteerd en correct worden gelanceerd op de kiosken. Daarbij optimaliseer je de menustructuur, productzichtbaarheid en upsell- en cross-sellmogelijkheden.

  • Je houdt platformproblemen in de gaten en werkt samen met IT en technologiepartners om deze op te lossen.

  • Je werkt intensief samen met Operations om het gebruik van de kiosken en de uitvoering in de restaurants te verbeteren. Daarnaast werk je nauw samen met collega's van Digital, Brand, Innovation, IT, Commercial en externe partners.

Over KFC Nederland

Kentucky Fried Chicken, de Amerikaanse restaurantketen gespecialiseerd in fried chicken, is sinds 1972 actief in Nederland. Inmiddels telt Nederland 96 KFC-restaurants. Dagelijks bereiden onze chefs verse kip- en vegetarische gerechten volgens het originele recept uit 1939 van oprichter Colonel Harland Sanders. Naast de focus op onze producten en de verdere groei van ons restaurantnetwerk, investeren we volop in de ontwikkeling van onze medewerkers.


Wat breng jij mee?

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in Marketing, Bedrijfskunde, Digital Commerce of een vergelijkbare richting is een pré, aangevuld met minimaal 3 tot 5 jaar ervaring in het beheren of optimaliseren van een digitaal klantkanaal.

  • Sterke analytische vaardigheden en ervaring met het monitoren van dashboards, het vertalen van data naar inzichten en acties, en het uitvoeren van A/B-testen.

  • Ervaring met het verbeteren van klantreizen, digitale interfaces en online merchandising.

  • Sterke projectmanagement- en stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden, met het vermogen om mensen te beïnvloeden zonder hiërarchische verantwoordelijkheid.

  • Een gestructureerde, proactieve en hands-on werkstijl, gecombineerd met een pragmatische en samenwerkingsgerichte aanpak.

  • Nieuwsgierigheid en de drive om continu te testen, leren en verbeteren.

  • Ervaring binnen restaurants, retail of QSR (Quick Service Restaurants) is een pré.

  • Uitstekende beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal, mondeling en schriftelijk.

Voldoe je niet aan alle eisen? Geen probleem!

Onderzoek laat zien dat mensen vaak pas solliciteren wanneer zij aan vrijwel alle functie-eisen voldoen. Bij Collins Foods kijken we niet alleen naar ervaring, maar ook naar potentieel en ambitie.

Word jij enthousiast van deze rol? Dan horen we graag van je. Misschien ben jij precies het talent dat wij zoeken.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij ons krijg je de kans om echt impact te maken binnen een internationale, dynamische en groeiende organisatie. Je komt terecht in een hecht team waar initiatief, ondernemerschap en creativiteit worden gewaardeerd én verwacht.

Daarnaast kun je rekenen op:

  • Veel vrijheid om je rol vorm te geven en jouw ideeën werkelijkheid te maken.

  • Vanaf dag één verantwoordelijkheid en eigenaarschap.

  • Een aantrekkelijk salaris afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring.

  • Een prestatiegerichte bonusregeling.

  • Uitgebreide mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

  • Een uitstekende pensioenregeling.

  • Een laptop en telefoon van de zaak.

  • 8% vakantiegeld.

  • 27 vakantiedagen.

  • Reiskostenvergoeding.

  • Personeelskorting op KFC-producten en deelname aan bedrijfsfitnessprogramma's.

  • Mogelijkheid om hybride te werken.

Klaar om impact te maken?

Zie jij jezelf in deze rol en wil jij meebouwen aan de digitale toekomst van KFC? Solliciteer dan vandaag nog. We kijken ernaar uit om je te ontmoeten!

Vragen?
Neem contact op met Sanne Gehner (Talent Acquisition Specialist) via +31 6 10906491.

Volg ons ook op LinkedIn en blijf op de hoogte van onze vacatures en ontwikkelingen.

title: Director, Marketing Events
descriptionHtml:
About the role

The Director, Marketing Events is a hands-on leader of Inizio’s congress and events activation, a critical part of the Marketing strategy. The role owns Inizio’s flagship congresses and industry events and sets the events playbook and shared vendors for Business Unit events, ensuring every event supports Inizio’s marketing strategy and growth priorities.

The role is central to Inizio’s integrated global marketing function, running events as a single program in which every event is linked to a campaign, to meetings with priority accounts and to a measured return. Building on strong existing events, the Director leads and develops the Marketing Events team as the program scales, setting its standards and overseeing delivery, and leads the global marketing team on site at key events.

As part of the Global Marketing Leadership team, the Director works closely with colleagues across the function. Driven by Inizio’s purpose to reimagine health, the role champions Intelligent Commercialization™ from discovery to post-launch.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the Marketing Events team, setting team standards as the program scales and overseeing the delivery team and its agency partners
  • Align Inizio’s event presence to the marketing strategy, ensuring a clear and consistent go-to-market presence
  • Own flagship congresses and industry events, delivering a single integrated Inizio presence at each and maintaining the master event calendar
  • Provide visible leadership on site at key congresses and events, as part of the global marketing leadership team
  • Deliver BU activation slots at flagship congresses centrally, and manage attendee readiness before, during and after each event
  • Deliver Inizio-hosted events and webinars, and showcase Inizio’s congress expertise, including the Intelligent Congress offering
  • Set the events playbook and negotiated vendor rates for BU-only events, support lean BUs to run them end to end, and provide a named event lead for each BU
  • Own event ROI, tracking attendee targeting, meetings and pipeline against a single standard and reporting through the marketing ROI dashboard
  • Manage the events budget, vendors and event contracts
  • Build strong relationships with BU Marketing Leads, Commercial, Communications and Marketing Operations, influencing without direct authority so events support pipeline and tell one Inizio story
  • Uphold Inizio’s brand, values and standards in all internal and external work

About you

  • A proven track record in B2B marketing or in running large events in the marketing space, ideally in health, life sciences or professional services
  • Commercially minded, linking events to pipeline and ROI
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, influencing BU leaders without direct authority and building senior relationships with clients and partners
  • Organized and calm under pressure, managing a complex calendar of events and budgets
  • Leads and develops teams and agency partners, setting high standards and best practice
  • Creative judgment and attention to detail, with a high standard for the quality of events
  • Uses AI and embeds it into workflows as part of continuous improvement, raising quality and efficiency
  • Growth marketing mindset, with experience using campaigns, data and testing to drive demand and pipeline
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, matrixed, global organization

Experience and Skills

Required

Marketing Events Leadership

  • 7+ years of B2B marketing experience, or of running large events in the marketing space, including senior leadership of events, teams and agencies

Events and Congresses

  • Experience planning and delivering flagship events, congresses or large conferences at global scale
  • Experience linking events to campaigns, account meetings and pipeline, and measuring return
  • Experience managing event budgets and agency and vendor partners

Partnerships and Measurement

  • Experience building partnerships and sponsorships with industry bodies and third parties
  • Experience using marketing reporting to measure impact
  • Experience working in B2B professional services, ideally in health or life sciences

Desirable

  • Knowledge of the pharma congress calendar and of life sciences clients
  • Experience using AI tools in event planning
  • Experience in a global, multi-business-unit organization going through integration or transformation

What Success Looks Like

  • A single integrated marketing events program, with a playbook agreed with the BU Marketing Leads
  • Return measured for every event against a single standard, and growing event-sourced pipeline
  • Meetings with priority accounts held at flagship congresses and events
  • Events delivered on time and within budget, with strong client and attendee feedback
  • Partnerships that raise Inizio’s profile with target clients
  • Marketing event plans clearly aligned to Inizio’s marketing strategy, with a measurable contribution to growth marketing goals

Our Benefits

At Inizio, we want you to feel supported both professionally and personally. Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing and financial future, while giving you flexibility in how you work.

Depending on your location and employing entity, our benefits include:

  • Private Healthcare – access to private healthcare or a healthcare allowance, depending on your location.
  • Pension – a company-supported pension scheme with employer contributions.
  • Annual Leave – 25 days' annual leave.
  • Hybrid Working – a flexible working model.
  • Life Insurance – cover of 4x your basic salary.
  • Income Protection – up to 75% of your basic salary in the event of eligible long-term sickness or absence.
  • Employee Assistance Programme – confidential support for personal, work and wellbeing concerns.
  • Cycle to Work – support towards the cost of a bike and cycling equipment.
  • Additional Wellbeing & Lifestyle Benefits – additional benefits may include eyecare, wellbeing resources and employee discounts, depending on your location and employing entity.

Benefits vary by location and employing entity. We will provide full details during the recruitment process.

About Inizio

At Inizio, we're a global team motivated by a shared purpose: to reimagine health.

Formed in 2022, we unite decades of experience and expertise with data, technology, and AI. We create tailored solutions that drive Intelligent Commercialization™ at every stage of the journey, from discovery to post-launch.

Our global network of over 10,000 experts operates across 50 countries, supporting clients with strategic insight, medical excellence, creative engagement, and real-world delivery. We work with the world's leading health and life sciences businesses to solve complex challenges and accomplish meaningful outcomes for our clients and patients.

What sets Inizio apart is our people - and we believe everyone should excel. Here, you're encouraged to reimagine your possibilities: to grow, to be curious and to make change happen. We value your individuality, support your development, and celebrate your ambition. If you're ready to push boundaries and accelerate your career, Inizio is the best place to be.

Artificial Intelligence

title: Director of INCO Entrepreneurs
descriptionHtml:
About us:

INCO is a leading social enterprise on a mission to shape a more inclusive and sustainable economy that creates opportunities for all. We have teams and programs in over 50 countries around the world. Our work is split across 5 complementary activities:

  • INCO Academy: skilling programs for individuals facing barriers to employment, leading to careers in fast growing industries such as technology, sustainability, healthcare and more (400,000+ job seekers trained to date).

  • INCO Kids: education and awareness programs empowering school-age learners with future proof knowledge in technology, sustainability, citizenship and more (350,000+ learners supported to date).

  • INCO Entrepreneurs: incubation and acceleration programs for underrepresented founders, and social entrepreneurs building and growing high-impact startups (2,000+ businesses supported every year).

  • INCO Ventures: management company, in charge of impact investment funds to support the growth of

    start ups and companies with social, environmental and territorial impact (€230M managed or advised).

  • INCO Spaces: co-working, co-living spaces for social and environmental innovators and entrepreneurs

    who make the world a better place (Paris, Berlin, Warsaw, and more).

About the role:

We are looking for a Director of INCO Entrepreneurs to lead our global portfolio of incubation and acceleration programs, helping underrepres nted and impact-driven founders build, fund and scale their businesses.

You will own the INCO Entrepreneurs strategic direction, program outcomes, funder relationships, and the related budget.

You will lead a global team with roughly 5 direct reporting lines and collaborate closely with the Associate Director and a group of Program Managers

across regions.

Most of our programs are funded by corporate partners who expect measurable impact.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in program management, team leadership, stakeholder engagement, acceleration and incubation programs, making sure every program changes founders’ trajectories.

You will report to the VP of Global Operations and be part of INCO’s operational leadership team.

What you’ll do:

Strategy and portfolio leadership

  • Define and own the multi year strategy for INCO Entrepreneurs: which founders we serve, what we prioritise and how we stand out in the entrepreneurship support ecosystem.

  • Manage the program portfolio: launch, scale, redesign based on impact data, funder demand and ecosystem gaps.

  • Spot market gaps and new models, such as sector-specific accelerators, investment-readiness tracks and hybrid or online formats, where INCO Entrepreneurs can add distinctive value.

  • Build strong links with INCO Ventures (deal-flow pipeline, investment readiness), INCO Spaces (physical hubs for founders) and INCO Academy.

Growth, funders and business development

  • Own the total of the entrepreneurship portfolio’s budget

  • Lead the senior relationship with key funders. Set expectations,support contract negotiations and renewals, and find opportunities to expand.

  • Support proposal strategy and collaborate with the partnerships team, so every commitment can be delivered and is financially sound.

  • Represent INCO Entrepreneurs externally at ecosystem events with investors, public bodies and in the media as a credible voice on inclusive entrepreneurship.

Impact and quality

  • Set the impact framework and headline KPIs, such as founder revenue growth, funding raised, jobs created, business survival and founder diversity.

  • Make sure monitoring, evaluation and learning (MEL) results feed into program design decisions and into persuasive impact stories for funders.

  • Hold the unit to high standards in founder experience, mentor and expert quality, and program outcomes.

Leadership and team

descriptionHtml:

Are you an experienced Veterinary Surgeon ready to take the next step into clinical leadership, or an established Clinical Director looking for a new challenge? Holmefield Veterinary Clinic is looking for a confident and motivated Clinical Director to lead our friendly, experienced team across our two practices in Brayton and Sherburn-in-Elmet, North Yorkshire. This is a fantastic opportunity to make a real difference in a well-established, highly respected small animal practice, combining hands-on clinical work with the chance to shape the future of the business. You'll have the freedom to bring new ideas, influence clinical standards, support your team's development and drive the practice forward, all while continuing to enjoy the clinical work you love. We're looking for someone who is passionate about delivering excellent patient care, enjoys bringing people together and has the confidence and enthusiasm to lead a team, build on the practice's existing strengths and make the role their own.

Lead, inspire and make your mark


As Clinical Director, you'll enjoy a great balance between clinical work and leadership, with approximately 80% of your time spent working clinically across a varied first opinion caseload, including consultations, surgery and medical cases. Alongside your clinical responsibilities, you'll take a leading role in supporting and developing the wider team, providing guidance with clinical decision-making, mentoring less experienced vets and new graduates, and helping to create an environment where everyone feels supported, valued and encouraged to grow. You'll also play an important part in shaping the strategic direction of both practices, working to maintain high clinical standards, improve patient and client care, and support the overall performance and future growth of the business. From leading multidisciplinary teams and developing clinical services to identifying opportunities for improvement, you'll have the autonomy to bring new ideas and make a genuine impact.
With a strong clinical foundation already in place, including certificate holders in small animal surgery and feline medicine, this is a fantastic opportunity to build on the practice's existing strengths. Whether that's introducing new services, supporting colleagues through further qualifications or developing the team's clinical capabilities, you'll have the freedom to help shape the future of Holmefield while maintaining the friendly, collaborative culture that makes the practice such a great place to work. We're looking for a confident, experienced GP vet with strong leadership and communication skills, who enjoys being hands-on clinically while taking responsibility for the wider success of the practice.

Fix or flex – find your perfect balance


We understand that finding the right work-life balance is important, particularly when balancing clinical and leadership responsibilities. This is a full-time position working 40 hours per week across either 4 or 5 days, alongside 1 in 4 Saturday mornings. There are no out-of-hours or on-call commitments, giving you plenty of time to enjoy life outside of work. We are also happy to dicuss flexible working options. With two practices across Brayton and Sherburn-in-Elmet, you'll have the opportunity to work closely with colleagues across both sites while enjoying a varied and rewarding working week.

Meet your new team

You'll be joining a friendly and experienced team of 6 Veterinary Surgeons, supported by a dedicated nursing and client care team who are passionate about delivering excellent care. With certificate holders in small animal surgery and feline medicine, there's a great mix of experience and clinical interests across the team. Our long-established, purpose-built main practice in Brayton has recently been extended and refurbished, offering bright, spacious facilities including digital X-ray, a dedicated dental suite, brand-new ultrasound with abdominal and cardiac scanning capabilities, K-laser, multiparameter monitoring and Doppler blood pressure equipment. We also have separate species wards, a dedicated cattery, a peaceful bereavement room and a dedicated vets' office. Our smaller branch in Sherburn-in-Elmet provides a more community-focused setting for consultations and routine surgery, with more complex and higher-risk cases managed at our main site.

Clinical development is a real priority at Holmefield, and as Clinical Director, you'll have the opportunity to build on the team's existing strengths while helping to shape the future of both practices. Whether that's mentoring colleagues, supporting further qualifications or introducing new clinical services, you'll play a key role in encouraging professional development and creating an environment where everyone can continue to learn, grow and thrive.


Location and culture


Our main practice is based in the picturesque village of Brayton, near Selby, with our branch in the thriving village of Sherburn-in-Elmet. Both locations offer a lovely semi-rural setting, with local pubs, restaurants, independent shops and plenty of character. We're ideally located for exploring North Yorkshire, with York just a 20-minute drive away and Leeds, Harrogate and Hull all within easy reach. Selby railway station also provides direct connections to Leeds, Manchester and London. For those who enjoy the outdoors, the North York Moors, Yorkshire Wolds and East Yorkshire coast offer plenty of opportunities for walking, cycling and exploring.
At Holmefield, we're proud of our close-knit and supportive culture. Regular team and practice meetings ensure everyone has a voice, while staff wellbeing is a genuine priority, with a mental health first aider and access to additional support resources. We're also a sociable bunch, enjoying everything from pub nights and BBQs to summer and Christmas get-togethers. As Clinical Director, you'll play an important role in maintaining this positive culture, supporting your colleagues and creating an environment where everyone feels valued, heard and encouraged to develop. If you're looking for a leadership opportunity where you can make a genuine impact, develop your team and continue doing the clinical work you enjoy, we'd love to hear from you!

What makes you a great fit

title: Engineering Manager, Sandbox
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The team

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all.

We run it all on our own metal, our own network, our own datacenters — which means when something breaks, the fix is ours to write.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it.

The Role

Agents don't run in browsers. They run in sandboxes — and you will lead the team building ours.

You will manage the team — hiring, coaching, performance, growth paths, honest feedback — while staying close to the code: roughly half your time in architecture decisions and the hardest technical problems the team faces, the other half leading your squad.

We build secure, isolated, network-controlled environments with snapshotting primitives, designed for AI agents and reinforcement-learning workloads. An RL training run doesn't need one environment; it needs thousands, created and destroyed every second. An agent needs to be sandboxed from the world while still feeling fast enough to be useful. That tension — airtight isolation, at fleet scale, at low latency — is the product.

Your customers are the people building the next generation of AI software on our infrastructure; the primitives you ship become the runtime their agents live in.

What You Will Do

  • Build the isolation layer: microVMs or containers, namespaces, cgroups, seccomp, snapshot and restore.

  • Own the security boundary. Customers run code they didn't write and can't fully trust — your systems make that safe.

  • Scale to fleets: creation latency, density, and lifecycle management for thousands of concurrent environments.

  • Design and build alongside your team, owning the architecture and the hardest implementation decisions.

  • Grow the engineers, not just the software — set the standard for ownership and coach people past their comfort zone.

  • Own people management for the team: hiring, performance, growth paths, and honest feedback.

  • Partner with Product Managers to turn frontier research needs into shippable primitives.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of real people leadership. You have managed engineers — hired, coached, given honest feedback, and grown them. Hands-on contribution matters here, but this role is judged on the team you build and lead, not just the code you write.

  • Deep Linux internals: namespaces, cgroups, seccomp, virtualization — ideally microVMs of the Firecracker class.

  • You have shipped production systems in Go. Not dabbled. Shipped.

  • You understand network isolation at the packet level — not just firewall rules.

  • Performance instincts: you know what a syscall costs, and you have the profiles to prove you've cared.

  • 8+ years building backend or infrastructure systems.

  • You have partnered with product, design, and business teams to ship software that reached real users.

  • A low-ego, team-first mindset. We care less about your exact domain and more about whether you are the kind of technical force other engineers want to work alongside.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

You will join a team that mostly focuses on large companies from Tech, Syntec, HCR, and B2B services, interacting with everyone from HR executives to CEOs.

  • HR priorities: Increasing productivity, obtaining fair and competitive pricing, contributing to employee well-being through customized health plans, simplifying HR processes with digital platforms, and managing change management concerns when implementing new health insurance (biggest fear for large companies)

  • Critical business characteristics: This segment requires breadth & depth of expertise to navigate complex organizations, account-based strategies with Key Account Management approach, early engagement in company roadmaps, face-to-face meetings, co-creation of insurance and digital products (tailored offers considering past results, specific regimes, demographics, payroll system integration), and ability to work through RFPs and with brokers.
