title: Founding Product
descriptionHtml:
About us

People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. In reality, hundred of thousands of operators acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on, with tools that have barely changed in decades and spending hours a day on email. Nexcade is building the agentic operating system for those people, transforming the way people communicate and optimise the $1T spend on logistics every year.

Our agents are live in production with leading global Freight Forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are rapidly expanding the platform to touch every part of the logistics lifecycle.

Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality from top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies.

How we work

  • Everybody builds, founders included. The whole company is technical and runs on coding agents. You will not be asked to write production software, but you will use agents for discovery synthesis, specs, prototypes and data analysis rather than doing them by hand.

  • Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate.

  • At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work.

  • End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it.

  • In person, in London. We value synchronous communication.

  • Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.

  • Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues.

The role

We’re building the AI platform freight forwarders rely on. We started with quoting and are expanding across the shipment lifecycle. As Product Lead, you will be central to that expansion, helping decide where we focus and turning those decisions into products customers depend on.

What you’ll do:

  • Own product outcomes: Own the roadmap, priorities and performance of specific products, from defining the customer problem through launch, rollout and adoption. Partner with the founders on overall product direction and strategy.

  • Build from customer insight: Work closely with freight forwarders across commercial and operational roles. Understand how they work, identify the problems customers share and build products for those needs rather than one-off solutions.

  • Prototype and build: Turn ideas into working prototypes and early product versions, using AI tools and code to test them with customers. Work hands-on with engineering to take promising ideas into production, not just write specs and hand them over.

  • Drive product expansion: Build a clear view of the market, including where we win, where we do not compete and why customers choose us. Use that understanding to identify the next workflows Nexcade should enter and turn them into products that grow revenue.

  • Raise the standard of product thinking: Define success measures, test assumptions and examine accuracy, edge cases and second-order effects before scaling. Write clear specs and decision documents, including a written recommendation on the hard calls.

  • Build the product operating system: Establish a clear planning and decision-making cadence without adding bureaucracy. Make sure product meetings are well prepared, teams have the context they need and decisions translate into shipped work.

  • Make product and platform trade-offs: Work closely with engineering to decide when to invest in shared capabilities and when a faster, product-specific approach is right.

What we look for

  • Strong product judgement: You have owned meaningful product work in a complex B2B product and can show how your decisions changed customer behaviour or business results. You define success clearly and test assumptions, accuracy and edge cases before scaling.

  • Product taste: You can turn complex workflows into products that feel simple, coherent and trustworthy. You care about the details that make people choose to use them.

  • Technical fluency: You work effectively with strong engineers, understand trade-offs across architecture, AI, data and integrations and bring the customer and product perspective to choices about speed, quality and reuse.

  • Excellent judgement: You get beyond what customers ask for to understand how their work really happens and distinguish repeatable needs from bespoke requests. You use customer and market insight to make product choices that drive adoption, expansion and revenue.

  • High agency and directness: You take ownership, hold a high bar and disagree openly and constructively. You are comfortable with ambiguity, fast iteration and changing priorities.

  • Obsess over the problem: You are drawn to complex, messy problems in industries the economy depends on and want to understand how the people and systems behind them really work. Industry experience is a bonus, but not required.

Why join

The biggest product choices are still ahead: how deep we go, where we expand and how everything fits together. Our product is already live with leading freight forwarders and this role will shape what comes next. You will build AI for the work that keeps global trade moving, alongside a team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will get meaningful equity in the company you help build.

title: Freelance System Engineer / Technical Architect
descriptionHtml:
Role Details:

Level: Lead

Start Date: December

Duration: 6 months

Day Rate: Dependent on experience

Weekly hours: 5 days/ week

Location: Hybrid, 2 days a week in London

 

We're looking for a Systems Engineer / Technical Architect to help us reimagine a function of government as part of an agentic ecosystem.

You'll join a small multidisciplinary team of designers, researchers and engineers, working closely with civil servants and the department's own technical teams.
You'll own working out what the new system is. What are the constituent pieces, how do they fit together, and what’s needed to make it secure, accountable and auditable? The role suits someone who can sketch a target architecture on Monday and make it real with a prototype by Friday.

In this role you will:

  • Design the target architecture based high-level requirements and constraints, agentic capabilities and best practices

  • Recommend approaches to new challenges such as delegated authority and permissions

  • Set out security, resilience and threat risks and mitigations, including agent-specific risks such as prompt injection and automated abuse

  • Design and build the components that make the system accountable and auditable, such as audit logging and permission checks

  • Identify and test the riskiest technical assumptions

  • Build working prototypes and PoCs with the engineers

  • Produce clear architecture decision records, diagrams and patterns that teams can reuse

  • Engage with the client’s architects, security and assurance experts to get input and agreement on the right approach

  • Set out a realistic path from prototype to delivery

 

Key skills and experience

Must haves:

  • Significant experience as a technical or solution architect working on complex, ambiguous problems

  • A strong background in API design, integration patterns and event-driven or distributed systems

  • Deep knowledge of how agents interact with other parts of the system; tools, MCP servers, agent-to-agent protocols etc

  • Experience designing for security, privacy, observability and auditability from the start including threat modelling

  • Experience of authentication and authorisation, including delegated access, such as OAuth

  • Hands-on coding skills, with the ability to build working prototypes quickly

  • Cloud architecture experience (AWS, Azure or GCP) and infrastructure as code

  • The ability to explain architecture clearly to designers, policy specialists and senior stakeholders

Nice to have:

  • Experience in working on UK government services

  • Exposure to data-sharing standards and legislation, such as the Digital Economy Act

  • An agency or consultancy background

Location

You will need to be able to work from our offices (London) for a minimum of two days a week.

1. Application
Please attach your CV, plus a portfolio or any work you would like to also share.

2. Initial screening call
A short conversation to cover the basics — your timezone, working languages, availability, and a chance for you to ask early questions about the role and how we work.

3. Technical interview (~60 minutes)
A deeper conversation about your technical background and experience. We’ll talk through how you’ve approached real problems, the decisions you’ve made, and how you’d apply that thinking to the work at IF.

4. Ways of working interview (~45–60 minutes)
A conversation about how you collaborate, communicate, and work with others — including how you operate in an advisory capacity with clients and teams.

We’ll aim to keep you updated at every stage and let you know the outcome promptly after each step.

Genau das tun wir! Als Vorreiter der modernen Gebäudetechnik verwandeln wir an sieben Standorten innovative Ideen in greifbare Realität. Das Beste ist: Hier arbeitest Du Seite an Seite mit Experten, die Ihre Leidenschaft teilen. In unserer Du-Kultur mit flachen Hierarchien hat jede Stimme Gewicht - auch Deine! Deine Bewerbung bei der Abicht Gruppe kann Dein Sprungbrett in eine aufregende Zukunft sein!

title: GenAI Engineer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Aufgaben

  • Als GenAI Engineer (m/w/d) entwickelst und implementierst du eigenständig Generative-AI-Modelle, (Multi-)Agent-basierte LLM-Anwendungen und KI-basierte Lösungen für unsere kundenspezifischen Anforderungen. Dabei identifizierst und analysierst du Probleme im Kontext von KI und generativen Modellen.

  • Du entwickelst und wartest KI-Pipelines, APIs und interaktive Anwendungen und arbeitest an Komponenten wie Large Language Models, multimodalen Modellen, Knowledge Graphs und KI-gestützten Produkten.

  • Die Arbeit an komplexen KI-Projekten, die Analyse von Geschäftsanwendungen für generative KI und die Übersetzung in technische Lösungen ergänzen deine Tätigkeiten.

  • Du nutzt deine Kommunikationsstärke, um eng mit unseren Kunden zusammenzuarbeiten, deren Probleme im Kontext von GenAI zu analysieren und die Ergebnisse verständlich zu präsentieren.

  • Du arbeitest über verschiedene Technologie-Stacks hinweg, z. B. Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks, LangChain, Hugging Face, OpenAI APIs, LLM-Frameworks und Cloud-Infrastruktur.

  • Du bist Mentor für Junior-Kolleg:innen im Bereich KI und sorgst für Wissenstransfer innerhalb des Teams.

  • Du profitierst von unserem Team, Lernressourcen, Hackathons und anderen Möglichkeiten, deine technische Entwicklung im Bereich Generative AI voranzutreiben und in der Community präsent zu sein.

Benefits

  • Regelmäßige und systematische (externe und interne) Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten in Generative AI, LLM-Entwicklung und Cloud-Architektur

  • Zugang zu branchenübergreifenden Projekten, z. B. Banken, Versicherungen, Automotive, Einzelhandel

  • Kooperationen mit führenden Partnern in Cloud, AI/ML und AutoML und Zugang zu Enterprise-Versionen führender LLMs

  • Arbeit in einer offenen, flachen Umgebung innerhalb eines breiten Reply-Netzwerks zum Wissensaustausch

  • Preisgekrönte Büroräume in der Münchner Innenstadt mit Zugang zur Stammstrecke

  • Deutschlandticket

  • Unterstützung sportlicher Aktivitäten über EGYM Wellpass und weitere Benefits der Reply Gruppe

  • Flexible Arbeitsumgebung zwischen Kundenprojekten, Reply-Büro und Remote-Arbeit


  • Abgeschlossenes Studium mit technischem Hintergrund, z. B. Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, (Wirtschafts-)Mathematik, Data Science oder ähnliches

  • Erfahrung mit Generative AI, LLMs, NLP und KI-basierten Produktionssystemen, Kenntnisse in Python, R, Rust, PySpark oder SQL

  • Erfahrung in Context Engineering, Prompt Engineering, Fine-Tuning, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) oder ähnlichen LLM-Techniken

  • Vertrautheit mit Cloud-Plattformen wie AWS, GCP oder Azure, Containerisierung und Deployment von KI-Modellen

  • Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auf Deutsch und Englisch

  • Lernbereitschaft, Teamfähigig und die Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Konzepte verständlich zu erklären

  • Gute Projektmanagementfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, sowohl unabhängig als auch im Team zu arbeiten

Über Machine Learning Reply

Machine Learning Reply bietet maßgeschneiderte End-to-End-Lösungen im Data-Science-Bereich an, die den gesamten Projektlebenszyklus abdecken – von der initialen Strategieberatung über die Datenarchitektur und Infrastrukturthemen bis hin zur Datenverarbeitung und Qualitätssicherung unter Verwendung von Machine-Learning-Algorithmen. Machine Learning Reply verfügt über umfassende Expertise im Bereich der Datenwissenschaft in allen Schlüsselindustrien der deutschen HDAX-Unternehmen. Machine Learning Reply befähigt seine Kunden, neue datenbasierte Geschäftsmodelle erfolgreich einzuführen sowie bereits bestehende Prozesse und Produkte zu optimieren – mit einem Schwerpunkt auf Open-Source- und Cloud-Technologien. Mit dem Machine Learning Incubator bietet das Unternehmen ein Programm zur Ausbildung der nächsten Generation von Entscheidungsträgern, Data Scientists und Entwicklern an.

title: Global Alliance Director
descriptionHtml:
Cato Networks is the converged network and security cloud for the AI era. 

As AI reshapes cybersecurity, enterprises face a dual challenge: unlocking AI’s potential while defending against AI-driven attacks. Cato addresses both through a unified, cloud-native platform, providing the visibility and context to prioritize risks and stop threats in real time across users, applications, data, and AI agents. 

Join us as we scale: take on ambitious technological challenges and shape the next generation of enterprise security at a company trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide. 

Join Cato Networks to turn our AWS and CrowdStrike alliances into joint pipeline across EMEA. You'll work directly with alliance partners and our regional sales teams to identify opportunities, organise joint activities and drive revenue. For the first 12 to 18 months, approximately 90% of your time will focus on AWS and CrowdStrike, with other alliances potentially added as they develop. 

This is a senior, hands-on individual contributor role, not a people-management position. You'll own partnership-specific targets and be accountable for commercial results, rather than focusing solely on relationship management or enablement. The preferred location is the UK, close to the sales and marketing colleagues you'll work with. 

Responsibilities 

  • Drive joint pipeline generation with AWS and CrowdStrike across EMEA, combining partner account management with proactive business development. 
  • Build relationships with alliance teams and Cato's regional sales organisation, turning those relationships into joint opportunities.  
  • You will play a critical role in building our cloud marketplace activities from the ground up, accelerating growth and win rates across Cato’s global sales organization.    
  • You will also help formalize our fast-growing technological alliances and partnerships with peer security vendors. 
  • Help sales teams understand and use AWS Marketplace to transact, drawing on practical knowledge of how marketplace deals work. 
  • Plan and execute joint partner and customer activities, including roundtables, events and enablement sessions, with pipeline generation as the goal. 
  • Own revenue targets and activity-based objectives for your partnerships, including objectives where revenue attribution is less straightforward. 
  • Work with product alliances, product marketing, field marketing and regional sales teams, using existing content, playbooks and sales engineering support to deliver joint activities. 

Requirements 

  • Experience in alliances, with a track record of generating pipeline and driving commercial outcomes through partners. 
  • Practical experience with cloud marketplace transactions and the ability to explain their value and process to sales teams. AWS Marketplace experience is preferred; relevant Azure Marketplace experience is also welcome. 
  • A proactive business development approach: you're comfortable finding opportunities, mobilising partners and sales teams, and being accountable for a number. 
  • The ability to build productive relationships across partner organisations and internal commercial teams. 
  • Availability for regular travel across EMEA, expected to be around 50%, with more travel initially as you establish relationships and activities. 

Additional experience we value: 

  • Experience working with AWS alliance teams and an established network in the AWS ecosystem. 
  • Experience with CrowdStrike or similar technology alliances. 
  • Alliances experience in cybersecurity. 

 *LI-NH1

title: Go-To-Market Strategy Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Growth at United Media

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why United Media

United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Growth Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
ZeitMind, the autonomous data engineer for the European mid-market

About Zeit AI

In the coming years, companies will replace their internal data teams with AI agents to run more efficiently. We will be the solution they'll use. ZeitMind connects to the systems companies already run (ERP, CRM, spreadsheets, internal databases), cleans messy data, runs analyses on its own and builds data applications. Every employee can then work with data in plain language, with no technical degree and no help from IT. Our customers use it to organise agricultural inventories, to schedule maintenance, crew and flights for jet operators, and to replace controllers' manual Excel reports.. Founded by Marvin and Leopold, both ex-Palantir. YC S24, backed by Oxford Seed Fund and Sequoia Scout. Customers in manufacturing, agriculture and aviation. Zero to €1M ARR in our first twelve months with six people. Small team, one room in Munich, regular team offsites.

Your Mission: Own how Zeit AI shows up

As our first marketing hire, you own everything between someone hearing our name for the first time and Sales having a qualified conversation. Website, search, content, brand, events. Your mission is to turn that into a steady stream of inbound from DACH.

Your Daily Business - no two days are alike

  • The website, in Webflow: content, structure, landing pages, conversion, tracking. You build and ship it yourself

  • SEO: keyword research, on-page and technical work, backlinks. A bet you keep placing, not a project that ends

  • SEA: Google Ads and LinkedIn, measured on qualified inbound, not impressions

  • YouTube: building and maintaining our channel with product demos, customer stories and explainers

  • PR and thought leadership: press articles, guest lectures and talks, getting Marvin and Leopold in front of the right audiences

  • Writing: blog, landing pages, one-pagers, customer stories

  • Brand guidelines that stick: fonts, colours, templates, tone, and the discipline to hold the line once they exist

  • Events, end to end: selection, stand, materials, speaker slots, follow-up

  • Reporting: you know which channel produced which pipeline

Your Skillset - what you bring to the table

  • 2 to 3 years in B2B marketing, ideally as the first or only marketer somewhere. What you have shipped counts more than where

  • You have marketed something that needs explaining: complex B2B products, ideally to operational buyers

  • Hands-on with Webflow, SEO, SEA and GA4. You have built the pages and run the campaigns yourself

  • German and English, both fluent.

  • You write sharply, think visually, and notice when something looks off

  • AI-native: you automate the repetitive parts and use tools like Claude Code and Claude Cowork to move faster

  • Nice to have: an eye for product UX

What We Offer

  • Full trust, maximum support. You shape this from day one, with the team as your content source

  • A real path into owning marketing at Zeit AI

  • Munich is our hub. In-person by design, and we cover your relocation within Europe

  • Regular team offsites

  • Best tools, zero blockers. Daily lunch allowance, dinner covered in the office, Wellpass

  • €5k referral bonus if we hire someone you refer

Interview Process

  1. First call with Elena (15 min)

  2. Role deep-dive with Deepika, GTM Lead (45 min)

  3. Call with Leopold, Founder (30 min)

  4. In-person case in Munich (2 hours), plus reference check

  5. Meet the team, including Marvin, Founder

We aim to get through this in two weeks.

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore. 

VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. 

For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on  LinkedIn #WeAreVML.

Nous recrutons, pour renforcer nos équipes Sales, un.e Head of Alliances.

Missions

En tant que Head of Alliances, vous pilotez le go-to-market de VML Consulting avec nos partenaires technologiques stratégiques (Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, Shopify) et les innovateurs de l’IA. Point de convergence entre nos partenaires, nos équipes commerciales et nos Business Units, vous transformez la force de l’écosystème en pipeline, en différenciation et en croissance. Comme l’ensemble de l’équipe de Business Développement, vous reposez sur un profil hybride dont les 2 piliers sont d’être :

  • Responsable du go-to-market conjoint avec nos partenaires technologiques stratégiques : co-construction des offres, des plans d’affaires et de la démarche de co-selling autour de nos capabilities auprès de clients et prospects,
  • Orchestrateur de l’écosystème en interne : enablement des équipes, montée en compétence et certifications sur les plateformes partenaires, pour activer la bonne expertise au sein de VML Consulting et du réseau WPP

Cette hybridation est la clé du succès : être à la fois moteur du business généré via l’écosystème partenaires et garant de la capacité des équipes à délivrer avec ces technologies.

Dimension Business :

  • Définit et déploie la stratégie de go-to-market et de marketing partenaires de VML Consulting avec ses partenaires technologiques stratégiques, afin de maximiser la valeur, la différenciation et le pipeline générés par l’écosystème,
  • Construit et anime les plans d’affaires conjoints (joint business plans) avec chaque partenaire clé (Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, Shopify…), en pilotant objectifs, jalons et indicateurs de performance partagés,
  • Orchestre le co-selling et le co-marketing : aligne partenaires, équipes commerciales et Business Units pour transformer les opportunités de l’écosystème en deals, du sourcing à la conversion,
  • Conçoit et orchestre le plan d’événements dédiés ou co-construits avec les partenaires (webinaires, ateliers, salons, temps forts commerciaux), afin de générer visibilité, demande et pipeline,
  • Met en œuvre, en continu, l’excellence de la démarche partenaires via les processus et outils internes ainsi que les portails partenaires, à des fins de visibilité, de pilotage et d’animation globale en interne,
  • Sécurise et défend les intérêts économique et contractuel de VML Consulting dans le cadre des accords de partenariat (referral, reselling, MDF, niveaux de partenariat),
  • Pilote le niveau de préférence et de mindshare de nos partenaires à notre égard : positionne VML Consulting comme partenaire de référence dans leur écosystème, fait progresser notre niveau de partenariat et suit la performance des objectifs conjoints,
  • Contribue au thought leadership de VML Consulting sur les enjeux d’écosystème et de plateformes (IA, data, commerce, CX), via des prises de parole conjointes valorisant nos réussites dans une logique de ROI business,
  • Construit et fait vivre un patrimoine de connaissances sur l’écosystème technologique (roadmaps produits, niveaux et programmes de partenariat, dispositifs de financement) afin d’accélérer et de fluidifier l’action commerciale,
  • Incarne, diffuse et fait vivre l’excellence du modèle partenaires en interne, en particulier auprès des communautés commerciale et managériale, pour l’inspirer et développer son réflexe écosystème.

Dimension Enablement & Delivery :

  • Travaille de concert avec le CTO, à qui revient la responsabilité de l’enablement, des certifications et de la montée en compétences des équipes sur les plateformes partenaires ; il s’assure que ces chantiers progressent au rythme des priorités business et des engagements pris auprès des partenaires,
  • Veille à la disponibilité et à la capitalisation des assets conjoints (cas clients, références, supports de co-vente) et au partage des retours d’expérience.

Profil recherché

Vous justifiez de 5 à 10 ans d’expérience, dont une expérience significative en alliances / partenariats technologiques, channel ou business development – idéalement acquise en cabinet de conseil, ESN, agence ou chez un éditeur / hyperscaler.

Notre croissance reposant sur un écosystème de partenaires technologiques (Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, Shopify…), vous maîtrisez les mécaniques de co-selling, de co-marketing et de joint business planning.

Vous pouvez justifier de contributions ou de succès significatifs dans le cadre d’initiatives partenaires ou de développement business, au-delà d’en comprendre la logique ou les bonnes pratiques.

Votre capacité à nouer des relations de grande qualité, tant avec les équipes partenaires (alliance managers, channel, avant-vente) qu’avec les décideurs internes (Directions commerciales, Business Units, Marketing), fait de vous un orchestrateur d’écosystème performant, du sourcing d’opportunités à la conclusion de deals conjoints équilibrant les intérêts du partenaire, du client et de VML Consulting.

Les enjeux des plateformes technologiques et de l’écosystème IA / data / commerce vous passionnent, et vous savez vous appuyer sur vos expériences pour bâtir un discours solide en interne comme auprès des partenaires.

Votre rigueur et votre curiosité font de vous un acteur à la fois à l’aise dans la logique de développement business sur des clients existants que sur de la conquête opportuniste, ou en relai d’un partenaire.

La maîtrise de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, est indispensable : vous adressez des partenaires et des interlocuteurs internationaux de manière totalement autonome.

title: Head of Compliance
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Head of Compliance and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.

You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive.

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business, generating opportunities via outbound outreach.

We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara's mission.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and Linkedin
  • Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.
  • Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling
  • Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles
  • 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum
  • Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
  • Curious and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and fluent in French

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in closing-sales roles
  • Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

ADR pathways

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.

  • ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.
  • The next level in the program is ADR II, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.
  • The highest level within our organization is ADR III. These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Industrialization Engineer H/F
descriptionHtml:
At Marso, as an Industrialization Engineer, you will turn the Marso robot from a working prototype into a product that can be built reliably, repeatably, and at scale. You will own the path from design to series production: manufacturability, assembly processes, testing, and supplier ramp-up.

Responsibilities

  • Work with design teams to make sure the robot is built for manufacturing and assembly (DFM/DFA) from the earliest design stages.

  • Define and document assembly processes, work instructions, and production test procedures.

  • Design and qualify production tooling, jigs, and end-of-line test benches, covering mechanical, electrical, and embedded calibration.

  • Lead pilot builds and the ramp-up to series production, both in-house and with contract manufacturers.

  • Track and improve quality, yield, cycle time, and cost per unit using structured methods (PFMEA, root cause analysis, 8D).

  • Manage engineering changes (ECOs) and keep BOMs and manufacturing documentation up to date.

  • Qualify and support suppliers on industrialization topics, including first article inspections and process audits.

Profile

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in industrialization, manufacturing engineering, or NPI, ideally on complex electromechanical products.

  • Strong knowledge of DFM/DFA, assembly processes, and production testing.

  • Hands-on experience ramping up production, ideally with contract manufacturers.

  • Command of quality tools (PFMEA, control plans, SPC, 8D) and a data-driven approach to process improvement.

  • Comfortable working with CAD (SolidWorks, Onshape, or equivalent) and PLM/ERP tools.

  • Rigorous, autonomous, and hands-on, and you enjoy being on the production floor as much as at your desk.

  • Nice to have: experience in robotics, automotive, or electronics; knowledge of battery, motor, or sensor integration; experience with CE marking or safety standards.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of background.

Chez Marso, en tant qu’Industrialization Engineer, vous ferez passer le robot Marso du prototype fonctionnel à un produit fabriqué de façon fiable, reproductible et à l’échelle. Profil

  • 3 à 5 ans d’expérience en industrialisation, ingénierie de production ou NPI, idéalement sur des produits électromécaniques complexes.

  • Bonne connaissance du DFM/DFA, des procédés d’assemblage et des tests de production.

  • Un plus : expérience en robotique, automobile ou électronique ; connaissance de l’intégration batteries, moteurs ou capteurs ; expérience du marquage CE ou des normes de sécurité.

Nous sommes engagés dans la construction d’une équipe diverse et inclusive. Toutes les candidatures qualifiées sont les bienvenues et nous accordons une attention particulière aux compétences, à l’impact et à la capacité à contribuer au projet.

title: Information Security Engineer - Infrastructure Security
descriptionHtml:
A World-Changing Company Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role

We're looking for an Information Security Engineer who can think broadly about how infrastructure is built, attacked, defended, and improved. You may have deep experience in one area—such as endpoint security, Active Directory, Data Loss Prevention, cloud security, identity, or detection and response—but you’re motivated by solving security problems across the environment.

As an Information Security Engineer focused on infrastructure security, you'll help protect Palantir's global endpoints, servers, identity systems, applications, networks, and data flows. You'll work across teams to reduce attack surface, improve defensive controls, investigate security events, and turn security findings into durable architectural and operational improvements.

This is not just a corporate security role; the adversaries we face are sophisticated. We need someone who understands both the details and the broader system: how a weakness in one part of the environment can create risk somewhere else, how controls interact, and how to build security improvements that hold up in practice.
Core Responsibilities
  • Design, implement, and improve security controls across endpoints, servers, identity systems, cloud services, SaaS applications, networks, and data flows.
  • Drive security posture improvements through hardening standards, configuration management, vulnerability remediation, access controls, monitoring, and ongoing validation.
  • Assess security risks in new platforms, products, architectures, vendors, and services, and turn findings into practical recommendations and engineering work.
  • Build and maintain automation for security operations, including configuration validation, drift monitoring, patching, access reviews, policy enforcement, alert triage, and security hygiene.
  • Partner with Identity, Infrastructure, Engineering, Legal, and other Information Security teams to strengthen security architecture and address recurring risks.
  • Turn insights from assessments, red team exercises, incident investigations, and operational reviews into durable fixes, such as configuration changes, architectural improvements, policy updates, and automation.
  • Build expertise in one or more security domains while contributing across the broader infrastructure security lifecycle.

    • What We're Looking For
  • Experience securing one or more major infrastructure domains, such as Windows, macOS, Linux, Active Directory, cloud platforms, SaaS applications, networking, identity systems, or enterprise endpoints.
  • A broad infrastructure security mindset and curiosity about systems beyond your primary area of expertise.
  • Familiarity with common infrastructure attack paths, adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures, and the controls used to prevent, detect, and contain them.
  • The ability to assess complex environments and recognize how weaknesses across identity, endpoints, applications, networks, cloud services, or data flows can combine to create risk.
  • Experience evaluating security tools and validating that controls are deployed effectively and continue to work as intended.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, CI/CD, or other approaches to making security controls repeatable and scalable.

    • What We Value
  • The ability to own projects, make progress through ambiguity, and balance competing priorities while working well with colleagues.
  • Experience in complex, high-assurance, regulated, or rapidly changing environments.
  • Comfort moving between strategic problem-solving and hands-on technical work.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risks and work with partner teams to drive remediation.
  • Contributions to security programs, tooling, automation, incident investigations, or technical research—whether public or internal.

    • What We Require
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in information security, infrastructure security, security engineering, security operations, or a closely related field.
  • Demonstrated experience securing at least one major infrastructure or security domain, with the ability and interest to work across multiple domains.
  • Active TS/SCI security clearance, or eligibility and willingness to obtain one.
  • A strong sense of ownership, sound judgment, and integrity.
    • Life at Palantir We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region. In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the city and or country in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office. If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process, please and let us know how we can help. Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

title: Internal Communications Internship
descriptionHtml:
About the role

Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality.

As our Internal Communications Intern, you’ll join our Marketing & Communications team and help keep colleagues across SkyNRG informed, connected and engaged. Working closely with our PR & Communications Manager and teams across the business, you’ll create engaging content, support internal campaigns and events, and help improve the channels and tools we use to communicate.

Your Responsibilities

  • Content creation: Draft and publish newsletters, intranet articles, announcements, interviews, employee stories and leadership updates.

  • Employee engagement: Support internal campaigns, company events and town halls that connect and engage colleagues across SkyNRG.

  • Channels & tools: Maintain internal communication channels and content calendars and help improve the processes and tools behind them.

  • Collaboration: Work with teams across the organization to gather information and turn it into clear and engaging communication.

  • Insights & improvement: Monitor engagement and use insights to continuously improve our internal communications.

Your profile

You recognize yourself in the following:

  • Current Bachelor’s or Master’s studies in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing, Business or a related field, with enrollment for the full duration of the internship.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to create clear and engaging content.

  • Strong interest in internal communications, employee engagement and organizational culture.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple activities simultaneously.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively with colleagues across different teams.

  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365 tools, including Teams, Outlook, PowerPoint and SharePoint.

  • Full-time availability for a 6-month internship from 15 February 2027 onwards.

About SkyNRG

Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality.

Collaboration is fundamental to achieving our ambition. We nurture genuine relationships with global partners in our drive to make SAF the alternative to fossil jet fuel.

Our in-house team of SAF experts have helped over 60 airlines and corporates reduce their climate impact using the Book & Claim mechanism; the most transparent and traceable way to support aviation sustainability with real emission reductions.

Sustainability is woven into the fabric of our company. We maintain an independent Sustainability Board, which advises the company on feedstocks and provides strategic guidance on wide-ranging sustainability issues. SkyNRG operations are certified against the RSB EU RED, CORSIA, and Book & Claim standards.

At SkyNRG, you’ll find:

  • An innovation-driven culture – where big ideas turn into real impact

  • Growth opportunities – in a fast-scaling, industry-changing company

  • A collaborative team – where your ideas and expertise are valued

  • A mission that matters – leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high-integrity SAF

What we offer

We offer a brand-new office in the heart of Amsterdam, designed for collaboration and creativity. Most importantly, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to a truly game-changing green initiative, making a real impact on the aviation industry and the planet.

Besides that, we offer:

  • A unique working experience in a scale-up at the forefront of sustainable aviation.

  • An inspiring international work environment in a fast growing and innovative industry.

  • A great opportunity to work in a multidisciplinary, committed, and talented team.

  • Work where it feels best for you: we offer flexible (hybrid in-office/remote) working arrangements.

  • A monthly internship allowance of 800 euros.

  • Commuting travel reimbursement.

  • Paid Volunteering Day.

  • Access to our electric company boat, free lunches, and social activities – all part of the deal!

Is this you?

Are you ready to take the next step in your career with SkyNRG? Explore our vacancies and become part of our company of change makers. Together, we can change the future of flying.

For more information about SkyNRG visit www.skynrg.com.

title: INTESCIA - Responsable produit / Product Owner (H/F) - CDI
descriptionHtml:
Responsable produit / Product Owner (H/F)

CDI

Rejoignez le Groupe INTESCIA, leader de la Business Intelligence en Europe !

Qui sommes-nous ?
Chez Intescia, nous transformons la donnée en levier de croissance. Leader européen de la Data Intelligence, nous opérons le portefeuille de données et de solutions le plus complet du marché pour aider les entreprises à détecter plus vite les opportunités, mieux comprendre leurs marchés et décider avec impact.

Présents en France, en Espagne, en Italie et en Belgique, nous réalisons plus de 75 M€ de chiffre d'affaires et figurons parmi les 50 plus grands acteurs de l'industrie du logiciel et de la data en France. Au quotidien, des milliers d'entreprises s'appuient sur nos solutions pour accélérer leur business.

Dans le cadre de notre stratégie produit, nous recherchons un Product Owner Senior pour la verticale Service Tertiaire & B2B. Cette verticale est stratégique : elle sert de socle commun à toutes les offres du Groupe.

Elle doit devenir l'un des moteurs des innovations qui vont changer la façon dont les entreprises détectent, qualifient et développent leurs opportunités commerciales. Elle alimente aussi les autres verticales d'Intescia (Construction, Immobilier, Manufacture et Services au Territoire) avec des capacités communes : connaissance des entreprises, détection d'opportunités, enrichissement de données et intelligence artificielle.

Votre mission :

En binôme avec le Product Manager de la verticale, vous transformez la vision et la roadmap en produits livrés, utilisés et créateurs de valeur.

Vous êtes le garant du backlog et le référent produit au quotidien des équipes de développement. Vous faites le lien entre les besoins des utilisateurs, les enjeux business et les contraintes techniques, data et IA. Votre objectif : livrer de façon régulière des fonctionnalités de qualité, qui ont un vrai impact.

Les fonctionnalités que vous livrerez sur cette verticale seront réutilisées dans l'ensemble des offres d'Intescia. La qualité de conception, la modularité et la cohérence de l'expérience sont donc au cœur de votre rôle.

Vos activités :

Piloter le backlog produit

  • Traduire la vision et la roadmap en epics, user stories et critères d'acceptation clairs, testables et orientés valeur.

  • Prioriser le backlog en continu selon la valeur client, l'impact business, la faisabilité technique et la dette.

  • Garantir un backlog toujours prêt (« ready »), avec deux à trois sprints d'avance.

Animer la delivery

  • Être le référent produit des équipes Tech, Data et IA au quotidien : vous répondez aux questions, arbitrez et levez les blocages.

  • Animer ou contribuer aux rituels agiles : affinage, planification de sprint, revue, rétrospective.

  • Recetter les fonctionnalités et valider leur conformité avant mise en production.

  • Suivre les indicateurs de delivery (vélocité, délais de livraison, qualité) et contribuer à leur amélioration.

Livrer les fonctionnalités IA de nouvelle génération

Spécifier et livrer des fonctionnalités qui s'appuient sur les dernières avancées de l'intelligence artificielle :

  • Agents IA

  • Recherche conversationnelle

  • Qualification automatique des prospects

  • Recommandations intelligentes

  • Automatisation des tâches commerciales

  • Copilotes de prospection

  • Sales Engagement augmenté

  • Vous travaillez étroitement avec les équipes Data et IA pour cadrer les cas d'usage, définir les critères de qualité des modèles (pertinence, précision, explicabilité) et organiser l'expérimentation : prototypes, tests utilisateurs, déploiements progressifs.

Exploiter la richesse de la donnée Intescia

Concevoir des fonctionnalités qui valorisent concrètement les actifs data du Groupe :

  • marchés publics

  • projets privés

  • données entreprises

  • presse économique et spécialisée

  • données essentielles

  • données financières

  • signaux d'affaires

  • données ouvertes

  • enrichissements issus de l'IA

Vous veillez à la qualité, à la fraîcheur et à la bonne exposition de ces données dans les parcours utilisateurs.

Construire des briques transverses réutilisables

Vous travaillez avec les Product Owners et Product Managers des verticales Construction, Immobilier, Manufacture et Services au Territoire. Ensemble, vous spécifiez des composants, des API et des services communes autour de la recherche, du scoring, de la recommandation, des signaux d'affaires et de l'automatisation.

Vous gérez les dépendances entre équipes, assurez une documentation fonctionnelle de qualité et facilitez l'adoption de ces briques par les autres verticales.

Rester au plus près des utilisateurs

  • Participer aux entretiens utilisateurs, aux ateliers et aux tests d'usage avec les équipes Design et Customer Success.

  • Analyser les retours clients, les données d'usage et les indicateurs d'adoption pour améliorer le produit en continu.

  • Accompagner les lancements avec les équipes Sales, Marketing et Customer Success : supports, démos, notes de version.

    La rémunération sur ce poste est de 55K€ annuelle + variable.

    Le profil que nous recherchons :

Vous êtes un Product Owner expérimenté, reconnu pour la rigueur de votre delivery et pour votre capacité à transformer des besoins complexes en fonctionnalités simples et utiles.

Vous avez idéalement au moins 5 ans d'expérience en tant que Product Owner dans un environnement B2B SaaS, Data ou IA.

Vous maîtrisez :

  • les méthodes agiles (Scrum, Kanban) et les outils associés (Jira, Confluence ou équivalents)

  • la rédaction de spécifications fonctionnelles et de user stories

  • les échanges avec des équipes techniques, data et IA (API, modèles de données, notions de machine learning et de LLM)

  • l'analyse de données d'usage pour guider vos priorités

Vous avez un réel intérêt pour :

· l'intelligence artificielle

· les plateformes de données

  • les produits B2B

  • les outils de prospection

  • les CRM

  • les technologies d'automatisation

Vous êtes à l'aise pour arbitrer, vous communiquez avec clarté et vous aimez les environnements en forte évolution, où l'innovation est au cœur de la stratégie.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Vous livrerez concrètement la prochaine génération de solutions d'intelligence commerciale.

  • Vous serez au cœur de la stratégie IA du Groupe et mettrez en production des fonctionnalités qui changeront durablement les usages de milliers d'entreprises.

  • Votre travail ira au-delà de votre verticale : les briques que vous livrerez enrichiront les offres Construction, Immobilier, Manufacture et Services au Territoire.

  • Vous rejoindrez une équipe produit ambitieuse, avec beaucoup d'autonomie, un impact direct sur le produit et la possibilité de contribuer à une plateforme qui servira tous les métiers d'Intescia.

Ce que nous vous offrons :

  • Poste basé à Issy-les-Moulineaux

  • Type de contrat : CDI

  • Rémunération fixe de 55K€ annuelle et variable sur objectifs

Le poste combine trois dimensions : le pilotage de projets, le management d'une équipe de trois personnes réparties sur les équipes métier, et une composante technique forte sur le CRM, l'automatisation et l'analyse stratégique de la donnée.

title: Investment Analyst (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über die Rolle

Eine gute Kaufentscheidung beginnt damit, dass jemand genau hinsieht. Bei Buena bist du das: Du verstehst das Unternehmen, hinterfragst Annahmen, erkennst Risiken und begründest, welchen Preis wir zahlen sollten.

Du verantwortest die Due Diligence für Hausverwaltungen, die wir übernehmen möchten: von der ersten Sichtung des Datenraums über die Bewertung und die Präsentation im Investment Committee bis zu den finanziellen und operativen Anlagen für den Kaufvertrag. Wenn das Committee ins Detail geht, kennst du das Unternehmen und kannst deine Empfehlung fundiert begründen.

Unser Prozess steht. Jetzt suchen wir jemanden, der die Verantwortung für die Qualität der Analysen übernimmt, die Due Diligence eigenständig steuert und unseren Prozess mit dem Wachstum weiterentwickelt.

Über Buena

Buena übernimmt Hausverwaltungen und digitalisiert sie mit selbst entwickelter Software. Wir verbinden Akquisitionen, operative Erfahrung und Technologie, um Immobilieneigentum und Verwaltung einfacher zu machen.

M&A ist ein zentraler Teil dieser Strategie. Die Unternehmen, die wir kaufen, werden Teil von Buena. Deshalb zählt unser Verständnis ihrer Zahlen, Verträge, Teams und Abläufe weit über den Abschluss einer Transaktion hinaus.

Deine Verantwortung

  • Das Unternehmen hinter dem Datenraum verstehen. Du führst Finanzdaten, Verträge, Objektlisten und Mitarbeiterinformationen zusammen. Du erkennst Lücken, gehst Widersprüchen nach und klärst offene Fragen mit den Verkäufern, bis ein belastbares Gesamtbild entsteht.

  • Die Bewertung fundiert herleiten. Du analysierst die wirtschaftliche Entwicklung, arbeitest mit unseren Kaufpreismodellen und prüfst die zugrunde liegenden Annahmen. Du zeigst, was deine Erkenntnisse für den Kaufpreis und die Investitionsentscheidung bedeuten.

  • Deine Ergebnisse im Investment Committee vertreten. Du verdichtest die Due Diligence zu einer klaren Einschätzung von Chancen, Risiken und offenen Fragen und präsentierst sie direkt vor den Entscheidungsträgern.

  • Die Details bis zum Closing begleiten. Gemeinsam mit unserem M&A-Anwalt bereitest du die finanziellen und operativen Anlagen zum Kaufvertrag vor und stellst sicher, dass die Angaben stimmen.

  • Für die Qualität einstehen. Du prüfst die Beiträge unserer Praktikant, erkennst Fehler frühzeitig und übernimmst Verantwortung für die fertige Analyse.

  • Den Prozess weiterentwickeln. Du lernst unsere Playbooks kennen, setzt sie sorgfältig um und bringst eigene Ideen ein, wie wir Datenräume, Analysen und Entscheidungen besser organisieren können.

Du passt gut zu uns wenn

  • Du bereits an Transaktionen gearbeitet hast. Idealerweise bringst du ein bis zwei Jahre Erfahrung als Analyst im Transaktionsumfeld, bei Private Equity oder Venture Capital mit. Auch fundierte Praktikumserfahrung kann relevant sein. Entscheidend ist, wie tief du in die Arbeit eingestiegen bist und welche Verantwortung du dir jetzt zutraust.

  • Deine analytischen Grundlagen sitzen. Du bist sicher in Excel, kannst Finanzdaten interpretieren und verstehst Bewertungskonzepte wie Equity Bridge und Discounted-Cashflow-Analyse.

  • Du den entscheidenden Details nachgehst. Eine Zahl, die sich nicht nachvollziehen lässt, oder eine Vertragsklausel mit unerwarteten Folgen ist für dich ein Grund, genauer hinzusehen.

  • Du dein Urteil erklären kannst. Du gehst souverän mit Rückfragen um, unterscheidest belastbare Erkenntnisse von Annahmen und änderst deine Einschätzung, wenn neue Informationen es erfordern.

  • Du Verantwortung übernimmst. Du hältst den Prozess in Bewegung, verfolgst offene Punkte konsequent und holst dir Unterstützung, wenn sie gebraucht wird.

  • Du dich in einem direkten, informellen Umfeld wohlfühlst. Du bringst sorgfältiges Arbeiten aus dem Transaktionsumfeld in ein Startup ein und gestaltest mit, wie wir arbeiten.

Die Besonderheiten von Hausverwaltungen und unsere internen Abläufe kannst du bei uns lernen. Startup-Erfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung.

Warum Buena

Früh eigene Verantwortung übernehmen. Du begleitest deine Targets durch die Due Diligence und stehst für die Ergebnisse ein. Deine Analysen fließen direkt in konkrete Kaufentscheidungen ein.

Direkt mit den Entscheidungsträgern arbeiten. Du präsentierst im Investment Committee und arbeitest eng mit Kolleg aus M&A, Legal und Operations zusammen.

Mit jeder Transaktion dazulernen. Unsere volle Pipeline bietet dir immer wieder die Gelegenheit, Unternehmen zu verstehen, Risiken zu bewerten und zu sehen, wie deine Erkenntnisse einen Deal beeinflussen.

Mitgestalten wie wir Unternehmen kaufen. Unser Prozess ist strukturiert und lässt sich weiter verbessern. Sobald du ihn kennst, hast du den Freiraum, einzelne Schritte zu hinterfragen und bessere Lösungen vorzuschlagen.

So lernen wir uns kennen

Wir sprechen über deine Transaktionserfahrung, deine Herangehensweise an Due Diligence und die Verantwortung, die du als Nächstes übernehmen möchtest. Anschließend bearbeitest du einen praxisnahen Case und lernst das Team kennen, auch bei einem gemeinsamen Mittag- oder Abendessen. Referenzgespräche sind Teil der abschließenden Phase.

Du möchtest die Due Diligence hinter Buenas nächsten Akquisitionen verantworten? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

title: iOS Developer - AI Finance Agent
descriptionHtml:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

We are looking for iOS engineers to build the native iOS experience for BJAK's app.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What Will You Build

  • Build and ship native iOS features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys.

  • Make complex financial flows feel clean, fast and simple on mobile.

  • Work with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take ideas from rough concept to production release.

  • Own app quality across performance, crash rate, loading states, edge cases, responsiveness and release stability.

  • Use production feedback, analytics and customer behaviour to improve features after launch.

  • Integrate APIs, authentication, secure data handling and financial workflows with strong attention to reliability.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Strong native iOS experience using Swift.

  • Experience shipping iOS apps used by real users.

  • Good understanding of SwiftUI, UIKit, async/await and iOS architecture patterns.

  • Strong product sense and care for UX, not just building screens.

  • Able to debug production issues and improve performance, reliability and app quality.

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and moving fast without lowering the bar.

 

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in United Kingdom. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in United Kingdom.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round


For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
