title: IT Support Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Zable

Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.

  • Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021

  • The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK

  • Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan

  • Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.

The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.

Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.

Join us if you want to

  • Take ownership across a broad remit - you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Zable from day one

  • Work in small teams of exceptional people - who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  • Build the best technology in-house - using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

 

About the role

We're looking for an experienced IT Manager, or a senior IT Lead ready to step up, who has built and run high-performing IT support teams. You’ll be the Head of IT’s right hand: running IT operations day to day, managing the team, and helping shape and deliver the strategic changes that keep Zable’s IT ready for its next stage of growth.

You care about people. You run regular 1:1s, set clear goals, give honest feedback and invest in your team’s careers, and you build a culture that is collaborative, inclusive and accountable.

You’re comfortable with senior stakeholders, vendors and budgets, and you stay close enough to the technology to make sound decisions, step in on complex escalations and challenge the team’s technical thinking, while knowing when to delegate. You’ll deputise for the Head of IT when they’re away.


What to expect


People leadership

  • Line manage the IT team, including regular 1:1s, objective setting, performance reviews and career development

  • Hire, onboard and develop IT Engineers, building a team with the skills to scale with the business

  • Manage workload, priorities and cover so the team delivers consistently high service

  • Address performance issues early and fairly, working with the People team where needed

 

Strategy and operations

  • Act as second-in-command to the Head of IT, deputising in their absence and representing IT in senior forums

  • Support the Head of IT in defining the IT roadmap and leading strategic change, such as tooling consolidation, identity and device management, new offices and international expansion

  • Own day-to-day IT operations across Windows, macOS and mobile devices and office equipment, for UK and international locations

  • Own the ITSM platform, SLAs and service reporting, and use the data to drive continuous improvement

  • Own joiner, mover and leaver processes across all locations, making sure they are secure, auditable and efficient

  • Drive automation, self-service and AI to improve user experience and team efficiency

  • Manage IT vendors, licences and contracts, and support budget planning and cost tracking

  • Work with Security, Engineering and Compliance to keep IT controls effective in a regulated environment, and provide evidence for audits

  • Act as the final escalation point for complex technical issues and major IT incidents


What we’re looking for

  • 7+ years in IT Support, IT Operations or Service Desk environments, including at least 2 years line managing an IT team

  • A track record of building, coaching and retaining high-performing, inclusive teams, including running 1:1s, performance reviews and difficult conversations

  • Experience supporting or leading IT strategy and change programmes in a scaling organisation

  • Strong hands-on background with macOS and MDM platforms such as Jamf or Kandji

  • Experience owning ITSM platforms (e.g. Jira, Zendesk, Freshdesk), defining SLAs and reporting service metrics to senior stakeholders

  • Experience managing vendors, licences and IT budgets

  • Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS and Google Cloud

  • Good understanding of security and compliance in IT operations, such as access management, endpoint security and audit evidence

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management, and confident presenting to senior leaders

  • Willingness to travel to our office locations in Kent and London as needed


Nice to haves

  • Direct experience scaling IT functions in high-growth tech environments

  • Experience in fintech, financial services or another regulated industry (e.g. ISO 27001, SOC 2 or FCA-regulated environments)

  • Experience supporting international offices or expansion into new markets

  • Experience with network management and troubleshooting

  • ITIL or a similar service management qualification

 

Interview process

  • A quick phone call with one of the talent team

    • Onsite or video interviews

      • Technical, IT operations & Leadership management interview

      • Leadership interview covering people management and IT strategy

      • Meet the team you’ll work with daily

 

Life at Zable

  • The opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

title: IT Techical Program Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

We are seeking a talented Technical Program Manager (IT) to own and drive our IT and DevOps IT project portfolio end-to-end.

You will work closely with a team of IT Technicians, IT Specialists, and IT Engineers, covering everything from helpdesk-driven initiatives and IT operations to office openings, automation, IT infrastructure design, CPE management, M&A integrations, and DevOps for IT.

You will ensure that the right projects move forward at the right pace, with the right people and resources. Beyond coordinating the overall portfolio, you will also take direct ownership of selected strategic projects, such as greenfield office buildouts (FDOBs) and M&A integrations.

This is a hands-on role combining portfolio management, project ownership, team coordination, and operational execution. You will help bring structure, visibility, and consistency to our IT project delivery while remaining close enough to the technical work to make things happen.

If you enjoy driving complex technical projects, coordinating diverse teams, and building scalable processes in a fast-growing environment, this role offers the opportunity to have a direct impact on how Mistral scales its IT operations globally.

What You Will Do

Portfolio and Program Management

  • Own the IT project portfolio, maintaining a single and accurate view of all projects, including their status, priorities, risks, and dependencies.

  • Drive planning and prioritization sessions with the IT Manager, ensuring alignment between the project portfolio and broader business and IT objectives.

  • Run regular project reviews and status reporting, proactively identifying risks, blockers, and delays while defining clear remediation plans.

  • Ensure projects are thoroughly executed, covering proper scoping, documentation, testing, handover, and closure, including post-launch validation.

Resource and Team Coordination

  • Manage resource allocation across projects in collaboration with the IT Manager, balancing workload, skills, and availability across IT Technicians, Specialists, and Engineers.

  • Identify capacity conflicts and propose trade-offs or changes in project sequencing to ensure efficient delivery.

  • Support and coach team members on project execution, helping them write project briefs, break down work, and define milestones and acceptance criteria.

  • Coordinate with stakeholders outside IT, including Facilities, HR, Security, Finance, and external vendors, on cross-functional projects.

  • Manage external vendors and integrators involved in IT projects, including statements of work, delivery follow-up, and acceptance.

Hands-On Project Ownership

  • Directly own and lead selected strategic projects, including:

    • FDOBs (Fit-outs / New Office Buildouts): Drive the end-to-end delivery of IT infrastructure and services for new office locations.

    • M&A Activities: Lead IT due diligence, Day 1 integration planning, and the full IT, identity, and network integration of acquired companies.

    • SEV and Incident Management: Support the coordination and management of critical incidents and ensure effective follow-up.

  • Be hands-on when needed, with the ability and willingness to contribute technically to delivery across endpoint setup, networking fundamentals, identity tooling, and documentation.

  • Define and maintain project standards, templates, and playbooks, such as office opening checklists and M&A integration runbooks, enabling the team to replicate successful project delivery.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in technical program or project management within IT, ideally across IT infrastructure, operations, or corporate IT environments.

  • Proven track record of managing a portfolio of concurrent technical projects across teams with different levels of seniority and expertise.

  • Hands-on IT background, with the ability to discuss and occasionally contribute to endpoint management, networking, identity (SSO/MDM), and automation topics.

  • Experience with at least some of the following: office openings and buildouts, workplace and IT infrastructure rollouts, M&A integrations, or DevOps-for-IT initiatives.

  • Strong command of project management methodologies, including Agile and traditional/Waterfall approaches, with a pragmatic mindset rather than rigid adherence to frameworks.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to write clear and concise status reports, run effective meetings, and communicate confidently with both business and technical stakeholders.

  • Strong stakeholder management and negotiation skills.

  • Highly organized, rigorous, and persistent, with a strong sense of ownership and a focus on seeing projects through to completion.

  • Fluent in English. French is a plus.

Bonus:

  • Previous experience as a Sysadmin, IT Support Technician, or Engineer before moving into program management.

  • Familiarity with project management tools such as Jira, Linear, Asana, and Notion, as well as ITSM tooling.

  • ITIL Foundation certification or similar.

  • Experience managing external vendors and integrators, including project budget tracking.

Gesucht wird kein reiner Support, sondern ein echtes Allround-Talent, das Systeme einrichtet, verbindet und am Laufen hält. Moderne KI-Tools sind dabei ein selbstverständliches Arbeitsmittel, etwa um Schnittstellen zwischen Logistikdienstleistern und dem ERP-System zu bauen, Prozesse zu automatisieren und Konfigurationen umzusetzen.

Aufgaben

  • Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung unseres Online-Shops auf Shopify, von der Bestellabwicklung bis zur Optimierung des Shops selbst

  • Konfiguration und Pflege des ERP-Systems sowie weiterer interner Systeme
  • Einsatz von KI-Tools zur Umsetzung von Automatisierungen und kleineren Programmieranpassungen
  • Einrichtung und Anpassung von Netzwerken, Geräten und Benutzerkonten
  • Unterstützung bei IT-Fragen im Tagesgeschäft, von der schnellen Fehlerbehebung bis zur Einrichtung neuer Hardware
  • Datenpflege und Datenabgleich in verschiedenen Systemen
  • Mitwirkung bei der Digitalisierung und Optimierung interner Prozesse

Qualifikation

Wichtiger als der formale Abschluss sind Ihre tatsächlichen Kenntnisse und Ihre Affinität zum Thema. Mehrere Wege passen gut zu uns:

  • Ein Studium der Wirtschaftsinformatik, mit dem Sie als Bindeglied zwischen Business und IT die Sprache beider Welten sprechen
  • Eine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker, ob in der Anwendungsentwicklung oder in der Systemintegration
  • Ein Quereinstieg mit ausgeprägter IT-Affinität und breitem Know-how über viele Bereiche hinweg

Darüber hinaus wünschen wir uns:

  • Grundverständnis von ERP-Systemen sowie ein gutes Gespür für Schnittstellen und Datenflüsse, etwa zwischen Logistikdienstleistern und dem ERP
  • Offenheit und Neugier im Umgang mit KI-Tools, die Sie aktiv einsetzen, um solche Schnittstellen und Automatisierungen umzusetzen
  • Erste Programmierkenntnisse sind von Vorteil, aber kein Muss
  • Eine strukturierte, zuverlässige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie Eigeninitiative im Umgang mit technischen Aufgaben

Benefits

  • Flexibles hybrides Arbeiten: Den Großteil Ihrer Arbeit erledigen Sie im Home-Office, ein bis zwei Tage pro Woche sind Sie bei uns in Paderborn vor Ort, vor allem wenn es um Hardware, Konfigurationen und den direkten Austausch geht
  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag in einem wachsenden, nachhaltigen Unternehmen
  • Vielseitige Tätigkeit mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum und Eigenverantwortung
  • Moderne Tools und die Freiheit, mit KI neue Wege auszuprobieren
  • Flache Hierarchien und direkte Kommunikation
  • Zukunftssicherer Arbeitsplatz in einer dynamischen Branche
  • Faire, leistungsgerechte Vergütung

Wir bei der Green TC GmbH setzen auf Teamarbeit, Eigenverantwortung und langfristige Zusammenarbeit. Wenn Sie technisches Verständnis mit organisatorischem Talent verbinden und Freude daran haben, Systeme nicht nur am Laufen zu halten, sondern aktiv besser zu machen, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

title: Junior Procurement Trader
descriptionHtml:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

What You Will Do

  • Make deals: negotiate prices, contracts and work closely with our Sales team to identify and seize market opportunities.

  • Establish and maintain international supplier relationships as part of our strategic procurement, purchasing a seven-figure trading volume per month.

  • Find new partners internationally, for example via trade shows or cold calls, and build these up into long-lasting relationships.

  • Resolve issues with internal and external stakeholders that block revenue.

  • Follow spot market trades, price dynamics and trends, and act on them at high speed.

  • Work with advanced AI tools that keep you a step ahead of the market.

Who You Are

  • You think like a trader. You like buying and selling and ideally have made money before, for example through trading, your own business, a side hustle or a sales role.

  • You want to win. You chase deals and results without waiting to be pushed.

  • You act fast. You decide and follow up.

  • You have a natural curiosity. You always ask how and why, and you learn fast from every conversation.

  • You are comfortable interacting with internal stakeholders and external parties in real-life meetings or (video) calls.

Background

  • You are fresh out of university, or you have a couple of years of work experience in a commercial role, for example sales or trading. Any industry works.

  • Self-employment, your own business or a side hustle is very welcome. We look for people who drive commercial value, understand trade and know how to create revenue.

Required Qualifications

  • You have a university degree.

  • You have strong analytical and negotiation skills, and can clearly articulate complex subjects with confidence and precision.

  • You bring a hands-on mentality: you take ownership, solve problems independently, and thrive in dynamic settings.

  • You are curious about AI and how it changes the way we trade.

  • German post: You speak German at C2 level (mandatory) and English fluently.

  • English post: you speak English fluently. Italian is a plus, and so is any other European business-fluent language.

What’s In It for You

  • Real ownership from day one - shape operational processes in a fast-scaling, AI-first company.

  • Learn from the best - work directly with senior operators, interact with skilled industry leaders and CEOs on a daily basis

  • Competitive compensation - attractive base salary and performance-based bonus program.

  • Personal growth & visibility - rapid learning opportunities, cross-functional exposure, and early leadership potential in a growing global team.

  • Vibrant company culture – modern Berlin office, monthly All-Hands, team events, and regular offsites.

Why Join

You’ll be joining a company that’s not only transforming a global industry but doing so with the speed, precision, and intelligence of AI.
Here, you won’t just manage supply chains - you’ll help redefine how global commerce operates.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength.

Compensation: €70K – €90K

title: Laser Architect (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Focused Energy is a fusion energy startup with the goal of generating unlimited clean energy to responsibly meet future global demand. With the use and commercialization of laser-induced inertial fusion, a clean and highly efficient power generation technology is coming within reach, suitable to ensure a secure and scalable future energy supply.

We are seeking a Laser Architect to join our dynamic laser development team. The Laser Architect is the system‑level technical lead responsible for the conceptual design, modeling, and experimental validation of laser driver architectures for inertial fusion energy (IFE) at the research and pre‑pilot stage.

This role focuses on defining and evolving credible laser driver concepts that can ultimately support fusion energy production, while operating primarily at the R&D and demonstrator level, where performance exploration, risk reduction, and physics‑driven trade studies dominate over industrial optimization.

The Laser Architect ensures coherence between laser physics, system architecture, and fusion requirements, guiding the transition from laboratory concepts toward scalable driver solutions. They enable the transition of inertial fusion energy from proof‑of‑principle laser experiments toward credible, scalable driver concepts, shaping the technical foundations on which future pilot plants and commercial systems will be built.

What you'll do:

  • Define and refine laser driver concepts suitable for IFE.

  • Explore alternative architectures and assess their feasibility through modeling and experiments.

  • Maintain ownership of the global architectural vision, even as individual subsystems evolve in parallel.

  • Define the laser R&D roadmap, including critical component development/evaluation, integrated beamline demonstrators, and intermediate testbeds

  • Work closely with experimental teams to ensure results feed back into architectural decisions

  • Support design of diagnostics and test protocols aligned with future scaling needs.

Who you are:

  • PhD or equivalent experience in laser physics, optical engineering, or related fields

  • Deep expertise in high‑energy and/or high‑average‑power laser systems

  • Strong background in laser system modeling and scaling analysis

  • Demonstrated experience in conceptual design and experimental validation of complex laser systems

  • Ability to operate across physics, optics, and systems‑level reasoning

  • Ability to bridge theoretical modeling and experimental reality

  • Operates as a system thinker with strong physics intuition

  • Comfortable exploring multiple architectural paths in parallel

  • Values quantitative modeling, experimental feedback, and iterative refinement

  • Communicates technical trade‑offs clearly to scientists, engineers, and leadership

What we offer:

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a subsidized canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

descriptionHtml:
What we’re all about.

It isn’t often you get to be part of a tech company that, since 2016, has been innovating the data analytics market in ways no-one else can. Our technology started out in FinTech, helping tackle serious criminal activity. Now, its potential is virtually limitless. Working at Quantexa isn't just intellectually stimulating. We’re a real team. Collaborating and constantly engineering better and better solutions. We’re ambitious, we think things through and we’re on a mission to discover just how far we​ can​ go. ​​​​​Nearly half​ of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. ​​We’re made up of people from 47 nationalities who speak over 20 languages. As a diverse mix of individuals, we make one big unstoppable team. We’re made up of people from 47 nationalities who speak over 20 languages. As a diverse mix of individuals, we make one big unstoppable team.

If our incredible culture sounds like you, we’d love you to join us.

The opportunity.

Our Quantexa Delivery team is all about bringing context to data. Technical Leads are drivers within our fast-paced delivery teams, implementing Quantexa’s innovative technology for an ever-expanding list of domains including banking, insurance, government, healthcare. We are problem solvers, delivering sophisticated end-to-end big data solutions to our internal and external client stakeholders. As a central part of our team, you will experience opportunities beyond that of an engineer. You will own the technical delivery of a project and the client’s trust in it. You enjoy leading by example, guiding and mentoring data engineers to solve complex technical problems, sharing success with the team and taking pride in achieving milestones together. You will balance your time engaging with our business teams and clients to break down requirements into technical tasks, working hands-on as a programmer, and supporting the work of other engineers within a collaborative environment.

The work you do here will be impactful. The challenges we tackle are big, but they're also incredibly rewarding. Your leadership in managing, transforming, and cleansing high volume data help our clients solve business problems across a wide range of areas including fraud, financial crime, data management, risk and customer intelligence.

What you’ll be doing.

  • You will lead, support, and mentor a team of junior data engineers within an agile framework.

  • You will own the technical delivery of a project, anticipating risks and issues, and make technical decisions that balance client needs, timescales and quality.

  • Write defensive, fault tolerant and efficient code for production level data processing systems.

  • You’ll configure and deploy Quantexa’s software, with our platform being hosted on both private and public virtual clouds, such as Google cloud, Microsoft Azure and Amazon.

  • You will set how your team uses AI coding tools, including review and testing standards for AI-generated work.

  • You will keep delivery focused on the value the client wants, working with partner and client engineers where they are part of the team.

  • You will be a trusted source of knowledge to your clients. You will articulate technical concepts to a non-technical audience helping them to make big decisions.

  • Collaborate with both our solution architects and our R&D engineers to champion solutions and standards for complex big data challenges. You proactively promote knowledge sharing and ensure best practice is followed.

What you’ll bring.

  • You’ll have a background in hands-on technical development, with typically six or more years of industry experience in a data engineering role or engineering equivalent, including at least two years of experience acting in a lead role within a data or software engineering team.

  • Proficiency in at least one programming language associated with data engineering, such as Scala, Python or Java. We believe that strong engineering principles are universal and transferrable.

  • You’ll have expertise building and deploying production level data processing batch systems maintained by application support teams. Importantly you’ll share an appreciation of what makes a high quality, operationally stable system and how to streamline all areas of development, release, and operations to achieve this.

  • Experience with a variety of modern development tooling (e.g. Git and build tooling) and technologies supporting automation and DevOps (e.g. Jenkins, Docker and a little bit of good old Bash scripting). You’ll be familiar with developing within a version-controlled process that regularly makes use of these tools and technologies.

  • The aptitude to pick up new technology quickly, and to help your team do the same. Technology in this field moves at a rapid pace.

  • Strong communication skills, with demonstrable experience of working with clients in rapidly changing environments to understand what they need.

  • Experience of delivering against a client’s success criteria, and keeping the project focused on the required value.

  • Knowledge of testing libraries of common programming languages (such as JUnit, pytest or equivalent). You’ll know the difference between different test types (unit test, integration test) and can cite specific examples of what you have written yourself.

  • Some of our work is for government and public sector clients. Experience delivering projects within Government or the wider Public Sector, particularly UK Central Government, would be advantageous.

  • Experience delivering data, analytics, AI, decision intelligence, financial crime, customer intelligence or public-sector projects would be advantageous.

  • Existing clearance to work within UK Government environments would be advantageous, with BPSS and ideally SC clearance.

Nice to haves.

  • Experience of setting standards for the use of AI tools in an engineering team.

  • Experience growing and up-skilling team members as a career mentor, technical line manager, or acting in an equivalent guidance role.

  • A passion for expanding the business – and leading initiatives to do so.

Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know - we’re happy to assist.

No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.

title: Lead Engineer - Travel FX App
descriptionHtml:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Lead Growth Marketing / Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d) - D2C E-Com
descriptionHtml:
Hast du schonmal gesehen, wie jemand beim Auspacken einer schön gestalteten Deko-Box die Augen leuchten lässt?

Hast du schonmal beobachtet, wie Menschen ihre ganz eigene Floristik-Kreation erschaffen und plötzlich Stolz und Freude auf einmal real werden?

Hast du schonmal ein Produkt in der Hand gehabt, das so durchdacht war, dass es Menschen einfach Lust macht, kreativ zu werden?

Ja? Nein?

Jeden Tag versuchen Menschen, ihre Wohnräume schöner zu gestalten — ohne professionelle Floristik-Kurse zu brauchen oder stundenlang Material zusammenzusuchen. Genau dafür entwickeln wir bei Flowers & Me wunderschöne DIY Deko-Boxen: durchdacht, inspirierend, einfach zum Selbermachen. Unsere Vision ist simpel: Wir wollen Menschen die Freude am Selbermachen leichter zugänglich machen und ihnen zeigen, dass sie selbst Designer ihrer Räume sind.

Und jetzt stehst du an einem Punkt, an dem deine Arbeit genau das möglich macht. Flowers & Me hat gerade erst begonnen. Wir skalieren von quasi Null auf 5 Millionen — und Performance Marketing ist der Hebel, der das möglich macht. Du baust das System, das uns von einer kleinen, ambitionierten Gründermarke zu einem europäischen Player entwickelt. Neue Märkte, neue Kundinnen und Kunden, exponentielles Wachstum.

Mit deiner Arbeit entscheidest du mit, ob Millionen Menschen die Freude am Selbermachen entdecken — oder ob sie es nie erfahren.

Aufgaben

Ja, wir zahlen fair, du arbeitest flexibel und hybrid, und du hast kurze Wege direkt zu Christian und unserem Gründerteam. Das ist für uns selbstverständlich.

Wichtiger ist: Du baust hier wirklich etwas – kein fertiges Setup, das du nur verwaltest. So gehst du es an:

  • Ownership: Du verantwortest Acquisition und Retention bei Flowers & Me und elvent und baust ein profitables, skalierbares Growth-System über den gesamten Funnel – mit klarem Fokus auf Wiederkauf, LTV und Brand-Wachstum.
  • Kanalsteuerung & Sparring: Du steuerst unser internes Meta-Team und unsere Google-Agentur strategisch, briefst, challengst und stellst Profitabilität sowie Wachstum sicher – ohne im Daily Doing zu versinken.
  • Strategie: Du entwickelst eine tragfähige Wachstumsstrategie inklusive Kanalpriorisierung, Retention-Hebeln, Testlogik und EU-Roadmap.
  • Brand & Community: Du baust eine konsistente Markenführung über alle Touchpoints (Ads, Newsletter, WhatsApp, Content) auf und entwickelst eine Community, die langfristig bei uns bleibt.
  • CRM & Retention (hands-on): Du baust Klaviyo-Flows, WhatsApp-/ChatArmin-Kanäle und Newsletter selbst auf und entwickelst sie weiter – Welcome, Post-Purchase, Winback, Replenishment, Cross-Sell und Reaktivierung mit messbarem Impact auf LTV und Wiederkaufrate.
  • Automatisierung: Du etablierst automatisierte Reporting- und Entscheidungsworkflows für schnellere, sauberere Performance-Entscheidungen über Acquisition und Retention hinweg.
  • KI-Einsatz: Du nutzt KI für Content-Produktion, Lokalisierung, Übersetzung und Lifecycle-/Creative-Workflows – mit Blick auf Qualität, Brand Fit und Skalierbarkeit über Märkte hinweg.
  • Leadership & Teamführung: Du führst das bestehende Marketing-Team (Meta-Spezialist, Videograf, Werkstudent) disziplinarisch, baust neues Personal auf und arbeitest direkt mit unserem Gründerteam an Unternehmenszielen, Budgetlogiken und Prioritäten.

Und ganz ehrlich: Das wird nicht nur bequem. Du wirst mit schnellwechselnden Trends, saisonalen Peaks, vielen Prioritäten und hohem Tempo umgehen. Nicht jedes Setup wird perfekt sein. Genau deshalb suchen wir dich – jemanden, der Klarheit schafft, Systeme baut und pragmatisch entscheidet.

Qualifikation

  • Bisherige Stationen: Du hast eine D2C-/Subscription-Brand idealerweise im Bereich 5–30 Mio. € Umsatz wesentlich mit aufgebaut bzw. skaliert und kannst konkrete Wachstums-, Retention- und Profitabilitätsbeispiele nennen.
  • Level: Du bist strategisch stark, bleibst aber hands-on. Du baust eine Roadmap und gehst trotzdem tief in Klaviyo, WhatsApp/ChatArmin, Newsletter, Reporting oder Briefings.
  • Meta & Paid Social (Steuerung): Du hast relevante Meta-Budgets gesteuert oder eng begleitet, kannst Creative-Testing-, Account- und Skalierungslogik auf Augenhöhe mit Spezialist:innen besprechen und challengen – ohne täglich selbst im Ads Manager zu sitzen.
  • Google / Shopping / PMax: Du bringst ein solides Verständnis für Search, Shopping, Feed-Qualität, PMax und Suchintention mit und kannst eine Agentur entlang klarer Profitabilitäts-KPIs sauber steuern.
  • Brand & Marketing Psychology: Du verstehst, wie Marken psychologisch aufgebaut werden, Community entsteht und Kund:innen langfristig bleiben – und übersetzt das in konsistente Tonalität, Story und Touchpoints.
  • CRM / Retention (hands-on): Du hast Klaviyo-Flows, WhatsApp/ChatArmin-Setups und Newsletter selbst gebaut und weißt, wie Welcome-, Post-Purchase-, Winback-, Replenishment- und Cross-Sell-Flows LTV und Wiederkaufrate konkret hebeln. GA4, GTM und CAPI sind für dich kein Nebenthema.
  • Mindset & Leadership: Du denkst unternehmerisch, priorisierst nach Impact, sprichst Klartext und übernimmst gerne disziplinarische Führung über ein bestehendes, kleines Team mit Spezialist:innen.
  • Sprachen: Mit sehr gutem Deutsch und Englisch steuerst du Kampagnen, Märkte und Lokalisierung sauber.

Bist du an Bord?

Benefits

  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit Homeoffice- und Remote-Möglichkeit nach Abstimmung
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Zusätzliche Urlaubstage
  • Mitarbeiterrabatte auf Flowers & Me Boxen (und wer liebt es nicht, selbst zu kreieren?)
  • Fitnessabo
  • Kostenlose Getränke und Snacks
  • Kostenloses Parken
  • Haustiere erlaubt

Also, bewirb dich noch heute

Wenn du Lust hast, Performance Marketing bei elvent und Flowers & Me nicht nur zu verwalten, sondern wirklich zu bauen, dann sollten wir sprechen.

Bewirb dich über unser Bewerbungsformular und hilf uns dabei, die Freude am Selbermachen noch mehr Menschen zugänglich zu machen.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Your profile

Machine Learning Engineer

Turba Labs · Heidelberg (Germany) or San Francisco Bay Area (USA) · On-site, hybrid or remote · Full-time · Candidates must live in Germany or the USA

A scheduling idea that works in a notebook is a rumor until it survives a client's cluster. Data centers now run mixed clusters of GPU generations, vendors and accelerators, and the software that schedules work on them was mostly built for uniform hardware. Turba Labs is building what replaces it, and it has to work on infrastructure we do not control.

Two products. The Scheduler runs live on our clients' infrastructure and decides which workload runs on which GPU, and when. The Simulator answers a related question before a data center spends a cent: given a planned build-out, what is the best way to use it? You make what we build reliable enough for a data center to depend on.

What you will own

  • Research to production. Take a validated idea into the Scheduler: design it, build it, test it, roll it out, monitor it, and own what happens after.
  • The ML platform's architecture. The decisions others build on, including when a learned approach earns its operational cost over a simple heuristic.
  • Training, evaluation and benchmarking pipelines. Every scheduling policy and performance model reproducible and comparable, so progress is measured, not argued.
  • GPU-level reality. Profile and optimize workloads and models on heterogeneous hardware, and feed what you measure back into the Simulator.
  • Safe failure. Guardrails, fallbacks and observability, so the system running on infrastructure we do not control degrades gracefully, never dramatically.
  • The interfaces. Clear contracts and release plans with the infrastructure and product engineers around you.

Who you are

title: Marketing Growth Engineer
descriptionHtml:
TL;DR:
We're looking for a full-stack engineer who wants to sit at the heart of Lovable's marketing engine - making every pound of spend measurable, and every manual workflow a tool. One sprint you're tracing spend from first click to revenue across Meta, Google and newer channels; the next you're shipping landing pages, experiments or an agent that saves the team hours a week. You think in React and APIs, but your first instinct is always: can we measure it, and does it help us grow faster?

Coding skills + excellent taste + growth instincts + marketing obsession = you.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What we’re looking for

  • Knowledge of Meta Pixel and Google Ad Network APIs, and experience working with data from ad networks. Experience with TikTok, LinkedIn, Reddit and Beehiiv, plus CTV/podcast tracking, is a plus.

  • Comfortable using data, funnels, analytics, attribution, and A/B testing to shape what you build and how you iterate.

  • Skilled at designing, measuring, and iterating experiments, and thorough in setting up growth systems "right" from the start.

  • Experience collaborating across functions (design, marketing, partnerships, support, data) to launch and grow new product surfaces and ecosystems.

  • Enjoys designing reusable growth, ecosystem, and monetization tools that other builders can plug into, with a pragmatic and detail-oriented mindset.

  • Motivated by helping others succeed and by seeing impact through engagement, measurable results, and revenue - you care about the scoreboard as much as the code.

What you’ll do

In one sentence: You'll sit between marketing and engineering and build whatever we need to grow faster, from the site and tracking to the tools the team uses every day - expect to be driving the thinking here alongside our team leads.

  • Build the tools marketing runs on: Find the manual work slowing the team down and replace it with tools, automations or agents, ideally built on Lovable.

  • Shape what gets built: Work with design, marketing, data and partnerships to decide what's worth doing, then own it end to end.

  • Own how we measure marketing: Make sure every pound of spend can be traced from first click to revenue, across Meta and Google and newer channels like CTV and podcast. This is what lets us scale spend with confidence.

  • Make experimentation cheap & fast: Build the events, funnels and A/B testing setup that let the team test an idea in days and double down on what works.

  • Turn the website into a growth surface: Ship landing pages, signup flows and first-run moments that get new users to value fast, without waiting in a product queue.

  • Keep it Lovable: Growth should feel like part of the product, never bolted on.

Our tech stack

We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:

title: Medior/Senior Full Stack Developer
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to work in a dynamic environment where your code really makes a difference? Are you a passionate developer who enjoys tackling complex technical challenges?

Join the Customer Champions team and create a world-class app in which all the value of the Momo platform comes together. Help us create reusable, and above all, user-friendly components and interactions that make caregivers love the app.

Who is Momo?

Momo Medical is a fast-growing and ambitious scale-up, tackling one of the biggest societal challenges: the future of elderly care. Over the next decade, demand for care is expected to double, while 30% of the current workforce is projected to retire. Our innovative solutions aim to reduce the pressure on healthcare workers while improving the quality of care for residents.

The most valuable aspects of the role

🚀 Your work defines the way caregivers interact with the app as well as how it looks. All while staying in very close contact with them to understand exactly what they need.

⚓ Work together with many teams, such as production, customer success, and hardware, to translate real-world problems into reliable software.

💛 You contribute to better care for nursing home residents and help reduce the workload for healthcare professionals.

📍 You’re available 32 - 40 hours per week and happy to spend at least 4 days per week with the team in Delft.

🎊 Thursday pizza nights, Friday drinks, team activities, travel allowance, pension plan, and plenty of growth opportunities that match your ambitions.

Your key responsibilities

As part of a multidisciplinary team you will work on innovative solutions that have a direct impact on healthcare professionals in the Netherlands and abroad. You will have the opportunity to develop your skills, specialize or grow into a team leader role. You can work on the front-end or the back-end, or even better: both!

Your key responsibilities include:

  • Maintain and improve the connection between business logic and UI in our Flutter app by employing Bloc and Clean Architecture.

  • Design, build, and maintain TypeScript services that drive the app to thousands of phones simultaneously. .

  • Design event-driven systems that provide the app with the freshest data possible

  • Automate manual workflows and improve reliability through observability, testing, and CI/CD.

  • Mentor teammates, set technical direction, and help prioritize the roadmap.

Who are you?

  • You have an advanced skill set of Flutter, Node, and TypeScript,backed by a track record of delivering full-stack features end-to-end in fast-paced environments.

  • You validate your features with automated tests, ranging from unit-tests to fully automated widget tests and end-to-end tests.

  • You’re comfortable modelling data and tuning performance in relational databases such as PostgreSQL.

  • A good level of English is required, and it is a plus if you can speak Dutch.

  • You enjoy collaborating with colleagues across the company and keeping multiple initiatives moving forward.

  • You’re available 32–40 hours per week and happy to spend at least four days a week with the team in Delft.

Why join Momo Medical?

Because you want to make a difference in healthcare at home and abroad. Because you are excited about a fast-growing scale-up where no two days are the same. And because you want to work with young, enthusiastic and talented international colleagues who all work hard to make healthcare a little bit better every day.

  • Salary: €4,000–5,000 (medior) or €5,000–6,000 (senior) per month based on 40 hours, plus 8% holiday allowance.

  • 30 vacation days per year to pick your own holidays (celebrate Christmas, Eid Al-Fitr, or any other holiday of your choice!).

  • Hybrid working, and a laptop of your choice.

  • Pension plan and travel reimbursement

  • Guided mentorship and clear paths toward tech lead or specialist roles.

  • Provided lunches, weekly company drinks and dinners, and regular team and company events.

  • Reimbursement of travel expenses and a pension plan

Good to know

Tech at Momo

At Momo, we use the following tools: Flutter, Swift, Kotlin, JavaScript, React, TypeScript, Express, Vitest, Node, PostgreSQL, Docker, Testcontainers, GitHub, and AWS.

What are the next steps?

First, we’ll review your CV and motivation to get a sense of how you are and to envision how you might fit within our team. After that, you’ll receive a short take-home assignment that helps us understand how you think, and you get insights into the kind of work we do at Momo. The next step is a chat at our offices in Delft, where we can go more in-depth on the role, the team and the Momo culture. Then, as a final exploration, you’ll have the chance to spend a work-along day with us to experience a day at Momo and to meet more people working on the same mission. When both you and we see the match, we’ll share an offer and start the onboarding process so you can join us in supporting caregivers!

title: Merchant Risk Analyst

This is a high-impact role where you directly protect Mollie's financial stability and reputation. This work is critical to safeguarding our platform integrity, ensuring our merchants and customers can trust Mollie as a secure and reliable payments provider.

You will be expected to conduct proactive and reactive fraud investigations, moving beyond simple alert validation to interpret complex fraud scenarios and uncover emerging risks. What you'll bring

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

title: Mid Market Account Executive - DACH
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:
Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $2.1B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers. While many in the tech scene are scaling back, our DACH team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from €10k to €300k, selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded, this is the place.

Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in Germany or London, UK, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis).

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role you will:

    • Own your destiny: Operate as a pure revenue leader, responsible for 80-90% net-new logo acquisition through self-sourced pipeline.
    • Get In Early: The DACH Mid-Market is a high-achieving segment in the company. The window to build something significant is open right now.
    • Sharpen Your Edge: Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer.

Minimum Requirements for the role:

  • Winning DNA: Minimum 18 months+ closing experience in an outbound-heavy SaaS environment. You must have a proven history of building your own pipe from scratch.
  • Over-achievement: A track record of hitting and exceeding quota in a competitive, complex environment
  • Strategic Grit: Experience managing multi-stakeholder deal cycles and technical POCs. We value your ability to hunt
  • Native German language speakers

Advantageous:

  • Intellectual Curiosity: You are eager to learn the inner workings of diverse industries, from waste management to food distribution, to better align our technology with their operational pain.
  • A Repeatable Sales Framework: You don't rely on luck or intuition. You have a structured methodology that delivers success and you understand that consistent, high-quality inputs lead to predictable results.
  • A Data-Minded Approach: You are a student of your own funnel. You understand how to structure your activity—prospecting volume, discovery depth, and multi-threading—to ensure a consistent output and forecast accuracy.
  • Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You are someone who actively seeks feedback, iterates on their approach, and understands that evolving your tactics is the only way to stay ahead of the market.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

title: Modelling Resident
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Most AI is frozen in place - it doesn’t adapt to the world. We think that’s backwards. Our mandate is to build efficient intelligence that evolves in real-time. We bring together exceptional people with the drive and creativity to push the boundaries of continual adaptation. We’re looking for builders and creative thinkers ready to shape the next era of intelligence.

Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in accountability, initiative and shared success. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. We operate with low egos, high velocity, and extreme ownership to build technology that expands access and benefits the many, not the few.

How We Work

  • Impact over activity: We are building a generational company. We value people who execute on ideas rather than comment from the sidelines. We believe our competitive edge lies in caring about excellence across the entire lifecycle - from research to product. No task is beneath anyone: no one is too senior to test the build, clean the data, or unblock a teammate.

  • Vulnerable, low-ego collaboration: We believe exceptional work comes from people who challenge, support and push one another to think bigger. Rapid iteration requires stepping into discomfort. We encourage bold, half-baked, and unorthodox ideas. When we disagree, we share feedback directly, never through side channels.

  • Celebrate decisively: Extraordinary effort should be deeply memorable. We celebrate milestones generously and publicly - via spot bonuses, team dinners, spontaneous gifts, and company-wide recognition - to fuel each other for the next sprint.

The Role

Our vision is AI systems that are flexible, adaptable, and accessible to everyone. We believe efficiency is what makes this possible. It’s how we expand access and ensure innovation benefits the many, not the few.

A modelling residency puts you in the center of a frontier lab. You'll be embedded in real work: placed on key production and research projects and mentored directly by our modelling team. We're building our frontier innovation around efficiency, gradient-free exploration, real-time learning, and interface design. By the end of this 8-month residency, our hope is that you leave with a track record you're proud to put on your resume and experiences that meaningfully upskill you.

What You'll Do

  • Innovation: Build the future of adaptive algorithms that continuously learn. Co-design algorithms that react in real-time to product signal and feedback, and explore new ways of capturing feedback that make those algorithms better

  • Cross-stack optimization: Collaborate across software, hardware, and algorithmic domains to drive system-wide efficiency gains

  • Measure what matters: We believe the ultimate signal of value is real-world impact. The smartest algorithm is one capable of interacting with the world — that's why product signal matters so much to how we work.

 

Skills You'll Bring

We look beyond traditional markers of experience. What matters most to us is what you’ve built and the impact you’ve had. We value demonstrable output, curiosity and alignment with our core values:

  • A degree or equivalent research/engineering experience in a computer science field.

  • Genuine interest in, and at least one project touching: model efficiency, synthetic data, interfaces, real-time alignment, or algorithmic optimization

  • Systems thinking — the ability to understand and optimize across the full ML stack

  • Strong Python skills and experience with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow)

  • Familiarity with model optimization techniques such as RLHF and fine-tuning

  • Strong communication and self-awareness — you know how to collaborate in a remote environment and you're open to feedback

  • You care about technical excellence and last mile impact. We value impact more than effort, and about owning outcomes end to end.

We value impact over credentials. Above all, we're looking for great teammates who make work feel lighter and aren't afraid to go out on a limb with bold ideas. You don't need to check every box - but you do need to be adaptable.


What We Offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: A dynamic environment with opportunities to take on new challenges, expand your responsibilities, and make an impact beyond your immediate role.

  • Adaption Passport: An annual travel allowance to explore somewhere new, experience different cultures and keep expanding your horizons. It can be used to travel to any country you haven’t previously been to.

  • Lunch on us: A weekly allowance for takeout or grocery delivery, wherever you are in the world. Whether it's stocking your fridge or having dinner delivered, it’s one less thing to think about.

  • Comprehensive benefits: High-quality medical coverage and benefits designed to support your health and well-being.

  • Team offsites and visits to SF HQ: We're a global team, but believe there's real value in spending time together in person. We regularly bring teammates together at our SF HQ and for team offsites in locations around the world, including London, Mexico City, and New York.

title: Navigation Engineer (Precise Navigation)
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As a Navigation Engineer within our Precise Navigation team, you will design and develop high-precision navigation and positioning solutions based on tightly-coupled IMU/GNSS filtering, improving localisation accuracy, integrity, and robustness to jamming and spoofing for our autonomous systems – from concept to field deployment. You will work hand-in-hand with the Navigation and Radar teams, as well as software and Electronic Warfare (EW) teams, to deliver robust, resilient Position, Navigation and Timing (PNT) and ensure overall performance, robustness and reliability.

Responsibilities

  • Navigation Architecture: Drive the architecture and implementation of navigation / PNT solutions for autonomous platforms.

  • Resilient PNT: Develop navigation resilient to GNSS degradation, jamming and spoofing (anti-jam / anti-spoof).

  • Sensor Fusion: Design multi-sensor fusion (GNSS, INS/IMU, RF, vision) and the associated estimation and filtering algorithms.

  • Testing & Validation: Design test plans (e.g. GNSS receiver testing in jamming environments), run simulations and replays, and report on findings and performance against targets.

  • Technical Coordination: Collaborate across HW, software, EW and ML teams on technical interfaces and system-level trade-offs.

  • System Reviews & Documentation: Contribute to design and architecture reviews and maintain requirements traceability and documentation.

Candidate Requirements

  • MSc in Engineering (aerospace, robotics, EE or related); PhD is a plus.

  • Strong mathematical background combined with good physical intuition.

  • Experience with GNSS, INS/IMU and navigation/estimation filters (e.g. Kalman filtering), particularly in tightly-coupled architectures.

  • Experience with navigation in GNSS-denied / contested environments.

  • Familiarity with RF and EW constraints (GNSS jamming / spoofing) is a plus.

  • Solid software / algorithm skills; combined algo + software profile rather than a pure coder.

  • Broad engineering culture with understanding of electrical, embedded and mechanical systems.

  • Rigorous, structured and mission-driven mindset with strong analytical skills.

  • Excellent communication and documentation abilities.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

Lieu de travail : Douai (59)

Description de l’IMT Nord Europe :

École sous tutelle du ministère de l’économie, des finances et de la souveraineté industrielle et numérique, IMT Nord Europe est née en 2017 de la fusion de Télécom Lille et de l’École des Mines de Douai. Elle compte aujourd’hui parmi les plus Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs au Nord de Paris avec plus 2200 élèves, dont un quart d’apprentis, plus de 600 diplômés par an et un réseau de 15 000 diplômés. Elle fait partie de l’Institut Mines Télécom, premier groupe public de Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France, et est partenaire de l’université de Lille.

IMT Nord Europe a 3 missions principales : former des ingénieurs responsables aptes à résoudre les grandes problématiques du XXIème siècle ; mener des recherches débouchant sur des innovations à haute valeur ajoutée ; soutenir le développement des territoires notamment en facilitant l’innovation et les créations d’entreprises. Son objectif est de former les ingénieurs de demain, maîtrisant à la fois les technologies numériques et les savoir-faire industriels. Idéalement située au carrefour de l’Europe, à 1 heure de Paris, 30 minutes de Bruxelles et 1H30 de Londres, IMT Nord Europe a l’ambition de devenir un acteur majeur des grandes transformations industrielles, numériques et environnementales du XXIème siècle en combinant, tant dans ses enseignements et que dans sa recherche, les sciences de l’ingénieur et les technologies du digital.

Localisée sur 2 sites principaux d’enseignement et de recherche, à Lille et à Douai, IMT Nord Europe s’appuie sur plus de 20 000 m² de laboratoire pour développer un enseignement de haut niveau et une recherche d’excellence dans les trois domaines « Systèmes Numériques », « Energie Environnement » et « Matériaux et Procédés ».

Pour plus de détails, consulter le site internet de l’École : www.imt-nord-europe.fr

Contexte scientifique et missions :

Le développement de capteurs autonomes en énergie pour l'Internet des objets (IoT) représente un défi scientifique et technologique majeur. Dans ce contexte, les technologies de récupération d'énergie constituent des solutions prometteuses pour convertir différentes sources d'énergie présentes dans notre environnement (mécanique, thermique, solaire, électromagnétique, etc.) en énergie électrique.

Le projet européen THERMOHARV, réunissant l'Université de Mons, l'Université de Lille, le C2DE et l’IMT Nord Europe, ambitionne de développer une nouvelle génération de microgénérateurs thermoélectriques organiques (OTEG), flexibles et performants, capables de convertir directement la chaleur fatale en énergie électrique. Ces dispositifs pourraient notamment contribuer à l'alimentation de capteurs autonomes dans les bâtiments, les centres de données ou les environnements industriels.

Dans ce cadre, le Centre d'Enseignement, de Recherche et d'Innovation Matériaux & Procédés (CERI MP) d'IMT Nord Europe développe des encres fonctionnelles à base de nanotubes de carbone, présentant des propriétés thermoélectriques. Ces encres sont déposées sur des substrats polymères flexibles grâce à un procédé innovant de fabrication additive par écriture directe (Direct Ink Writing, DIW).

L'enjeu scientifique consiste à maîtriser les interactions entre la formulation des encres, leur imprimabilité et les performances thermoélectriques des dispositifs obtenus afin de concevoir des générateurs optimisés.

Dans ce contexte, les missions scientifiques et technologiques confiées à la personne recrutée seront les suivantes :

  1. Formulation des encres : développer et optimiser des encres thermoélectriques à base de nanotubes de carbone, notamment en étudiant l'influence des conditions de dispersion sur leurs propriétés.

  2. Caractérisation physicochimique : étudier les relations entre la formulation, l'état de dispersion des nanotubes de carbone et les propriétés rhéologiques des encres.

  3. Optimisation du procédé d'impression : identifier les paramètres d'écriture directe permettant d'obtenir des dépôts homogènes, reproductibles et présentant une géométrie maîtrisée.

  4. Conception et optimisation des dispositifs : modéliser l'influence de la géométrie des générateurs sur leurs performances thermoélectriques.

  5. Fabrication et caractérisation d'un prototype fonctionnel : concevoir, fabriquer et évaluer les performances d'un prototype de générateur thermoélectrique flexible.

Ce stage permettra ainsi de participer à l'ensemble de la chaîne de développement d'un dispositif fonctionnel, de la formulation des matériaux jusqu'à la validation expérimentale d'un prototype, au sein d'un environnement de recherche collaboratif.


Profil de la personne recrutée :

La personne recrutée devra être étudiante en Master 2, en dernière année d’école d’ingénieurs ou suivre une formation équivalente dans le domaine de la science et du génie des matériaux, de la physicochimie ou du génie des procédés.

Des connaissances en formulation et dispersion d’encres, notamment par ultrasons, en fabrication additive (impression 3D, écriture directe) ainsi qu’en caractérisation des matériaux (rhéologie, goniométrie, profilométrie) seront particulièrement appréciées. Une expérience ou des connaissances dans le domaine de la thermoélectricité constitueront un atout supplémentaire.

Au-delà des compétences techniques, la personne recrutée devra faire preuve de rigueur scientifique, d’autonomie, de curiosité et d’un intérêt marqué pour la recherche expérimentale. De bonnes capacités d’analyse, de synthèse et de communication scientifique, tant à l’écrit qu’à l’oral, sont également attendues.

As an Operations Manager at Harmattan AI, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth and reliable functioning of our operations. Requirements

  • Comfortable working autonomously in a fast-growing environment with high expectations.
