Please note, you must be currently residing in the UK to be considered for this role.

 

Our mission:

Two in five people in the UK rent their homes. Our mission? To be the gold standard platform for renting.

We started Goodlord because we wanted to make renting simple and transparent for everyone involved: the agent, the landlord, and the tenant. We knew Generation Rent would lead to more tenants, with higher digital expectations and we were confident we could provide a solution

Like all scale-ups it’s been a bit of a rollercoaster journey, but we’re now stronger than ever, with around 3,000 letting agents using the platform, exciting and varied products and 320+ Goodlordians across the group supporting the mission!

The Opportunity:

We're looking for someone who loves digging into data, spotting trends and turning insights into meaningful improvements. Sitting within our Referencing team, you'll analyse performance, customer trends and risk indicators to help us understand what's working, where things could be better and how we can make smarter decisions.

You'll work closely with teams across Referencing, Insurance, Compliance, Operations and Product, using tools like SQL and Google Sheets to investigate challenges, uncover opportunities and make recommendations that have a real impact.

This is more than just reporting numbers. We're looking for someone who is naturally curious, takes ownership of their analysis and isn't afraid to challenge the status quo or bring forward ideas. You'll play an important part in improving our processes, strengthening controls and enhancing the customer experience.

In a nutshell, you'll be:

  • Analysing data to spot trends, risks and opportunities across Referencing.

  • Investigating the root causes behind issues, including fraud, insurance claims and customer experience.

  • Building reports that help teams understand performance and make informed decisions.

  • Turning complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Working with stakeholders across the business to drive improvements.

  • Taking a proactive approach to identifying problems and finding better ways of working.

What we need from you:

You should apply if you have:

  • Experience in an analytical role, ideally involving operational, risk or customer data

  • Strong Google Sheets skills, and confidence working with SQL

  • A track record of turning data into clear insight and going a step further to recommend action

  • Comfortable working independently, prioritising your own work, and knowing when to escalate or flag something

  • Confident engaging with stakeholders across different teams and functions, and can adapt how you communicate depending on the audience

  • A naturally curious mindset - you ask why something is happening, not just what happened

  • Strong attention to detail and comfort working with large, often messy datasets

  • Structured thinking, able to break down ambiguous problems into something workable

Why you'll love being a Goodlordian

Aside from the role, the people, our culture and our mission, we have some other things that make Goodlord a pretty awesome place to be. Here’s a few favourites amongst Goodlordians (check out our careers page for more info).

  • Grow with Goodlord: your development is important to us, that’s why we are Great Place to Work - certified. Have a goal in mind? Share it with us so we can use some of our annual development fund to support it. We guarantee you’ll learn loads and develop both personally and professionally!

  • Your well-being matters: bi-weekly coaching with Sanctus to provide Goodlordians with a safe place to talk and support your mental health

  • 25 days holiday (plus UK Bank holidays) plus 1 day per full holiday year up to 32 days: We believe regular breaks are essential for well-being and we encourage (some may say expect!) all Goodlordians to take full advantage of their annual leave entitlement.

  • Supporting your family: we offer Goodlordians of all genders a generous 3 months of fully-paid time off to look after their new arrivals

  • Our team: we’re an energetic, sociable, and talented bunch who are super passionate about what we do and determined to make a difference. We’re all in it together, we learn from each other, we’re genuine and we don’t have time for politics

What’s next?

If you’re ready to help us on our mission to be the gold standard platform for renting, then click apply (2-3 minutes)!

A full job spec is available on request.

Goodlord wants applicants from all backgrounds and walks of life; we are an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment.

Creating a space where everyone feels included is central to who we are. Because we're an open book and we learn from each other, we actively champion diverse perspectives and unique life experiences. If there is anything you need to participate fully in the interview process, we'd love to hear about that too - please include it in your application.


** Please note, as we are regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority, all Goodlordians are required to pass a thorough referencing check via Experian before joining the team. We will only ask for references at the point of making an offer.

No agencies please - we have tried and trusted partners we would turn to should we require support.

title: Organic Growth & Content Manager
descriptionHtml:
Organic Growth & Content Manager (m/f/d)

Your Mission

Make Cosuno the leading digital authority in the construction industry.

Cosuno is the AI construction platform connecting the European construction industry. We're transforming one of Europe's largest and still largely analogue industries through technology, proprietary data and artificial intelligence.

As our Organic Growth & Content Manager, you'll make Cosuno impossible to overlook, wherever our customers search, learn and form opinions. From Google and AI assistants to industry publications, social media and professional networks, you'll establish Cosuno as a trusted source of knowledge and innovation.

You'll own our organic growth and content strategy, turning our unique market data, customer expertise and technological innovation into a competitive advantage. Your ambition goes beyond generating traffic: you'll build industry authority, create demand and turn visibility into measurable business growth.

You'll join just in time for our biggest marketing project of the year, our website relaunch, and become one of the first members of a growing marketing team, with significant freedom to shape how we operate.

What you'll do

Build an industry-leading content strategy

  • Content strategy & editorial direction: Develop a unified content strategy informed by customer needs, search demand, industry trends and commercial priorities.

  • Thought leadership: Establish Cosuno as an authoritative industry voice through original research, market intelligence, whitepapers, industry reports and expert perspectives, leveraging our proprietary construction data.

  • Customer references & storytelling: Build a strong portfolio of customer success stories, case studies and testimonials that demonstrate measurable value and strengthen credibility.

  • Content distribution: Build a scalable content ecosystem that repurposes and distributes content across our website, blog, LinkedIn, newsletters, trade media, partner channels and sales enablement.

  • Editorial excellence: Manage freelance writers and external contributors, ensuring consistent quality, relevance and brand positioning across all formats.

Own organic visibility across search and AI

  • On-site SEO: Own our organic website performance, including technical SEO, content architecture, landing pages, Marketplace pages and programmatic SEO.

  • Off-site SEO & digital PR: Build domain and brand authority through backlinks, editorial placements, industry publications, relevant directories, guest contributions and strategic content partnerships.

  • AI search (GEO & AEO): Establish Cosuno as a frequently referenced and recommended source across AI-powered search engines and assistants, optimizing both our own content and our presence across external sources.

  • Website relaunch: Own the SEO strategy, requirements and migration alongside our website agency, turning the relaunch into a significant organic growth opportunity.

Build a scalable organic growth engine

  • AI-powered execution: Work with our GTM & Growth Engineer to automate research, content production, optimization, distribution and reporting without compromising quality.

  • Experimentation: Explore new content formats, data-driven landing pages, interactive tools and distribution opportunities. Scale what generates measurable results.

  • Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Demand Generation and industry experts to ensure content creates value across the entire customer journey.

  • Performance & measurement: Track organic visibility, AI search presence, engagement, qualified sign-ups, demo requests and pipeline contribution.

Until our Partnerships & Social Manager joins in mid-2027, you'll also oversee our organic LinkedIn presence and founder communications, establishing the editorial foundations for future collaboration.

What you bring

We're looking for someone who combines the analytical mindset of a growth marketer with the editorial judgment of a content strategist.

  • Organic growth expertise: You've owned SEO and content strategy in B2B SaaS or a digital marketplace, with measurable impact on acquisition or pipeline.

  • Strong SEO fundamentals: You're experienced in technical, on-page and off-page SEO, including website migrations and scalable content architectures.

  • AI search expertise: You understand GEO, AEO and the role of external sources, brand authority and structured content in AI-generated recommendations.

  • Content strategy experience: You've built editorial strategies across formats and channels, including thought leadership, customer stories and research-led content.

  • Editorial excellence: You write exceptional German, develop compelling narratives and know how to turn complex topics and proprietary data into accessible, authoritative content.

  • Distribution mindset: You understand that great content is only valuable if it reaches the right audience. You're comfortable building media relationships and content partnerships.

  • Analytical mindset: You're proficient in Search Console, GA4, Semrush or similar tools and measure success beyond traffic and rankings.

  • AI-first mentality: You leverage AI and automation to increase output and quality, rather than relying on manual execution.

  • Ownership: You're proactive, comfortable with ambiguity and excited to build a function from the ground up.

  • Native-level German and fluent English.

Your Benefits

  • Room to shape and grow: Build our organic growth and content function from the ground up, including our upcoming website relaunch.

  • Unique data and stories: Access proprietary construction market data and industry expertise with the potential to set the agenda for an entire industry.

  • AI at the core: Work with the latest AI technologies and dedicated engineering support to bring ambitious ideas to life.

  • Competitive compensation: Above-market salary and a permanent contract in a stable, well-funded technology company.

  • Flexibility: Fully remote or from our Berlin Kreuzberg office, with flexible working hours.

  • Top equipment: A new MacBook Pro and access to the tools you need.

  • A great team: An ambitious, international team with regular off-sites, team events and an open feedback culture.

About Cosuno

Construction is one of the world's largest industries, yet much of it still runs on fragmented information, spreadsheets and manual processes.

We're changing that.

Cosuno combines an intelligent marketplace, proprietary industry data and artificial intelligence to transform how construction companies find partners, manage tenders and award contracts.

Join us and help shape the voice of the future of construction.

Compensation: €60K – €75K

title: Outbound Account Development Representative - France
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive.

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business, generating opportunities via outbound outreach.

We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara's mission.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and Linkedin
  • Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.
  • Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling
  • Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles
  • 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum
  • Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
  • Curious and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and fluent in French

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in closing-sales roles
  • Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

ADR pathways

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.

  • ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.
  • The next level in the program is ADR II, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.
  • The highest level within our organization is ADR III. These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Package Reliability Engineer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

The Role

We are seeking a Package Reliability Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will own the reliability of our packaged products, from defining mission profiles and reliability targets to identifying package-level failure mechanisms, developing qualification strategies, and making evidence-based release recommendations.

Reporting to the Quality & Reliability Program Lead, you will work closely with the Package Architecture, Device Reliability, Product Engineering, and OSAT/laboratory partners to translate product use cases into mission profiles and FIT/MTBF targets. You will assess reliability risks, define and execute package-level reliability test plans, lead failure analysis activities, and ensure findings are driven to resolution.

Your core focus will be to transform product requirements into robust reliability strategies, validate package concepts through targeted stress testing, and provide data-driven recommendations that enable confident product release.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Own mission profiles and reliability targets by defining product operating conditions (temperature, voltage, humidity, thermal cycling, and lifetime requirements) and allocating FIT, MTBF, and lifetime targets across package, interconnect, and device-level contributors.

  • Assess package reliability risks by evaluating failure mechanisms across substrates, die attach, interconnects, solder joints, board attach, and optical/fiber interfaces, including delamination, warpage, fatigue, electromigration, and optical or electrical drift.

  • Define and execute package reliability qualification plans covering thermal, mechanical, environmental, and board-level stress testing in accordance with JEDEC, AEC-Q100/Q006, IPC, IEC, and customer-specific requirements.

  • Lead the technical interface with OSATs, substrate suppliers, and labs, defining reliability requirements, reviewing data, and challenging results when the supporting evidence is insufficient or unrepresentative.

  • Drive root-cause investigations and failure analysis, leveraging techniques such as X-ray, C-SAM, cross-sectioning, SEM/EDX, and related methods, and translate findings into CAPA/8D actions, design improvements, and requalification decisions.

  • Develop risk-based qualification strategies for novel packaging technologies, such as UBC and optical interconnects, where industry standards are incomplete or do not yet exist.

  • Provide data-driven release recommendations by assessing whether products are ready for customer sampling, qualification milestones, or production release, while clearly communicating any remaining reliability risks.

Your Qualifications

  • Educational background with a Master's degree (or equivalent experience) in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Materials Science, Reliability Engineering, or a related field.

  • Package reliability expertise with 3–5+ years of experience evaluating semiconductor package construction (substrates, die attach, interconnects, and solder joints) and understanding the failure mechanisms associated with these technologies.

  • Understanding of high-speed I/O and RF reliability, including how reliability degradation impacts high-speed serial, RF, and optical interfaces (e.g., signal integrity, insertion loss, jitter, and eye closure over product lifetime). This expertise goes beyond conventional digital logic reliability and is a core requirement for this role. Experience with photonics reliability is highly desirable.

  • Solid foundation in reliability engineering, including FIT and MTBF calculations, mission profile development, acceleration models, and translating product use cases into measurable reliability requirements and targets.

  • Experience with industry qualification standards, including JEDEC, AEC-Q100/Q006, IPC, and IEC, as well as the judgment to apply knowledge-based qualification approaches when existing standards are not sufficient.

  • Failure analysis expertise, with the ability to interpret results from techniques such as X-ray, C-SAM, cross-sectioning, and SEM/EDX, and translate findings into risk-based recommendations.

  • Experience collaborating with OSATs, substrate suppliers, and external laboratories, including defining technical reliability requirements, reviewing qualification data, and driving technical discussions to ensure robust evidence for product qualification.

  • Excellent cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate reliability risks, trade-offs, and evidence gaps to architects, engineers, suppliers, and leadership.

  • Thrives in a startup environment, demonstrating initiative, ownership, adaptability, and the ability to make progress in a fast-paced, resource-conscious setting.

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

Can you picture yourself in this Role and our Company? Let’s connect!

title: Payments Optimization Consultant
descriptionHtml:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

You'll identify high-impact opportunities to improve payment performance by analysing merchant data, transaction trends, and industry benchmarks.

  • Identify opportunities to improve payment performance through merchant data, transaction trends, and industry benchmarks.

  • Build and refine payment optimisation methodologies and playbooks that help Airwallex stay ahead of industry developments.

  • Lead deep-dive conversations with enterprise merchants about payment performance, acting as a trusted strategic advisor to improve transaction outcomes.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to develop optimisation levers, including AI- and machine-learning-powered approaches to smart routing, cost reduction, and payment success.

  • Translate merchant feedback and frontline insights into product roadmap recommendations.

  • Enable Sales and Account Management teams with practical payment optimisation knowledge, tools, and training.

  • Build relationships with external stakeholders, including card issuers and payment networks, to improve the end-to-end payment experience.

You'll work from our London office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 5+ years of experience in payments, with strong knowledge of e-commerce, card-based processing, and payment optimisation.

  • Strong understanding of card network rules, local payment methods, and regulatory requirements such as PSD2 and PSD3.

  • Strong analytical skills and experience using data and business intelligence tools to identify opportunities and explain performance trends.

  • Experience turning complex analysis into clear recommendations for both technical and commercial audiences.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with confidence engaging enterprise clients and senior stakeholders.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Sales, and Account Management teams.

  • A self-directed approach and the ability to make progress in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

  • Intellectual curiosity and a practical approach to solving complex customer and payment problems.

Preferred

  • Experience with BI and data platforms such as Looker, Power BI, Tableau, or Databricks.

  • Experience working with payment optimisation, smart routing, fraud mitigation, or transaction success-rate improvement.

  • Experience engaging directly with card issuers, payment networks, or other global payments stakeholders.

  • Experience creating standardised methodologies, playbooks, or enablement programmes for commercial teams.

You'll thrive here if

  • You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

  • You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

  • You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

  • You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.

Learn more about your team

Merchant Services at Airwallex is made up of two teams: Solutions Engineering and Technical Support, working together to turn customer-facing technical work into product progress. Across both teams, we help businesses design, integrate, launch, optimize, and scale on Airwallex's global financial infrastructure, covering solution architecture, delivery, technical account management, optimisation, and support.

The mandate is simple: solve for the customer in front of us, and build for the customers we haven't met yet. Sitting close to Product, Engineering, and Design means the patterns you see in real customer integrations can become better APIs, documentation, tooling, onboarding paths, and product capabilities. The hard part is doing both at once: shipping for today's customer without losing the signal that improves the product for the next.

This is a team for people who can earn trust with builders, reason through complex systems, communicate clearly, and stay grounded in commercial outcomes. If you want to work at the intersection of agentic finance, customer impact, and product development, this is where your work compounds.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. descriptionHtml:
About myTomorrows 

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.   

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.   

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection.   

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business.  

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

The opportunity: People Business Partner

As a People Business Partner at myTomorrows, you are a trusted advisor to senior leaders and the Leadership Team. In this Individual contributor People Business Partner role, you will translate business priorities into practical people solutions that enable high performing teams and organizational growth.

You will partner closely with leaders across the organization to strengthen leadership effectiveness, organizational design, performance, engagement, and talent development. You enjoy balancing strategic thinking with hands on execution and are comfortable navigating the pace, ambiguity, and opportunities of a fast growing international scale up.

Given that most of our team is located in the Netherlands, we only consider candidates who live within commuting distance of our Amsterdam office.

What you'll do in this role:

  • Partner with senior leaders and Leadership Team members on organizational design, workforce planning, team effectiveness, and organizational health.

  • Coach leaders on performance management, leadership effectiveness, feedback, development, and difficult people conversations.

  • Lead complex employee relations cases, including performance improvement, conflict resolution, absence management, and sensitive exits.an

  • Drive and continuously improve key People programs, including performance management, engagement, talent reviews, succession planning, and career development.

  • Translate business strategy into practical People initiatives that support organizational growth and scalability.

  • Use people data and insights to identify trends, challenge assumptions, and recommend actions that improve engagement, retention, and organizational performance.

  • Partner closely with Talent Acquisition and People Operations to deliver an outstanding employee experience across the entire employee lifecycle.

  • Ensure consistent application of People policies, employment legislation, and People practices across your business areas.

  • Lead cross functional People projects that improve organizational effectiveness, manager capability, and operational excellence.

  • Act as a trusted sparring partner who balances strategic thinking with hands on execution.

What you bring to the table:

  • At least 5 years of progressive HR experience or experience as a People Business Partner in a fast growing international organization.

  • Demonstrated experience partnering with senior leaders on organizational and people topics.

  • Extensive experience managing complex employee relations, performance management, and organizational change.

  • Strong coaching, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Solid knowledge of Dutch employment law and HR best practices.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate people data into actionable business insights.

  • Comfortable operating independently, making sound judgments, and managing competing priorities.

  • Experience working in a technology, SaaS, HealthTech, or scale up environment is highly preferred.

  • Experience with modern HR systems such as Personio is a plus.

  • Experience supporting international teams is a plus.

What we offer:

  • Serve a purposeful mission by helping patients gain access to potentially lifesaving treatments.

  • International work environment with scale up energy and a flat organization.

  • Competitive salary, annual performance bonus, and equity.

  • Great career development opportunities in a growing company.

  • Learning and development budget alongside internal knowledge sharing sessions.

  • Attractive pension plan with the full premium covered by us.

  • Hybrid working model.

  • Policies that support working parents.

  • Healthy lunch at the office.

  • Unlimited access to professional guidance by certified psychologists through OpenUp.

  • An additional holiday every year to celebrate Liberation Day on May 5.

Equal opportunities

myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. The best work comes from our best selves, and we go to great lengths in supporting our team members to be just that.

title: Performance Marketing Manager - Meta Ads / Senior Media Buyer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:

  • Du fährst Sales-Events wie die Black Week mit sechsstelligem Budget eigenverantwortlich.

  • Du hast auf Meta sechsstellige Monatsbudgets selbst gesteuert, idealerweise für eine E-Commerce-Brand oder in einer Performance-Agentur.

  • Du arbeitest genau und triffst mutige Budgetentscheidungen, wenn es ums Skalieren geht.

  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und gutes Englisch.

In Peakphasen wird auch am Wochenende in den Account geschaut. Das ist deine Verantwortung, die Zeit gleichst du unter der Woche wieder aus.

Benefits

  • Rund 500.000 € Ad-Spend im Monat, Tendenz steigend. Du fährst den Account ab Tag eins selbst.

  • Corporate Benefits.

Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Beantworte uns stattdessen zwei Fragen: Was war das größte Monatsbudget, das du auf Meta selbst gesteuert hast, wo und wie lange? Und was war dein bester Skalierungsschritt, was hat er gebracht?

Tabea und das Valkental-Team freuen sich auf dich!

title: Photonics Packaging & Cryogenic Integration R&D Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry.
Its offerings include a very energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers.
Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components.
Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.
Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Description of the Team/Project

We are looking for a Photonics Packaging & Cryogenic Integration Engineer to contribute to the development and industrialization of our photonic quantum systems.

You will work on the integration of single-photon sources, photonic integrated circuits and optical/electromechanical assemblies, with a strong focus on miniaturization, automation and operation under cryogenic conditions.

This is a highly hands-on role at the intersection of photonics, electronics, mechanics, automation and experimental physics.

You will contribute across the full development cycle: design, prototyping, assembly, testing, optimization and transfer toward industrial-scale production.

Your Key Responsibilities:

    • Design and develop packaging and integration solutions for photonic and quantum devices.
    • Integrate single-photon sources, photonic integrated circuits and optical components into complete systems.
    • Develop and optimize optical coupling strategies, including fiber coupling and direct chip-to-chip integration.
    • Design, build and assemble precision positioning and alignment systems, including nano-positioning stages and multi-axis platforms.
    • Develop experimental setups operating under cryogenic conditions, typically in the 2–4 K range.
    • Design mechanical parts and assemblies using CAD tools.
    • Contribute to electronics development, including PCB design, instrumentation and control systems.
    • Automate alignment, test and characterization processes using Python, C++, Rust or similar programming languages.
    • Work with microcontrollers, FPGA-based systems or other hardware-control architectures when relevant.
    • Build, test and iterate rapidly on prototypes, including using 3D printing and other rapid prototyping techniques.
    • Perform test and measurement activities to characterize system performance and identify failure modes.
    • Contribute feedback to the design of photonic chips and single-photon sources based on integration and testing results.
    • Support the transition from laboratory prototypes to repeatable and scalable manufacturing processes.
    • Document designs, experiments, procedures and lessons learned, and actively share knowledge within the team.

Requirements

What we're looking for:

You should ideally bring:

  • A PhD in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, applied physics, condensed matter physics, solid-state physics, optics, photonics or a related field.
  • Strong hands-on experience building and testing scientific or high-precision equipment.
  • Experience with photonics, optomechanics, semiconductor devices, cryogenics or precision engineering.
  • Familiarity with optical alignment, fiber coupling and/or photonic packaging.
  • Experience with mechanical design and CAD tools.
  • Good understanding of electronics, instrumentation and test equipment.
  • Programming skills in Python, C++, Rust or similar languages for automation and hardware control.
  • Experience working with multidisciplinary systems combining optics, mechanics, electronics and software.
  • Strong experimental problem-solving skills and the ability to iterate quickly from concept to prototype.
  • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to produce clear technical documentation and collaborate in an international environment.

Nice to Have

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be particularly valuable:

  • Cryogenic systems and experiments at very low temperatures.
  • Photonic or optoelectronic packaging.
  • Chip bonding, indium bump bonding or related micro-assembly techniques.
  • Pick-and-place systems or automated precision assembly.
  • Nano-positioning and multi-axis motion control systems.
  • Robotics or computer vision.
  • FPGA or microcontroller development.
  • PCB design using KiCad or similar tools.
  • Finite-element simulation using tools such as ANSYS or COMSOL.
  • Semiconductor or quantum photonics environments.

More than a specific academic background, we are looking for someone who enjoys building complex scientific systems and solving problems directly at the hardware level.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience
  • Company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer:

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one

title: Platform Engineer (GoLang)
descriptionHtml:

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebratingour wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

Are you a creative problem solver who can both give and receive feedback? Do you lead with inclusion, collaboration, and openness? Do you have strong experience with high-scale B2B and B2C platforms?

As a Platform Engineer, you'll be crafting and helping build the next generation of the Anaplan Platform. You’re comfortable with both full-stack systems design for the hybrid cloud as well as hands-on distributed systems programming with extensive knowledge of Java, JVM, Rust, Linux internals and container orchestration.


The Role
We're looking for experienced engineers who've built real products at scale and apply that same rigor to platform engineering. You'll engineer new platforms as products, not just operate existing infrastructure. You understand user experience, reliability, and technical debt from shipping production systems. You'll design platforms that are extensible, observable, and maintainable, enabling internal teams to build on top of them while handling the complexity underneath.

Your Impact

Kubernetes Engineering & Automation
You don't just write Helm charts or YAML manifests; you extend the Kubernetes API.

  • Custom Operators: Proven ability to write Kubernetes Operators (using Kubebuilder or Operator SDK) to manage complex, stateful application lifecycles.
  • Control Plane Logic: Deep understanding of reconciliation loops, custom resource definitions (CRDs), and how to automate operational knowledge into code

Scalable Microservices & Distributed Systems
You build for high concurrency, low latency, and eventual consistency.

  • High-Scale SaaS: 10+ years of experience building and operating production-grade SaaS products. You have first-hand experience with the "death by a thousand cuts" that
    comes with scaling to millions of requests.
  • Systems Programming: Advanced proficiency in Go, Rust, or JVM-based languages, with a focus on writing memory-efficient and thread-safe code.

Deep-Tier Cloud Storage & Persistence
You understand the physics of data.

  • Storage Internals: We need more than S3 API knowledge. You should understand the performance characteristics, limitations, and cost-drivers of S3, NFS, and enterprise
    storage like NetApp OnTap or AWS FSx.
  • Data Locality: Experience managing data persistence across hybrid environments (Public Cloud vs. Private DC).

Operational Maturity (The "SRE" DNA)
You believe that "if it isn't monitored, it doesn't exist."

  • Instrumentation: Expert-level experience with OpenTelemetry. You don't just look at metrics; you design the telemetry that allows for deep-dive distributed tracing and root-cause analysis.
  • Observability Infrastructure: Hands-on experience scaling Prometheus and Grafana to
    handle high-cardinality data.


Your Skills
· Strong experience in Golang programming
· Proven experience in building and working with CRDs and Operators.
· Proven cloud experience using observability and operating workloads in Kubernetes.
· Experience with cloud storage S3, NFS, NetApp OnTap, AWS FSX
· Distributed Systems and programming techniques.
· Monitoring and metrics infrastructure (OTEL, Prometheus, Grafana).
· Cloud (AWS / GCP/ Azure / Private DC).
· Bonus: Experience with AI/ML, Natural Language

Technologies you’ll work with:
· Programming languages: GoLang, Java11, Kotlin, Rust, Python
· Storage & Persistence: S3, NFS
· Container and Orchestration: Kubernetes/Containers (Docker)/Rancher RKE
· Cloud providers: AWS, GCP, Azure, Private Data Centers
· Observability/Telemetry: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana
· Deployment: Jenkins, ArgoCD

title: Praktikum Product Marketing (x/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Gesundheitsversorgung der Zukunft 

Doctolib sucht Dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als Praktikant:in im Bereich Product Marketing  für unseren Standort in Berlin. 

Als Teil des Product Marketing Teams bei Doctolib trägst du dazu bei, innovative Lösungen für das Gesundheitswesen noch wirkungsvoller zu machen. Unser Ziel ist es, die Markteinführung neuer Produkte strategisch zu steuern und sicherzustellen, dass unsere Angebote echten Mehrwert für Gesundheitsfachkräfte und Patient:innen schaffen. Wir denken den gesamten Weg von der Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Platzierung am Markt mit – immer mit dem Anspruch, die Digitalisierung im Gesundheitswesen voranzubringen und nachhaltige Veränderungen zu ermöglichen.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Praktikant:in unterstützt Du uns dabei in folgenden Aufgabenbereichen: 

  • Du wirkst sowohl strategisch als auch operativ bei der Einführung der neuen Praxismanagement Software 

  • Du analysierst die Bedürfnisse unserer Nutzer:innen entlang der Customer Journey und hilfst uns, unsere Value Delivery und Kundenzufriedenheit gezielt zu steigern

  • Du unterstützt die Umsetzung unserer Go-to-Market-Strategie für verschiedene Kundensegmente und neue Produktfeatures

  • Du beobachtest Markt- und Wettbewerbslandschaften, analysierst technische und regulatorische Entwicklungen und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen für unsere Produkt- und Unternehmensstrategie ab

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Produktteams, dem Vertrieb und weiteren kundennahen Abteilungen zusammen und stimmst Dich cross-funktional ab

Während Deiner Tätigkeit bei uns wirst Du:

  • Einblicke in die Vorbereitung und Umsetzung eines Product Launches gewinnen und aktiv mitgestalten

  • Go-to-Market-Strategien und Product Marketing im B2B SaaS- und Marketplace-Umfeld kennenlernen

  • Die Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen erleben und verstehen, wie innovative Lösungen gemeinsam erfolgreich am Markt platziert werden

Dein Profil

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen!

Um Teil unseres Teams zu werden, bringst Du Folgendes mit: 

  • Du befindest dich in einem mindestens fortgeschrittenen Bachelorstudium eines wirtschaftswissenschaftlichen Studiengangs,  oder hast dieses bereits abgeschlossen und hast Lust, Deine Kenntnisse in einem 6 monatigen Praktikum einzubringen

  • Du hast bereits erste relevante Praxiserfahrungen gesammelt, idealerweise in einem ebenfalls dynamischen und schnelllebigen Umfeld wie Consulting, SaaS oder VC

  • Analytisches Denken liegt Dir und Du hast Freude daran, komplexe Sachverhalte zu durchdringen, aber Du packst auch gerne mit an und möchtest konkrete Ergebnisse sehen

  • Du gehst strukturiert und lösungsorientiert an Aufgaben heran und behältst auch bei mehreren Projekten parallel stets den Überblick

  • Du verfügst über fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (jeweils min. C1)

Besonders interessant sind für uns außerdem: 

  • Erfahrungen aus Beratung, Start-ups oder vergleichbaren Tätigkeitsfeldern

  • Interesse oder erste Erfahrungen im Gesundheitswesen

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Ein strukturiertes und individuelles Onboarding im Rahmen unserer Doctolib Academy sowie ein breites Angebot an firmeneigener Trainingsprogramme

  • Ein von Doctolib gesponsertes Deutschlandticket oder die Übernahme Deines Semestertickets

  • 28 Urlaubstage im Jahr (anteilig auf Deine Arbeitszeiten berechnet)

  • Ein flexibles Arbeitsmodell, das hybrides- und Office-basiertes Arbeiten ermöglicht

  • Regelmäßige Frühstücksangebote im Büro, sowie Bezuschussungen zu Deinem Lebensmitteleinkauf

  • Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club

Der Interviewprozess

  • Interview mit Deiner Managerin

  • Interview und Case Study mit Deiner Managerin und einem Teammitglied

Job Details

  • Praktikum (Vollzeit, 40h / Woche) 

  • Tätigkeitsdauer: 6 Monate

  • Arbeitsort: Berlin

  • Gehalt: 1900€ / Monat (Pflichtpraktikum), 2425€ / Monat (freiwilliges Praktikum)

  • Startdatum: zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt

  • Arbeitsmodus: Hybrid (3 Tage / Woche)

 

Wir verfolgen die Vision, die Gesundheit aller zu verbessern. Dies spiegelt sich auch im Recruiting wider. Wir evaluieren Bewerbungen ausschließlich auf der Grundlage von Qualifikation und Motivation. Diskriminierung wird bei uns nicht toleriert.

Je diverser unser Team und die Ideen sind, desto mehr wird unser Produkt die Gesundheit unserer Nutzer:innen verbessern können. Deshalb laden wir dich ein, dich bei uns zu bewerben, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Religion, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer Herkunft oder Behinderung. 

Um Chancengleichheit zu gewährleisten, kannst Du in deiner Bewerbung auf Angaben wie Fotos, Alter, etc. verzichten. Lass uns bitte wissen, welche Vorkehrungen wir treffen können, um Dich bestmöglich zu unterstützen. Wir freuen uns, mit Dir das Gesundheitswesen zu digitalisieren!

IDnow is a leader in digital identity and fraud prevention in Europe with a mission to transform trust into the most powerful asset in the digital world, empowering enterprises with AI-driven, SaaS-based identity solutions that deliver scalable security, adaptive compliance, and real-time fraud prevention.Through its broad portfolio of digital identity and fraud prevention solutions, IDnow establishes, maintains and enriches trust throughout the customer journey, ensuring businesses can confidently and securely operate while leveraging digital identity to drive growth, security and scalability.

Its portfolio of international clients spans a wide range of end markets including financial services, telecommunications, travel & mobility, gaming, and other industries.

When you provide the right information, the Sales Manager closes the deal.

We are looking for a Solution Sales Specialist to help our sales teams win higher-value, more complex deals. You will own the solution and value narrative across the entire sales cycle - not just feed information to the Sales Manager - and partner with Account Executives as a co-pilot on qualification, discovery, and the business case. title: Principal Backend Engineer - Java
descriptionHtml:
Principal Backend Engineer – Java

Location: London (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Technology & Engineering | Type: Permanent

Architect the next generation of financial platforms. Lead with Java expertise. Deliver impact at scale.

The Role

We’re looking for a Principal Backend Engineer (Java) to lead the architecture, design and delivery of secure, scalable, cloud-native platforms for global financial services clients.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of complex engineering challenges, influence technical direction and shape the standards that underpin high-performing backend systems. You'll combine deep Java engineering expertise with strong architectural judgement, a security-first mindset and the ability to guide engineering teams through critical technical decisions.

Working with Tier 1 financial institutions, you'll challenge assumptions constructively, balance architectural trade-offs and ensure solutions deliver lasting value through reliability, performance, security and maintainability. You'll also play a key role in developing engineering talent, promoting technical excellence and strengthening Capco's engineering capabilities.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead backend architecture and engineering delivery, designing and developing secure, scalable cloud-native applications using Java 11+ and Spring Boot, while taking ownership of technical quality, reliability and long-term maintainability.
  • Architect distributed systems and cloud solutions, guiding the development of microservices and event-driven architectures on public cloud platforms, preferably AWS, and making informed decisions across performance, resilience, security and scalability.
  • Shape technical strategy and engineering decisions, constructively challenging architectural approaches, evaluating technical risks and trade-offs, and aligning engineering solutions with enterprise strategies and measurable client outcomes.
  • Champion engineering excellence and responsible innovation, embedding test-first development, automated quality controls and continuous improvement. Where appropriate, use approved AI-assisted engineering tools to support code analysis, test generation and technical documentation, with human validation, security safeguards and established governance controls.
  • Lead, coach and develop engineering teams, mentoring developers, guiding delivery processes, strengthening engineering standards and influencing technical practices across Capco to deliver consistent, high-quality outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven principal-level engineering capability, with experience leading the design and delivery of complex, enterprise-grade backend systems and establishing high standards for software quality.
  • Strong architectural judgement, with the ability to assess complex technical challenges, evaluate competing approaches and make informed decisions across security, scalability, reliability and maintainability.
  • A security-first engineering mindset, with experience identifying technical risks, embedding appropriate controls and ensuring security considerations inform architecture and delivery decisions.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership, including the ability to manage, mentor and develop engineering teams, influence technical strategy and guide decisions across multiple stakeholders.
  • A collaborative and commercially aware approach, with the confidence to challenge assumptions constructively, communicate complex technical decisions clearly and connect engineering priorities to client objectives and practical business outcomes.

Technical Skills & Experience

You'll bring deep hands-on expertise and architectural experience across the following essential technologies and engineering practices:

  • Java & Spring Boot: Expertise in Java 11/17+ and Spring Boot, with extensive experience designing, developing and delivering enterprise-grade backend applications and AWS-based cloud solutions.
  • Microservices & Distributed Architecture: Proven experience architecting secure, scalable services using microservices and CQRS patterns, including distributed and event-driven system design.
  • CI/CD, Data & Messaging: Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines, SQL and NoSQL databases, Kafka, CloudFormation and streaming frameworks, supporting reliable enterprise software delivery.
  • Security Engineering: Advanced understanding of system security protocols and controls, including OAuth, Identity and Access Management (IAM), TLS and encryption, with the ability to apply security-first principles to backend architecture.
  • Technical Leadership & Strategy: Demonstrated capability to manage and mentor engineering teams, lead technical decision-making, establish engineering standards and drive technology strategy across complex delivery environments.

Bonus Points For

  • Contributions to thought leadership, mentoring initiatives or Requests for Proposal (RFPs) within consulting or technology environments.
  • Hands-on experience with GitLab CI/CD, Cucumber and Behaviour Driven Design (BDD).
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect certification (Associate or Professional).
  • A history of delivering large-scale, customer-facing applications.
  • A passion for experimenting with emerging tools, technologies and approaches within backend engineering.

Why Join Capco

  • Deliver high-impact technology solutions for Tier 1 financial institutions.
  • Work in a collaborative, flat, and entrepreneurial consulting culture.
  • Access continuous learning, training, and industry certifications.
  • Be part of a team shaping the future of digital financial services.
  • Help shape the future of digital transformation across FS & Energy.

Benefits

We offer a competitive, people-first benefits package designed to support every aspect of your life:

  • Core Benefits: Discretionary bonus, competitive pension, health insurance, life insurance and critical illness cover.
  • Mental Health: Easy access to CareFirst, Unmind, Aviva consultations, and in-house first aiders.
  • Family-Friendly: Maternity, adoption, shared parental leave, plus paid leave for sickness, pregnancy loss, fertility treatment, menopause, and bereavement.
  • Family Care: 8 complimentary backup care sessions for emergency childcare or elder care.
  • Holiday Flexibility: 5 weeks of annual leave with the option to buy or sell holiday days based on your needs.
  • Continuous Learning: Your growth, your way - minimum 40 Hours of Training Annually. Take your pick; workshops, certifications, e-learning. Also, Business Coach assigned from Day One: Get one-on-one guidance to fast-track your goals and accelerate your development.

Inclusion at Capco

We’re committed to making our recruitment process accessible and straightforward for everyone. If you need any adjustments at any stage, just let us know – we’ll be happy to help. We value each person’s unique perspective and contribution. At Capco, we believe that being yourself is your greatest strength. Our #BeYourselfAtWork culture encourages individuality and collaboration – a mindset that shapes how we work with clients and each other every day.

title: Principal Consultant - Strategic Infrastructure Advisory
descriptionHtml:
About Infrata

Infrata, part of dss+, is a specialist infrastructure advisory business of around 100 people working with investors, lenders, owners, operators and governments across transport, aviation, maritime, energy, digital infrastructure and the energy transition.

Our reputation is built on technical and commercial due diligence: fast, rigorous, independent work on the assets and businesses our clients are buying, financing or operating. We are now building on that base to offer clients strategic advice across the full life of an asset, not only at the point of transaction.

Why this role

Infrata has strong technical expertise and established client relationships. We are looking for someone who can help us build on these strengths by developing new consulting services, winning work and leading projects.

You will work with our technical specialists to identify where clients need advice beyond due diligence, develop services we are well placed to deliver, and take them to clients. You will also lead the projects you win, bringing in specialists as needed.

Your impact at Infrata

The role has three main responsibilities: developing services, winning work and leading delivery.

  • Develop services. Work with clients and colleagues to identify problems we have the expertise to address but do not currently advise on. Develop services we can deliver consistently, with a clear scope, team, price and evidence of their value.

  • Win work. Introduce these services to existing and new clients, lead proposals and presentations, and secure new projects.

  • Lead delivery. Lead the projects you win, agreeing the approach, managing the client relationship and team, and taking responsibility for the quality of the advice. Our due diligence specialists will contribute their expertise; you will be responsible for the overall engagement.

Key accountabilities

Service development

  • Understand the team's expertise and identify opportunities to offer advisory services beyond due diligence.

  • Test ideas with clients before investing in their development, and focus on those with genuine demand.

  • Define the client need, approach, team, fees and deliverables for each service, supported by evidence of our experience.

  • Build the supporting material: credentials, case studies, proposal templates, pitch decks.

  • Identify opportunities to sell Infrata's data and analytical tools as products or recurring services, and assess whether they are commercially viable. You will establish what clients would pay for and work with our data and technology colleagues to develop it; you are not expected to build the technology yourself.

Business development

  • Carry a personal sales target for new strategic advisory work (target to be agreed at offer).

  • Build and maintain relationships with decision-makers at investors, lenders, operators and public bodies.

  • Identify opportunities, qualify them, and write or lead proposals and pitches.

  • Work with sector leads to extend existing due diligence relationships into advisory work.

  • Keep the pipeline and client records in our systems current.

Engagement leadership

  • Act as lead consultant on engagements you win: scope, plan, staff, budget, and deliver.

  • Define the questions the project needs to answer and the analysis required. Take responsibility for the conclusions and final recommendations.

  • Manage the client relationship day to day, including scope changes, difficult messages and sign-off.

  • Run the project team, including specialists drawn from across Infrata and dss+, and give them clear briefs and feedback.

  • Deliver high-quality work on time and within budget, building client confidence and opportunities for further work.

Building the team's consulting capability

  • Coach due diligence staff who work on your engagements in consulting skills: problem structuring, client handling, writing for decision-makers, presenting.

  • Set clear standards for strategic advisory proposals, workplans and deliverables, and apply them in your own work.

  • Help improve resourcing, time recording, project management and cash collection across Infrata.

Service areas in scope

The role covers four service areas. You should have the experience to lead projects in at least one of these areas and be comfortable selling services across all four.

Strategy
You will advise owners, operators, developers and public bodies on areas including market entry and growth strategy, asset and portfolio strategy, business planning, governance and assurance, policy and regulatory positioning, and investment case development.

Value creation
Working primarily with private equity and infrastructure fund investors and their portfolio companies, you will lead engagements such as full-potential reviews, 100-day plans, operational and commercial improvement programmes, exit readiness and portfolio performance reviews.

Climate advisory
You will support investors, lenders and operators with decarbonisation roadmaps, climate risk and resilience assessments, transition planning, sustainability strategy, and ESG and climate reporting.

Data and digital services
You will help investors, lenders, operators and public bodies get greater value from data. This could include turning existing traffic, asset, transaction and benchmark data into advisory products or subscription services, using AI tools to accelerate analysis and delivery, and helping clients make better use of their own data.

Most projects will combine Infrata's knowledge of aviation, maritime, roads, rail, energy and digital infrastructure with dss+ expertise in operations, safety and sustainability.


Who you are

Essential experience

  • At least eight years in management consulting, strategy consulting or advisory, including substantial experience in infrastructure. A background in project finance, lender's or investor's technical advisory, or assurance would help you understand our clients' needs and how our team works.

  • Experience leading strategy, value creation or climate advisory projects, with responsibility for the engagement rather than an individual part of the work.

  • Direct experience of winning work: writing proposals, pitching, negotiating scope and fees, and converting relationships into revenue.

  • Experience developing or launching a new service, product or practice area, including on a small scale.

  • Experience leading mixed teams of generalists and technical specialists.

Desirable

  • Hands-on experience of project finance, due diligence or technical assurance on infrastructure transactions, and of the lenders, investors and sponsors involved.

  • Experience working with private equity or infrastructure fund investors on portfolio companies.

  • Sector depth in one of aviation, maritime, roads, rail, energy or digital infrastructure.

  • Climate, decarbonisation or sustainability advisory experience.

  • Experience commercialising data, analytics or digital products within a professional services business.

  • A second European language, or experience working with teams in Spain, Latin America or Canada.

Capabilities

  • Can make sense of complex or poorly defined problems and explain them clearly.

  • Writes and presents for senior decision-makers.

  • Exercises sound commercial judgement on project costs, fees and which opportunities to pursue.

  • Comfortable with technical detail without needing to be the technical expert.

  • Uses AI and data tools confidently and understands when they are useful for clients and when they are not. Technical development skills are not required.

  • Works well with technical specialists, including those new to consulting, earning their trust and helping them contribute effectively.

title: Principal Software Engineer - Security
descriptionHtml:
What You'll Do

As a Principal Software Engineer - Security, you will help set the technical direction for Radiant's security capabilities across the cloud platform and infrastructure, leading the design and delivery of the systems that underpin them.

You'll work across identity, access control, secrets, network security, platform hardening, auditability, and compliance controls. You'll partner closely with product, infrastructure, SRE, networking, security, and compliance teams, and with customers on their most demanding security requirements.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on making security embedded, scalable, automated, and easy to consume across the platform, through architecture, code, and the standards other teams build on.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Set the technical vision and architecture for security systems and platform capabilities, and lead their design and implementation.

  • Design and build core security services across IAM, RBAC, workload identity, secrets, encryption and key management, audit logging, network controls, and policy enforcement.

  • Translate product, customer, and regulatory requirements into robust architectures, APIs, and technical designs, working closely with the Security Product Manager.

  • Drive automation of policy enforcement, configuration hardening, detection, remediation, and software supply chain security.

  • Ensure strong tenant isolation and least-privilege access across the control plane and network and data plane.

  • Act as a senior technical voice in enterprise customer security reviews, audits, and incident response.

  • Raise the security engineering bar across the organisation through mentoring, code review, and technical standards.

 

Your Profile

  • Strong hands-on engineering skills in one or more systems languages such as Go or similar.

  • Extensive experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems, with significant depth in cloud and network security, IAM, or security infrastructure.

  • A track record of technical leadership at staff or principal level, including setting direction across multiple teams and delivering complex, high-stakes systems.

  • Deep technical expertise across:

  • Identity & access: IAM, RBAC/ABAC, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, SSO, federation, mTLS, workload and service identity

  • Security controls: applied cryptography, encryption at rest and in transit, secrets management, KMS/HSM, key rotation, policy engines

  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes internals, containers and runtime isolation, cloud networking, compute, storage

  • Security operations: audit logging pipelines, detection engineering, vulnerability management, incident response

  • Automation: policy-as-code, infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD security, software supply chain (signing, SBOMs, provenance)

  • Hands-on experience with technologies such as Vault, OPA/Gatekeeper, SPIFFE/SPIRE, Kubernetes admission control and security tooling, Sigstore, SIEM platforms, cloud KMS, or similar.

What You Bring

  • Technical leadership: Influence direction across teams without relying on authority, and grow the engineers around you.

Qualities we look for:

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.
