title: Privacy & AI Officer
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij bijdragen aan een organisatie die in control is op het gebied van privacy en verantwoorde inzet van AI? En weet jij wet- en regelgeving te vertalen naar duidelijke processen en praktisch advies? Als Privacy & AI Officer help je afdelingen zorgvuldig om te gaan met persoonsgegevens en AI-risico’s tijdig te herkennen. Je adviseert, coördineert, bewaakt en rapporteert. Zo maak jij het verschil voor onze leden, collega’s en de continuïteit van Univé Zuid-Nederland!

Wie ben jij?

Je bent een toegankelijke professional met een passie voor privacybescherming en verantwoorde AI-governance. Je hebt een scherp oog voor risico’s en verbindt beleid, processen en praktijk op een natuurlijke manier. Met jouw analytisch vermogen en zorgvuldige oordeelsvorming help je de organisatie risico’s tijdig te herkennen en beheersen. Je schakelt makkelijk met collega’s, management en andere belanghebbenden en maakt complexe onderwerpen helder en praktisch.

Daarnaast breng je mee:

  • Hbo+ werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in een juridische richting.

  • Diepgaande kennis van de AVG, privacywetgeving en relevante wet- en regelgeving.

  • Praktische kennis van de AVG en ervaring met bijvoorbeeld DPIA’s, datalekken of privacyprocessen.

  • Kennis van en interesse in AI-governance, AI-beleid, de AI Act en het beheersen van AI-risico’s.

  • Ervaring met het implementeren en bewaken van beleid, regelingen en processen.

  • Sterk analytisch vermogen, zorgvuldige oordeelsvorming en resultaatgerichtheid.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om belanghebbenden mee te nemen.

Wat ga je doen

Als Privacy en AI Officer ondersteun je afdelingen bij het naleven van de AVG, het Univé privacybeleid en het AI-beleid. Maar pak je ook (pro-)actief zelf activiteiten op in het kader van dit aandachtsgebied. Je hebt een spilfunctie in het vroegtijdig onderkennen en beheersen van privacy- en AI-risico’s. Je adviseert je collega’s in de eerste lijn, coördineert de implementatie van beleid en zorgt voor het onderhoud en de naleving van privacy-instrumenten en processen.

Daarnaast registreer, coördineer en beheer je AI-toepassingen, AI-risico’s en relevante beheersmaatregelen. Je helpt bij AI-use cases, naleving van wet- en regelgeving en verantwoord gebruik en rapporteert hierover. Ook speel je een actieve rol in beleidsontwikkeling en advisering. Je volgt wijzigingen in wet- en regelgeving en vertaalt deze naar de praktijk. Zo help je Univé Zuid-Nederland om aantoonbaar in control te blijven. Het zwaartepunt van de functie ligt bij privacy, waarmee jij vanuit de eerste lijn waarde toevoegt in dit domein. AI speelt daarin een aanvullende rol en er is ruimte om je hierin verder te ontwikkelen, net als de organisatie dat doet. Je adviseert niet alleen: je helpt ook zelf bij de uitvoering waarbij je samenwerkt met de eerste lijn business owners. Juist die combinatie maakt deze functie afwisselend en zichtbaar waardevol voor de organisatie.

Hieronder een greep uit jouw werkzaamheden:

  • Je helpt afdelingen bij privacy, AVG, AI-beleid en relevante wet- en regelgeving.

  • Je coördineert de implementatie, naleving en doorontwikkeling van beleid en processen.

  • Je registreert, coördineert Privacy- en AI-risico’s en zorgt voor opvolging en borging van de (beheers)maatregelen.

  • Je signaleert risico’s, ontwikkelingen en verbeterkansen en vertaalt deze naar duidelijke acties.

Wat wij bieden

Een veelzijdige functie van 32 uur per week met directe lijnen naar de bestuurder, ruimte voor eigen initiatief en mogelijkheden om je professioneel te ontwikkelen. Je werkt aan onderwerpen die ertoe doen voor onze leden en collega’s, binnen een coöperatieve organisatie waarin samenwerken en verantwoordelijkheid nemen centraal staan. Wie wij zijn

Univé Zuid-Nederland is één van de acht regionale Univé’s, een coöperatie met de missie om de meest menselijke financiële dienstverlener van Nederland te zijn. title: Product Designer (Fin)
descriptionHtml:
Good Maven is supporting Fin in hiring Senior, Staff & Principal Product Designer

Dublin, London, Berlin - Remote

Designer to push the boundaries of product craft.

We are one of the most design-driven and AI first technology companies. Fin, our AI Agent is
the best performing, most widely adopted, and highest grossing AI service agent on the
market. We are shaping the future of how businesses communicate with their customers
through AI and humans. Our product is used by millions, and our design team plays a critical
role in making it world-class.

Why you should join Fin today

AI is transforming everything—fast. We’re at the forefront, shaping the AI Agent category
and redefining customer service with Fin. Soon, Fin will handle the vast majority of customer
interactions, setting a new standard for support.
This shift isn’t just changing what we build—it’s changing how we work. Our team is
constantly evolving, integrating AI into design, development, and go-to-market strategies.
At Fin, design is in our DNA. With 60+ designers across R&D and Brand—and two
co-founders from design—you’ll never have to fight for your place at the table. Here,
designers lead from the start, shaping products that millions of people interact with daily. If
you want to work on cutting-edge AI experiences that push the boundaries of product
design, there’s no better place to be.

Why this role exists


In a world where it’s easier and easier to get software off the ground and to 75% built, it’s the
last 25% that really matters. We need deep craft specialists—people who will raise the
quality bar, bring a spark of creativity, drive best-in-class interaction and visual design, and
push execution excellence across our most strategic product areas. This is not a
strategy-only or people-management role. We need a maker, a doer, a leader in craft.
If you have a deep passion for interaction design, product thinking, and pixel-perfect
execution—and the leadership and autonomy to drive impact without waiting for
direction—this is the role for you.

Must Have Experience
We’re looking for a world-class IC designer who:

 

  • Has shipped complex, high-quality software products.

  • Designs for multiple surfaces—desktop, mobile, chat interfaces, AI first and
    emerging experiences.

  • Balances speed and detail—knows when to move fast and when to obsess over
    the last 1%.

  • Thinks end-to-end—from big-picture systems thinking to the smallest interaction
    detail.

  • Understands engineering and can build prototypes to communicate ideas (Framer,
    Loveable, Windsurf, Vercel, Figma, code etc…).

  • Has taste. You know what great design looks and feels like, and you push to get
    there.

  • Can tell a compelling story—articulating your decisions with clarity and conviction.

  • Operates with agency, ownership, and autonomy—doesn’t wait to be told what to
    do.


Who This Role Is Not For

This role is not for you if:

  • You prefer strategy, research or system design over execution—this is a
    craft-heavy role.

  • You need a lot of direction or structured processes—you should thrive in
    open-endedness and ambiguity.

  • You don’t obsess over details—we’re looking for someone who sweats the pixels.

  • You primarily work on marketing sites—this role is about designing deep,
    functional software experiences.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

What you’ll be doing:

  • Owning end-to-end design for high-impact product areas from concept to
    execution.

  • Defining new interaction patterns and design paradigms for Fin, our automation,
    and AI-powered tools.

  • Sketching, prototyping, and testing ideas at different fidelities to validate
    decisions.

  • Working closely with engineers and PMs to define problems, move quickly, and
    deliver high-quality solutions.

  • Maintaining high standards of craft while balancing speed and execution.

  • Contributing to design culture—mentoring others, pushing for greatness in a team,
    refining processes, and sharing knowledge inside and outside Fin.

 

What Success Looks Like

You’ll know you’re successful if:

  1. You’ve raised the design bar. Your work is referenced as an example of
    exceptional craft and taste.

  2. You’ve shipped product with major business impact. The areas you own are
    visibly better because of you.

  3. You operate autonomously. You don’t need direction—you see what needs to be
    done and do it.

  4. Engineers love working with you. Your designs are considered, clear, and easy
    to implement.

  5. Your peers trust your judgment. When you push for quality, people listen.

Interview Process
We understand that interviewing for a new role is both time and energy consuming–we aim
to be thorough, speedy and transparent in our approach. You should expect for the entire
process to be no more than 4 weeks from start to finish. You’ll meet with various members of
our team and have the opportunity to fully validate that Fin and the role is the right fit for you.
Ready to build something great?


If you're driven to push the boundaries of product design and have the craft, autonomy, and
taste to make a real impact, we want to hear from you.

title: Product Engineer KI-first (m/w/d) - Full Stack, 100 % remote
descriptionHtml:
In unserem Portal bereiten mittelständische Unternehmen ihren Antrag bei der Bescheinigungsstelle Forschungszulage vor. Sie erfassen dort Projektzeiten und Kosten, laden ihre Unterlagen hoch und arbeiten mit unseren Beratern aus ihrer Entwicklungsarbeit ein förderfähiges Vorhaben heraus. Das Portal läuft, Mandanten arbeiten damit, und es hat noch viel vor sich.

Dafür suchen wir die Person, die es verantwortet. Sie haben schon einmal eine produktive Anwendung weitgehend allein getragen und wollen das wieder tun. Sie entscheiden mit, was als Nächstes entsteht, und Sie bauen es: Funktionen, Antragsprozess, Oberfläche, Server und Sicherheitsarchitektur. Dabei arbeiten Sie KI-first. Coding-Agenten sind Ihr erstes Werkzeug und nicht Ihr letztes Wort, denn Sie bauen schnell und beweisen dort, wo es zählt, dass es stimmt.

fundloop unterstützt mittelständische Unternehmen dabei, ihre Forschung und Entwicklung zu finanzieren. Sie arbeiten zu 100 Prozent remote, mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung und zu den Menschen, die mit Ihrem Werkzeug arbeiten.

Aufgaben

Sie entwickeln unser Portal eigenverantwortlich weiter, von der Idee bis zum Betrieb. Im Einzelnen heißt das:

  • Funktionen bauen, die Mandate voranbringen: Sie nehmen auf, woran Berater und Mandanten hängen bleiben, entscheiden mit uns über die Reihenfolge und liefern in kurzen Zyklen aus.

  • Den Antragsprozess weiterentwickeln: Der Weg vom Mandantengespräch bis zum fertigen Antragsentwurf ist bei uns ein geführter, KI-gestützter Ablauf mit fachlichen Prüfschritten. Sie machen ihn treffsicherer und schneller und sorgen dafür, dass er auch bei vielen parallelen Mandaten trägt. Das fachliche Urteil bleibt bei unseren Beratern.

  • Mit Sprachmodellen arbeiten, im Portal und beim Bauen: Sie gestalten Prompts, Agenten und Prüfläufe und messen, ob ein Schritt wirklich besser geworden ist.

  • Die Sicherheitsarchitektur verantworten: Mandantentrennung auf Datenbankebene, Rollen und Rechte, Verschlüsselung, Zwei-Faktor-Anmeldung und Protokollierung. Unsere Mandanten vertrauen uns Personal- und Finanzdaten an. Vor jeder Auslieferung prüft deshalb ein Test die Mandantentrennung, und Sie bauen diese Beweisführung aus.

  • Server und Betrieb führen: Auslieferung, Testumgebung, Datenbankmigrationen, Backups und Überwachung. Sie halten die Umgebung schlank, nachvollziehbar und wiederherstellbar.

  • Oberfläche und Nutzerführung gestalten: Sie sorgen dafür, dass eine Geschäftsführerin oder ein Entwicklungsleiter ohne Schulung durch das Portal kommt. Ein Design-System gibt es bereits.

  • Datenschutz mitdenken: Sie setzen technische und organisatorische Maßnahmen um und entscheiden bei jedem neuen Dienst mit, ob er zu unseren Anforderungen passt.

Qualifikation

Darauf kommt es an

  • Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung mit Webanwendungen im produktiven Betrieb, in TypeScript und React, am besten mit Next.js. Eine Anwendung haben Sie schon einmal weitgehend allein getragen.

  • PostgreSQL und Zugriffskonzepte als sicheres Fundament. Row Level Security, Rollenmodelle und Migrationen sind für Sie Handwerk, und bei jeder Änderung fragen Sie, wer danach worauf zugreifen kann.

  • Sie arbeiten KI-first, beim Bauen und in der Anwendung. Coding-Agenten sind Ihr tägliches Werkzeug, Sie können ihre Ergebnisse einordnen, prüfen und verwerfen. Außerdem haben Sie schon Abläufe mit Sprachmodellen in eine Anwendung gebaut und wissen, wie man deren Qualität misst.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, da Portal, Anträge und Fachgespräche auf Deutsch stattfinden. Englisch brauchen Sie für Dokumentation und Fachliteratur.

  • Betrieb in eigener Hand: Linux, Docker, Auslieferung und Backups, am besten mit einer Wiederherstellung, die Sie schon einmal wirklich geübt haben. Erfahrung mit Supabase, gern auch im Eigenbetrieb, ist ein Plus.

  • Die Anforderungen der DSGVO an Software, die personenbezogene Daten verarbeitet.

  • Gespür für Nutzerführung. Sie müssen nicht Design studiert haben, aber Sie merken, wenn ein Formular jemanden allein lässt.

  • Lust auf ein Fachthema. Das Forschungszulagengesetz müssen Sie nicht kennen. Sie sollten es aber verstehen wollen, denn die besten Funktionen entstehen dort, wo Sie den Prozess selbst durchdrungen haben.

  • Remote heißt bei uns Vertrauen. Sie setzen Ihre Prioritäten eigenständig und sagen früh, wenn etwas hakt.

Benefits

  • 100 % remote innerhalb Deutschlands. Vor Ort sehen wir uns nur gelegentlich, bei uns in Düsseldorf.

  • Unbefristet, in Vollzeit oder vollzeitnaher Teilzeit, Start nach Vereinbarung.

  • Verantwortung für das Ganze. Architektur, Werkzeuge und Reihenfolge entscheiden Sie mit, statt Tickets abzuarbeiten.

  • Werkzeuge, mit denen Sie schnell sind. Aktuelle Modelle und Coding-Agenten gehören bei uns zur Grundausstattung.

  • Kurze Wege. Sie sprechen direkt mit der Geschäftsführung und mit allen, die mit Ihrem Werkzeug arbeiten.

  • Wirkung, die man sieht. Was Sie bauen, kommt kurz darauf in der Arbeit an echten Förderanträgen an.

  • Ein Thema mit Rückenwind. Die Forschungszulage wächst, der Beratungsbedarf im Mittelstand wächst mit.

Wenn Sie lieber ein ganzes Portal verantworten als einen Ausschnitt davon, dann passen Sie zu uns.

So geht es weiter: Wir melden uns innerhalb weniger Tage. Im ersten Gespräch lernen Sie die Geschäftsführung kennen. Im zweiten lösen Sie eine überschaubare Übungsaufgabe, die unserem Alltag nachgebaut ist, mit den Werkzeugen Ihrer Wahl, und zeigen uns Ihren Weg zum Ergebnis. Danach entscheiden wir gemeinsam und zügig.

Arbeitgeber ist die Fundloop GmbH, Fleher Str. 32, 40223 Düsseldorf.

title: Product Lead - AI Finance App
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within Doit's AI Finance App.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

 

What You'll Own

  • Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

  • Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

  • Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

  • Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

  • Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

  • Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

  • Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

  • Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

  • Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

  • Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

  • Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

  • Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Can set direction and still go deep into details.

  • Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

  • Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

  • Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

  • Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.


This Role Is Not For

  • Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

  • People who cannot go deep into product details.

  • Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

  • Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

  • People who need large teams before they can create progress.


Location

This role is based in the United Kingdom. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our United Kingdom office at least 3 days per week.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Product
descriptionHtml:
At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

About the role

We’re looking for a hands-on product expert to collaborate closely with clients and engineers to identify opportunity and figure out what we need to build to accelerate growth and decarbonisation.

What you will be doing

  • Driving product–market fit including in new markets, ensuring customer needs and commercial objectives stay in sync.

  • Championing a customer-first mindset, translating feedback into impactful product solutions.

  • Overseeing end-to-end delivery - from scoping and defining success metrics to launch and iteration.

  • Designing user experiences that are clear, intuitive, and drive measurable impact

What we're looking for

  • 3+ years of product management experience

  • Proven ownership of delivery: you've been responsible for something live in the real world, not only the strategy or concept around it

  • Experience building products that touch the physical world. You respect real-world complexity and design around things going wrong

  • Experience in B2B, B2B2C or data-heavy products, with comfort working across partners and end users

  • User research and discovery: you know how to speak to users and run discovery towards a clear goal

  • You identify pain points and needs, turn them into plans, and ensure delivery.

  • Comfortable with hands-on prototyping and design, at least to the level of high-fidelity concepts

Nice to have

  • Fluency in one or more European languages

What's in it for you

A meaningful slice of equity in Axle, alongside a competitive salary. We operate with a deliberately flat structure. We aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

Enhanced parental leave to support you through life's meaningful moments.

Bupa private healthcare from day one of employment.

Hybrid working - We have a dog-friendly office around Farringdon. To maximize collaboration, we ask that you spend 2-3 days a week in the office.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse company, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

Interview process

  1. Initial interview

  2. Take-home exercise

  3. Final interview (in-person)

  4. Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

title: Product Manager (m/w/d) – Digital Wealth Management (apeiron)
descriptionHtml:
Über Uns

Ginmon ist einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Deutschland. Seit der Gründung im Jahr 2014 in Frankfurt am Main verfolgt das Unternehmen die Mission, professionelles, wissenschaftlich fundiertes Vermögensmanagement einer breiten Zielgruppe zugänglich zu machen. Mit apeiron hat Ginmon diese Technologie und Investment Expertise zu einer eigenständigen B2B-Plattform weiterentwickelt, die sich gezielt an unabhängige Vermögensberater:innen richtet. apeiron unterstützt Berater:innen mit intelligenten Tools für Beratung, Portfoliomanagement, digitales Onboarding, Gebührenabrechnung und Wertpapierabwicklung und ermöglicht ihnen damit ein modernes, skalierbares Endkundenerlebnis.

Als Product Manager (m/w/d) übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung von apeiron und gestaltest somit die technologische Zukunft der unabhängigen Vermögensberatung in Deutschland aktiv mit.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du führst Markt- und Nutzerforschung durch und identifizierst neue Produkt-Features und Trends im Bereich WealthTech.

  • Du nutzt moderne KI-Tools wie Claude, Gemini sowie Design-Software wie Figma, um Analysen, Nutzerflows, Produktideen und erste Prototypen schneller zu entwickeln.

  • Du entwickelst die Produkt Roadmap für apeiron und erarbeitest gemeinsam mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams detaillierte Produktanforderungen, User Stories und Abnahmekriterien.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Abteilungen im Unternehmen sowie mit externen Partnern und weiteren Interessengruppen zusammen und stimmst dich regelmäßig mit ihnen ab.

  • Du stehst im laufenden Austausch mit unabhängigen Vermögensberater:innen, holst kontinuierlich Feedback ein und übersetzt deren Anforderungen in konkrete Produktverbesserungen.

  • Du stellst sicher, dass Produktfunktionen spezifikationsgerecht, in hoher Qualität und termingerecht umgesetzt werden.

  • Du beobachtest die Leistung bestehender Funktionen und der zugrunde liegenden Plattform und identifizierst Potenziale für technische Optimierungen und UX-Verbesserungen.

  • Du übernimmst vollständige Verantwortung für deine eigenen Themenbereiche und trägst aktiv zu Produktentscheidungen bei.


Dein Profil

  • Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium.

  • Du bringst mindestens 3 bis 5 Jahre praktische Erfahrung im Produktmanagement oder Software-Engineering mit, idealerweise im Fintech- oder Start-up-Umfeld.

  • Du bringst Kenntnisse oder Erfahrung im deutschen Vermögensverwaltungssystem mit, idealerweise im Umfeld unabhängiger Finanzberater:innen oder Vermögensverwalter.

  • Du kennst dich sehr gut mit agilen Methoden wie Scrum sowie dem gesamten Software-Entwicklungszyklus aus.

  • Du hast einen sicheren Umgang mit Tools wie Jira, Claude for Design, Framer, Grafana, Brevo oder Figma.

  • Du arbeitest sowohl selbstständig als auch im Team und triffst eigenständig fundierte Entscheidungen.

  • Du kommunizierst sicher und transparent innerhalb deines Teams, unternehmensweit (auch mit CTO und CEO) sowie mit externen Stakeholdern und Berater:innen.

  • Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch (mindestens C1), da der laufende Austausch mit deutschen Vermögensberater:innen ein zentraler Teil deiner Rolle ist, sowie fließend Englisch.

  • Du lebst im Rhein-Main-Gebiet und kannst mindestens 60 % deiner Arbeitszeit in unserem Büro in Frankfurt am Main verbringen.

Warum Ginmon?

  • Hohes Maß an Autonomie und die Möglichkeit, unsere Produktstrategie in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Management-Team aktiv mitzugestalten.

  • Ein dynamisches, internationales Team mit flachen Hierarchien, schnellen Entscheidungswegen und einer "Get-things-done"-Mentalität.

  • Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt mit einem attraktiven, erfolgsorientierten Bonussystem, gekoppelt an deine Partnership-Meilensteine.

  • Beteiligung am langfristigen Erfolg von Ginmon durch ein Virtual Employee Share Option Program (VESOP).

  • Spezielle Konditionen für Mitarbeiterinvestments und Nutzung unserer Plattform;

  • Hybrides Arbeiten (60 % vor Ort) und flexible Arbeitszeiten.

  • Modernes Büro im Herzen Frankfurts mit High-End-Equipment und optimaler ÖPNV-Anbindung.

  • Regelmäßige Teamevents und eine angenehme Büroatmosphäre (Snacks, Getränke, Firmen-Merch u. v. m.).

  • Erstattung deiner Internetkosten und der Kosten für dein Deutschlandticket.

  • Vielfältige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

title: Product Manager, Finance Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us to redefine the future of on-demand delivery. To do this, we're building a world-class Finance Engineering (FinEng) organization across all global markets we support at DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt. in which each of our product managers plays a critical role in helping to define and execute our vision to move money accurately and at scale across every market we operate in and ensure finance and accounting compliance. As we grow, billions of dollars in money movements flow through our platform every year and our team makes sure every one of them is understood, trusted, and correctly reflected in the financial books.

About the Role

Product Managers on the Finance Engineering team need a systems-oriented mindset, platform thinking, and strong cross-functional collaboration. In this role, you will define the strategy and vision for systems that track billions of dollars in company-wide money movement, translate transactions into accounting entries, and accelerate the financial close. You will build scalable, audit-ready automation for complex, high-volume financial activity.

This is an opportunity to reshape modern accounting by applying AI to reconciliation, investigations, and incident detection and mitigation. Your products will form a critical part of the company's financial infrastructure and help earn the confidence of leadership, auditors, and regulators.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Drive the product definition, strategy, and long-term vision for accounting automation. You own the roadmap
  • Build systems that track billion-dollar-level money movements across the entire company and automatically convert them into accurate accounting entries
  • Reinvent and accelerate the accounting close process, reducing manual effort and shortening close timelines
  • Champion AI-driven approaches to transform close reconciliation, financial investigations, and incident detection and mitigation
  • Partner with FinEng, Accounting, and Finance leaders to translate complex financial and regulatory requirements into scalable, automated products
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams of engineers, designers, data scientists, accountants, and operators
  • Communicate product plans, benefits, and results to key stakeholders including the leadership team

We're excited about you because…

  • You have a track record in product management, including driving product strategy, vision, and roadmap alignment
  • You have built complex, back-end, data-intensive, or platform products. Ideally in fintech, payments, accounting, or financial systems
  • You have a strong grasp of accounting concepts (e.g. double-entry, ledgers, reconciliations, the close process) and how financial data flows through complex system
  • You do your best work with range: global platform thinking alongside the accounting reality of a specific brand or market
  • You're an execution power-house who thrives in ambiguity and operates at the lowest level of detai
  • You are excited about applying AI/ML to real-world financial problems such as reconciliation, investigation, and incident mitigation
  • You have experience presenting business reviews to senior executives
  • You have empathy for the users you build for, including accountants, controllers, and finance operators
  • You are motivated by building financial infrastructure that works across DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt

Why Join Us?

title: Product Manager IA - Paris
descriptionHtml:
💡 Envie de construire des produits IA qui vont au-delà du POC ?

L'intelligence artificielle transforme les usages, mais le véritable défi reste de concevoir des solutions utiles, performantes et capables de passer à l'échelle.

Chez Hubvisory, nous accompagnons de grandes organisations dans la conception et le développement de produits digitaux à forte valeur ajoutée.

Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un(e) Product Manager spécialisé(e) en IA pour imaginer, structurer et déployer des solutions innovantes, en combinant vision produit, compréhension technologique et impact business.

🎯 Ton rôle au quotidien

Tu interviendras sur des projets stratégiques, de l'identification des opportunités jusqu'au déploiement des solutions.

Tes principaux challenges :

  • Identifier les opportunités IA : comprendre les enjeux business et utilisateurs pour faire émerger des cas d'usage pertinents.

  • Définir la stratégie produit : construire et prioriser une roadmap cohérente, en intégrant les possibilités offertes par les LLM, le RAG et les agents IA.

  • Passer de l'expérimentation à l'industrialisation : évaluer la faisabilité, anticiper les contraintes et garantir la création de valeur.

  • Faire le lien entre métier et technologie : collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Engineering, Data et MLOps pour orienter les décisions produit.

  • Mesurer la performance : définir les bons indicateurs, suivre l'adoption et optimiser les solutions en continu.

  • Embarquer les parties prenantes : porter une vision claire, faciliter les arbitrages et accompagner le changement.

Tu auras l'occasion d'évoluer dans des environnements exigeants, auprès de références telles que LVMH, Sephora, TF1 ou l'Urssaf.


🔎 Le profil que nous recherchons

Nous recherchons avant tout un(e) Product Manager capable de connecter les enjeux business aux possibilités concrètes de l'intelligence artificielle.

Ce qui fera la différence :

  • Tu disposes de 3 à 6 ans d'expérience en Product Management, avec une expérience concrète sur des produits IA ou fortement orientés data.

  • Les concepts de LLM, RAG, IA générative et systèmes agentiques te sont familiers.

  • Tu sais travailler avec des équipes techniques, comprendre les grands principes d'une architecture IA et participer aux arbitrages sans nécessairement coder.

  • Tu maîtrises les fondamentaux du Product Management : discovery, priorisation, delivery, KPI et OKR.

  • Tu sais prendre du recul, challenger les besoins et défendre tes convictions avec pragmatisme.

  • Tu es à l'aise dans des environnements complexes, avec des interlocuteurs variés.

  • Tu communiques avec aisance en français comme en anglais.

Ton état d'esprit ? Curieux(se), analytique, autonome et toujours à l'affût des évolutions de l'écosystème IA.

✨ Ce que tu trouveras chez Hubvisory

Rejoindre Hubvisory, c'est intégrer une communauté de passionnés du Product, où l'expertise se partage et où chacun peut continuer à progresser.

Au programme :

  • 🎓 Un onboarding de 2 semaines au sein de notre Campus pour approfondir tes compétences Product.

  • 🧠 Une communauté d'experts avec des rendez-vous réguliers pour partager retours d'expérience, méthodes et nouvelles pratiques.

  • 📈 Une évolution accompagnée, avec des revues salariales deux fois par an.

  • 🎁 Des avantages complémentaires : intéressement et jours de congés supplémentaires.

  • 🎉 Une vraie vie d'équipe : événements, séminaires, activités et moments de convivialité.

  • 💎 Une culture fondée sur cinq piliers : bienveillance, ambition, expertise, apprentissage et méritocratie.

💰 Package

46 000 à 58 000 € brut annuel fixe, selon expérience, auxquels s'ajoutent une rémunération variable et un dispositif d'intéressement.

🤝 Comment se déroule le recrutement ?

Un processus structuré pour apprendre à se connaître et se projeter ensemble :

  1. Premier échange RH avec Caroline : ton parcours, tes motivations et tes attentes.

  2. Mise en situation Product : un cas pratique de 90 minutes avec un manager produit.

  3. Rencontre avec le leadership : 90 minutes d'échange avec un VP ou cofondateur dans les locaux.

  4. Dernier échange et proposition : alignement final et discussion autour du package.

Nous nous engageons à te faire un retour sous 7 jours maximum à chaque étape.

🚀 Prêt(e) à donner une nouvelle dimension à ta carrière Product ?

Si tu veux travailler sur des produits IA concrets, relever des défis complexes et évoluer aux côtés d'une communauté d'experts, on serait ravis d'échanger avec toi !

👉 Postule et construisons ensemble les produits intelligents de demain.

title: Product Manager Soft Fabrics
descriptionHtml:
Hunter Douglas is wereldwijd marktleider in raamdecoratie en een toonaangevende producent van architecturale producten. Wij zijn een merk dat u kent en vertrouwt. Met meer dan 100 jaar ervaring in innovatie hebben wij onze industrie mede vormgegeven met unieke producten die baanbrekend design en functionaliteit combineren. Onze producten zijn wereldwijd te vinden in miljoenen woningen en commerciële gebouwen. Wij zijn op zoek naar gedreven, intelligente, creatieve en ondernemende mensen. Door uitdagende functies en versnelde groeimogelijkheden te bieden, gedreven door een gezamenlijke ambitie om succesvol te zijn, creëren wij een omgeving waarin uw carrière zich verder kan ontwikkelen.

In ruil voor uw expertise bieden wij een competitief en uitgebreid arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket, zodat u zich gewaardeerd voelt voor de bijdrage die u levert. Onze ambitie is om het snelst groeiende en meest geliefde raamdecoratiebedrijf ter wereld te worden. Wat is uw ambitie?

Product Manager Soft Fabrics

Wil jij bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van hoogwaardige stoffen die hun weg vinden naar klanten door heel Europa? Krijg je energie van de combinatie van productontwikkeling, commercie en projectmanagement? Dan is dit een mooie kans om als Product Manager Soft Fabrics onderdeel te worden van ons Product Team.

Jouw rol

Als Product Manager Soft Fabrics ben je verantwoordelijk voor het product en het commerciële succes van onze collecties voor gordijn- en meubelstoffen. Design is verantwoordelijk voor de creatieve ontwikkeling van de stoffen. Vanuit Product Management vertegenwoordig jij de markt-, klant- en businessbehoefte. Je brengt markt- en klantinzichten in en vertaalt deze naar duidelijke productbriefings en commerciële uitgangspunten. Vervolgens bewaak je samen met Design het ontwikkelproces en stuur je op een succesvolle productintroductie en optimale productlevenscyclus. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's van Sales, Marketing, Procurement, Supply Chain en het Design Team.

Je combineert projectmanagement met commercieel inzicht, data-analyse en een passie voor textiel. Een veelzijdige rol waarin je veel verschillende mensen en disciplines bij elkaar brengt.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je beheert het fabrics-portfolio gedurende de volledige productlevenscyclus, van concept tot uitfasering.
  • Samen met Design vertaal je marktinzichten naar productbriefings en commerciële uitgangspunten voor nieuwe stoffen en collecties.
  • Je coördineert productontwikkelingsprojecten van conceptfase tot marktintroductie, waarbij je samenwerkt met Design voor de ontwikkeling van nieuwe stoffen en collecties.
  • Je bewaakt planning, voortgang, risico's, budget en afstemming tussen de verschillende betrokken teams.
  • Je bent gedurende het ontwikkelproces een commerciële en strategische sparringpartner voor Design.
  • Je analyseert markt-, klant- en verkoopdata en vertaalt inzichten naar kansen voor het portfolio.
  • Je ondersteunt bij prijsstelling, productpositionering en businesscases.
  • Je werkt samen met Sales en Marketing aan productintroducties, trainingen en commerciële tools.
  • Je zorgt voor goede productinformatie en bent een belangrijk aanspreekpunt voor interne en externe stakeholders.

Dit breng jij mee

Je bent een junior/medior professional die graag verantwoordelijkheid neemt en energie krijgt van het verbinden van mensen, ideeën en projecten. Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar relevante ervaring in bijvoorbeeld productmanagement, projectmanagement, category management of een vergelijkbare functie.

Daarnaast heb je:

  • Een hbo diploma in bijvoorbeeld Bedrijfskunde, Marketing, Textieltechnologie of een vergelijkbare richting.
  • Sterke projectmanagement- en stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden.
  • Commercieel inzicht en een klantgerichte instelling.
  • Een analytische, data-gedreven manier van werken.
  • Ervaring met het managen van meerdere projecten en stakeholders tegelijk.
  • Goede beheersing van het Nederlands en Engels.
  • Interesse in AI en de mogelijkheden om hiermee productiviteit, inzichten en bedrijfsprocessen te verbeteren.
  • Ervaring binnen een productieomgeving, textiel, interieurproducten of een industriële omgeving is een pré.

Je bent georganiseerd, proactief en hands-on. Je houdt gemakkelijk overzicht, ook wanneer er verschillende belangen en deadlines spelen. Tegelijkertijd werk je graag samen en weet je anderen mee te krijgen in jouw aanpak.

Waarom deze rol?

Je komt terecht bij Artex in Aarle-Rixtel, maar bent deel van het Product Team van Hunter Douglas met hoofdkantoor in Rotterdam. Hunter Douglas is een wereldwijd toonaangevende speler in raamdecoratie en architecturale producten, met meer dan 100 jaar ervaring in innovatie.

Als Product Manager Soft Fabrics krijg je de ruimte om eigenaarschap te nemen, ideeën in te brengen en zichtbaar bij te dragen aan de toekomst van ons stoffenportfolio. Je werkt samen met collega's uit verschillende disciplines en landen en hebt een belangrijke rol in het verbinden van design, commercie en productontwikkeling.

Wil jij jouw ervaring inzetten in een rol waarin product, commercie en design samenkomen? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Door hieronder je sollicitatie in te dienen, geef je vooraf toestemming om sms-berichten te ontvangen om je op de hoogte te stellen van updates over de status van je sollicitatie en om gedurende je sollicitatieproces met je in gesprek te gaan. Je kunt de sms-service op elk moment annuleren. Stuur gewoon “STOP” als antwoord op een van onze sms-berichten om je af te melden. Er kunnen kosten voor berichten en data van toepassing zijn. De frequentie van berichten kan variëren. Als je vragen hebt over privacy, lees dan ons privacybeleid, https://www.hunterdouglas.com/privacy-policy of onze gebruiksvoorwaarden https://www.hunterdouglas.com/terms-of-use.

title: Product Marketer
descriptionHtml:
We’re looking for a Product Marketer to join the Contentoo team and turn everything we build into one clear story that Sales can confidently take to market.

This is a hands-on role for an experienced product marketer who is genuinely interested in AI and what it’s doing to marketing and content operations. You’ll own the product story across our platform, AI capabilities, human experts, and managed support, and make sure the way we explain it holds up in a real sales conversation.

You’ll report to our Content Lead and work closely with our VP GTM, Product, Sales, and Customer Success. You’ll sit in on product, pricing, roadmap, and release conversations, join customer calls, and brief our specialists across copy, design, and SEO when enablement needs to be made.

About Contentoo

Contentoo helps global marketing teams scale content without turning their marketers into project managers.

We combine AI agents, human expertise, and managed content operations to take more of the production and coordination burden off marketing teams, so they can spend more time on the work that actually needs their judgment.

What you’ll be doing

A big part of your role is giving Sales a sharp, defensible story built on what customers actually experience.

Positioning & Messaging

  • Own the development of our core product narrative and website messaging, defining clear propositions, use cases, and proof points.

  • Show how our software, AI tools, and managed services work together as a cohesive solution rather than disconnected features.

  • Ensure messaging across our website, pitch decks, and demos aligns without contradictions.

GTM Launches & Sales Enablement

  • Package new and existing capabilities around defined ICPs, customer problems, and commercial value.

  • Plan and coordinate launches across Product, Sales, Marketing, and CS—from readiness and evidence to external comms.

  • Build field-tested enablement materials (one-pagers, pitch decks, demo narratives, battle cards, and objection-handling guides) based on real sales conversations, not theory.

Customer & Market Intelligence

  • Join sales calls, discovery sessions, and CS check-ins to spot recurring objections, use cases, and buying triggers.

  • Gather competitive intelligence and market trends to inform product, pricing, and messaging decisions.

  • Push back constructively when internal assumptions don't match market reality.

Release Governance

  • Establish a lightweight release process that separates early experiments from market-ready features and approved external claims.

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for someone who talks about what they shipped, not what they planned. Someone structured, with good judgement and the confidence to tell us when something isn’t ready to sell.

  • You have 4–5 years of marketing experience, with at least 2–3 years directly in product marketing.

  • You have a proven track record of creating or repositioning propositions, launches, and sales enablement materials that teams can execute without a walkthrough—and the outcomes to show for it.

  • You take strong project ownership, synthesizing fragmented input and aligning Product, Sales, and Customer Success without formal authority or becoming a bottleneck.

  • You’re genuinely interested in AI and content operations, able to speak plainly about what it does well, its limits, and where humans still matter, without hype or excessive technical jargon.

  • You’re curious about customers and grounded, comfortable joining live sales calls to understand objections, and ready to push back constructively when claims lack evidence.

  • You have native or bilingual-level English, live in or near Amsterdam, and can work from our Houthavens office 3 days a week.

  • You also get bonus points for experience in B2B SaaS (especially hybrid platform/service models), AI-enabled tools, localisation, or agency workflows, or fluency in Dutch, German, French, or a Nordic language (nice to have, not essential).

Why you’ll like it here

  • You’ll shape how the market understands a hybrid AI agent and human expert proposition, not polish someone else’s collateral

  • You’ll have a seat in product, pricing, roadmap and release conversations, and bring the customer view into the decision

  • Your work gets tested in live deals every week

  • It’s highly visible: Sales, Customer Success, Marketing and leadership will use what you build

  • You’ll own the product story and website messaging, with specialists to help you execute

What you’ll get

  • A competitive salary based on experience

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • Pension contribution

  • Laptop of choice (Mac or HP)

  • A monthly Alleo budget

  • A learning budget

  • Lunch at the office

  • Hybrid work environment (great office at the Houthavens, 3 days in office, 2 days home, plus remote flexibility)

  • A bar in the office. Who doesn’t want a bar in their office?!

  • A fun and International team, with regular drinks, boat days, and more

Sounds interesting?

Let’s have a virtual coffee to get to know each other! :)

title: Product Owner Werkplek & Support (Detachering / ZZP)
descriptionHtml:
Hoe zorg je ervoor dat ruim 3.300 collega’s iedere dag goed hun werk kunnen doen? Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support geef je richting aan onze werkplekdienstverlening: van Microsoft 365 en randapparatuur tot support en servicedesk. Je bepaalt de roadmap, brengt focus aan en zorgt samen met het team en onze leveranciers dat we sneller, voorspelbaarder en met een betere gebruikerservaring leveren.

Wie ben jij

Je bent iemand die verder kijkt dan de eerstvolgende sprint. Je kunt zelfstandig een visie en roadmap ontwikkelen, brengt focus aan en durft keuzes te maken wanneer belangen uiteenlopen.


Daarbij hoef je niet jarenlang de formele titel Product Owner te hebben gehad. We vinden het belangrijker dat je aantoonbaar eigenaarschap hebt genomen over een IT-product of -dienst en gewend bent om daarin richting en prioriteiten te bepalen. Je krijgt in deze rol veel ruimte. Je stelt zelf de roadmap op, maakt inhoudelijke keuzes en stuurt op verbeteringen binnen Werkplek & Support. Die autonomie betekent niet dat je alles alleen doet. Je stemt keuzes af het team, Servicemanager en teammanager zodat je elkaar kunt challengen op de juiste prioriteiten.


Het team bestaat uit collega's die al langere tijd bij Univé werken én collega's die relatief nieuw zijn. Het team heeft behoefte aan iemand die vanuit de Product Owner-rol richting en focus kan geven, zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn.


Onze werkplek is sterk gebaseerd op Microsoft 365, maar omvat meer dan alleen de digitale werkplek. Denk ook aan randapparatuur, lokale ondersteuning en supportdienstverlening. Je hoeft niet zelf de technisch specialist te zijn. Wel begrijp je moderne werkplekdienstverlening voldoende om een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn voor engineers, architecten, securityspecialisten en leveranciers.


Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is de operationele samenwerking met onze externe servicedesk en andere leveranciers. Samen met het team geef je richting aan prioriteiten en verbeteringen en zorg je dat ontwikkelingen binnen Werkplek & Support goed aansluiten op de ondersteuning van onze medewerkers.


Je voelt je daarnaast thuis in een omgeving die verandert. Je durft bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie te stellen, kunt omgaan met weerstand en neemt stakeholders mee wanneer nog niet alles vaststaat.

Wat ga je doen

Wat breng je mee?
Voor ons is niet je exacte functietitel of het aantal jaren ervaring doorslaggevend. We willen vooral zien dat je dit soort verantwoordelijkheid eerder succesvol hebt gedragen.

• Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het bepalen van visie, roadmap en prioriteiten voor een IT-product of IT- dienst;

Je kunt verschillende belangen afwegen en duidelijke besluiten nemen en onderbouwen;
• Je kunt vanuit een Product Owner-rol richting en focus geven aan een team zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn;
• Je bent sterk in stakeholder- en relatiemanagement en krijgt engineers, gebruikers, management en leveranciers mee;
• Je hebt ervaring met externe IT-dienstverleners en weet in operationele samenwerking, samen met het team, verbeteringen te realiseren;
• Je begrijpt werkplekdienstverlening en IT om inhoudelijk een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn;
• Je hebt ervaring met het verbeteren van dienstverlening en kunt sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid en klantbeleving;
• Je kunt omgaan met weerstand, bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie stellen en koers houden wanneer nog niet alles duidelijk is;
• Je beschikt over hbo/wo-werk- en denkniveau.
Ervaring met Microsoft 365 is welkom, maar diepgaande technische expertise is niet noodzakelijk. Ervaring met grotere transities of het insourcen van IT-dienstverlening is een pré.

Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support ben je verantwoordelijk voor de visie, roadmap en prioritering van onze werkplek- en supportdienstverlening.

Daarbij staat één vraag centraal: hoe zorgen we dat onze collega's prettig, veilig en efficiënt kunnen werken én snel en goed geholpen worden wanneer ondersteuning nodig is?

We willen vooral sneller en voorspelbaarder worden in wat we leveren en tegelijkertijd de gebruikerstevredenheid verder verhogen. Jij vertaalt die ambitie naar concrete keuzes en verbeteringen.


• ontwikkelen en onderhouden van de visie, roadmap en backlog voor Werkplek & Support;
• prioriteren van ontwikkelingen, incidenten en structurele verbeteringen;
• vertalen van IT-doelstellingen en behoeften van medewerkers naar concrete prioriteiten;
• richting geven aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Microsoft 365-gerichte werkplek, randapparatuur en ondersteunende dienstverlening;
• sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid, kwaliteit en gebruikerstevredenheid;
• onderhouden van nauw contact met stakeholders, waaronder Regionale Univé's en decentrale beheerders, en hen meenemen in keuzes en veranderingen;
• afstemmen met engineers, architecten, security, servicemanagement, leveranciers en andere IT-teams;
• samen met het team operationeel aansturen van de externe servicedesk en andere relevante leveranciers en verbeteringen realiseren;
• signalen en terugkerende vragen vanuit Support gebruiken om de werkplek structureel te verbeteren;
• richting geven aan lifecyclemanagement, upgrades, migraties en vernieuwingen van de werkplek en randapparatuur;
• kansen rond onder andere automatisering, selfservice en AI vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen;
• organiseren en voorbereiden van Scrum-activiteiten binnen het team, waaronder sprintplanning, reviews en retrospectives.

Je krijgt daarbij ruimte om zelfstandig richting te geven. Dat betekent ook dat we verwachten dat je bestaande keuzes kritisch bevraagt en de teammanager durft te challengen wanneer jij denkt dat het beter kan.

Wat bieden wij

Je krijgt een functie binnen IT Kern Services voor 36–40 uur per week met veel ruimte om zelf richting te geven. Werkplek & Support wordt dagelijks door duizenden collega's gebruikt. De keuzes die jij maakt zijn dus direct merkbaar in de organisatie.

Ontwikkeling vinden we bij Univé belangrijk. Dat geldt voor de dienstverlening waarvoor je verantwoordelijk bent, maar ook voor jezelf.

Het team werkt hybride vanuit Zwolle en Assen. Er is één vaste teamdag per week, afwisselend in Zwolle en Assen. De overige dagen werk je veelal vanuit je standplaats of thuis.

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die altijd dichtbij haar leden staat en gericht is op het bieden van financiële zekerheid. Het groeiende bedrijfsonderdeel IT staat voor de uitdaging om het IT-landschap en de IT-organisatie binnen de Univé Formule te transformeren in een wendbare, innovatieve, bestuurbare en toekomstgerichte platform-organisatie.

Schaalbare technologie en processen, optimaal gebruik van datatoepassingen, integratie en standaardisatie zijn hierbij belangrijke doelen. Zo levert IT kostenefficiënt en effectief een strategische bijdrage aan de continuïteit en innovatiekracht van Univé.


IT Kern levert het IT-fundament waarmee Univé haar doelen kan realiseren. Binnen IT Kern richt Services zich onder andere op werkplekdiensten, eerstelijns gebruikersondersteuning, proces- en servicemanagement en consultancy.
Binnen Werkplek & Support werk je samen met functioneel beheerders, IT-specialisten en een Business Informatie Analist. De servicedesk en het lokale beheer in Zwolle en Assen worden momenteel geleverd door een externe partner.
Je komt terecht in een team met verschillende achtergronden en ervaringsniveaus, binnen een organisatie met veel verschillende belangen en afhankelijkheden. Dat maakt de omgeving soms complex, maar geeft je als Product Owner ook veel ruimte om verbinding te leggen en zichtbaar verschil te maken.

title: Product Sales, Billing
descriptionHtml:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

About the team

The Product team at Airwallex is a group of passionate builders and problem-solvers who are obsessed with crafting customer-centric solutions that empower businesses to operate anywhere, anytime. We combine technical expertise with a deep understanding of our customers' needs to design and build unified, intuitive, and scalable products. As a team, we thrive in a collaborative and fast-paced environment, constantly iterating and pushing boundaries to deliver exceptional product experiences.


What you'll do

Product Sales is a new team of deep functional and technical specialists who both lead and advise on deals to drive adoption of our strategically critical Billing solutions across new and existing Airwallex customers.

You'll use your product, technical, and commercial expertise to enable regional sales teams and help them win. Part product sales, part solution architect, you'll join regional pitches and deals to scope customer requirements and recommend the right technical solution across Subscription Management, Usage-Based Billing, Invoicing, Tax, and Payments.

You'll work closely with core sales and account management, marketing, product, and partner teams to build deep product and industry knowledge, and you'll act as the bridge to product and engineering — bringing regional customer needs into the roadmap while continually testing, building, and executing against our go-to-market strategy.

Responsibilities

  • Enable regional sales teams on Billing — arming them with the pitches, positioning, and technical answers they need to sell with confidence.

  • Partner with account executives on high-value and complex deals, joining customer conversations to scope requirements and recommend the right technical solution.

  • Design solutions that map customer billing needs to our platform, and explain the trade-offs to both business and technical stakeholders.

  • Test market positioning and the appropriate selling motion for Billing products at Airwallex and continue to iterate and improve on them over time..

  • Refine the go-to-market playbook by working closely with Strategy, Revenue Operations, and Product Marketing.

  • Provide feedback to Product to inform the development roadmap and commercial priorities.

Who you are

We're looking for people who meet the minimum qualifications for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum qualifications:

  • 3–5 years in product sales, solution architecture, or solution engineering at a technology company, ideally in billing or subscriptions.

  • Technical fluency to talk credibly with product and engineering stakeholders, understand APIs and integration patterns, and recommend sound solutions.

  • Ability to drive the sales cycle in collaboration with existing AE/AM teams, and to translate technical detail into business value for the customer.

  • Evidence of working cross-functionally across multiple stakeholders to drive product or solution adoption.

  • The ability to deal effectively with ambiguity and thrive in an unstructured, fast-moving environment.

  • A proven ability to be a self-starter capable of driving business results without significant supervision.

  • Strong presentation skills, particularly for in-person and online meetings with multiple stakeholders with different backgrounds across finance, product, and engineering.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Background at a billing platform or competitor, for example Stripe, Chargebee, or Recurly, or at a billing startup.

  • Alternatively, experience at a technical consulting firm, for example Accenture, Deloitte Digital, or BCG X, designing and selling technical solutions.

  • You are an adaptable specialist, capable of engaging in business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organisation, including CEO, CFO, and CTO.

  • You're used to building value in competitive situations and enjoy working on complex products that require deep product understanding combined with technical knowledge.

  • You're equally comfortable working with external clients as with internal stakeholders, with a proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial agreements.

  • You're excited to become an expert and to share your knowledge, and you have a track record for improving the processes and organisations around you.

  

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Product Support Engineer - EMEA
descriptionHtml:
Hello!

I’m Allie, Head of Support at Ashby. I’m excited to share that we’re hiring a Product Support Engineer in EMEA 🎉

We’re expanding our global Support team to provide 24/7 coverage across time zones. You’ll join a global team while establishing the technical Support Engineering presence in EMEA, with the ownership and visibility that come from being one of the first Support Engineers across European time zones. We staff across regions rather than relying on on-call rotations; we’ll discuss the specific schedule for this opening during the process.

Not sure which Support role is right for you?

We’re hiring for both Product Support Specialist and Product Support Engineer roles.

  • Support Specialist owns cases and customer communication end-to-end. Troubleshoots complex issues by navigating internal tooling — audit logs, user experience testing, and API testing — to help customers reach successful outcomes.

  • Support Engineering serves as the escalation point between Support Specialists and Product Engineering. Owns integrations, supports data mapping and data migrations for customers, and resolves escalated tickets that don't require product code changes.

Please choose the role that best reflects your experience and interests rather than applying to both. If another Support role seems like a closer match, we’ll consider that in our review.

About the role

Support Engineering is the technical layer between frontline Support and Engineering. You’ll take on complex issues involving integrations, APIs, permissions, data, reporting, migrations, and workflows—using application behavior, logs, databases, and customer context to determine whether an issue can be resolved through Support or represents a product defect.

You’ll investigate issues end to end using tools such as Plain, GitHub, Datadog, databases, and the codebase. You won’t write the fix; you’ll give Engineering a well-validated escalation with reproduction steps, relevant evidence, customer impact, and a root-cause hypothesis when possible. You’ll also identify recurring issues, improve documentation and enablement, and partner with Product and Engineering on improvements. As an early Support Engineer in EMEA, you’ll establish regional operating practices and handoff norms across European time zones while bringing EMEA customer patterns to a global team.

What you’ll own

  • Own complex technical issues from intake through resolution or escalation—investigating APIs, integrations, logs, data, configuration, and workflows to determine whether Support can resolve them or Engineering should be involved.

  • Set a high bar for complex technical investigations and ensure Engineering receives clear, actionable, well-validated product issues.

  • Build trusted working relationships with frontline Support, Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and customers.

  • Identify recurring problems and turn them into documentation, enablement, tooling, process improvements, or product feedback.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering on recurring product improvements by synthesizing customer patterns, validating defects, and sharing the technical context needed to choose between a product change, documentation, tooling, or process improvement.

  • Establish EMEA coverage, handoff, and operating practices across European time zones while bringing regional customer patterns to the global Support Engineering team.

  • Track and improve the outcomes that matter: resolution speed, escalation quality, fewer avoidable Engineering escalations, frontline self-sufficiency, reduced customer effort, and customer confidence.

You should apply if:

  • You’ve worked in a hands-on, customer-centric technical role where you independently investigate ambiguous issues involving APIs, integrations, logs, data, and application behavior.

  • You’re comfortable moving between customer conversations, APIs, logs, databases, product behavior, and code-level context to find root causes.

  • You can distinguish a configuration, data, documentation, or enablement issue from a true product defect—and explain your reasoning clearly.

  • You write precise investigations that others can quickly understand and act on, and communicate thoughtfully with technical and non-technical audiences across time zones.

  • You naturally look beyond the immediate ticket and improve the systems around it through documentation, enablement, tooling, or process design.

  • You want to be an early technical owner for EMEA and are energized by building regional structure within a global team.

You should not apply if:

  • You’re looking primarily for a high-volume support role centered on predefined troubleshooting steps, rather than open-ended technical investigation and ownership.

  • Most of your experience is in internal IT, help desk, endpoint, hardware, network, infrastructure, cloud operations, systems administration, infrastructure maintenance, or service deployment—and you haven’t worked extensively with customer-centric SaaS applications, APIs, logs, or data-backed troubleshooting.

  • You prefer to pass difficult issues to another team rather than reproduce, investigate, and explain them yourself.

  • You’re looking for a role focused mainly on writing production code; this role diagnoses and escalates bugs but does not own code changes.

  • You prefer clear-cut problems and predefined answers over working through ambiguity with careful documentation, focused questions, and evidence-based decisions.

  • You want a narrowly defined role without regional operating ownership or projects that improve how the broader Support team works.

About Ashby

Ashby builds a suite of products that helps talent leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers run their hiring process significantly better. We raised a $50M Series D in July 2025 and support nearly 5,000 customers, including Shopify, Snowflake, OpenAI, Deliveroo, and Confluent. We’re growing much faster than 100% year over year, with a team of roughly 300 people across 22+ countries. Learn more at ashbyhq.com.

About Go To Market

We view our Support team as an extension of the product itself, one that ensures an optimal customer experience for customers ranging across all market segments. Here are a few points that should give you an idea of what it is like to work with us:

  • We spend a lot of time building best-in-class products since we believe a highly differentiated product is easier to sell.

  • We also spend a lot of time building a best-in-class customer experience. We aim to offer deep expertise whenever we interact with prospects and customers.

  • We strongly believe that small teams with very talented people and the right work environment deliver much better performance than teams with large headcount.

We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over experience, and thoughtful communication (we put a lot of effort into using the right communication channels) - we’ll get into these and other values during the hiring process. You can take a look at our Leadership Principles to get a sense of what we value in People Leaders at Ashby.

Interview process

Our interview process is thorough and designed to give you enough information to assess whether Ashby is the right fit for you, while helping us evaluate technical reasoning, communication precision, and ownership.

  • Intro call with Recruiting — 30 min

  • Take-home assessment — 5 days to complete

  • Hiring Manager interview — 45–60 min

  • Virtual onsite — 120 min

    • Meet the team — 30 min

    • Technical & integration skills — 45 min

    • CS and Support leadership — 30 min

    • Closing questions — 15 min

Onboarding

Your onboarding will combine Ashby-wide product and company training with a Support Engineering-specific ramp plan. You’ll learn the product and support workflow, get familiar with the tools and systems used for technical investigations, and build relationships across Support, Product, and Engineering. With support from your manager and onboarding buddy, you’ll take on increasingly complex investigations as you build context, with regular check-ins throughout your first 90 days.

Benefits

Benefits vary by country and are shared in more detail during the process. International employees receive statutory benefits and, where available, employer-paid supplemental health coverage.

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited PTO. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅

  • A $1,200 annual learning and professional-development budget.

  • A one-time $2,000 home-office setup budget for furniture, monitors, peripherals, and ergonomic equipment, plus a company-provided laptop.

  • Opportunities to spend time with teammates through an annual company offsite, team offsites, local meetups, and virtual events.

  • Extended health benefits for you and your dependents (subject to availability with our Employer of Record)

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

title: Project Planner - Aberdeen
descriptionHtml:
About XYZ Reality


XYZ Reality created the world’s first engineering-grade augmented reality for construction. Our site-safe hardhat, The Atom, overlays the design model onto the live build, so our engineers can verify work as it goes in on some of the most complex mission-critical projects in the world.

Backed by Series B investment and growing fast across the US, UK and Europe, we’re a driven, passionate team changing how the industry builds.

If you want your work to shape how the world gets built, we’d like to hear from you.

 

Help shape the future of construction project delivery with XYZ Reality.

 

Our Customer Operations team is at the heart of project delivery, bringing XYZ Reality's technology to life on site and supporting our clients from initial mobilisation through to successful project handover.

 

THE ROLE

We're looking for an experienced planning professional to take the lead on programme planning and controls across a portfolio of complex construction projects.

This is an opportunity to combine your expertise in project planning and scheduling with innovative technology, including 4D planning and augmented reality, to bring greater visibility, accuracy and confidence to project delivery.

As our client-facing planning lead, you'll work closely with project teams and stakeholders across multiple locations, identifying risks, challenging assumptions and keeping programmes on track. You'll also collaborate with our Engineering, Production and Sales teams.

Based in Aberdeen, Scotland, you'll report to the Head of Project Controls Analytics.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop and maintain project programmes integrated with 3D design models, sequencing the build within the BIM environment in accordance with client requirements.

  • Integrate MEP (Mechanical, Electrical and Plumbing) programmes into the overall project schedule to coordinate multi-disciplinary workstreams.

  • Embed the 4D scheduling workflow, linking time-sequenced programme data to the 3D model to enable real-time progress tracking, into project delivery.

  • Lead external planning teams, directing their use of Primavera P6, Asta Powerproject, and 4D integration tools.

  • Identify schedule risks and coordination issues across multi-disciplinary workstreams, driving structured resolution with the relevant stakeholders.

  • Produce regular progress reports at both customer and company level, using Microsoft Power BI, Power Apps, and Excel to generate clear, actionable project data.

  • Monitor productivity and completion deadlines, maintaining up-to-date programme status for all active portfolios.

  • Act as the primary planning contact for clients across active project portfolios, managing relationships proactively throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Support the Sales Team on client calls, demonstrating strong schedule knowledge and the capability of our planning approach

  • Coach and challenge both management and non-specialist audiences on programme matters, operating effectively across technical and non-technical settings

 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Minimum 4-6 years of scheduling or programme controls experience in a complex, multi-disciplinary project environment (construction, Oil and Gas, Energy, Infrastructure, Manufacturing, or similar), with demonstrable progression in client-facing or leadership responsibilities

  • Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6 or equivalent enterprise scheduling platform

  • Senior stakeholder communication and progress reporting

  • Proactive, solutions-focused approach to stakeholder management, comfortable challenging assumptions at all levels and sustaining momentum when projects become complex.

  • Degree in Engineering, Project Management, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience demonstrating the same level of competence.

  • Right to work in the UK (visa sponsorship is not currently offered).

 

KEY EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

  • Self-directed and comfortable managing ambiguity, able to build planning frameworks rather than simply follow established ones.

  • Confident operating across technical and non-technical audiences without losing precision or rigour.

  • Collaborative by default, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and hold a position when the programme requires it.

  • Genuine curiosity about technology and how it changes the way projects are planned and delivered.

  • Commercially aware, understands the relationship between programme performance and client outcomes.

  • Primavera P6.

  • Power BI and Power Apps for project data analytics (desirable).

  • Working knowledge of BIM workflows or 4D model integration (desirable).

  • Exposure to construction or built environment projects (desirable).

  • Experience operating in a technology-led or scale-up delivery environment (desirable).

 

BENEFITS

  • 🪙 Annual salary reviews

Du bist kommunikativ, digital fit und ein echtes Organisationstalent? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen! 💙 Du hast Spaß daran, mit Menschen zu sprechen, behältst auch bei vielen Bewerbungen den Überblick und arbeitest gerne mit digitalen Tools? Gleichzeitig magst Du es, wenn Dinge gut organisiert sind und alles seine Ordnung hat? Dann werde Teil unseres Recruiting-Teams bei MHC! Dich erwartet ein Mix aus Bewerberkommunikation, Recruiting und administrativen Aufgaben – in einem Team, das gemeinsam anpackt und Erfolge feiert Dann schick uns einfach Deinen Lebenslauf – ganz ohne Anschreiben! Deine Unterlagen kannst Du uns einfach an folgende E-Mail-Adresse schicken: ----- Bei Fragen kannst du dich gerne an Franzi Wild wenden - 089 954 287 104 oder einfach per Mail. Wir freuen uns auf Dich! 💙

Aufgaben

  • Bewerberkommunikation: In telefonischen Erstgesprächen lernst Du unsere Kandidaten kennen und begleitest sie durch den Bewerbungsprozess
  • Recruiting: Du erstellst Stellenanzeigen, sichtest Bewerbungen und findest passende Kandidaten für unsere offenen Positionen
  • Bewerbermanagement: Die Koordination von Bewerbungsprozessen liegt in Deinen Händen – dabei sorgst Du für eine positive Candidate Experience
  • Administration & Datenpflege: Du pflegst Bewerberprofile, dokumentierst Gespräche und hältst unser Recruiting-System auf dem neuesten Stand
  • Digitale Prozesse: Mit unserem eigenen Recruiting-System arbeitest Du täglich, findest Dich schnell in neue Funktionen ein und unterstützt einen reibungslosen Ablauf

Anforderungen

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Offen auf Menschen zuzugehen fällt Dir leicht, Du telefonierst gerne und findest schnell einen guten Draht zu anderen
  • Digitale Kompetenz: Du bist technisch fit, lernst neue Software schnell kennen und kommst auch mit sich verändernden Systemen und Prozessen gut zurecht
  • Organisationstalent: Eine strukturierte und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise zeichnet Dich aus – auch wiederkehrende Aufgaben wie Datenpflege und Dokumentation machen Dir Spaß
  • Eigeninitiative: Du denkst mit, packst an und behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn mehrere Dinge gleichzeitig anstehen
  • Motivation & Lernbereitschaft: Neues zu lernen macht Dir Spaß und Du freust Dich, wenn Du gemeinsam mit Deinem Team Ziele erreichst
  • Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder ein Studium ist eine gute Grundlage – erste Erfahrungen im Recruiting, Personalwesen oder Kundenservice sind ein Plus

Benefits

  • Monday is Funday©: Ein herzliches Team, flache Hierarchien und eine Arbeitsatmosphäre, in der Spaß und Zusammenhalt nicht zu kurz kommen
  • MHC-Workation: Einmal im Jahr geht es gemeinsam an eine besondere Destination 🌴
  • Monday-Meal: Jeden Montag gibt es ein kostenloses, gesundes Mittagessen mit dem Team
  • Birthday-Vacation: 30 Urlaubstage plus einen zusätzlichen freien Tag an Deinem Geburtstag 🎁
  • Homeoffice-Möglichkeit: Wir lieben unseren Teamspirit im Office und bieten Dir gleichzeitig die Möglichkeit, auch mal im Homeoffice zu arbeiten 💻
  • Automatische Gehaltserhöhungen: Dein Gehalt steigt bei uns automatisch zweimal im Jahr
  • Purpose: Wir bringen Menschen und Unternehmen im Raum München zusammen und schaffen neue berufliche Perspektiven
  • Onboarding & Feedback: Eine strukturierte Einarbeitung, regelmäßiges Feedback und ein persönlicher Mentor
  • Weiterentwicklung: Seminare, Coachings und Zugang zu exklusiven Online-Akademien 📚

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung! Senden Sie uns einfach Ihren Lebenslauf und Arbeitszeugnisse zu – auf ein Anschreiben können Sie gerne verzichten. Für Rückfragen steht Ihnen Franziska Wild gerne unter 089 954 287 104 zur Verfügung.
