title: Redactiestage Zo Zit Dat
descriptionHtml:
Amsterdam - Hoe komt een luiaard aan zijn naam? Gaan er ooit mensen naar Mars? En waarom is poep bruin? Zo Zit Datbeantwoordt elke maand de leukste vragen! Daarnaast staat dit weetjesblad propvol leerzame strips, puzzels, tips, reportages, interviews en foto’s. Met Zo Zit Dat ontdekt de lezer (8-14 jaar) zélf hoe het zit. Onze redactie zoekt een stagiar(e) voor deperiode februari 2027 tot en met juni 2027!

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je schrijft rubrieken en artikelen voor gewone edities, speciale abonneenummers, het Zo Zit Dat-vakantieboek en eventuele andere uitgaven.

  • Je ondersteunt de redactie met dagelijkse werkzaamheden, zoals het bijhouden van de algemene mailbox en het regelen van winacties.

  • Je denkt actief mee en voert je eigen ideeën uit.

  • Je maakt berichten voor de website, werkt mee aan de ontwikkeling van social media-kanalen en maakt de nieuwsbrief.

    Wie zijn wij?
    Zo Zit Dat is onderdeel van het kidsdomein van DPG Media. We zijn een kleine redactie, maar werken nauw samen collega’s van Donald Duck en Kidsweek. Omdat het Zo Zit Dat-team heel klein is, maak je het blad van kop tot staart.

    Wat maakt jou de ideale kandidaat?

  • Je studeert journalistiek, wetenschapscommunicatie, Creative Business of een andere media gerelateerde HBO- of WO-opleiding.

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig en leergierig.

  • Je schrijft foutloos Nederlands.

  • Je staat open voor feedback.

  • Je hebt interesse in de belevingswereld van kinderen.

  • Je bent digitaal vaardig en voelt je thuis in de wereld van TikTok.

    Wat krijg je van ons?

  • Een mooie plek in ons spiksplinternieuwe duurzame kantoor in Amsterdam.

  • Zorgen dat je je helemaal thuis voelt in ons kleine maar fijne team.

  • Laten je vrij in creativiteit, bij ons is niks te gek!

  • Zorgen dat je een hele hoop ervaring opdoet.

  • Een stagevergoeding van 400 euro per maand.

    Stagelopen bij DPG Media
    Stagelopen bij DPG Media betekent niet alleen dat je de door jou geleerde theorie in de praktijk brengt door een bijdrage te leveren aan onze ambitieuze teams, ook ga je bij ons écht wat leren. Een aanvulling ben je zeker, want jouw creatieve en frisse blik wordt erg gewaardeerd. Na je stage kan je zeggen dat je ook nog eens écht toffe dingen hebt bereikt én hebt gewerkt bij het grootste mediabedrijf van Nederland. Zet dat maar op je cv!

    Over DPG Media
    DPG Media heeft met haar sterke merken een stevige marktpositie in alle onderdelen van de mediabranche. Elke dag werken we met ontzettend veel plezier aan ons portfolio dat bestaat uit uiteenlopende A-merken, waaronder AD, AutoWeek, Donald Duck, Libelle, Margriet, Linda, NU.nl, Qmusic, vtwonen en RTL. Je wordt dus onderdeel van een groter geheel: met al onze merken bereiken we elke maand 98% van de Nederlanders. Hoe tof is dat?

    Interesse, en dan?
    Solliciteer direct en uiterlijk 8 december via de sollicitatiebutton op deze site. Wil je eerst nog meer weten of heb je vragen? Neem dan even contact op met Kimberley Koopman via

title: 1022.1 | Senior Business Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Intetics Inc., a leading American technology company specializing in custom software application development, distributed professional teams creation, software product quality assessment, and “all-things-digital” solutions, is on the lookout for a Senior Business Analyst to join our team and provide exceptional customer support.

Long-term cooperation on an as-needed basis, with potential part-time assignments and travel to the client’s office if required

Responsibilities

  • Elicit, analyze, and document business and functional requirements, user stories, and testable acceptance criteria
  • Ensure requirements are sufficiently detailed to support solution design, estimation, development, testing, and acceptance
  • Maintain requirements and backlogs in Jira, supporting prioritization, refinement, traceability, and consistency
  • Identify and resolve requirements gaps, dependencies, ambiguities, risks, and conflicts
  • Facilitate requirements discussions and workshops with business stakeholders, designers, developers, testers, architects, and vendors
  • Reconcile different perspectives and align business needs, user experience, solution design, and delivery priorities
  • Create and maintain UML models and requirements documentation
  • Prepare reports, presentations, and status updates for technical and non-technical audiences
  • Follow established delivery processes, governance standards, quality controls, and information security requirements

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience as a Business Analyst or in an equivalent requirements-analysis role within digital or IT initiatives
  • 7+ years of experience eliciting, analyzing, and managing business and functional requirements, including user stories and testable acceptance criteria
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience using Jira for requirements management
  • 5+ years of practical experience with UML
  • 5+ years of direct collaboration with business stakeholders and multidisciplinary delivery teams
  • 3+ years of experience leading other analysts or contributing to business analysis standards, templates, quality assurance practices, or methods
  • 3+ years of experience working with or guiding external vendors, consultants, or delivery partners in interpreting and implementing requirements
  • Proven experience independently leading requirements analysis for complex, ambiguous, or cross-domain initiatives
  • Experience working independently and within complex environments involving multiple teams, vendors, countries, or business functions
  • Experience delivering IT solutions within structured and/or Agile environments
  • Understanding of enterprise applications, integrations, APIs, system dependencies, and non-functional requirements
  • Experience working in accordance with information security, privacy, confidentiality, and data protection requirements
  • A bachelor’s degree or higher in business administration, economics, information systems, computer science, engineering, public administration, or another analytical discipline

Would be a plus:

  • Experience working with or for large organizations with complex structures and multiple business units
  • The degree must be awarded by a university ranked among the top 500 in an overall or subject-specific university ranking
  • At least one relevant professional certification, such as IIBA ECBA, CCBA, CBAP, PMI-PBA, BCS Foundation/Practitioner in Business Analysis, or IREB CPRE

descriptionHtml:

Our client operates in the real estate and home improvement industry, specialising in bathroom remodelling. They help homeowners transform their bathrooms through tailored renovation solutions. They are looking for an experienced Dutch-speaking High-Ticket Sales Closer to join their sales team and convert qualified prospects into customers.

Working directly with prospective customers through video sales calls, you'll be responsible for building rapport, understanding customer needs, handling objections, and closing high-value deals. This is an opportunity for a confident sales professional who knows how to create trust, communicate value, and consistently deliver results in a performance-driven environment.

  • Strong objection-handling and negotiation skills
  • Excellent verbal communication skills and a confident, engaging tone of voice
  • Strong rapport-building, active listening, and mirroring skills
  • Ability to adapt communication and closing techniques to different customer personalities and cultural backgrounds
  • Comfortable conducting video sales calls and working towards daily sales and revenue targets
  • Reliable, organised, and able to communicate availability consistently
  • Familiarity with GoHighLevel, Slack, and Google Meet

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in real estate or property-related sales
  • Experience in construction, home improvement, or bathroom remodelling

Benefits

💻 Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with international teams

🚀 Career Growth: Join companies in SaaS, MarTech, and B2B services

🤝 Peer Community: Connect with high-performing sales professionals in our network

🧭 Ongoing Support: Receive guidance from Huzzle before and after placement

💰 Tailored Compensation: Salaries vary by client and candidate preference — we’ll match you with options that fit your goals

title: Account Executive - Mid Market (Evergreen)
descriptionHtml:
About Karbon

Karbon is the global leader in AI-powered practice management software for accounting firms. We provide an award-winning cloud platform that helps tens of thousands of accounting professionals work more efficiently and collaboratively every day. With customers in 40 countries, we have grown into a globally distributed team across the US, Australia, New Zealand, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the Philippines. We are well-funded, ranked #1 on G2, growing rapidly, and have a people-first culture that is recognized with Great Place To Work® certification and on Fortune magazine's Best Small Workplaces™ List.

Are you a sales professional looking for an opportunity to make an impact in a rapidly growing, award winning and well-funded SaaS business that is disrupting a multibillion-dollar industry? 

We are always looking to connect with top-performing, self-starter sales executives who have the experience and drive to manage all aspects of the sales cycle — from prospecting and lead qualification to demand creation and closing new business.

While we may not have an active opening at this moment, we’re continuously building our pipeline of exceptional talent and would love to hear from you. When the right opportunity opens up, we move quickly — and we want to already know who you are.

Our sales team is based throughout the United Kingdom with the flexibility to work remotely. When positions do become available, they represent a tremendous career opportunity with strong professional and financial upside.

If this sounds like the kind of team you want to be part of, we’d encourage you to apply and introduce yourself.

About the Role

As a Sales Account Executive, you will be responsible for identifying and managing leads and opportunities, demonstrating Karbon’s value, communicating the compelling reason to change, and leading technical demonstrations of our platform while providing a first-class experience and ultimately optimizing how prospects run their firms. 

  • Respond to prospective customers promptly, book discovery calls with inbound leads, uncover their pain points, and tailor presentations to demonstrate how Karbon will help them modernize their firm, accelerate their growth and retain top talent
  • Drive and expand your portfolio of prospects through outbound engagement and call activity (~40% of appointments are generated by the rep)
  • Create Outreach sequences leveraging marketing rich content and/or custom campaigns that include phone, email, e-gifting, and LI to secure meetings with decision makers in ICP accounts
  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of opportunities with a minimum of 3 times quota securing next step meetings throughout the process
  • Ensure accurate and timely updates of information and forecasts (call/meeting notes, supporting documentation, next steps etc.) in Salesforce/Gong
  • Demonstrate how Karbon's value proposition aligns with clients' requirements

About You!

We are looking for someone who thrives working independently in a high growth, fast-paced environment. The ability to multitask, leverage lots of modern software to automate tasks, set and adjust priorities, and be a team-player is critical. If you are hungry to learn and enjoy being a part of a high-performance team where authenticity and passion for action are valued, Karbon is your future home.

Candidates with the following qualifications and experience are encouraged to apply:

  • 3+ years of experience selling SaaS to mid-market businesses with a track record of being top performing and consistently exceeding quota
  • Experience with outbound sales; hunter mentality
  • Team player with a strong work ethic who is self-motivated and driven by results
  • Ability to demonstrate a strong business case for Karbon through a consultative and value driven sales process
  • The technical aptitude to master our sales tools /tech stack
  • Ability to prioritize and multitask sales opportunities of varying lengths and depths, and effectively articulate the potential you have with each account
  •  A friendly, but assertive demeanor
  • Bonus points if you have previous experience working at a company that sells Workflow, Accounting, or Project Management software 

Our sales team has amazing additional incentives focused on performance including an annual President’s Club Trip, Rep of Month, Quarter and Year!

Why Work at Karbon?

  • Competitive salary with uncapped monthly bonus potential and high quota attainment
  • Excellent benefits package including:
    • Flexible work hours
    • Work remotely or in an office
    • Commuter & work from home benefits
    • Home office equipment menu for you to choose how you deck out your home office
    • Employee Assistance Program
    • Up to 10 wellness days (because you don't need to be "sick" to stay well)
    • Karbon Fun / Social Club!
    • Up to 5 weeks paid vacation
  • Opportunity to sell a leading platform (number 1 on G2) with a highly recognized and valued brand/product offering
  • Work with (and learn from) an experienced, high-performing team
  • Be part of a fast-growing company that firmly believes in promoting high performers from within
  • A collaborative, team-oriented culture that embraces diversity, invests in development, and provides consistent feedback
  • Additional incentives focused on performance, including President’s Club Trip, Rep of Month, Quarter, and Year
  • OTE for this role at target is £130,000

Please be aware that Karbon will only contact you via email from our domain, karbonhq.com. If you receive an email from any other domain, please do not click any of those links.

title: Client Delivery Lead - Billing or Accounting Experience (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Kraken Customer

 

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

We have been licensing Kraken for over 4 years now, transforming businesses by not only moving their customer base to our Kraken platform but also changing their operating model & ways of working. Throughout this time our team has been at the forefront of industry leading migrations whilst setting a new standard for what business transformation can look like. 

 

🏠 Where you'll fit in:

 

You will be joining the client delivery team with Kraken working to support European clients through their technology transformation journeys, supporting long term migration projects.

The Client Delivery Lead has direct responsibility managing a tech domain (billing, finance, comms...) for our client projects. This is either migrating onto our Kraken platform or managing long term technology requirements. They need to work in partnership with the technology and operational teams at Kraken as well as the client to deliver results for our client’s project or business needs. 

 

The Client Delivery Lead has to really understand how Kraken works, understand problems or requests raised by the client and refine solutions in the best way to leverage existing and new capability. They will bring technology, people and processes together to innovate improvements for our clients. You will also support the client in adapting to ways of working that are aligned to Kraken’s development style. You will work closely with Kraken’s product managers and developers to request development needs and act as a link to the client.

🚀 What you'll own:

  • You will be managing the relationship with client counterparts (often product owners and business owners)

  • You will be the first point of contact for tech development and the escalation and resolution point with customers for specific domain/product issues

  • Being the knowledge base of how Kraken works and how we deliver Kraken Platform

  • Triaging incoming requests and communicating client priorities internally. 

  • Summarising and articulating client needs, considerations, timelines internally to enable the ongoing development of the Kraken platform.

  • Supporting the engineering team to deliver product features

  • Challenging the client to think differently about tech development, having full belief in the continuous iteration and deployment approach we have.

 

This is a hands-on, individual contributor position. The role is European based and your projects could be run from any country, travel is expected as part of this role.

 

We are a flat and agile organisation and plan to remain this way. We are looking for open minded individuals who are comfortable with ambiguity and an ever changing environment. To thrive here you must be a self-starter and willing to roll your sleeves up to solve any problem, constantly flexing outside of your typical job role to drive progress for our clients and organisation.

You must be  committed to the Kraken way of delivering tech based on simplicity, client benefit and efficiency while bringing stakeholders through a journey of change. 

 

You must be willing to challenge beliefs, have the ability to see through multiple viewpoints and, if needed, reach beyond your remit to support the client. 

 

We are building a Kraken for everyone, a universal platform where there is greater benefit in sharing development to enable the green energy transition. Pioneers in this space, we are excited about how Kraken can change the lives of our customers and convinced that Kraken is the best answer, not only for efficiency but as a tool to tackle the climate crisis. If you believe this too then Kraken Tech is the right place for you.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party:

  • In this position you will be laser focused on satisfying our customer’s needs. We are looking for people with strong problem solving skills and a super positive solutions oriented mindset. If you have a taste for raising up to challenges and a winner mindset, this position is the right fit for you! (“Every problem has a solution, facing new challenges is exciting because that’s what makes us better every day and the bigger the challenge, the bigger the feeling of success”)

  • Strong client delivery and/or product ownership experience

  • Agile delivery experience 

  • Experience of product management and customer journeys

  • Solid understanding of technology and associated trends

  • Excellent communications, collaboration and presentation skills

  • Strong influencing skills and ability to challenge traditional ways of thinking

  • Experience of working with significant complex delivery pipelines for clients

  • Patience and initiative - our clients are undergoing huge transformations that take time and require our understanding 

  • Time management and a get-stuff-done attitude

  • Consulting experience is a plus 

  • Fluent in English (German is not mandatory)

  • Experience in the energy sector is a plus. We welcome candidates from a range of backgrounds, including accounting, finance, billing, payments, and fintech.

FitMe is a fitness app created for people who want to stay active without long, repetitive workouts. It offers short, easy-to-follow routines that can be done at home with no equipment. FitMe is perfect for busy people who want to maintain their health, boost energy levels, and feel good every day — without going to the gym or spending hours on exercise.

This is a hands-on, early-stage role. You'll start solo or with a very small team, with your own test budget, and take every hypothesis all the way through: research → test → numbers → decision → scale or kill.

Requirements:

  • 3+ years in Product Marketing, Growth, Growth Product Management, Product or a similar role, ideally in subscription apps or D2C

  • Deep understanding of the full user funnel, from acquisition through onboarding and paywall to retention and LTV, and of what drives each metric

  • Ability to build your own LTV and payback assumptions without waiting for an analyst

  • A hands-on track record: you've launched tests yourself, not only managed people who did

  • Strong ownership and discipline: you keep your commitments and treat the budget like your own money

  • English at B2 or higher

Would be a plus:

  • Experience leading a team

  • Experience with new monetization models or non-app products

Responsibilities

  • Validate new use cases inside the core product through marketing first, then turn the winners into content and features in the app

  • Explore monetization models and revenue streams beyond the current ones

  • Find and validate hypotheses that could become standalone products, inside or outside Health & Fitness

  • Research markets, trends, competitors and user behavior, and turn the findings into a prioritized list of bets

  • Launch tests yourself: run campaigns, vibe-code landing pages and prototypes, run surveys and user interviews

  • Own the budget, timelines and commitments for every experiment, and report results honestly, including the ones that fail

  • Bring in design, product, analytics and marketing once a bet has earned more resources

title: Hands-on Engineering Manager DevOps (GCP/Kubernetes)
descriptionHtml:
Location: 100% remote (EMEA)

Classification: Full-time

Pay Range: 82.000€ to 140.000€ - determined by several factors, including location

Miaplaza is dedicated to making education engaging and accessible through innovative online learning platforms. We develop personalized learning experiences for students, helping them grow in a supportive and interactive environment. Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive education curriculum platform where all students can be successful!

As an engineering manager at Miaplaza, your team will build technology with a direct impact on the lives of hundreds of thousands of students. Every step of the way, you will have the opportunity to influence our direction. Through our platforms, we create engaging, safe, and thoughtfully designed learning experiences that help children grow academically, creatively, and personally. Every feature we ship, every system we scale, and every improvement we make contributes to shaping how the next generation learns and discovers their potential. If our platform is down, a child might not go to school that day. We’re looking for leaders who want their work to matter in classrooms and homes, who care about access to quality education, and who are excited to craft technology that makes a difference in young people’s lives. Here, your impact doesn’t just power a product; it shapes future generations!

What you’ll work on:

We’re moving everything towards GCP and Kubernetes. We’re growing towards a scale that no longer matches our legacy architecture and actively investing in modernization. We’re migrating on-premise workloads to GKE, strengthening security and business continuity best practices, and moving toward platform self-service for our development teams. A core goal is to consolidate and shrink the stack, and every migration decision is measured against whether it lowers the daily burden on the team. You’ll need to work with your team balancing both platform initiatives and the operational needs of the engineering teams you serve. You’ll report to our head of engineering and be expected to split your time roughly 50/50 between people management and hands-on development. Prioritization always goes to leading and supporting your engineers. Your team will consist of four engineers.

What’s unique about management at Miaplaza:

Miaplaza is a US-based education company, which means we probably are doing things differently than you’ve done in your past experience. Here are a few differences you may notice:

  1. You will first onboard within your team as a senior engineer for 2 months. You will start to onboard as a manager during month two and will take over the team roughly at 10 weeks. This is non-negotiable as both periods of time are equally important.

  2. We expect our EMs to spend approximately 50% of their time hands-on, even after they’ve completed onboarding as a senior engineer.

  3. We emphasize the importance of pedagogical principles. A responsibility is to grow your engineers and those around you.

  4. One of such pedagogical principles is that we expect you to have full oversight into your direct reports' work; you can’t properly teach if you don’t see the process behind the output.

  5. Feedback is the norm. You’ll be expected to give meaningful, specific reinforcement and constructive feedback whenever you notice something. You should also expect to receive feedback. Ultimately, everything we do is optimizing ourselves, our teams, our processes, and our company to best support our students.


  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

  • 2+ years of experience being a mentor/leader, of which:

    • 1+ years leading a team, formally or as a tech lead

  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Infrastructure Engineering, of which:

  • 3+ years running production workloads on Kubernetes (GKE preferred)

  • 3+ years of experience with a major cloud provider and Infrastructure as Code. GCP is our primary cloud and we expect senior-level knowledge of IAM, networking, KMS, GKE, CloudSQL and Secret Manager

  • 3+ years of experience operating at a Senior, Staff, or Principal Engineer level.

  • Experience with CI/CD pipeline design and operations

  • Experience with GitOps (FluxCD or ArgoCD)

  • Experience working directly with engineering teams and other managers as your customers on scoping and prioritization

  • Experience leading incident response, including running postmortems

What makes you stand out:

Experience leading a team through a significant architectural migration

Experience with consumer platforms at scale

Experience building in regulated environments

Experience operating self-hosted observability stacks (Prometheus, Thanos, Loki, Grafana, Tempo, OpenTelemetry)

Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling

Experience supporting .NET/C# application deployments

Experience with database operations (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, RabbitMQ)

Experience with Istio or other service meshes

Responsibilities

  • Work with your team to design, build, and operate the infrastructure the rest of engineering depends on: clusters, pipelines, databases, edge, and observability

  • Your customers are the other engineering teams. Work with the other Engineering Managers and product development leadership to scope and prioritize platform work

  • Set the quality bar for your team. Lead by example.

  • Manage, lead, and mentor your team while working side by side with them in code quality, clean infrastructure-as-code, soft skills, best practices, etc

  • Lead team trainings, set SMART goals, hold performance reviews, and provide individual feedback recurrently to each of your devs

Our hiring process

As a remote company, we receive a large number of applicants, and finding the best fit for this role is our top priority — that’s why our process is longer than usual. At every stage, we try to be respectful of your time and grateful you’re spending it with us.

  • Application and CV Review - Our team will review your application responses and CV, then follow up with an update.

  • Initial Technical Screen (20 minutes) - A quick screening call to answer some administrative questions and confirm your basic technical knowledge. You'll be asked some administrative questions and 7 short technical questions related to the role.

  • Behavioral Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of our HR team to discuss your experience and share your approach throughout your career so far.

  • 1st Technical Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of the Infrastructure team to answer focused technical questions tailored to our work.

  • Scenario-based Technical Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of the Infrastructure team and the team's engineering manager to work through two hypothetical DevOps scenarios and how you would tackle them.

  • Leadership Interview (1 hour) - With our head of engineering and executive leadership.

  • Reference check - We'll reach out to the 3 references you provided, at least one being a former or current manager and any former or current direct reports.

  • Offer & background check - Once you sign your offer, we'll run a background check in accordance with applicable law.

We give honest, timely feedback at every step. Job searches are hard; we don't want to make yours harder.

Compensation and setup

The pay range for this role is €82,000 - 140,000. Miaplaza’s compensation philosophy ensures equity and competitiveness while considering regional differences in labor costs. Placement within a range is determined based on factors such as demonstrated skills, internal equity, and local labor market rates for the candidate’s geographic area.

Miaplaza is a growing, self-funded EdTech company. We're an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If you need accommodations at any point in the process, just let us know.

title: Member of Technical Staff - Infrastructure Security
descriptionHtml:
About Black Forest Labs

We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world.

Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use.

Our FLUX models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. We're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. From our labs in Freiburg to San Francisco, we're building what comes next.

 

Why This Role

We develop AI models and run the infrastructure on which those models are trained, deployed, and served to customers. Securing that infrastructure comes with real challenges: researchers need flexible access to significant compute resources, production systems need strong isolation and reliability, and model assets and customer data need protection throughout their lifecycle.

Our research and production infrastructure teams design, build, and operate these systems. We're looking for an experienced, hands-on security engineer to partner with them as we grow: someone who can dig into the details, do the engineering, and work alongside those teams to improve our defensive posture.

This is an engineering role: you'll spend time reading code, understanding systems, debugging problems, and shipping changes.

 

What You’ll Work On

These are the areas this role draws from; you're not expected to cover
them all at once:

  • Infrastructure architecture and isolation. Understand how our research and production environments fit together, identify consequential attack paths, and work with infrastructure teams to improve network boundaries, workload isolation, and access controls.

  • Identity and access. Improve how people, services, and workloads authenticate and obtain access to infrastructure. Reduce unnecessary privileges, strengthen secrets management, and develop practical approaches to short-lived credentials and privileged access.

  • Cloud and compute security. Strengthen security across cloud infrastructure, compute clusters, containers, storage, and orchestration systems. Help establish reusable patterns that engineers can adopt without unnecessary friction.

  • Model and customer-data protection. Work with research and engineering teams to protect model artifacts, training and inference pipelines, and sensitive data. Understand where trust boundaries matter and develop ways to verify that they hold.

  • Security in engineering workflows. Improve the security of infrastructure-as-code, build and deployment pipelines, and software artifacts. Build tooling and guardrails that help engineering teams prevent, detect, and fix problems without making security a bottleneck.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong experience securing production cloud infrastructure, with a solid understanding of identity, networking, operating systems, and distributed systems.

  • Hands-on engineering ability. You can write and review code, work with infrastructure-as-code, debug unfamiliar systems, and implement the improvements you recommend.

  • Good security judgment. You can distinguish meaningful risks from theoretical ones, make sensible tradeoffs, and explain why a particular security improvement matters.

  • Experience working closely with infrastructure or platform engineers, including designing changes that are practical to deploy and operate.

  • Experience in using LLMs and agents for security work, along with a clear-eyed view of where they help, where they don't, and how they themselves can be attacked.

  • Comfort working with real autonomy, finding your way through complex systems, and turning loosely defined problems into concrete improvements.

Experience with GPU clusters, ML infrastructure, multi-tenant services, Kubernetes, and software supply-chain security would be particularly relevant, but none is a prerequisite. We're more interested in people who have solved difficult security problems in real systems than in candidates who can check every box on a technology list.

 

How We Work Together

We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. This role is based in San Francisco, and you’ll join us in the office at least 2 days a week, or one full week every other week.

Everything we do is grounded in four values:

  • Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.

  • Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.

  • Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.

  • Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.

If this sounds like work you’d enjoy, we’d love to hear from you.

Base Annual Salary:

US $220,000 - $280,000 USD + Equity

 

Note: We may use AI-assisted tools to help organize applications. All hiring decisions are always made by our team.

Compensation:

For this principal development role, with 12+ years of experience, the compensation range is  $12,500 - $20,800 USD based on location and experience level per month and in gross amount. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience

About the Role: 

We are seeking an exceptional Principal Infrastructure Engineer to design, build, operate, and scale the platform that powers Sezzle. Your focus will be the hardest infrastructure problems: increasing throughput, reducing latency, removing capacity bottlenecks, strengthening resilience, and making production operations more automated and predictable as the business grows.

You will own complex technical initiatives from architecture and prototyping through implementation, production rollout, and ongoing operation. Your impact will come from the systems you build, the problems you solve, and measurable improvements in reliability, performance, and cost efficiency.

Our stack runs on AWS, with workloads orchestrated on Kubernetes and data anchored in Aurora RDS (MySQL and Postgres). You should know these technologies deeply and be comfortable moving between cloud architecture, networking, cluster internals, database performance, and application behavior to understand how the entire system scales. You will write code and infrastructure-as-code, debug production systems, and deliver changes that hold up under real traffic and failure conditions.

Operational ownership is part of the job. You will participate in the on-call rotation and take a hands-on role in recovering from major incidents, including full outages. We need someone who can form and test hypotheses using logs, metrics, and traces, make sound mitigation decisions with incomplete information, and turn incident findings into lasting engineering fixes.

You will also build and apply AI-assisted infrastructure and SRE tooling for incident investigation, capacity analysis, runbook automation, and toil reduction. You will evaluate these tools through practical results and apply appropriate access controls, validation, and auditability to their use in production.

This role reports to engineering leadership and works closely with application engineers, Security, and Compliance. You will develop a deep understanding of how Sezzle's business operates and how customer journeys, transaction patterns, and product decisions shape infrastructure demand and behavior. You will use that understanding to identify and deliver improvements across teams and technical domains, connecting infrastructure decisions to better customer outcomes and business performance.

What you’ll do: 

  • Own the technical architecture and evolution of core infrastructure: identify system limits, prioritize technical improvements, and implement changes that support increasing traffic, data volume, and workload complexity.
  • Connect business understanding to improvements across the system: learn how key business workflows behave in production, trace their impact across applications, data, and infrastructure, and partner across teams to improve performance, reliability, and cost efficiency beyond any single service or team's scope.
  • Engineer for scale and performance: build capacity models, run load and stress tests, diagnose bottlenecks across compute, networking, Kubernetes, and databases, and validate improvements against throughput, latency, saturation, and cost per workload.
  • Design and build AWS infrastructure: implement resilient account, IAM, network, and service architectures; address service quotas, fault isolation, and multi-AZ or multi-region requirements as workloads grow.
  • Build and operate the Kubernetes platform: improve cluster architecture, lifecycle automation, workload isolation, resource allocation, autoscaling, safe upgrades, and deployment reliability.
  • Scale and optimize Aurora RDS for MySQL and Postgres: tune queries and indexes, address connection and replication bottlenecks, plan capacity, improve failover behavior, and implement safe schema changes and database migrations with application engineers.
  • Improve reliability through engineering: define and instrument service-level objectives and error budgets with service owners; implement failure isolation, backpressure, load shedding, and safe retry behavior where needed to prevent cascading failures.
  • Participate in on-call and drive technical recovery during serious incidents: use evidence-based triage, execute mitigations, communicate findings, and implement corrective actions from postmortems.
  • Implement and test disaster recovery: design backup, restore, and failover mechanisms against agreed recovery time and recovery point objectives; run recovery exercises and document measured results.
  • Build infrastructure-as-code and operational automation: make provisioning, configuration, deployments, upgrades, and recovery reproducible, reviewed, testable, and recoverable. Eliminate recurring manual work through code.
  • Build observability that makes production diagnosable: improve metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and actionable alerts, with visibility into service health, scaling limits, and customer impact.
  • Deliver safe infrastructure migrations: design phased rollouts, compatibility checks, validation, and rollback paths for changes to shared production systems.
  • Improve cloud cost efficiency through technical changes: right-size resources, improve utilization, tune autoscaling and storage, and quantify savings while maintaining reliability and performance targets.
  • Build and evaluate AI-assisted operational tooling: apply AI to investigation, runbooks, anomaly analysis, and repetitive operations, with bounded permissions, reviewable actions, and measurable improvements in accuracy or toil.
  • Make technical decisions clear and executable: write architecture proposals, evaluate technology tradeoffs through prototypes and benchmarks, review changes affecting shared infrastructure, and document how systems operate and fail.

What We look for: 

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a similar technical field (required)
  • 12+ years of experience across infrastructure, platform, site reliability, software development, or related engineering disciplines, with substantial hands-on depth designing and operating production infrastructure at scale.
  • Deep expertise with AWS: production experience across compute, IAM, multi-account architectures, and networking, including VPC design and private connectivity.
  • Deep expertise with Kubernetes in production: cluster lifecycle, scheduling, resource management, autoscaling, networking, and troubleshooting business-critical workloads. EKS experience is strongly preferred.
  • Deep expertise with relational databases at scale, specifically RDS/Aurora (MySQL and/or Postgres): query performance, indexing, connection management, replication, high availability, failover, and verified backup and recovery.
  • A track record of personally delivering infrastructure scaling improvements: identifying constraints, measuring baseline behavior, implementing changes, and demonstrating gains in capacity, latency, reliability, or cost efficiency.
  • Strong coding and automation skills, using Golang, Python, or similar languages to build production tooling and eliminate operational toil, alongside infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform or equivalent.
  • Strong systems fundamentals: Linux, networking, DNS, TLS, storage, concurrency, and distributed system failure modes, with the ability to debug problems across infrastructure and application boundaries.
  • Experience operating a 24/7, high-availability platform where downtime has direct customer or revenue impact, including hands-on incident response and postmortem remediation.
  • Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation and demonstrated ability to recover production systems under pressure using evidence-based triage, safe mitigation, and clear technical communication.
  • Experience implementing and testing disaster recovery against defined recovery objectives, including restoring data and validating service recovery.
  • Practical experience with observability, load testing, capacity planning, and safe CI/CD practices for shared production infrastructure.
  • Active use of AI tooling in engineering or operations, with practical judgment about its limitations and how to verify generated code, recommendations, and operational actions.
  • Ability to carry ambiguous technical problems from investigation through production delivery and collaborate across engineering disciplines to resolve system-wide constraints.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Experience in fintech, payments, or banking, operating infrastructure with demanding reliability, security, and audit requirements.
  • Experience with multi-region architectures, chaos engineering, and failure testing, including the consistency and recovery tradeoffs of distributed data systems.
  • Proficiency with Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, or comparable observability systems.
  • Experience building internal platform capabilities and self-service tooling, including deployment automation, progressive delivery, and reusable infrastructure components.
  • Experience building AI-assisted incident investigation or operational automation with restricted access, auditable execution, and clear human review points

About You: 

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.
  • You go deep: you investigate how systems behave under load and failure, follow the evidence, and fix underlying causes.
  • You build and ship: you turn architecture into working code, tested infrastructure, and safe production changes.
  • You measure results: you can explain the impact of your work in availability, latency, capacity, recovery time, cost, or hours of toil removed.
  • You value simplicity: you choose systems that are understandable, operable, and appropriate to the problem, and reduce unnecessary complexity.
  • You earn trust: you listen carefully, communicate clearly, challenge technical decisions respectfully, and follow through on commitments.
  • You stay accountable for the outcome: you verify that changes work in production and that fixes remain effective as the platform scales.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Python
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres
  • DevOps and Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Open Source: Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome? 

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

title: Senior AI Product Designer  (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Recare

As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 100 employees, we continue to grow – and we are looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system and solve administrative complexity across care journeys in Europe.

What you'll own as our Senior AI Product Designer

  • You'll own end-to-end design for one of our core product areas, on a platform where AI is the foundation of the product, not a bolt-on feature. Your mission is to bring consumer-grade craft to a B2B healthcare product used by clinicians and hospital administrators under real time pressure, and to help invent the design patterns for AI-native surfaces that don't exist anywhere else yet.

  • You design the AI-native surfaces our platform is built around, including multi-modal interfaces, agent state, uncertainty, and human-in-the-loop controls, inventing the patterns as you go rather than adapting existing ones.

  • You own end-to-end design for a product area – Discharge Core, Voice Desktop, Extract & Docs, Patient Overview, or Agent – taking work from a messy problem statement through to what ships in production.

  • You contribute to our design system, building the components and AI-specific conventions that other designers and teams build on.

  • You partner closely with product and engineering, shaping technical and product direction rather than being handed a spec to execute against.

    You work with other designers across the organisation, bringing your input and influence beyond your own product area rather than staying inside a single team's boundary.

  • You hold a high craft bar in critique, lifting the standard of what the wider design team ships.

You help hold coherence across our AI Suite (Voice, Docs, Extract, Agent) and Discharge Core, so a fast-growing multi-product platform still feels like one product to the people using it.

How we design:

  • We're AI-native. We use AI tools daily in our own process, not just in what we design, and we want strong, opinionated views on how to wield them well.

  • Consumer-grade craft is the bar, even in B2B. Our users are clinicians and hospital administrators.

  • Human-in-the-loop by default. This is healthcare: AI proposes, people stay in control, and we design the approval and verification moments that make that real, not just a confidence score bolted on.

  • We ship in production, not just in Figma. Craft is judged by what clinicians actually use, so we stay close to what ships.

What to expect as our Senior AI Product Designer (m/w/d):

  • Purposeful work – your role will have a positive impact on patients, their families, and healthcare professionals.

  • Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We'll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement.

  • Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs.

  • Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you'll have the day off.


Here's how we picture you as our Senior AI Product Designer (m/w/d):

  • You have 8+ years of product design experience, with at least 3+ years operating at Senior, Principal, or Staff altitude.

  • You have designed for AI and non-determinism before, and can talk concretely about how you've communicated agent behaviour, handled errors, and kept users in control, not just in the abstract.

  • You have owned or significantly contributed to a design system, at the level of patterns and principles rather than individual components.

  • You are block-shaped: equally strong across UX process, UI craft, product thinking, research, storytelling, and cross-functional collaboration.

  • You have taken features from 0 to 1 through an ambiguous problem statement to shipped code, and you're comfortable feeling like a PM or frontend developer on the days that calls for it.

  • You have high agency and spot gaps without being asked to look for them, including outside your own product area.

  • You hold a position under pressure but change it when new information warrants, rather than becoming precious about your own decisions.

  • You communicate confidently in English and are comfortable operating in an international environment; German is a plus but not required.

  • You bring a consumer-grade craft background with exceptional design; healthtech experience is a plus but not required.

  • If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Senior DevOps Engineer

Reports to: Engineering Manager

Location: UK / Europe

Company Overview:

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we’re building this organisation from the ground up. We’re looking for people who’d rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of the team you’ve previously managed.

About the Role

As a Senior DevOps Engineer at Radiant, you’ll be a hands-on engineer at the heart of our engineering organisation, owning the design, delivery and reliability of critical infrastructure. You’ll automate and continuously improve our deployment pipelines, cloud and bare-metal environments, and Kubernetes-based orchestration layer, so our systems scale reliably to support high-performance AI and GPU workloads.

You’ll partner with Infrastructure, SRE and Product Engineering teams to embed a strong DevOps culture across the organisation. You’ll champion infrastructure as code, observability and automation at every layer of the stack, and help improve how we build and operate systems at scale.

Our engineering teams cover Infrastructure, Cluster, Network, Storage, Cloud, Observability, Security, and AI (Training & Inference).

Our Engineering teams are grouped as follows:

  • Infrastructure: Compute, Infra, Network & Storage

  • Platform: Cloud, Observability & Security

  • AI: Training & Inference

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and continuously optimise CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions to support fast, reliable, and repeatable software delivery

  • Own and evolve Infrastructure as Code practices using Terraform and Ansible, ensuring infrastructure is version-controlled, peer-reviewed, and consistently provisioned across dev, staging, and production

  • Scale CI to handle agent-driven change volume, including merge queues and fast, parallel test runs

  • Identify and eliminate human and agent bottlenecks across the software development lifecycle

  • Instrument DORA metrics and agent adoption: agent versus hand-written merges, defect and rework rates

  • Manage and maintain hosted application environments, ensuring high availability, scalability, and smooth deployment of services into production

  • Partner closely with Engineers to deeply understand their development workflows and release processes, identifying and removing friction points that slow delivery

  • Measure and improve the developer experience, improving productivity

  • Champion a self-service DevOps culture, enabling development teams to own their deployments and operational concerns through well-designed tooling, documentation, and guardrails

  • Help make runbooks and decision records a natural part of our definition of done

Your Profile

  • Proven experience in DevOps engineering and best practices

  • Hands-on experience running and automating infrastructure across public cloud and bare-metal environments

  • Strong experience with CI/CD workflows, observability, security and automation best practices

  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform and Ansible

  • Deep understanding of Kubernetes, Helm and other containerisation related tooling

  • Demonstrable scripting ability in Go, Python and Shell

  • Strong knowledge of branching, deployment strategies including the use of Git based version control

What You Bring

  • Automation instinct: If you do it twice, you automate it.

  • Engineering quality: Write clean, tested, maintainable code, and review others’ work with care.

  • Ownership: Take features from design through production, and stay accountable for how they run.

  • Pragmatism: Ship what matters, simply, and improve it from real-world feedback.

  • Collaboration: Work openly with product, infrastructure and SRE, and share what you learn.

Qualities we look for:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

  • Inspire the change: There's no blueprint for the future. You'll embrace challenges and change

  • You're real and you're true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you'll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you're talking to, you treat everyone the same.

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

  • Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

  • Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

  • Participation in the company shares program

  • Enhanced parental pay & leave

Our process: Talent screen → Hiring Manager → Technical interview (two engineers) → Final.

An overview of this role

As a Senior Engagement Manager, PS Sales focused on Germany, you will play a critical role in driving GitLab’s growth in the region by structuring services engagements that create true partnership and shared success with our customers. You will lead efforts to design, position, and close outcome-oriented professional services engagements that translate complex DevSecOps and digital transformation initiatives into clear, measurable mission-critical outcomes. 

Reporting to the Senior Manager of Engagement Management, EMEA, you will work at the intersection of technical solutioning and customer requirements, aligning each engagement to their unique needs and objectives.  In your first year, you will build trusted advisor relationships with technical leaders and partners to help integrate professional services into account strategies from early discovery through successful delivery. This is a unique opportunity to shape large-scale implementations that improve how customers plan, build, secure, and operate software using GitLab.

Some examples of our projects

  • Designing and structuring outcome-based professional services engagements that align GitLab capabilities to customers needs
  • Partnering with account executives, solutions architects, and delivery leaders to turn complex DevSecOps transformations into clear, actionable implementation roadmaps and statements of work

What you'll do

  • Build trusted advisor relationships with division chiefs, program managers, and technical leaders 
  • Conduct discovery sessions with with prospects and Systems Integrators to understand current-state capabilities, requirements and desired business outcomes
  • Design outcome-oriented services proposals that align GitLab capabilities with customer success metrics and objectives
  • Structure engagements and commercial proposals to clear outcomes maintaining flexibility for staff augmentation and packaged offerings when needed
  • Develop custom-scoped SOWs and staffing plans for complex implementations, engaging with technical architects and delivery leadership to ensure deliverability
  • Articulate GitLab's services value proposition, catalog offerings, and implementation methodologies in the context of customer requirements

  • Manage project- and account-level escalations, ensuring rapid resolution and maintaining customer confidence
  • Position consulting, training, success tiers, and additional solutions proactively to ensure successful outcomes and long-term customer retention
  • Facilitate solutioning sessions including implementation roadmapping, enterprise strategy discussions, and executive-level requirements gathering
  • Drive measurable outcomes by structuring services that support customer success metrics, accurately forecasting services bookings, and tracking key performance indicators related to bookings, margin, and attachment to strategic opportunities.
  • Own the engagement lifecycle from initial discovery and pre-sales solutioning through scoping, SOW development, staffing alignment, and transition to delivery, ensuring engagements are deliverable, clearly defined, and outcome-oriented.
  • Influence cross-functional teams by articulating GitLab’s professional services value proposition in the context of federal requirements and compliance frameworks, and by feeding customer insights back into sales, delivery, and practice management.
  • Partner with regional sales and engagement leadership to prioritize and manage services opportunities that support critical deals and strategic initiatives, providing clear recommendations on risk management, negotiation strategies, and commercial structures.
  • Foster a culture of enablement and continuous improvement by training field teams on how to position and sell professional services by sharing trends, feedback, and suggestions that improve go-to-market content and operational processes.

What you'll bring

  • Demonstrated progressive experience structuring, scoping, and selling professional services engagements in the region
  • Proven success operating in a pre-sales context, conducting discovery, designing outcome-oriented proposals, and developing custom statements of work (SOWs) and staffing plans for large, complex implementation projects.
  • Solid understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), DevOps practices, and cloud transformation initiatives, with the ability to connect technical solutions to mission objectives and measurable business outcomes.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills with executive presence, able to build trusted advisor relationships with division chiefs, program managers, contracting stakeholders, and senior technical leaders.
  • Highly developed facilitation, negotiation, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to guide customers through acquisition processes, commercial structures, and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Comfort working cross-functionally with sales, solutions architecture, delivery, and operations teams to align on deal strategy, staffing, and successful execution in a fast-paced environment.
  • Capacity to work autonomously and asynchronously in a fully remote setting, managing multiple complex opportunities while maintaining accurate forecasting and consistent alignment with GitLab values and goals.

The Professional Services Engagement Management team at GitLab is dedicated to designing and structuring services engagements that set our customers up for successful, long-term adoption of our DevSecOps platform. We build and manage strategic relationships with customers to understand their goals, surface their services needs, and translate complex transformation initiatives into clear, outcome-oriented engagement plans. Composed of experienced services, consulting, and delivery professionals distributed across multiple regions, we operate asynchronously to support field teams, shape implementation strategies, and guide customers through their services journey. We focus on creating scalable engagement models, fostering open communication with internal stakeholders, and adapting our services offerings to the evolving needs of a rapidly maturing organization and its customers. For more on how our team works, see the Professional Services Engagement Management handbook page.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off 
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave 

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. title: Senior Microsoft 365 Copilot & AI Consultant (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Vollzeit | 100 % Remote

Viele Unternehmen möchten KI einsetzen. Damit daraus ein sinnvoller Arbeitsalltag wird, braucht es passende Anwendungsfälle, eine gut vorbereitete Microsoft-365-Umgebung und eine saubere technische Einführung. Du verbindest diese Themen und begleitest unsere Kunden von der ersten Idee bis zur produktiven Nutzung.

Wir unterstützen mittelständische Unternehmen im deutschsprachigen Raum bei der Digitalisierung, Prozessautomatisierung und beim Einsatz von KI. Du arbeitest direkt mit unseren Kunden und unserem Entwicklungsteam zusammen. Dabei verbindest du verständliche Beratung mit der technischen Umsetzung in Microsoft 365.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst mit Kunden konkrete Anwendungsfälle für Microsoft 365 Copilot und Microsoft-Cloud-KI-Lösungen und bewertest Nutzen, Aufwand und technische Voraussetzungen.

  • Du übernimmst die fachliche und technische Verantwortung für die Einführung: von Bestandsaufnahme und Pilotierung über die Konfiguration bis zum Rollout und zur Übergabe.

  • Du prüfst Tenant-Konfigurationen, Identitäten und Datenzugriffe und setzt gemeinsam mit dem Kunden eine sichere Grundlage für den KI-Einsatz um.

  • Du berücksichtigst Microsoft Entra ID, Rollen und Berechtigungen sowie Security, Governance und Compliance – insbesondere Informationsschutz, Freigaben und den Umgang mit vertraulichen Daten.

  • Du konzipierst und implementierst Lösungen mit Microsoft 365 Copilot und Copilot Studio und verbindest geeignete Anwendungsfälle mit Power Automate, Power Apps und vorhandenen Geschäftssystemen.

  • Du bewertest, wann Standardfunktionen ausreichen und wann zusätzliche Microsoft-Cloud-Dienste oder individuelle Entwicklungen sinnvoll sind. Die Umsetzung stimmst du mit unserem Entwicklungsteam ab.

  • Du führst Workshops und Schulungen durch, begleitest die Einführung in den Fachbereichen und prüfst anhand vereinbarter Kriterien, ob die Lösungen den gewünschten Nutzen bringen.

  • Du dokumentierst Architektur, Konfiguration und Betriebsanforderungen und entwickelst unsere Standards für sichere KI- und Automatisierungslösungen weiter.


Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung in Microsoft-365-, Cloud- oder Digitalisierungsprojekten und hast Kunden sowohl beraten als auch technische Lösungen selbst eingeführt.

  • Du bringst praktische Erfahrung mit Microsoft 365 Copilot mit und kannst erklären, wie du eine Einführung vorbereitet, umgesetzt und begleitet hast.

  • Du hast einen breiten Überblick über Microsoft 365, insbesondere Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive und Exchange Online, und verstehst deren Zusammenspiel mit Copilot.

Kenntnisse in Microsoft Purview, Azure-KI-Diensten, Microsoft Graph oder PowerShell sind hilfreich. Wir suchen jemanden, der Kunden ganzheitlich beraten und Lösungen umsetzen kann; du musst nicht jede Microsoft-Cloud-Technologie im Detail beherrschen.

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager - EMEA
descriptionHtml:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionaryin 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

Hi there! We're hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our Product Marketing team.

We're a group that cares about getting the story right, not just getting it out the door. We work closely with product, sales, and demand gen, and we hold ourselves to a high bar because our work directly shapes how the market understands what we build.

This role gives you real ownership. You'll shape positioning and messaging for a meaningful piece of our product portfolio, build the competitive intelligence that keeps our field teams sharp, and work directly with sales leaders who depend on your materials to close deals. It's a role with visible impact, not one where your work disappears into a shared drive.

As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you'll drive go-to-market strategy for your area, from positioning through launch through enablement, while partnering with product and sales to make sure the message actually lands. This role matters because clear, credible product marketing is what turns a strong platform into a business result. Camunda operates in a technical, complex space, and getting that translation right is not optional.

What You Will Do

  • Own positioning and messaging for your product area, translating technical capability into a clear value proposition for both technical and business buyers.

  • Build and maintain a competitive intelligence program that sales actually uses, not just battlecards that sit in a folder.

  • Lead go-to-market execution for launches in your area, coordinating across product, sales, and demand gen so the message is consistent everywhere it shows up.

  • Arm the field with content that works in real conversations: pitch decks, demos, solution briefs, and objection handling.

  • Use market and customer research to inform product and positioning decisions, not just to validate ones already made.

  • Mentor and support other marketers on your team, sharing what you've learned without being asked.

What You Will Bring to the Role

  • Significant experience in B2B product marketing, ideally in enterprise software, with a track record of owning positioning and messaging end to end, not just contributing pieces of it.

  • A real competitive intelligence practice under your belt. You've built and maintained a program that sales relied on, not just responded to research requests as they came in.

  • Comfort marketing technical products to technical buyers. You can go deep enough into a technical concept to be credible with a developer, and simplify it enough to be clear to an executive.

  • Field enablement experience at scale. You've built programs that changed how a sales team talked about a product, and you know how to tell if it worked.

  • Strong cross-functional instincts. You know how to build trust with product and sales without relying on authority, and how to bring people along on a positioning decision rather than just announcing it.

  • Comfort using AI tools in your day to day work. This isn't a checkbox, it's part of how the role actually operates.

This role is an existing vacancy

title: Solution Architect (Anaplan) m/f/d
descriptionHtml:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebratingour wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

Anaplan is seeking a Solution Architect to join our Professional Services team in Germany—a group of expert consultants who are passionate about delivering real, measurable value through Anaplan’s cutting-edge planning platform.

As a key member of our Professional Services team, you won’t just be implementing solutions, you’ll shape the future of enterprise planning for our most strategic customers. This team partners closely with stakeholders across Finance, Supply Chain, and Sales Performance Management to solve complex business challenges with smart, scalable solutions. From the very first engagement, you’ll have the opportunity to lead design, delivery, and strategic advisory work that drives transformation at the enterprise level.

As we drive financial transformation, you will be a key player in architecting the future direction of decision excellence in enterprise grade companies across Germany. You will influence and drive a companies planning direction and play a pivotal role in delivering the outcomes the CFO, CIO and CEO need to take their business to the next level. 

We’re known for collaboration, deep expertise, and ability to unlock the full potential of Anaplan’s powerful connected planning platform. You’ll work with Anaplan’s industry-leading Hyperblock™ technology that delivers real-time data capabilities, and best in class planning and modelling capabilities. Grow your own skills while helping customers outpace disruption and outperform the competition—by planning smarter, faster, and more effectively.

Your Role

As an Architect, you are responsible for the successful delivery of Anaplan planning solutions in some of our most important strategic accounts. 

  • Serve as the Architectural SME for large-scale connected planning solutions.

Your Qualifications

We’re looking for smart, consultative professionals who love solving problems, building relationships, and pushing boundaries. We want you to bring your vision, experience, and passion to our team – helping our customers to out-predict, out-plan and outperform their competitors. 

  • 3+ years of experience implementing planning or EPM solutions in a customer-facing context (consulting, Professional Services or partner).

  • Experience running workshops, gathering requirements, presenting solution design.
  • German (C1 or higher) and fluent business English.
  • Willingness to travel within DACH.
  • Ability to work remote and independently.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer

The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.  

Anaplan does not:

Privacy & AI Notice

Candidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist our team in evaluating qualifications.
