title: Stellvertretende Ärztliche Leitung der Ovivamed Clinic
descriptionHtml:
Warum Ovivamed?
Bei Oviva und Ovivamed Clinic verfolgen wir die Mission, nachhaltige, personalisierte und klinisch wirksame Versorgung für alle zugänglich zu machen, während wir Europas führende KI-gestützte Plattform für die Behandlung chronischer Krankheiten aufbauen. Unsere digitalen Programme unterstützen Menschen dabei, gewichtsbedingte Erkrankungen in den Griff zu bekommen. Dabei konzentrieren wir uns auf das, was am wichtigsten ist: die Gesundheit zu verbessern, das Selbstvertrauen zu stärken und die Lebensqualität zu steigern.

Bis heute haben wir über eine Million Menschen in Grossbritannien, der Schweiz und Deutschland unterstützt. Hinter unserer Mission steht ein engagiertes Team, das in vier Ländern tätig ist, einschliesslich unseres Hubs in Polen. Jedes Gespräch, jede Coaching-Session und jede Zeile Code bringt uns einer gesünderen Zukunft näher.

Die Rolle

Als Stellvertretende Ärztliche Leitung verbindest du die direkte Arbeit mit Patient:innen mit klinischer Verantwortung. Rund 60% deiner Zeit verbringst du in Konsultationen, in denen du Patient:innen auf ihrem Weg begleitest. Die übrigen 40% arbeitest du eng mit der ärztlichen Leitung zusammen: Du vertrittst sie in Besprechungen und Entscheidungen, unterstützt deine Kolleginnen und Kollegen und bist bei Abwesenheit die erste Ansprechperson für klinische Fragen. Du arbeitest sowohl hybrid sowie wahlweise an einem unserer Praxisstandorte (Zürich, Bern, Basel oder Luzern).

Deine Aufgaben

  • Behandlung: Du führst Konsultationen und medizinische Abklärungen durch und begleitest Patient:innen mit Adipositas und Begleiterkrankungen langfristig, auch mithilfe unserer digitalen Werkzeuge.

  • Qualität: Du achtest auf eine sorgfältige Dokumentation und Abrechnung und gehst mit gutem Beispiel voran.

  • Stellvertretung: Du vertrittst die ärztliche Leitung in Fachgremien und bei betrieblichen Besprechungen.

  • Unterstützung im Team: Du begleitest Ärztinnen und Ärzte durch gemeinsame Fallbesprechungen, Hospitationen und gibst ehrliches, wertschätzendes Feedback.

  • Sicherheit: Du unterstützt die Umsetzung medizinischer Richtlinien gemäss den Schweizer Vorgaben (FMH, BAG, Datenschutz) und bist erste Anlaufstelle bei Fragen zur Patientensicherheit.

  • Abläufe: Zusammen mit dem Team Medical Operations sorgst du dafür, dass Termine gut geplant sind und die Versorgung reibungslos läuft.

  • Einarbeitung: Du begleitest neue Ärztinnen und Ärzte in ihren ersten Wochen bei Oviva.

  • Digitale Angebote: Du bringst deine klinische Erfahrung ein, wenn wir neue digitale Funktionen gemeinsam mit unseren Produktteams testen und verbessern.

Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung in der Anleitung oder Führung medizinischer Fachpersonen, idealerweise im ambulanten Bereich

  • Fundiertes Fachwissen in Adipositasmedizin, Diabetologie oder Innerer Medizin und Freude an der direkten Arbeit mit Patient:innen

  • Gute Kenntnisse des Schweizer Gesundheitswesens und der ambulanten Tarife (TARDOC bzw. ambulante Tarife)

  • Die Fähigkeit, Abläufe zu verstehen, Engpässe zu erkennen und pragmatische Lösungen umzusetzen

  • Eine klare, einfühlsame Kommunikation, auch in heiklen Situationen

  • Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch (Schweizerdeutsch ist von Vorteil, weitere Sprachen sind willkommen)

  • Qualifikation: Facharzttitel FMH in Innerer Medizin oder Endokrinologie/Diabetologie

Was Ovivamed dir bietet

  • Wirkung mit Sinn in einem stark wachsenden Umfeld, in dem sich Strukturen und Prozesse laufend weiterentwickeln.

  • Eine abwechslungsreiche Aufgabe, in der das Wohl der Patient*innen im Mittelpunkt steht

  • Persönliches Weiterbildungsbudget und attraktive Konditionen bei der beruflichen Vorsorge

  • Moderne Arbeitsmethoden und flexible Arbeitsmodelle

  • Eine offene, wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur, die Zusammenarbeit und Eigeninitiative fördert

Es ist uns sehr wichtig, eine Kultur zu haben, in der die Menschen gerne arbeiten wollen. Dies erreichen wir, indem wir unsere Werte bei allem, was wir tun, in den Vordergrund stellen:

Patient*innen stehen bei uns an erster Stelle, Wir befähigen unsere Teams, Wir machen es möglich

Oviva engagiert sich leidenschaftlich dafür, eine inklusive Kultur zu schaffen, die die unterschiedlichen Stimmen unserer Mitarbeiter*innen ermutigt, unterstützt und feiert. Wir sind ein wirklich inklusiver Arbeitsplatz, an dem man selbst sein kann und alle willkommen sind.

Bereit, etwas zu bewirken? Begleite uns bei der Transformation der digitalen Gesundheitsversorgung. Bewirb dich noch heute!

title: Technical Pre - Sales Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

At RobCo, we automate the ordinary, so humans can do the extraordinary. To achieve this, we are looking for an ambitious (Senior) Robotic Sales Engineer (m/f/d) to help us establish RobCo as leading provider of automation solutions.

Your mission

As a Robotic Sales Engineer (RSE), you are RobCo’s technical face to the customer and the technical lead on every deal you own, from the first customer call to a handover-ready solution. You work as a team with our Account Executives, and every technical question on the deal runs through you. You carry a quota together with your AE, and you win deals as a team.

Your job is to understand the customer’s process better than anyone else in the room, decide early what is feasible and what is not, and turn a real production problem into a clear, qualified automation case. You recommend the right automation approach and hand it over to our Solutions Development team without late surprises.

You work where modular robotics, software and AI come together, and you help bring physical AI from the lab into real production. You show customers what robots that perceive, learn and adapt can do in their plant today. You have direct access to the engineers, product managers and data behind our robots, and you help shape what we build next.

What you will do

  • Qualify – Join discovery calls and site visits with your AE. Assess use cases early for technical fit, business value and risk, and say no when a deal does not fit.

  • Run requirement workshops – Lead structured on-site workshops with production, engineering and operations teams. Capture parts, processes, cycle times, layout, interfaces, safety and acceptance criteria.

  • Check feasibility – Make the first technical call on reach, payload, cycle time, gripping and vision. Use quick layouts, simulations and tests to back it up, and pull in Product or Solutions Development where needed.

  • Drive the concept – Turn workshop results into clear requirements and recommend the right automation approach. You own the collaboration with Solutions Development and Product until a complete, buildable concept is in place.

  • Be the technical face to the customer – Explain our robots and solutions to plant managers, engineers and executives in plain language. Run demos and support business cases and RaaS pricing inputs.

  • Close the loop – Feed field insights back to Product, so what customers need shapes what we build.

What you bring

  • 3+ years where automation meets the customer: technical pre-sales, application engineering or automation projects

  • You want to be measured by results: you share a quota with your AE and push deals over the line

  • You have had your hands on robot cells, from grippers and vision to feeders, conveyors and safety, and you know what makes them run on the shop floor

  • You walk through a plant, watch a process for ten minutes and see where automation pays off

  • You lead conversations with confidence, whether with an operator on the line or the plant manager signing off the investment

  • You think in structure: after your workshop, the team can build on what you captured

  • You can sketch a layout or check reach in CAD or simulation (e.g. Autodesk Fusion, Visual Components)

  • You speak German and English fluently and enjoy being on the road, around 30% of the time

  • Experience in physical AI (AI-based perception, learning-based manipulation, autonomous robots) is a plus

  • Know-how in machine tending, palletizing, assembly or pick-and-place is a plus

  • Robot programming or system integrator experience is a plus

Why join RobCo?

  • Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

  • Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

  • As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

  • Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

  • Work out across Germany in over 7,200 studios with our subsidized Wellpass membership.

  • Flexible working hours, a modern office, and - depending on the role - the option to work from home.

  • Regular team events - from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that continuously learns and improves, requiring zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. In October 2026, RobCo reached unicorn status with a valuation exceeding one billion US dollars, with its valuation doubling in less than nine months. title: Research Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Hudson River Trading (HRT) is a quantitative trading firm at the forefront of technological innovation. We build and deploy cutting-edge systems within one of the world’s most advanced computing environments to power our global trading operations. Our non-siloed, collaborative coding environment empowers talented engineers to make significant contributions and see their impact daily. At HRT, you'll be challenged to solve the most complex problems in trading alongside many of the brightest minds in the field.

We are seeking highly motivated and skilled Research Engineers who will work very closely with our Algo Developer (Quant Research) trading teams. These roles require exceptional programming fundamentals, a strong user focus, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with constantly evolving requirements. Multitasking and context switching are inherent aspects of this role, through which you will gain insight into the ideation and execution of some of the world's most sophisticated trading strategies.  

Research Engineers at HRT work on a wide variety of projects. Examples include:

  • Designing highly customized quantitative systems that enable Algo Developers to easily express and backtest new predictive signals.
  • Building world-class research tooling to speed up Algo Developers’ research iteration.
  • Aiding the development and deployment of very large deep learning models for HRT’s live trading.
  • Improving HRT’s monetization systems which turn our predictions into profitable trades.
  • Evaluating sim vs. live differences to improve the fidelity of our simulations.
  • Building systems to monitor and manage live trading.
  • Specializing in specific time horizons, from high frequency trading to mid-to-low frequency hedge fund-style strategies.
  • Working across a very wide variety of asset classes (from equities to fixed income to options) and regions (from North America to Asia Pacific) – you’ll interact with markets across the world!

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, performant, and scalable software systems.
  • Optimize existing codebases for performance, reliability, and efficiency.
  • Debug complex issues across distributed systems in a time-sensitive environment.
  • Optimize both the mechanics and ergonomics of Algo Developer research workflows; this requires developing a deep intuition for research methodologies.
  • Balance the short term goals of individual trading teams with the longer term goals of HRT’s generalized trading platforms across trading teams. Because we don’t work in a pod environment, REs on different trading teams are expected to share technology and ideas.

Qualifications

  • Completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. If you are currently pursuing your Bachelor's degree, please apply to our Campus/New Grad opportunities.
  • Previous experience at a top-tier finance or technology company with an excellent track record of rapid advancement and superlative reviews.
  • Experience with supporting internal users is preferred; bonus if you have real hands-on experience with quant research and/or ML/Deep Learning platforms.
  • Experience with python numerical, ML and data-oriented libraries is a big plus (e.g. pandas, scikit, pytorch, etc.)
  • Candidates should be prepared for technical interviews in either Python or C++. While there is no hard language requirement for RE roles, proficiency in one of these languages will be assessed during the interview process.
  • Kindness and empathy is a real requirement. No “smart jerks” at HRT. 
  • Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and design principles.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • HRT ships every day. The ability to thoughtfully, methodically, and reliably deploy new software and features is a critical skill. 
  • If you have management experience, that’s always a bonus – but even so, expect to code!

The estimated base salary range for this position is 200,000 to 300,000 USD per year (or local equivalent). The base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role will also be eligible for discretionary performance-based bonuses and a competitive benefits package.

For more info about interviewing at HRT, see this blog!

Culture

Hudson River Trading (HRT) brings a scientific approach to trading financial products. We have built one of the world's most sophisticated computing environments for research and development. Our researchers are at the forefront of innovation in the world of algorithmic trading.

At HRT we welcome a variety of expertise: mathematics and computer science, physics and engineering, media and tech. We’re a community of self-starters who are motivated by the excitement of being at the cutting edge of automation in every part of our organization—from trading, to business operations, to recruiting and beyond. We value openness and transparency, and celebrate great ideas from HRT veterans and new hires alike. At HRT we’re friends and colleagues – whether we are sharing a meal, playing the latest board game, or writing elegant code. We embrace a culture of togetherness that extends far beyond the walls of our office.

Feel like you belong at HRT? Our goal is to find the best people and bring them together to do great work in a place where everyone is valued. HRT is proud of our diverse staff; we have offices all over the globe and benefit from our varied and unique perspectives. HRT is an equal opportunity employer; so whoever you are we’d love to get to know you.

We employ various methods to evaluate the authenticity of candidate responses. If we determine that AI assistance was used by an applicant during an interview or an assessment, we reserve the right to immediately end the interview or assessment, disqualify the applicant’s candidacy and/or rescind any job offers extended.

descriptionHtml:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

At RobCo, we automate the ordinary, so humans can do the extraordinary. To achieve this, we are looking for an ambitious Sales Development Representative (m/f/d) to help us establish RobCo as leading provider of automation solutions.

You are part of our revenue team and actively drive the new customer pipeline. You independently build relationships with potential clients, qualify accounts, and turn market potential into concrete sales opportunities. With a data-driven and performance-oriented approach, you directly shape the growth of RobCo in Germany and make a significant contribution to the team’s success.

Your Responsibilities

  • Contact Specialist:
    You initiate first contact with potential customers and identify the right decision-makers.

  • Sales Professional:
    You generate new sales opportunities and work strategically within a dynamic marketing landscape.

  • Relationship Manager:
    You build and maintain relationships in line with RobCo’s Operating Principles and ensure a smooth handover to the Field Sales team.

  • Team Player:
    You collaborate closely with other departments and support our campaigns to optimize the overall sales strategy.

We're looking for someone who has:

  • 1–3 years of relevant professional experience in Sales Development, Business Development, or a comparable performance-driven role. You have experience in direct customer interaction and are motivated to actively contribute to building and growing the revenue team.

  • Results-driven: You have a proven track record of meeting or exceeding prospecting and outreach quotas.

  • Technology enthusiast: You have a strong interest in robotics or the manufacturing industry.

  • Customer-focused: You are a natural networker who builds trusted customer relationships and understands the importance of excellent customer engagement.

  • Strong communicator: You possess excellent communication skills in both German and English.

Why join RobCo?

  • Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

  • Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

  • As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

  • Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

  • Work out across Germany in over 7,200 studios with our subsidized Wellpass membership.

  • Flexible working hours, a modern office, and—depending on the role—the option to work from home.

  • Regular team events—from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that continuously learns and improves, requiring zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. In October 2026, RobCo reached unicorn status with a valuation exceeding one billion US dollars, with its valuation doubling in less than nine months. With $200M raised from investors including Sequoia, Lightspeed, Lingotto, Kindred, Cherry Ventures, and the European Tech Collective, 225+ people globally, and 3.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our Bay Area Lab in San Francisco.

title: SAP Engineer
descriptionHtml:
TL;DR: We're looking for exceptional SAP engineers eager to build the AI layer for operating the world’s most complex IT setups. This role moves beyond just ABAP: you’ll develop software across the stack, design AI harnesses and agents, influence product direction, and work with customers.

Why Conduct

Today, no single person fully understands their ERP setup: decades of customisation, millions of lines of ABAP, and undocumented changes from thousands of consultants has led to spiralling complexity. As a result, projects take years and migrations costs hundreds of millions.

Conduct lets IT teams run faster. Teams collaborate alongside AI agents to accelerate their work, be it fit-gap analyses, hypercare support, deciphering business processes, writing ABAP, and more.

We believe this is a generation-defining mission: by accelerating IT, businesses can evolve faster, unlocking productivity across industries. Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems, we just closed a $50M+ Series A from top-tier funds, and we're still early enough that what you build here defines the company.

We're a small, talent-dense team doing our life's work at Conduct. We value ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. If you bring that same drive, we'll make sure this is the place you do yours too.

Who We Hire

We're looking for an developer who understands ABAP inside out, down into implementation and runtime details, and is excited about what becomes possible when you put AI on top of it.

You'll stand out if you:

  • Have experience of hands-on ABAP and SAP development experience: technical consultant, ABAP developer, solutions architect, or similar

  • Understand how SAP systems are actually structured beneath the surface: data models, BAPIs, IDocs, function modules, enhancement frameworks

  • Have worked within or alongside large SAP implementations and migrations, understanding the complexities that arise from these

  • Are eager to work beyond ABAP, including in writing AI agents, backend and frontend, infrastructure, etc.

  • Bring strong, pragmatic engineering instincts and care about code that holds up in production at enterprise scale

We hire the best, wherever they come from: we sponsor visas and are based in London. We believe diverse teams build better products and especially encourage underrepresented groups in tech to reach out.

What You'll Own

We don’t box people by background or role: if you have a strength in an area, we’d love for you to contribute. This means everything from writing developing our connector in ABAP, developing AI agents that execute ABAP development tasks, to contributing to product direction and implementation.

You'll speak to customers, shape product direction, and ship things that run inside some of the most complex enterprise environments in the world. As an SAP specialist you’ll catch the edge cases, constraints, and quirks that only someone with that experience would spot.

Our Stack

Our stack prioritises what matters: shipping to customers—fast—without compromising on quality and engineering.

Fundamentals are more important to us than familiarity with any technology or tool: if you're strong, we’re sure you'll pick it up fast. Here’s our setup:

  • ABAP: Custom reports to integrate ABAP-based systems with the Conduct platform

  • React, Vite, TanStack frontend

  • Kotlin backend: Modern and expressive, paired with the maturity, tooling, and depth of the Java ecosystem. Lets us ship fast now without painting ourselves into a corner later.

  • Temporal and PortKey: Absorbs infrastructure complexity around durable execution and enterprise-compliant LLM routing, so we can focus on shipping instead.

  • Specialised LLM Harness: Built from hard-earned experience to give agents maximum freedom and intelligence without compromising on enterprise control, governance, or reliability.

title: Senior Board Test Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About the job

Turn board design insight into reliable tests that detect manufacturing defects in Graphcore’s hardware.

As a Senior Board Test Engineer in Bristol, you’ll develop manufacturing tests for Graphcore’s advanced electronic products. You’ll focus on printed circuit board assemblies and the faults that affect their operation.

Your work will help improve defect coverage across the test and inspection tools used by contract electronics manufacturers. You’ll help the team detect and manage hardware faults arising during manufacturing and product use.

You’ll analyse PCB designs for testability and manufacturing risks, then develop boundary scan and embedded functional tests. You’ll also diagnose complex electronic faults down to component level.

The role takes your test solutions beyond development, through deployment and support in factory and field environments.

The team and culture

The Product Test and Diagnosis team detects and manages hardware defects across chips, boards and finished systems. Its work covers manufacturing sites and products in the field.

You’ll work closely with Hardware Design and Manufacturing Operations, linking design analysis with manufacturing test needs. You’ll also work with software, silicon design and external board test partners on complex hardware problems.

What we’re looking for

  • Strong electronics fundamentals and experience in manufacturing test for advanced electronic systems.
  • Understanding of PCB manufacturing, surface-mount assembly, failure mechanisms, and automated optical and X-ray inspection capabilities.
  • Experience developing JTAG 1149 boundary scan test solutions.
  • Awareness of bed-of-nails testing (ICT/MDA) and high-volume in-system or on-board programming techniques (ISP/OBP).
  • Ability to solve problems in complex electronic systems and diagnose defects down to component level.
  • Clear communication and the ability to work with internal engineering teams and external board test partners.

While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. We also welcome engineers returning to the profession after a career break, including through returnship routes.

Benefits

  • Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility
  • Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work
  • Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension
  • Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success
  • Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day
  • Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones
  • Electric Vehicle Scheme: Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice
  • Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme and dental cover

We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.

Sponsorship

Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.

Access to controlled technology

Some roles at Graphcore involve access to technology subject to U.S. export control regulations. Depending on the role, we may need to assess whether export authorisation is required, taking account of factors such as work location, citizenship and immigration status. Where authorisation is required, this may affect whether or when you can start the role. We’ll explain any relevant requirements during the recruitment process.

Join the Team at Graphcore

Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.

Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.

Bring your board test expertise to Graphcore. Apply for the Senior Board Test Engineer role.

title: (Senior) Business & Financial Analyst (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Foodji macht frisches, gutes Essen im Büro jederzeit verfügbar. Unsere autonomen Foodjis stehen in bald tausend Unternehmen in Deutschland, jede Transaktion, jede Lieferung und jedes Gericht erzeugt Daten. Diesen Datenschatz wollen wir noch konsequenter nutzen und die ganze Organisation befähigen, mit starkem AI-Enablement selbst mit Daten zu arbeiten. Dafür suchen wir dich.

Du wirst Teil unseres Finance & BI Teams und arbeitest eng mit Controlling und BI. Wir bauen zusammen die Zahlenbasis, auf der Foodji gesteuert wird und gehen Fragen aus dem Business gemeinsam an: schnell, präzise und mit dem Anspruch, jede Frage bis zur Entscheidung durchzudenken.

Deine Mission bei Foodji

  • Ist-Zahlen & Treiber: Du analysierst gemeinsam mit dem Controlling die operativen Treiber hinter den Ist-Zahlen und leitest konkrete Maßnahmen ab für alle Teams.

  • Planung: Du baust treiberbasierte Modelle für Budget und rollierenden Forecast, inklusive Szenarien und Annahmen aus den Fachbereichen.

  • Reporting: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Controlling das Management-, Board- und Investorenreporting weiter, mit Fokus auf Treiber und Ausblick.

  • Business Cases & Unit Economics: Du bewertest neue Standorte, Kundensegmente, Pricing und Initiativen und findest die Hebel für Marge und Wachstum.

  • Metriken: Gemeinsam mit dem BI-Team definierst du Metriken und Business-Logik im Semantic Layer, damit alle mit denselben Zahlen arbeiten.

  • Business Partnering: Du bist Sparringspartner:in für Geschäftsführung, Sales, Account Management, Operations, Culinary und Marketing und begleitest die Umsetzung deiner Empfehlungen.

AI-native arbeiten

AI ist bei uns das Werkzeug, mit dem wir Analytics bauen. Wir arbeiten täglich mit AI-Tools wie Claude und Claude Code, direkt auf unserem Snowflake Data Warehouse.

  • Du nutzt AI, um Daten zu explorieren und zu analysieren sowie für die Automatisierung von wiederkehrenden Tasks.

  • Du prüfst Ergebnisse kritisch, auch die zugrunde liegenden Abfragen, bevor sie in eine Entscheidung gehen, und befähigst andere Teams, selbst mit Daten und AI zu arbeiten.

Das bringst du mit

  • 2 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung in FP&A, Controlling, Corporate Finance, Beratung oder Investment Banking, idealerweise in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen.

  • Ein sehr gutes Studium in Wirtschaft, Finance, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Mathematik, Informatik oder einem verwandten Fach.

  • Sehr gute Modellierungsskills in Excel und Erfahrung mit BI-Tools wie Tableau.

  • Nachweisbare Praxis mit AI-Tools für Analytics, z.B. Claude Code, Claude oder vergleichbaren Tools. Zeig uns, was du damit gebaut hast.

  • Tempo und Ownership: Du wartest nicht auf Aufträge, siehst die nächste Frage, bevor sie gestellt wird, und bringst Dinge zu Ende.

  • Ein gutes Verständnis dafür, wie Zahlen, Operations und Go-to-Market zusammenhängen.

  • Du übersetzt komplexe Analysen in eine klare Botschaft, für das Management genauso wie für Kolleg:innen ohne Finance-Hintergrund und sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch.

  • Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse.

  • Ein Plus: Erfahrung in einem Startup oder Scale-up und ein Hintergrund in Food, Retail, Logistik oder einem anderen operativ geprägten Geschäftsmodell sowie Erfahrung mit einem Data Warehouse (z. B. Snowflake), SQL oder einem Semantic Layer.

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

  • Echte Wirkung: Deine Analysen fließen direkt in Entscheidungen von Geschäftsführung und Fachbereichen.

  • Kurze Wege und enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern.

  • Einen modernen Stack (Snowflake, Tableau, NetSuite, AI-Tools) und den Freiraum, ihn weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Ein Team, das gerade neu aufstellt, wie FP&A mit AI und Semantic Layer arbeitet, und dich dabei mitgestalten lässt.

  • Ein Unternehmen, das Hardware, Food und Software verbindet, mit Büro in München.

UNSERE BENEFITS

  • Office Foodji & Lunchit App: Immer bestens versorgt

  • bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente

  • Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung

  • EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios

  • JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec

  • KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind

  • Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands

  • Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen

  • Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Perspektiven!

  • Flexwork: Arbeite 30 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU-Ausland

  • Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür

  • Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam!

NOCH FRAGEN?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter!

Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds.

Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst.

Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür.

Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns.

Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt.

Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife
The engineering challenge

You will design and evolve the services that power core banking products. The systems you help build process thousands of financial transactions every day. They must be scalable, resilient and secure. When money moves, it has to work. Every time.

But this role goes beyond implementation.

You will shape technical direction. Influence cross-team initiatives. Own complex, high-impact work from concept through to production. You will help decide not just how we build, but what we build and why.

This is senior in impact, not just title.

We’re growing across several of our product-engineering tribes at Zopa, with current opportunities in Current Accounts, Lending, Credit Cards and Product Enablement.

We care deeply about great engineering, which is why our core stack is Kotlin, running on a modern platform with Kafka, Kubernetes, Docker and AWS Aurora Postgres. But great engineers aren’t defined by a single language which is why we are agnostic with our hiring.

We want the right people, not the 'right' language, so if you come from a C#/.NET background, bring solid fundamentals, and have an appetite for learning something new, we’ll invest in you, help you grow your skills and confidently step into our Kotlin ecosystem.


Your impact:

  • Owning complex initiatives end to end, from idea to measurable outcome

  • Designing scalable backend systems that stand up to real-world scale and complexity

  • Making architectural decisions that balance immediate delivery with long-term sustainability

  • Bringing structure and clarity to ambiguous problems

  • Influencing prioritisation and trade-offs across teams

  • Raising the bar for engineering quality, reliability and accountability

  • Mentoring engineers and strengthening overall team capability

  • Driving continuous improvement in how we build and operate systems


    • Your toolkit:
  • You'll work with C#, Kafka, Kubernetes, Docker, AWS Aurora Postgres, and other modern technologies. If you haven't worked with all of these, we value skilled engineers with a willingness to learn.

  • A track record of delivering high-impact, complex systems in production environments

  • Strong testing discipline, with a commitment to strictly following Test-Driven Development (TDD)
  • Strong systems thinking and architectural judgement
  • The ability to navigate ambiguity and turn complexity into clear, actionable plans
  • Confidence making data-informed technical decisions with long-term consequences in mind
  • Experience influencing beyond your immediate team
  • A deep customer focus and a bias toward measurable outcomes
  • Experience mentoring others and amplifying team impact
  • Ownership beyond your own output

    • We’ll support your transition and cross-training into a JVM/Kotlin environment. What matters most to us is how you think, how you approach problem-solving, and the scale and impact of what you’ve built.


    Our engineering culture:
  • Customer impact over unnecessary complexity
  • Team success over individual heroics
  • Operational ownership, not just feature delivery
  • Continuous improvement through honest feedback

    • Added bonus:
  • Experience with fintech or banking is a plus, but we value problem-solvers from all backgrounds

    • At Zopa we value flexible ways of working.

    We value face-to-face collaboration and a good work-life balance. This hybrid role requires you to come to our London office 2-3 days a week.

    You'll also have the option of working from abroad for up to 120 days a year!* But no matter where you are, we’ll make sure you’ve got everything you need to thrive, both in your work and home life, from day one.

    *Subject to having the right to work in the country of choice

    Diversity Statement

    Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments.

    Our approach to AI in interviews

    At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030, we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs.

    Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process.

    Behavioural and competency-based interviews: please don't use AI. These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other.

    Technical interviews: it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your Talent Partner will let you know what's expected at each stage. Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way.

title: Senior Cloud Platform Engineer (AWS/GCP)
descriptionHtml:
At Ensono, our purpose is to be a relentless ally, disrupting the status quo and unleashing our clients to Do Great Things! We enable our clients to achieve key business outcomes that reshape how our world runs. As an expert technology adviser and managed service provider with cross-platform certifications, Ensono empowers our clients to keep up with continuous change and embrace innovation.

Developing impactful solutions is something we do together at Ensono because Ideas Start Here. Great things happen when many voices are heard, and people are supported to run with their ideas. On our teams, you will be backed by leaders with a passion for our business. This is a place where your ideas can Do Great Things.

We can Do Great Things because we have great Associates. The Ensono Core Values unify our diverse talents and are woven into how we do business.

Adventure starts here. Here you will be a part of a team that encourages you to master your craft, ask tomorrow’s questions today, and chart your path. Our Associates focus on client impact with curiosity and a feeling of relentless commitment.

About the role and what you will be doing:

This is an exciting opportunity to join a small, friendly, Agile-based, team working on some of the hottest public cloud technologies.  

The Public Cloud Product Engineering team works closely with our Product Management team to bring to life standard services and solutions that can be repeatedly sold to multiple managed service customers.  

Using your strong background in automation, engineering, and best practice you will also play a major role in defining and evolving our public cloud standards, implementing new tools, onboarding new AWS and GCP services, and act as an SME supporting other teams. 

The successful candidate will be someone who can demonstrate a genuine desire and passion for public cloud; automation; keeping it simple, supportable, and scalable; with proven ability to deliver pragmatic workable solutions on time. 

Responsibilities:

  • Act as the lead engineer on Product Engineering epics and stories.
  • Develop (“operationalize”) new repeatable Ensono public cloud services and solutions.
  • Define and evolve public cloud technical standards to ensure repeatability, supportability, scalability, and security.
  • Make recommendations on technical stack including research, assessments, bake-offs, and proof of concepts.
  • Assess and onboard new AWS and GCP services in line with the Product roadmap.
  • Drive the deployment of automated infrastructure and systems using IAC, config management and scripting.
  • Provide subject matter expertise and advice to pre-sales architects on our technical standards.
  • Act as a final line of escalation and assistance for the cloud operations team for major problems.
  • Proactively keep up to date on public cloud services and related technology. 

Desired Skills and Experience

  • 8+ years’ experience in supporting highly customer-focused mission critical environments (e.g., high profile web or enterprise infrastructure) essential.
  • 5+ years’ experience of architecting, engineering, or supporting public cloud solutions on AWS or GCP.
  • Sound knowledge of AWS or GCP best practice, security considerations, and architectural design patterns.
  • Experience of implementing and supporting public-cloud based workloads and services.
  • Hold multiple current AWS or Google Cloud Certifications (or be able to demonstrate equivalent level of knowledge).
  • Experience of building solutions using Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, Cloud formation) 
  • Experience of config management systems (e.g., Ansible).
  • Excellent Linux O/S knowledge and experience (RHCE or equivalent level of knowledge).
  • Scripting ability in Python, Perl, or Bash.
  • Experience of using Git for version control.
  • Experience of the AWS or GCP CLI and scripting against it.
  • Experience of working with, designing, deploying, or supporting containerized environments (ECS/EKS/Kubernetes/Docker) is useful, but not essential.
  • Experience of Jenkins or other CI/CD pipeline technology useful.
  • Able to leverage AI tools to improve productivity and quality (e.g. Copilot/Claude/Kiro)
  • Good knowledge of TCP/IP.
  • A degree in a computing-related discipline preferred or equivalent ability and knowledge.
  • Experience working in ITIL and Agile environments beneficial.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Able to share knowledge via clear and concise documentation, and demos/presentations.
  • Able to implement supportable solutions and make the complex simple.
  • Able to work in an organized and efficient manner without close supervision  
  • Must be self-motivated, a self-starter and possess a good working attitude.
  • Desire to continually grow, develop and improve.
  • Able to perform as a role model within the team. 

Benefits: 

We believe that great work deserves great rewards. In return for your ideas, commitment and ambition, we’ll give you a very competitive base salary and a range of benefits as soon as you join. On top of your highly competitive base salary, we offer: 

  • Highly competitive salary
  • Prestigious sales and broader team recognition with Annual Presidents Club
  • Company equity incentive plan
  • 27 days annual leave + plus bank holidays (increasing to 30 with length of service)
  • ½ day leave for your birthday
  • Sabbatical options at 5-years & 10-years’ service
  • 5 days study leave
  • 1 day charity leave to work for a charity of your choice
  • Competitive pension
  • Private healthcare for you and your family
  • Enhanced parental leaves
  • Life and income protection
  • Payroll giving to your favorite charity
  • Coaching & mentoring opportunities
  • Additional perks such as discounted gym membership, cycle scheme, EAP and more!

If this all sounds great, we’d love to hear from you!

title: (Senior) Consultant (m/w/d) SAP Data Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Seit über 25 Jahren verwandeln wir bei der Windhoff Group Daten in echte Geschäftschancen – von klassischer Business Intelligence bis zur KI-getriebenen Automatisierung. Dabei denken wir ganzheitlich: Wir begleiten unsere Kunden End-to-End, von der Strategie über die technische Umsetzung bis zum produktiven Betrieb. Ob BI-Reporting, Data Warehousing, Predictive Analytics oder KI-Lösungen – unser Anspruch ist es, aus Daten messbaren Mehrwert zu machen.

Als Teil unseres Teams wirst du gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Kolleg:innen an anspruchsvollen Projekten arbeiten und dich in der gesamten Data & AI-Landschaft in die Richtung weiterentwickeln, die zu dir passt.

Warum solltest du jetzt bei Windhoff starten?

Windhoff wird in der aktuellen Lünendonk®-Studie 2025/2026 explizit als einer der 20 führenden Anbieter von Data & AI Services in Deutschland genannt. Getragen wird unser Wachstum von unserem Gesellschafter Aurelius, einem globalen Private-Equity-Investor, der seit 2023 an der Windhoff Group beteiligt ist. Unser SAP-Kerngeschäft bauen wir dabei gezielt zu einer Multi-Vendor-Strategie aus – mit Databricks, Snowflake, Dremio sowie den Cloud-Plattformen Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud und AWS (u. a. Amazon Athena). Du profitierst von einem Marktumfeld, das deutlich stärker wächst als der klassische IT-Dienstleistungsmarkt – und von einem Unternehmen, das dieses Wachstum aktiv mitgestaltet, statt nur zu verwalten.

Neben unserer fachlichen Expertise sind wir ein Arbeitgeber, der Vielfalt fördert und sicherstellt, dass alle Mitarbeitenden fair behandelt werden. Teile
uns mit, wenn wir auf etwas besonders Rücksicht nehmen sollen - wie zum
Beispiel auf bestimmte Arbeitszeiten oder andere Rahmenbedingungen, deine
Situation im Privatleben oder besondere Bedürfnisse bei der Arbeit.

Klingt nach einem Traumjob? Dann jetzt Teil des Teams werden!

Aufgaben

  • Du berätst Kunden sowie Kolleg:innen, analysierst gemeinsam mit deinem Team die fachlichen und technischen Anforderungen und setzt diese in Data-Engineering-Lösungen auf Basis des SAP-Portfolios (SAP BW/4HANA, SAP Datasphere, SAP Business Data Cloud) um. Dabei tauchst du in die Geschäftsprozesse der Kunden ein und lieferst das entsprechende Datenmanagement.

  • Da dein Schwerpunkt im Backend liegt, konzipierst und implementierst du Datenmodelle und ETL-Strecken im SAP-Umfeld. In hybriden Szenarien, in denen SAP mit Plattformen wie Databricks oder Snowflake zusammenspielt, arbeitest du eng mit unseren Spezialist:innen zusammen.

  • Du bist ebenfalls am Test und an der Übergabe in den Echtbetrieb beim Kunden beteiligt.

  • Du begeisterst dich für neueste Technologien wie die SAP Business Data Cloud und denkst im Sinne unserer Multi-Vendor-Strategie mit SAP als Kern mit.

  • Durch Wissenstransfer, Projektpräsentationen und interne wie externe Technologie-Events gibst du dein Wissen an Kolleg:innen weiter.

  • Du unterstützt bei Presales- und Angebotsprozessen und bringst deine Projekterfahrung in Lösungskonzepte ein.

Qualifikation

  • Du bringst mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im SAP Data Engineering mit Schwerpunkt SAP BW/oH/4HANA und SAP Datasphere mit.

  • Du beherrschst LSA/LSA++, ABAP, AMDP, CDS und SQL-Script sicher.

  • Ergänzende Erfahrungen mit Frontend-Tools wie SAP Analysis for Office und der SAP Analytics Cloud sind gerne gesehen und runden dein Profil ab.

  • Erfahrung mit Nicht-SAP-Plattformen wie Databricks, Snowflake oder den Cloud-Plattformen Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud und AWS ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung – wichtig ist uns deine Offenheit, über den SAP-Kern hinauszudenken.

  • Du begeisterst dich für aktuelle Trends & Methoden, neueste Technologien und Standards.

  • Von Vorteil ist Erfahrung darin, agentische KI in deinen Arbeitsalltag und die Durchführung von Data-Engineering-Projekten zu integrieren. Dafür stellen wir dir ein modernes Toolset mit verschiedenen Integrationsmöglichkeiten (u. a. MCP-Server und agentische Frameworks) rund um unseren SAP-Kern bereit.

  • Durch deine hohe Eigeninitiative und sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit bringst du deine Ideen sowohl intern als auch im Umfeld unserer Kunden erfolgreich ein. Hierfür sind auch verhandlungssichere Deutsch- (C1-Niveau) und gute Englischkenntnisse erforderlich.

Benefits

  • Wir stellen standortunabhängig ein. Du kannst – je nach Projekt – zu 90 % von zuhause aus oder an einem unserer Standorte arbeiten, wenn dieser für dich gut erreichbar ist. Zu gelegentlichen Kundenterminen und Teamevents startest du von deinem Lebensmittelpunkt aus, egal wo in Deutschland du wohnst.

  • Langfristige Projekte mit wechselnden technologischen Herausforderungen

  • Ein festes Budget für Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten sowie persönliche und fachliche Entwicklungsperspektiven

  • Eine gute Work-Life-Balance durch flexible Arbeitszeiten, Überstundenausgleich sowie bis zu 40 Tagen Urlaub

  • Kurze Wege im Unternehmen, ein fairer Umgang miteinander sowie unterhaltsame Teamevents

Nutze deine Chance: Wir bieten das passende Umfeld für deine Karriere.

title: Senior CRM & Lifecycle Analyst (B2C) – Marketing Automation (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Analytics first: Du baust CRM und Lifecycle Marketing bei Foodji komplett neu auf, vom analytischen Fundament bis zur Integration der Systeme – datengetrieben, KI-enabled und mit hohem Iterationstempo.

In dieser neu geschaffenen Rolle verantwortest du die Segmentierungs- und Journey-Logik unserer B2C-Kommunikation. Dein Werkzeug sind Daten, nicht Pixel: Du entwickelst Hypothesen, übersetzt sie in Events, Segmente und Journey-Konzepte, wertest Tests aus und iterierst schnell auf Basis der Ergebnisse. Kampagnen und Content kommen aus dem Marketing- und UI/UX-Team, du lieferst das Wer, Wann und Warum. Rund 60 bis 70 Prozent deiner Arbeit sind Analytics, und KI-Tools wie Claude nutzt du dabei ganz selbstverständlich.

Foodji ist dabei kein klassischer Onlineshop: Jeder Foodji hat individuelle Stocklevels und Produktkombinationen. Genau das macht CRM bei uns besonders spannend. Dazu kommt eine riesige Datenbasis: Fast alle Kund:innen sind registriert und haben ein eigenes Profil. Du entwickelst die Logik für dynamische, hochgradig segmentierte Kommunikation über alle Kanäle – von der Foodji App über In-App-Messages, Push und Mail bis zum Foodji Screen direkt am Gerät – und nutzt Daten, um sie kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Deine Mission bei Foodji

  • Du legst das analytische und konzeptionelle Fundament für eine skalierbare CRM- und Lifecycle-Funktion für unsere B2C-Kund:innen.

  • Von der Hypothese über Segmentierung und Testdesign bis zur Auswertung von A/B-Tests und Kohorten: Du definierst, was wir ausprobieren, misst, was wirkt, und iterierst schnell auf Basis der Ergebnisse.

  • Welche Events lösen welche Kommunikation aus? Du definierst sie auf Basis unserer Daten, konzipierst dynamische Segmente und Journeys, die Stocklevels, Produktkombinationen und Nutzerbedürfnisse berücksichtigen, und entscheidest datenbasiert, ob App, In-App, Push, Mail oder Foodji Screen der richtige Kanal ist.

  • In Snowflake und mit KI-Tools wie Claude analysierst du Daten eigenständig, findest die relevanten Hebel und priorisierst Maßnahmen nach ihrem erwarteten Impact.

  • Mit Marketing, Product, Revenue Management und BI arbeitest du eng zusammen und machst Daten und technische Möglichkeiten für CRM nutzbar. Dem Team, das Kampagnen und Content umsetzt, lieferst du Segmente, Journey-Konzepte und klare Briefings.

  • Du verantwortest Datenqualität und Governance deiner Segmente, Events und Systeme und stellst sicher, dass alles performant, sicher und datenschutzkonform läuft.

  • Du baust unser CRM komplett neu auf und übernimmst die Projektverantwortung für die Integration in unsere System- und Datenlandschaft, von der Anforderungsdefinition bis zum Go-live. Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze oder vergleichbare Plattformen kennst du so gut, dass deine Konzepte direkt umsetzbar sind.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in CRM Analytics, Data Analytics, Lifecycle Marketing oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.

  • Ausgeprägter Datenblick: Du arbeitest sicher mit Daten in Snowflake oder vergleichbaren Data Warehouses, baust komplexe Segmente und Kohorten und leitest daraus klare Maßnahmen ab.

  • Analytics first: Rund 60 bis 70 Prozent deiner Arbeit sind für dich Analytics. Du iterierst schnell über Hypothesen, A/B-Tests und Kohortenanalysen, statt lange an der perfekten Gestaltung zu feilen.

  • Du bist komplett KI-enabled: Tools wie Claude oder MCP nutzt du ganz selbstverständlich in deinem Arbeitsalltag.

  • Gute Kenntnisse in Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze oder einer vergleichbaren CRM-Plattform: Du weißt, was technisch möglich ist, und konzipierst Segmente und Journeys entsprechend. Ein Plus ist Erfahrung mit Omnichannel-Journeys über App, Push, In-App und Mail.

  • Technisches Verständnis und Lust auf enge Zusammenarbeit mit Product: Du kennst die Abläufe zwischen CRM-Systemen, Plattformen und Datenquellen und achtest auf Performance, Sicherheit und Datenschutz.

  • Erfahrung im Aufbau oder in der Einführung eines CRM-Systems: Du übernimmst Ownership, treibst die Integration als Projekt eigenverantwortlich voran und koordinierst die beteiligten Teams und Dienstleister.

  • Sichere Kommunikation auf Deutsch oder Englisch in Wort und Schrift.

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

  • bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente

  • Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands

descriptionHtml:
At Dragos, the mission is personal. The systems we protect deliver the water you drink, power your home, and keep the hospitals your community depends on running. Those critical infrastructure systems that power our civilization around the world are under attack every day by adversaries. When those systems fail, people are immediately at risk. We are the global leader in xOT cybersecurity, combining technology, threat intelligence, and expert services. The people here chose this work because they understand what is at stake. Here, you will find a remote-first mission-driven team across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and APAC built on authenticity, transparency, and trust. If safeguarding the systems that protect your family, friends, and community is the kind of work that matters to you, you are in the right place.

title: Senior Data Scientist, Experimentation
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay makes millions of dynamic, interconnected decisions across its network every day, and each one shapes the experience of the thousands of couriers who work with us. Knowing what any one of those decisions actually did is hard: couriers interfere with each other, effects vary from person to person, and the outcomes that matter compound over time.

Science at Relay is the brain of the operation: machine learning, operational research, recommender systems, causal inference, location intelligence and experimentation, working together to decide how every parcel gets delivered. You'll lead causal inference at Relay from the start.

Causal Inference Highlights

  • A live, two-sided marketplace to experiment in, with every decision logged across millions of parcels.

  • Interference between couriers, heterogeneous effects and long-term outcomes are the norm here, not the exception.

  • Four marketplaces, each with its own app and its own economics.

  • Your insights and models feed straight into Relay's network-wide optimisation.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Data Scientist at Relay, you'll:

  • Set the standard for causal inference at Relay.

  • Measure how our decisions affect each courier, today and over time.

  • Shape how Relay experiments across a live, two-sided marketplace.

  • Adapt advanced techniques across causal inference, statistics and machine learning to Relay's problems, and see them through to production.

  • Partner with Operational Research to embed your insights and models into Relay's network-wide optimisation, and help build our research culture and voice in the tech community.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Bring deep expertise in causal inference, experimentation and machine learning, whether from a PhD, publications, or years at the frontier in industry.

  • Come from statistics, an experimental science such as biology or psychology, or quantitative research.

  • Have applied advanced techniques to real marketplaces or products, and owned the outcome.

  • Think in mechanisms, and let evidence guide decisions.

  • Are energised by open, interconnected problems, and know how to find the signal.

  • Collaborate generously, and explain complex ideas simply.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

title: Senior Delivery Consultant
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Software Improvement Group (SIG) helpt organisaties grip te houden op de software waar hun business op draait. Ons platform Sigrid® bestaat uit twee delen. Sigrid Core geeft organisaties continu inzicht in de kwaliteit, security en risico’s van hun volledige softwareportfolio, en borgt kwaliteitsstandaarden tot in de ontwikkelstraat. Sigrid Axis, gelanceerd in oktober 2026, brengt diezelfde standaarden naar AI coding agents: het controleert elke wijziging die een agent maakt in real time en verbetert bestaande code, zodat organisaties agentic engineering kunnen opschalen zonder grip te verliezen op kwaliteit, kosten en risico. 

Beide zijn gebouwd op ’s werelds grootste benchmark voor softwarekwaliteit, met meer dan 40.000 systemen en ruim 600 miljard regels code, en op ruim 25 jaar ervaring in het enige ISO/IEC 17025-geaccrediteerde lab voor softwarekwaliteit ter wereld. Samen met onze consultants vertalen we die inzichten naar strategisch en praktisch advies, zodat technologie een aanjager van succes is in plaats van een bron van risico. 

Onze klanten zijn grote (internationale) ondernemingen, financiële instellingen en overheidsorganisaties. Zij vertrouwen op SIG om softwarekwaliteit structureel onderdeel te maken van de manier waarop ze hun IT-landschap besturen.


Where you come in

Als Senior Delivery Consultant zorg je ervoor dat onze grootste klanten Sigrid succesvol inbedden in hun organisatie. Sigrid is geen tool die je even installeert: het is complexe software voor kwaliteitsmanagement die raakt aan de ontwikkelstraat, de architectuur, de securityprocessen en de besluitvorming van een organisatie. Jij leidt die implementaties van begin tot eind: van kick-off en technische onboarding tot training, rapportage en de borging van softwarekwaliteit in de werkwijze van de klant. Of Sigrid nu als SaaS-oplossing wordt afgenomen of on-premise in de eigen infrastructuur van de klant draait, jij zorgt dat het project slaagt. 

Dat maakt het werk uitdagend en cutting edge. Je werkt met technologie die vooroploopt, op het snijvlak van softwarekwaliteit en AI, bij organisaties die nu de stap zetten naar softwareontwikkeling met AI coding agents. Wat je bij hen implementeert, bepaalt mede hoe zij die stap veilig en beheerst kunnen maken. 

Je werkt voor grote corporate organisaties en overheidsinstellingen, vaak met honderden ontwikkelteams en duizenden applicaties. Dat betekent complexe trajecten met veel belanghebbenden: van CIO en CISO tot architecten, IT-beheer, inkoop en ontwikkelteams. Je brengt structuur aan in die complexiteit, houdt planning en scope in de hand, en houdt de vaart erin zonder mensen kwijt te raken. 

Je vertaalt de inzichten uit Sigrid naar rapportages en adviezen die passen bij je publiek. Een bestuurder wil weten waar de risico’s zitten, een architect wil technische schuld gericht aanpakken en een ontwikkelteam wil het dagelijkse werk verbeteren. Dezelfde data vertelt voor ieder van hen een ander verhaal, en jij weet die vertaalslag te maken. 

Intern noemen we deze rol Senior Guidance Consultant. Je maakt deel uit van ons Guidance-team: een klein, hands-on team van consultants dat nauw samenwerkt met onze Customer Success Managers, Account Executives, technische consultants en het productteam. Na de implementatie draag je de klant over aan de Customer Success Manager, die de langetermijnrelatie voortzet. 


Wat ga je doen 

  • Je leidt complete implementatietrajecten waarin Sigrid wordt ingebed in grote organisaties, zowel SaaS als on-premise: van projectplan en kick-off tot technische onboarding, training en overdracht. 
  • Je bent de projectleider: je bewaakt planning, scope en budget, managet risico’s en afhankelijkheden, en sluit aan op de governance van de klant, zoals stuurgroepen, security- en compliance-eisen en beheerprocessen. 
  • Bij on-premise implementaties werk je samen met de infrastructuur- en securityteams van de klant en met onze technische consultants, zodat installatie, configuratie en integratie soepel verlopen. 
  • Je begeleidt ontwikkelaars, architecten, managers en bestuurders bij het adopteren van Sigrid en het verankeren ervan in hun processen. 
  • Je levert heldere rapportages en presentaties aan zowel management als technische doelgroepen, afgestemd op de doelen van de organisatie. 
  • Je helpt klanten bij de inzet van Sigrid Axis, zodat hun AI coding agents werken volgens dezelfde kwaliteitsstandaarden als hun ontwikkelteams. 
  • Je adviseert klanten over sturen op softwarekwaliteit, het beheersen van technische schuld en de verantwoorde inzet van AI in softwareontwikkeling. 
  • Je managet meerdere trajecten tegelijk, gestructureerd en pragmatisch, inclusief een nauwkeurige projectadministratie in ons CRM. 
  • Je ondersteunt salestrajecten met overtuigende productdemo’s en met je inbreng over implementatieaanpak en planning. 

Je draagt bij aan de doorontwikkeling van onze implementatiemethodiek, onze Academy-content en de ondersteuning van partners die zelf Sigrid-implementaties uitvoeren. 




What's in it for you?

  • Een betekenisvolle rol op het snijvlak van technologie, consultancy en organisatieverandering 

  • Directe impact bij enkele van de grootste organisaties van Nederland, in het bedrijfsleven en bij de overheid 
  • Een platte organisatie met ruimte voor ondernemerschap, initiatief en creativiteit 
  • Een grondig inwerkprogramma in onze tooling en methodiek, en ruimte voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling 
  • Flexibele werkafspraken en een betrokken team van hoog niveau 
  • Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder een mobiele telefoon, MacBook en verzekeringen 

Wij geloven dat software beter kan en moet bijdragen aan de organisaties waarin het draait. Deel jij die overtuiging en wil je helpen die waar te maken? Dan horen we graag van je. 


Job Requirements

Je bent een senior professional die sterk projectmanagement combineert met plezier in klantcontact. Je hebt eerder complexe projecten geleid binnen grote organisaties en weet hoe je resultaat boekt in een omgeving met veel belanghebbenden, wisselende prioriteiten en formele besluitvorming. 

  • Minimaal vijf jaar ervaring in een klantgerichte rol als implementatieconsultant, projectmanager of vergelijkbaar 
  • Aantoonbare ervaring met het leiden van complexe projecten, bij voorkeur de uitrol van een SaaS- of on-premise softwareoplossing bij grote corporate klanten en/of overheidsorganisaties 
  • Ervaring met de governance van grote organisaties: je weet hoe stuurgroepen, inkoop-, security- en beheerprocessen werken en hoe je daarbinnen voortgang boekt 
  • Een projectmanagementcertificering (zoals PRINCE2, PMP of IPMA) is een plus; bewezen praktijkervaring weegt het zwaarst 
  • Affiniteit met softwareontwikkeling, softwarekwaliteit en technische schuld; je voert het gesprek net zo makkelijk met ontwikkelaars als met bestuurders 
  • Uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlands in woord en geschrift, en daarnaast goed Engels 
  • Heldere, overtuigende communicatie, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk 
  • Een flexibele, pragmatische houding, gecombineerd met een gestructureerde en zorgvuldige manier van werken 
  • Werk- en denkniveau op masterniveau 

Je bent woonachtig in Nederland en mag hier werken zonder dat je nu of in de toekomst sponsoring door een werkgever nodig hebt.

descriptionHtml:
Company Overview

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.

title: Senior Embedded Development Engineer
descriptionHtml:
🚀 Join SE3 Labs as Senior Embedded Development Engineer

Own the electrical brain of our autonomous systems, from schematics to flight. Early team, deep tech, high impact.

About SE3

SE3 Labs is building Spatial AI by combining 3D computer vision with large language models (LLMs). We believe the ability to reason about and act within physical space is foundational to unlocking the next generation of automation, from construction to smart infrastructure, and ultimately, defense.

Now, we’re building the physical platform to bring Spatial AI to life. That means high-performance, real-world robotic systems (starting with UAVs) and we’re looking for skilled, hands-on engineers who're ready to bring these machines into the real world.

About the Role

As Senior Embedded Hardware Development Engineer, you’ll own the complete electrical design of our UAV compute, sensor and avionic systems. From architecture to component selection, from first schematic to flight test, you’ll be in charge of engineering the electronic and firmware backbone of our spatial intelligence systems.

You’ll collaborate closely with mechanical, software, and AI teams, but this is your domain, and you’ll be trusted to build it right.

  

What You’ll Work On

  • Architecture & Design: Translate top level goals into requirements, then schematics and detailed designs for sensors, compute and communication across our flying platforms

  • Program & Bringup: Bring your design to life by developing and deploying the foundation layers of code in forms of firmware, drivers and operating systems

  • Prototype & Iterate: Build, rework, and test hardware with speed and precision, both in simulation and in flight

  • Optimize & Troubleshoot: Analyze designs via simulation and real-world testing, including EMI/EMC, thermal, power and performance

  • Validate in the Loop: Support hardware-in-the-loop and environmental validation workflows to ensure rugged, reliable designs

  • Document with Purpose: Keep clear records of requirements, tradeoffs, test results, tuning procedures, and design rationale

  • Technologies we use: NXP ARM SoCs, Nvidia Jetson, various NPUs, MIPI-CSI, GMSL, Linux, ROS, Altium Designer and more

  

Your Profile

  • You hold a M.Sc. in Electronics Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline

  • You bring 5+ years of hands-on experience in mixed hardware development and software integration, from component selection and PCB design to low-level programming

  • You’re fully proficient in PCB layout tools and eCAD like Altium designer, and have a practical eye for clean, testable and maintainable designs

  • You’re confident with lab equipment (multimeters, oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, logic analyzers) and use them to diagnose and debug with purpose

  • You’re experienced in PCB-bringup, debugging, and ensuring they survive real-world use

  • You write and debug embedded firmware in C and/or C++, including peripheral drivers and interfaces between hardware and software

  • You’re familiar with hardware-in-the-loop and environmental testing, and understand how designs fail in the wild

  • You speak fluent English; German is a plus

  • Most importantly, you’re structured, fast-moving, and mission-driven. You don’t wait for perfection. You iterate until it works. You love building things that last.

  

Especially Valued Bonus Skills

  • Deep understanding of design and verification of EMC / robustness against EMI

  • Thermal design and analysis for compact electronics

  • RF integration and noise suppression

  • MIL-STD, DO-254, CRA and RED qualification experience

  • Automation of test rigs for HIL testing

  

Perks & Benefits

  • Real Ownership: Own product design and get equity early, real stock options to participate directly in SE3’s growth

  • AI-boosted workplace: We empower every employee with best-in-class AI tools and agents, giving you unlimited access to the latest advancements and a true productivity edge

  • Work Environment to Excel at: Find a high-quality and modern toolset, flat hierarchy and a skilled, driven team which will push the limits together with you

  • 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off

  • Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass

  • Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Greece and Spain

  • Mentorship: Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth

  

Our Process

  1. Intro Call (30 min): Let’s get to know each other (conducted by Eugene, our Head of Talent)

  2. Technical Interview (45 min): (with Lukas, our Hardware Lead)

  3. Onsite Trial/Case (2 hrs): We’ll build or test something together, just like on the job (together with our Hardware Team)

  4. Team Dinner/Lunch: See if it’s a culture fit on both sides

We're a Y Combinator W23 company. We just closed an $18M Series A in March 2026 led by Balderton Capital (with Uncorrelated Ventures, IRIS, and YC following on). In AI, context is the moat. At Escape, the data model is the context: and a team of three owns it end to end.

Every Escape product (ASM, DAST, AI Pentesting) is built on top of one data model rich enough to represent an entire attack surface and everything our agents learn about it. Frontend: Svelte + TypeScript, GraphQL client Backend: Node.js, GraphQL (Yoga + Pothos), Prisma, PostgreSQL, Kafka Infra: AWS, GitLab CI, Grafana Adjacent deep tech: Python (AI/ML), Go (network tooling)
