Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Product Marketing sits within Allica’s Growth function, based around talented, empowered and autonomous individuals who are responsible for driving engagement, retention and growth from our existing customer base across a combination of channels to meet objectives set across the business. You will get the opportunity to work with different teams across the business including product squads, distribution, data and operations to deliver on Allica’s mission of becoming the UK’s most recommended business bank.

We use data to find where customers need us, then apply commercial thinking and creativity to make sure every message and touchpoint is clear, relevant and useful.

We are rare amongst banks in that our senior leadership team have backgrounds at world-leading fintechs, which shows in their active engagement in both the strategic and execution elements of our rapidly scaling organisation. Because we are working on one of the last untapped fintech opportunities, in a small team it will mean that we’re often working on entirely new challenges and unpicking complexity as we move along. No two days are ever the same.

Role Description

We are seeking a Senior Growth Marketing Executive to join our Product Marketing team within Growth. You will help us grow engagement, retention and value from our Business Rewards Account customers - including the lending growth that comes from within that base - by combining sharp analysis with creative, well-executed marketing.

This is a hands-on role that blends data and creativity in equal measure. You will own our monthly product update programme and the campaigns around product and feature launches: making sure customers know what is coming, building interest through warm-up campaigns, and giving them the chance to share their views and feedback. You will grow our engaged customer base and make sure our content drives real engagement with our products, so customers keep moving along the lifecycle stages. You will plan and manage campaigns end-to-end across different channels - email, in-app, push and online banking - using data to understand customer behaviour, target the right customers and prove what worked.

You will help shape the messaging for each launch and manage stakeholders across Product, Data, Compliance, Operations and CRM so roll-outs land smoothly. From 2027 the team's focus widens to post-launch activity and feature adoption based on customer behaviour, and you will contribute by spotting who is under-using a feature and helping design the campaigns that help them get value from it. We also want to re-engage longer-standing customers who have gone quiet and may need reactivating. You will be a natural problem solver who questions assumptions, gets to the root cause and finds practical, scalable fixes. You will join an AI-enabled team, using AI tools day-to-day to move faster on analysis, content and reporting, with the support and space to keep building new skills as the tools and our work evolve.

You will report to the Product Marketing Lead and work closely with the Product Marketing Manager and the wider Growth team. Success looks like a growing, more engaged customer base, strong awareness and uptake of new features, and measurable improvements in reactivation, account usage, retention and cross-sell, delivered through campaigns and experiments you own from idea to live.

Principal Accountabilities

Data & Insight

  • Analyse customer behaviour, campaign performance and engagement trends to find the biggest opportunities to improve feature adoption, usage and retention, and to identify customers who have gone quiet and could be reactivated.

  • Turn analysis into clear, prioritised recommendations, and tell the story in a way that gets the team and senior stakeholders aligned.

  • Maintain regular reporting on in-life performance (engagement, feature adoption, transactions, retention and campaign results), flagging trends and risks early.

Campaign Design & Delivery

  • Own and grow the monthly product update, and plan and run the campaigns around product and feature launches: building awareness of upcoming features, running warm-up campaigns that capture interest, and collecting customer feedback and opinions to feed back into Product.

  • Manage campaigns from brief to post-campaign review: set objectives and audiences, write and build the content, coordinate sign-off and send, and report results against engagement and adoption goals.

  • Design, build, launch and optimise multi-channel lifecycle campaigns across in-app, email, push notifications and online banking, with clear, compelling and on-brand creative.

  • Re-engage and reactivate longer-standing customers who have become inactive or under-use our products, through personalised messaging, nurture journeys and notification frameworks.

  • Use CRM and marketing automation tools such as HubSpot and Customer.io to make sure touchpoints are timely, relevant and personalised, and automate wherever it saves time or improves the customer experience.

Experimentation & Problem Solving

  • Develop and run experiments (for example A/B tests, engagement triggers and new messaging), measure the results and decide what to scale, pause or iterate.

  • Challenge assumptions, get to the root cause of problems and propose creative, scalable solutions.

Collaboration & Customer Insight

  • Work with the Product Marketing Manager and Product Marketing Lead, and with Product, Data, Content, Brand, Compliance, Risk and Operations, to plan and deliver customer engagement initiatives end-to-end, making sure customer communications go through the right review and sign-off.

  • Align with customer-facing teams to share insight, training and tools that improve engagement, and bring customer feedback back into the product roadmap.

  • Use AI-enabled tools to speed up analysis, drafting and reporting, and keep finding new ways to apply them.

Personal Attributes & Experience

We are looking for someone who can clearly show where they have gone the extra mile - a campaign, test or piece of analysis they spotted, owned and delivered that moved the numbers, and how they did it.

Skills & Experience

  • Growth & lifecycle marketing - Demonstrable experience in growth, lifecycle, CRM or product marketing, running campaigns end-to-end and measurably improving engagement, adoption or retention.

  • Data & analysis - Strong proficiency in Excel, including pivot tables, formulas and large datasets, plus data visualisation tools. Able to track customer lifecycle metrics such as active engagement, feature adoption and transactional behaviour, and spot what is driving them. Comfortable using AI tools to speed up analysis and uncover insight.

  • Creative & commercial - Strong writing and creative instincts, with the commercial judgement to turn an insight into a message and a journey that customers act on. Able to address real customer problems in the copy, so every campaign solves for a pain point.

  • CRM & automation - Hands-on experience with HubSpot, Customer.io or a similar CRM and marketing automation platform to build, target, test and measure campaigns.

  • Experimentation - Experience designing and running experiments (A/B tests, triggers) and using the results to refine engagement and lifecycle strategy.

  • Storytelling - Able to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations and compelling presentations that influence decisions.

  • AI-enabled - AI-literate and keen to use AI tools day-to-day to speed up analysis, content drafting and reporting.

Mindset & Working Style

  • Customer-centric - Strong understanding of customer behaviour and lifecycle stages, proactively finding ways to add value and reduce churn.

  • Problem solver - Recognises false assumptions, applies structured thinking and proposes creative, practical solutions.

  • Ownership & execution - Takes full ownership of projects from analysis to live campaign, delivers high-quality work on time and works autonomously while staying aligned with product marketing objectives.

  • Collaborative - Communicates insights and recommendations clearly to cross-functional teams and leadership, and influences without formal authority.

  • Adaptable - Comfortable in a small, fast-moving team where priorities can shift and processes are still being defined, bringing structure rather than waiting for it.

  • Mission-driven - Motivated by impact and passionate about helping established businesses thrive through better banking.

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

title: Senior Jet Engine Design Engineer – Interceptor Drones
descriptionHtml:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

About the Role
We are building next-generation interceptor drones and are looking for a Senior Jet Engine Design Engineer to lead the development of small-scale jet propulsion systems (12–25 kg thrust class), from concept to flight-ready hardware. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role in a fast-moving startup environment where speed and iteration matter more than lengthy upfront studies.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop new small jet engines (12–25 kg thrust range) in-house, optimized for very low production cost

  • Own the aerodynamic design of turbine components, balancing performance, manufacturability, and cost

  • Design a large portion of the turbine for metal 3D printing (additive manufacturing), leveraging design-for-AM principles to reduce part count, weight, and cost

  • Work closely with 3D printing operations to define printable geometries, tolerances, post-processing, and qualify parts for flight use

  • Drive a rapid, fail-fast iteration process: build, test, learn, and redesign quickly rather than relying on long analytical phases before prototyping

  • Integrate propulsion systems into airframes such as flying wings and other interceptor drone configurations, working with aerostructures and systems teams

  • Apply and enforce design rules for operation in extreme environments (cold and hot climates, rain, humidity, icing conditions) to ensure engine reliability across the full operational envelope

  • Contribute to engine testing (bench and flight), performance validation, and continuous design improvement

Candidate Profile:

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in jet engine / gas turbine design, with a proven track record of having designed and delivered engine models (not just component-level work)

  • Strong hands-on experience with small jet engines in the 12–25 kg thrust class

  • Solid global understanding of jet engine architecture: compressor, combustor, turbine, fuel system, controls, and their interactions

  • Experience designing turbine/engine components for metal additive manufacturing (DfAM), and practical knowledge of metal 3D printing processes and constraints

  • Comfortable working in a rapid-iteration, fail-fast development culture rather than a traditional long-cycle aerospace process

  • Experience integrating propulsion systems into airframes (flying wing or similar unconventional platforms is a strong plus)

  • Knowledge of design requirements for extreme operating environments (temperature extremes, precipitation, icing)

  • Ability to work autonomously in a small, fast-paced startup team, wearing multiple hats when needed

Nice to Have

  • Experience with UAV/drone propulsion specifically (vs. manned aviation)

  • Familiarity with low-cost manufacturing strategies for defense/dual-use hardware

  • Prior startup or skunkworks experience

Join our team as a

Senior Machine Learning Engineer - AI Technical Lead!

This is a hybrid role, and we are currently considering candidates based in the Netherlands. Protolabs is a digital manufacturing company that turns CAD files and technical drawings into physical parts fast and at scale. Our AI team builds systems that empower workflows in digital manufacturing such as finding similar parts, geometry understanding, and automated routing of work to the right expert. We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to act as Technical Lead for our horizontal innovation work, the foundational technical building blocks that serve multiple use cases across the value chain.
The work is distinct in that the technology often comes first and the use case follows: this is true innovation, where you prove a capability is possible and then drive it into business value. You will be the single technical point of contact for these initiatives, driving core development of transformative capabilities. You will observe the market, bring new innovations into the organization, and partner across engineering and business teams to turn technology into measurable impact — mentoring and influencing engineers inside and outside your own team without formal authority.
What You Will Do:
Technical leadership & core development
  • Drive core development of transformative capabilities.
  • Take over full technical ownership as the primary technical contact for product management, engineering management, and partner teams on the delivery and roadmap of these initiatives.
  • Create, maintain, and review the technical roadmap together with product and engineering management.
  • Provide architectural guidance for ML systems on inference, agentic approaches and hybrid AI systems; industrialize and maintain proven-value use cases.
    • Technical implementation across a broad range of AI use cases
  • Implement progressive ML solutions for various business domains in agile, crossfunctional teams; rapidly prototype to validate feasibility and value in a scalable manner.
  • Co-develop use cases with domain software teams in temporary cross-functional setups.
    • Market observation & innovation
  • Observe the market and propose new innovations based on technologies emerging outside the company.
  • Evaluate build vs. buy vs. adapt decisions based on cost, effort, risk, and long-term maintainability.
  • Produce written technology-evaluation recommendations (opportunity, feasibility, effort, fit) and find ways to multiply exploration speed by involving other engineers.
  • Identify opportunities where new technology could add business value; hand clear tech ideas to product and business teams to review and validate; identify integration requirements.
    • Cross-organisation delivery & architecture
  • Partner with other engineering teams to deliver business impact through integrating new technologies and new solutions.
  • Draft, share, and align architectural designs for each building block across the organisation, obtaining sign-off from affected teams before integration starts; bring designs to architecture board review.
    • Platform & environment
  • Contribute to foundational environments for (Gen)AI experimentation, model development, evaluation, and deployment.
  • Collaborate with global platform counterparts to implement MLOps, CI/CD, data pipelines, and observability.
  • Advocate for reusable components, shared libraries, and internal tooling to accelerate usecase delivery.
    • Mentoring & influencing
  • Mentor and coach engineers across the organisation — inside and outside your own team— through PR reviews, work scoping, design reviews, and documentation reviews.
  • Proactively surface in-team and cross-team barriers to leadership as they arise, with suggestions on how to resolve them.
  • Identify needs and tech-stack gaps blocking engineers from delivering, and raise them for prioritization.

    • What You Bring:
    Technical
  • 7+ years of hands-on AI/ML engineering experience, with strong depth in machine learning and deep learning — modeling, data pipelines, evaluation, and shipping models to production using state-of-the-art frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow/Keras, scikit-learn, XGBoost).
  • Proven ability to build models that serve as autonomous decision systems — applied to critical business problems with large, heterogeneous data.
  • Strong Python engineering fundamentals: clean, modular, testable code; data pipelines; model versioning; CI/CD for ML; packaging for production (e.g. Docker, service wrappers).
  • Solid ML experimentation practice: experiment tracking set up from scratch (e.g. Weights & Biases, MLflow), model evaluation, and iterative improvement tied to measurable business outcomes.
  • Solid understanding of data transformation techniques, languages, and libraries (e.g. Pandas, Polars, SQL, dbt).
  • Familiarity with modern GenAI — LLMs, transformers, vector stores, retrieval techniques (RAG), embedding strategies, and agentic workflows — and GenAI stacks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, and OpenAI/Azure/AWS SDKs.

title: Senior Manager Growth - Europe

descriptionHtml:

For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on  LinkedIn #WeAreVML.

Senior Performance Analyst (Digital Insights and Analytics)  

Company: VML / WPP
Location: London, UK
Working Model: Hybrid
Reporting to: Data Director 

Internal Job title: Senior Analyst/P3

Location: Sea Containers office, London, SE1

About the opportunity:

You will be a web analytics specialist who connects website performance with other channels, such as media, for an F100 automotive company across Europe. The purpose of this team is to influence marketing change in local markets and central teams through deep insights and actionable recommendations. You go deep into site journeys, features and changes to find what improves conversion, and support media decisions by running MMM scenarios and linking media to what happens on the site. Working with a cross-functional team of analysts, you turn this into recommendations that drive better web performance, across Europe and in individual markets.


What you'll do:

  • Dig into journeys and features: find where and why visitors drop off, by market and device.
  • Measure change: read A/B test results and evaluate site changes before and after launch.
  • Work with raw data: use SQL on clickstream, media and business-outcome data to answer questions standard reports can't.
  • Connect media to the site: analyse how paid media traffic behaves on the site and converts.
  • Support media decisions: run MMM scenarios for budget questions and connect the results to web performance, showing how changes in media spend and mix affect site traffic, key actions and leads.
  • Keep the data reliable: spot tracking issues and help define tracking for new site features.
  • Support the story: prepare analysis for insight readouts, and join client calls to present findings and answer technical questions.

Key tools:

Critical: Adobe Analytics (or GA4), SQL

Nice to have: Contentsquare, Adobe Target, Python, MMM scenario planner

What we're looking for:

  • Proven Hands-on web or digital analytics.

Must have:

  • Advanced web analytics: builds segments, flow and fallout analyses and calculated metrics. Understands the tracking setup well enough to diagnose data issues.
  • SQL and clickstream data: joins and cleans large web, media and business-outcome datasets, including visit-level clickstream data.
  • Deep dives that feed the readout: runs detailed journey and feature analyses, reads A/B test results, and evaluates site changes before and after launch. Supplies the evidence behind recommendations.
  • Media and site connection: analyses how paid media traffic behaves on the site and converts, and runs MMM scenarios to support budget and media planning.
  • Client support: joins client and stakeholder calls to present their analysis and answer technical questions. Can lead a call when needed.

Nice to have: 

  • A/B testing and experimentation.
  • Automotive experience.
  • Statistical analysis skills.

What's in it for you:

Alongside a generous annual leave allowance and pension, you’ll have access to a wide range of benefits, including:

  • Life Assurance
  • Permanent Health Insurance

  • Flexible hybrid working
  • Enhanced family-friendly policies

  • Cycle to Work Scheme
  • Eye Care and Glasses Vouchers
  • Season Ticket Loans
  • WPP Discounts

You’ll also have access to ongoing learning and development opportunities and support for your longer-term career development.

title: (Senior) Performance Marketing Manager (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Holidu is one of the world’s fastest-growing holiday rental technology companies. Our mission is to make booking and hosting holiday homes free of doubt and full of joy, by helping hosts generate more bookings with less work and helping guests find a holiday home they truly enjoy. Our team of 700 colleagues from 60+ nations shares a passion for tech, an ambition for constant improvement, and a relentless drive to bring the best experience to more than 40k holiday rental hosts and 4 million annual guests.

Your future team

You will be part of the Paid Search team, the growth engine of Holidu's Performance Marketing: we run Google Ads and Microsoft Ads across all Holidu domains and brands in Europe, on both sides of the marketplace - Guest (B2C, bookings) and Host (B2B, lead generation). We are a small, international and highly analytical team: value-based bidding at scale, our own bidding infrastructure, and data-driven in every decision. We work AI-first, and we are early: as marketers, we build our own analyses, automations and internal apps with LLM tooling (mainly Claude), together with our MarTech team. The team is led by Andreas, who has two decades of experience in digital marketing, and you will work closely with Rasmus, one of Holidu's Co-Founders.

What you will do

This role suits a proactive builder: strong numerical mindset, comfortable creating structure where none exists yet, at home in both strategy and hands-on execution.

  • Own large-scale Search Engine Advertising across multiple European markets (Google Ads and Microsoft Ads), from account structure to value-based bidding that grows efficiently

  • Challenge how we do paid search today: question our bidding logic, structures and processes, and bring perspectives we have not considered. With us, arguments and data weigh more than job titles

  • Co-build internal marketing apps with Claude Code and GitHub, as a marketer, not an engineer. We are first movers here: you will learn a skill almost nobody in the market has yet, and you will shape our tooling together with our MarTech team

  • Own your numbers end-to-end: find the improvement potential others walk past, run high-impact A/B tests across large budgets, decide with data, and turn results into playbooks instead of one-off learnings

  • Pilot what is next in paid search: AI Max, the first generation of LLM advertising (OpenAI/ChatGPT Ads), and AI-powered workflows from anomaly detection to statistical analysis

What you bring

  • A sharp, quantitative mindset and strong analytical thinking: you make decisions with data, spot what others miss, and can argue your case clearly

  • Ownership of business results: you think in outcomes, not processes, and build solutions rather than wait for instructions

  • Hands-on experience in paid search (Google Ads; Microsoft Ads as a plus): trajectory and depth of thinking matter more to us than years

  • Genuine curiosity about AI in marketing: you’ve already used AI tools to change how you work, not just to draft texts, and want to go deeper. No engineering background needed, curiosity is the requirement

  • Fluent English (our working language); any additional language is a plus

What we offer

  • Impact: Make a difference for hundreds of thousands of monthly users.

  • Growth: Take responsibility from day one and develop through regular feedback, workshops, and knowledge exchanges.

  • Personal Development: Use your learning budget and 2 extra study days for conferences, books, courses, and more.

  • Community: Engage with international, diverse, yet like-minded colleagues through regular events and 2 office days per week with your team.

  • Flexibility: Benefit from our hybrid work policy and the chance to work from other local offices for up to 8 weeks a year.

  • Fitness: Get a premium gym membership at a discounted rate.

  • Travel: Enjoy 28 vacation days + 13 public holidays in Bavaria and the possibility to take up to 10 unpaid vacation days with special discounts on our Holidu Homes properties.

Life at Holidu

title: Senior Product Analyst, Driver Supply
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Delivery companies have always bought capacity by guesswork. Book too few drivers and parcels wait; book too many and you pay for empty vans. Most carriers accept that waste as the price of being reliable. Relay is building a marketplace where it isn't. You can't schedule drivers. You can only design what's on offer, and measure what happens.

Every part of our network runs on decisions. The next two years are about building the systems that make them well, and proving they do. Engineering and operational research build what you design.

Marketplace Highlights

  • You own decision-making, not the model: you decide what Marketplace changes on booking, matching and shifts, and recommend on pay. Our scientists' models and experiments feed your calls, and the squad lead acts on them.

  • Drivers choose when to work. What makes a shift worth booking early, and how do you prove what works when a clean experiment isn't possible?

  • Every booked shift is paid, used or not, and every unserved route means late parcels. Where should each area sit between the two, and what would let the network get there on its own?

  • Local shops hold our parcels while running their own businesses. Where does the network need more of them, what should a shop be paid, and how would you see a closed shop coming?

  • A whole area, not a slice: no playbook, and the result is on the street the next morning.

  • Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Product Analyst, Driver Supply at Relay, you'll:

  • Decide which Marketplace problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

  • Design how Marketplace decides: which signals count, and what good looks like for booking, matching and pay.

  • Tell the squad lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

  • Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

  • Go and look when the data and the street disagree: the sort centre, the van, the shop.

  • Get the missing data built, and prove whether each change worked. In a year, Marketplace's booking and pay decisions run on a system you designed.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Have owned the decisions a matching, pricing or incentive model fed, in a two-sided marketplace or gig platform, rather than building the model itself.

  • Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or engineers built what you asked for.

  • Can trace why drivers or couriers stop booking or cancel, and can read the experiments behind a pricing or incentive change, including when a clean test isn't possible.

  • Have been through real change, such as a pivot, fast growth or a new market, and rebuilt something because of it.

  • Are hands-on and fluent in SQL, with or without AI, and happy to build their own analysis apps, monitors and alerts.

  • Would rather ship a working answer this week than a perfect one next quarter. No logistics experience needed, just the appetite to learn a physical operation fast.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

title: Senior Product Designer, Boltz Lab
descriptionHtml:
About Boltz

Boltz is a public benefit company building the next generation of AI-powered molecular modeling tools to make biology programmable and accelerate drug discovery, while keeping frontier capabilities broadly accessible.

Boltz began as an MIT spin-out. Our founders built Boltz-1 at MIT, and it became the first fully open-source model to match AlphaFold 3's accuracy in predicting the 3D structure of biomolecular complexes.

We focus on two things:

  • Open foundation models. Boltz-1, Boltz-2, and BoltzGen are open models trusted by 100,000+ scientists across biotech and academia, and used in programs at every Top 20 pharma as well as leading agrichemical and industrial research organizations.

  • Boltz Lab. Our commercial platform runs our latest models and design agents as reliable, production-grade tools built around real chemistry and biology workflows. Teams start from a target and a hypothesis, then generate, evaluate, and rank candidate molecules, while we provide the compute, infrastructure, and collaboration layer so their scientists can move faster.

The two feed each other: open-source adoption earns scientific credibility and community insight, and Boltz Lab turns that into real impact on our partners' discovery programs.

You can read more about our mission, research and product vision in our manifesto.

About the role

As Product Designer for Boltz Lab, you will own how scientists experience, trust and use our AI for molecular modeling and drug discovery. Our models are powerful but complex; design is what makes them usable, and trustworthy, for researchers who aren't ML experts.

You will work closely with Product engineering, ML Research and our chemistry and biology experts to turn user needs into clear concepts, interaction patterns and end-to-end workflows.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys technically deep products, cares about craft and usability, and wants to build tools that expand what scientists can do.

What you'll do

  • Own Boltz Lab's design end to end, from discovery and user research through prototyping, visual design and engineering handoff.

  • Define the product's information architecture, interaction model and visual language, and keep them consistent as it grows.

  • Design interfaces for exploring data, configuring models, interpreting results and iterating on experiments.

  • Make ML outputs interpretable and actionable, so users can judge when to trust a result.

  • Run research and usability testing with expert users, and feed what you learn back into the product and roadmap.

About you

Minimum Requirements

  • Excellent interaction design, information architecture and visual design, with strong prototyping in modern tools (e.g. Figma).

  • Ability to turn abstract or highly technical concepts into intuitive, well-structured experiences.

  • A track record of owning product design end to end, from discovery to shipped product.

  • Close collaboration with engineers and researchers, and clear communication of design decisions and trade-offs.

Preferred Requirements

  • Basic understanding of biology, chemistry, drug discovery or ML workflows.

  • Experience using Boltz models, or usability testing with expert users.

We know great people don't always tick every box. If this role excites you and you meet most of the minimum requirements, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Senior Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
Travel is essential, whether it's visiting family, starting a new adventure, or taking a career-defining trip. Yet over 4 billion airline passengers rely on tech that hasn't changed in decades. At Duffel, we're rebuilding the infrastructure underpinning the global travel industry. Backed by top-tier investors (Benchmark, Blossom, Index Ventures and Kima Ventures) and born out of Y Combinator (S18), we're simplifying complex systems to build the future of travel.

The Role

As Senior Product Designer, you’ll help solve a uniquely rewarding challenge: making travel disruptions easier for everyone involved. When plans change unexpectedly, travellers need fast, clear answers, while the businesses that sold them the trip need to stay in control. You’ll design our AI support product end-to-end, shaping the experience for both the travel businesses using Duffel (B2B) and the travellers they serve (B2C).

Working closely with product, engineering, and operations, you’ll champion design across Duffel, helping define what great looks like and elevating the craft of our products as a whole. To thrive in this role, you’ll bring experience designing complex products from start to finish and partnering closely with cross-functional teams to bring those ideas to life.

What you'll be doing

  • Own end-to-end design for our AI support product, from discovery and flows to prototypes and shipped software, in a product where airline rules, payments and customer expectations all collide.

  • Run discovery with customers and the travellers they serve, and turn needs from multiple stakeholders into clear, prioritised requirements.

  • Be the voice of design at Duffel: set and uphold the quality bar across craft, accessibility and consistency, and raise it in every review.

  • Work shoulder to shoulder with Product Managers and engineers to take designs through to delivery, then learn from real usage and feedback quickly.

  • Explain the why behind every design decision, welcome challenge from anyone, and change your mind when the evidence says so.

  • Design how AI and people work together: what the AI should do, when it hands over to a human, and how users understand, trust and correct it.

  • Bring ideas from other products and industries to Duffel, and share them so the whole team's design thinking improves.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years designing digital products, with a portfolio that shows you've taken a complex product from problem to shipped outcome and can say what changed because of it.

  • Strong craft across interaction, visual and systems design: you ship the states, edge cases and accessibility, not only the happy path.

  • Experience working with several stakeholder groups at once, ideally both business customers and end consumers, and a clear method for turning their conflicting needs into decisions.

  • Experience designing AI, conversational or support products, and an understanding of what makes them hard: uncertainty, failure states, trust and handover to humans.

  • A close working relationship with engineers and PMs, including prototyping in code or with AI tools where it speeds up learning.

  • A collaborative mindset with a strong point of view: you push back with evidence, take feedback well and can articulate the why behind any design.

  • The confidence to hold a quality bar and speak for design across the company. You influence without authority and you're happy to set the example.

What you'll be working on

  • Designing the experience of an AI support agent that answers travellers and hands over to our travel support team when it should.

  • Defining the patterns for AI behaviour: when it acts, asks, escalates or defers, and how users see what it did and why.

  • Building tools for the businesses on Duffel to review, correct and trust what the AI does on their behalf.

  • Helping other teams with their design needs when they ask, and sometimes when they don't yet know they have one.

  • Sharing design progress, rationale and open questions weekly with product, engineering and operations,

Why You’ll Love Working at Duffel

We believe in true ownership. That’s why every permanent employee gets equity in the business.

title: Senior Product Engineer (Full Stack)
descriptionHtml:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

About the role

Andercore runs global trade end to end, from sourcing and pricing to sales, logistics and financing, and much of that work is done by AI agents. Agents are only as good as the product around them: reliable data, well-designed APIs, and interfaces where our team can review, correct and approve what an agent proposes before real money and real shipments move.

As a Senior Product Engineer, you own business problems end to end. You talk to the people who use what you build, decide with Product what to solve, and ship the whole slice: data model, services, AI agents and the user interface. You work in a domain where prices and stock change daily, supplier data arrives in every possible format, and a wrong number costs money. You set the quality bar for the team and make the engineers around you better.

Tech stack

Java 21 and Spring Boot 3, Python, LangGraph and LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), PostgreSQL, Kinesis, AWS with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and TypeScript with Node.js, Next.js and React. You don't need to know all of it on day one. We use AI coding tools heavily and expect you to pick up whatever part of the stack the problem needs.

What you will do

  • Own a business problem from first conversation to production and beyond, for example making supplier pricing reliable from ingestion all the way to the quote a salesperson sends.

  • Build backend services for pricing, inventory, orders and the integrations that connect suppliers, customers and logistics partners.

  • Build our AI agents and the tools and APIs they use, and make their actions safe through idempotency, validation, audit trails and human review where it matters.

  • Design and build the interfaces where our commercial teams work with agents: reviewing proposals, correcting mistakes and approving decisions quickly.

  • Turn messy external data such as supplier price lists, datasheets and stock feeds into trustworthy data the rest of the business relies on.

  • Measure whether what you shipped works, including evaluating and monitoring LLM-driven workflows in production.

  • Lead technical decisions, write down the trade-offs, and mentor other engineers through code review, pairing and direct feedback.

  • Help us hire by running interviews and defining what good engineering looks like at Andercore.

In your first six months, you might

  • Build a pricing engine that scales with our growing assortment and number of markets, and serves correct prices to sales, and later directly to customers, in milliseconds.

  • Automate procurement: turn supplier price lists, quotes and order confirmations into structured data, and let AI agents handle the manual steps between our buyers and suppliers.

What you bring

  • At least 5 years of experience building and running software in production, with real users and real consequences when it fails.

  • Strong backend skills at production scale in Java or a comparable language such as Kotlin, C# or Go, and willingness to work in Java and Spring Boot. Experience designing distributed, event-driven systems, with a focus on data correctness and failure modes.

  • Solid command of PostgreSQL and hands-on experience with AWS.

  • Your depth is on the backend, but full-stack delivery is expected: you build frontends in TypeScript and React. You don't need to be a frontend specialist, but you can ship a good interface for the problem you own.

  • Product sense: you ask why before how, you talk to users, and you can turn a vague problem into a clear plan.

  • Experience in a fast-growing company, where priorities shift and you keep shipping while the business changes around you.

  • A track record of solving business problems, not only technical ones.

  • Experience building with LLMs or agent frameworks is a strong plus. Curiosity and good engineering judgment about them is a must.

  • You raise the level of the people around you, and you push back when something doesn't make sense.

  • Experience in trading, marketplaces, supply chain, fintech or other domains where data errors cost money is a bonus.

Practical details

  • Location: Berlin, hybrid

  • Working language: English

  • A learning budget for your development

  • Start date: As soon as possible

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength.

title: Senior Product Engineer (m/w/d) mit Claude Code
descriptionHtml:
Als Product Engineer verantwortest Du bei uns ein Produkt als Ganzes. Du sprichst mit Kunden und Team, findest heraus, welches Problem wirklich gelöst werden muss, und entscheidest, was gebaut wird und was wegfällt. Dann setzt Du es mit Claude um, bringst es live und schaust, ob es im Alltag der Nutzer funktioniert. Was Du dort lernst, wird die nächste Version.

Wer wir sind

Lightweb Media ist eine AI-first Software- und KI-Entwicklungsfirma mit Büros in Dresden und Hamburg. Bei uns läuft die gesamte Firma über Claude: Entwicklung, Betrieb, Projektmanagement und Kommunikation. Dafür haben wir eigene Werkzeuge gebaut: ein Company Brain, in dem unser Wissen und unsere Abläufe liegen, ein eigenes Secret Management und ein eigenes KI-Projektmanagement-Tool. Daneben entwickeln wir eigene Produkte und B2B-Plattformen für Kunden, die im Betrieb laufen müssen.

Das machst Du

  • Du setzt Projekte von der Idee bis zum Deployment um und betreust sie danach weiter: Anforderungen klären, Lösung entwerfen, bauen, ausliefern, beobachten, verbessern.

  • Du orchestrierst Claude und Subagenten über mehrere Repositories parallel, mit Plan, Review-Schritten und Freigaben vor Push und Deploy.

  • Ob etwas funktioniert, prüfst Du an der echten Datenbank und im laufenden Betrieb.

  • Releases bringst Du selbst live, schaust danach auf Health-Checks, Logs und Fehlertracking und behebst, was auffällt.

  • Du verantwortest Infrastruktur und Deployments: Server, Container, CI/CD, Monitoring und Sicherheitsupdates.

  • Am Company Brain baust Du mit: Skills, Hooks, Routinen und die Regeln, nach denen unsere Agenten arbeiten. Was sich wiederholt, machst Du zu einer Routine, die von selbst läuft.

  • Nach jedem Release schreibst Du die Nachricht an Kunden und kommunizierst im Team.

Das erwarten wir außerdem

  • Mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung

  • Mindestens sechs Monate Arbeit mit Claude

  • Erfahrung mit Infrastruktur und Deployments: Linux-Server, Docker, CI/CD und Releases, die Du selbst live gebracht hast

  • Erfahrung mit Agenten-Orchestrierung: mehrere Agenten oder Subagenten parallel steuern, mit Plänen, Prüfschritten und Freigaben

  • Der Abschnitt „At a Glance“ aus Deinem /insights-Bericht

  • Du hast Software gebaut und selbst betrieben und kennst die Probleme, die erst nach dem Livegang auftauchen

  • Backend und Datenbank sind Dein Terrain: Bei langsamen Abfragen misst Du erst und urteilst dann

  • Große Aufträge gibst Du an Agenten ab und sorgst dafür, dass am Ende der ganze Umfang fertig ist

  • Fließendes Deutsch, weil wir mit unseren Kunden und intern Deutsch sprechen

*Ein Lebenslauf zeigt, was Du gemacht hast. Der Abschnitt „At a Glance“ zeigt, wie Du mit Claude arbeitest: wie Du Aufgaben zuschneidest, was Du abgibst, wo Du nachprüfst und wo es hakt. Ein makelloser Bericht ist nicht das Ziel. Uns interessiert, wie Du mit den Stellen umgehst, an denen es nicht rund läuft.

Das hilft (kein Muss)

  • Eigene Apps oder Produkte, die Du uns zeigen kannst, als Link, Repository oder Demo

  • Ein Blick für Sicherheit und Datenschutz in KI-Workflows

title: Senior Product Engineer (Product Manager)
descriptionHtml:
About Zable

Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.

  • Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021

  • The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK

  • Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan

  • Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.

The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.

Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.

Join us if you want to

  • Take ownership across a broad remit - you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Zable from day one

  • Work in small teams of exceptional people - who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  • Build the best technology in-house - using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

 

About the role

We're building a larger, dedicated Platform team at Zable, increasing our investment in the infrastructure that enables our products and engineering teams to scale.

We're hiring a Technical Product Manager to sit within Engineering and connect platform technology, reliability and commercial value. You'll own what we prioritise and why, giving engineers the business context they need while helping Product and leadership understand the impact and opportunities that Platform enables.

This is a hands-on technical IC role, where you'll stay close to engineering through writing code, reviewing PRs and contributing to architecture discussions.

Working closely with the Platform Engineering Manager and Tech Lead, you'll help shape the Platform roadmap, connect technical investment to measurable business outcomes, and build the foundations that allow Zable to move faster and scale with confidence.

What you'll be doing

Own platform stability

  • Own platform stability as a primary accountability - SLA/SLO metrics, incident rates, release quality.

  • Hold release gating authority: block features from production that don't meet testing standards or introduce unacceptable regression risk.

  • Enforce CI/CD standards centrally so pods don't fragment into one-off solutions.

  • Track and report stability metrics alongside commercial outcomes - stability is the foundation that makes the rest possible.

Be commercially accountable

  • Own the business case for platform investment and answer "why are we spending six engineers on this for three months?" in terms leadership understands.

  • Track platform impact in business terms: developer velocity, incident cost, time-to-market, reliability, capacity - e.g. "CXO rollout removes a 3-second API fan-out, reducing session abandonment" or "we can now handle 20k simultaneous logins".

  • Input into headcount and investment decisions for the platform team.

Own the platform roadmap

  • Own the platform backlog, prioritised by business value and sequenced to unblock the highest-value product teams first - not driven by technical debt or engineer preference alone.

  • Make trade-offs explicit: "if we do X now, we defer Y by Z weeks - here's what that means for products depending on us".

  • Ensure every initiative has a defined success metric that non-engineers can track.

Be the stakeholder interface

  • Act as the single point of contact for Pod Leads: business requirements coming from pods and engineering/developer requirements flowing to pods; prioritise both in service of platform stability.

  • Make platform work visible to leadership - regular forums with product MDs and PMs to capture upcoming dependencies before they become blockers; represent platform work in leadership reviews; translate technical milestones into business milestones.

  • Drive cross-team collaboration and buy-in with other PMs; engage architecture in technical design.

  • Escalate when product teams make requests that would create unsustainable platform load or technical debt.

Contribute as an engineer

  • Write code, review PR's, and participate in architecture design as a core part of the role - not a side project.

  • Bring a strong technical voice to roadmap decisions without owning final architecture calls (that's Architecture and Tech Leads).

What we're looking for

Essential

  • Deep, hands-on engineering background - this role must be staffed by someone who has shipped production systems, not someone who has only managed backlogs.

  • Strong commercial instinct: can build a business case, speak to P&L impact, and hold a line on ROI.

  • Exceptional stakeholder management across product, engineering, and finance without direct line authority over all of them.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity - platform value is often indirect and long-horizon.

  • Track record of contributing as an IC while operating at a senior, cross-team level.

  • Proactive, low-ego, and clear communicator - able to hold a line with leadership and pod leads alike.

Nice to have

  • Experience in platform, infrastructure, or developer tooling contexts.

  • Familiarity with SLA/SLO frameworks and incident management at scale.

  • Experience enforcing CI/CD standards across multiple teams or pods.

  • Prior work making "invisible" infrastructure legible to non-technical leadership.

Our tech stack

Platform & backend: Kotlin, AWS, Postgres, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes.

Gateway & clients: Node GraphQL gateway, React Native / TypeScript mobile app, Relay.

Tooling & observability: GitHub, GitHub Actions, Jira, Confluence, Datadog, Sentry, Grafana.

Interview process

  • Quick call with the Talent Team (30 minutes)

  • Hiring manager interview (30 minutes)

  • Technical and Product interview (90 minutes)

  • Culture-add interview (60 minutes)

Life at Zable

  • The opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

title: Senior Product Manager, AI Products & Agentic Hospitality (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About the role

At Apaleo, we're building the open, API-first property management platform for hospitality. With integrations across hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, and the first AI agent marketplace for hospitality in our Agent Hub, we simplify operations, elevate the guest journey and drive revenue growth for our customers.

We're looking for a senior Product Manager to ownin our AI product domain. You'll turn our AI capabilities into coherent, commercially viable products that solve real operational problems for hoteliers. Your goal is to help hotels move towards genuinely autonomous operations, not to ship isolated automations or AI assistants.

This is not a backlog role. You'll take an ambiguous opportunity, find the right customer problems, define the proposition, build it with Engineering, bring it to market and drive adoption. You'll also play a central role in turning our AI capabilities into a meaningful and growing source of revenue.

This is a senior individual contributor role with real autonomy. You won't receive a roadmap and execute it. You'll shape it along our vision, using customer insight, data and sound reasoning. You'll work closely with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing and Customer Success, and in close collaboration with our other value stream teams.

What you'll be up to

  • Productising and commercialising our AI capabilities. Define the proposition, target customers and use cases, and shape packaging and launch with commercial teams.
  • Building the foundations for AI across our ecosystem. Shape how our AI capabilities understand each hotel's context and work reliably with Apaleo and connected systems across operational areas.
  • Productising hospitality knowledge. Turn hospitality expertise and operational processes into scalable product experiences, with appropriate human oversight.
  • Driving autonomy and measurable value. Think in complete outcomes, such as staff hours saved and manual work removed. Show hoteliers tangible ROI.
  • Driving adoption. Run discovery, shape onboarding and usability, measure adoption and improve from real-world feedback.
  • Keeping AI products reliable and viable. Define good agent performance, understand cost and latency, set up evaluation and monitoring with Engineering, and trade off autonomy, reliability, human intervention and cost.
  • Owning strategy, roadmap and delivery in your scope, with clear specs, a definition of done and impact analysis.
  • Working with Engineering on trade-offs, dependencies, quality and our API-first AI-first architecture.
  • Balancing ambition with reality. Weigh the roadmap against operational requests, bugs and technical debt, and say no to good ideas that aren't great ones.
  • Spotting dependencies early with Hotel Operations and other engineering teams, since our AI capabilities build on the core platform.
  • Using AI in your own PM work and championing AI-assisted engineering.

What you'll bring

  • 6+ years as a Product Manager, owning products from discovery through launch and adoption with limited day-to-day direction.
  • Proven zero-to-one experience. You've taken a new B2B product, not a feature, from an ambiguous problem to paying customers, driving discovery, validation, definition, prioritisation and launch.
  • Ownership after launch. You've owned a revenue, adoption or retention number and can tell us what moved and what you killed, pivoted or repriced.
  • Commercial thinking. You've defined propositions, packaging and pricing, validated willingness to pay and worked with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success on go-to-market.
  • Systems and process thinking. You break processes into steps, decisions and handoffs, and understand how systems with different data models and sources of truth affect the reliability of agents.
  • Meaningful AI product experience. You've built and launched AI-powered products or capabilities used by real customers, understand what makes a product agentic, and can discuss context, tools, latency, cost and evaluation, with a view on human-in-the-loop design.
  • Customer centricity and product judgement. You turn interview patterns into opportunities, make tough trade-offs and prioritise ruthlessly.
  • Platform thinking. You weigh customer needs against reusable capabilities, API consistency and long-term platform evolution.
  • Stakeholder alignment. You align Engineering, commercial teams and peers, manage cross-team dependencies and communicate trade-offs with confidence.
  • Autonomy and adaptability. You take ownership, raise risks early and make progress through ambiguity.

Strongly preferred

  • Agentic AI products in production. You've taken an agentic AI product beyond prototype to paying customers, and dealt with reliability, permissions, exceptions, human intervention and evaluation. This is different from AI-powered features such as chatbots, summarisation or copilots.

Nice to have

  • Hospitality technology or hotel operations experience.
  • Experience with PMS, RMS, CRS, channel managers, OTAs or hospitality distribution.
  • Experience in B2B SaaS platforms, ecosystems or integration-heavy products.
  • Experience with AI governance, permissions, identity, orchestration or enterprise AI adoption.
  • Experience in a fast-moving startup or scale-up.
  • Comfort with AI-assisted engineering processes.

Don't tick every box? Hospitality experience is an advantage, not a prerequisite. A strong zero-to-one B2B product builder from another domain, with real AI product experience and a commercial mindset, can be a better fit than a hospitality specialist without them. We'd still love to hear from you.

Who you are

  • You take high ownership. You answer for product outcomes, not just delivery commitments.
  • You're strategic and hands-on. You can set a product vision and still get into customer discovery, operational processes and detailed product decisions.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. You make progress when the problem or the solution isn't fully defined.
  • You think commercially. You ask what customers will buy and why, not just what Engineering can build.
  • You're customer obsessed. You understand real operational pain and test your assumptions with customers.
  • You're technically curious. You know enough about AI and agentic systems to hold meaningful discussions with engineers and make informed product decisions.
  • You measure what matters. You judge success by customer outcomes, adoption and commercial impact, not features shipped.

What we offer

Culture and growth

  • A diverse and international team. Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique perspectives and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech.
  • Growth and development. You'll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility.
  • Autonomy and ownership. Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly, in an environment built on trust and transparency.
  • Competitive and fair compensation. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams.

Perks and lifestyle

  • Flexible and remote work options. We focus on results, not clocking hours. Work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup.
  • Free public transport. Travel across Germany with a fully covered Deutschland Ticket.
  • Paid time off. 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired.
  • Health and wellbeing. Access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership.

Joining Apaleo

How you make an impact joining Apaleo: Joining Apaleo is more than taking on a role. It's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions and help redefine the future of hospitality tech.

title: Senior Product Manager (Towed Array Solutions)
descriptionHtml:
Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on.

As Senior Product Manager Towed Array Solutions you join our towed array product group as its second Product Manager, as we expand the team to keep pace with our current growth. You will initially focus on the Submarine and Special Warfare Support Vessel (SSV) domain, working closely with the Product Manager UxV, and build a deep understanding of the towed array systems and solutions we supply to our defense partners and clients, and of the anti-submarine warfare (ASW) and intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR) missions they support.

You are responsible, from a product point of view, for bringing towed array solutions for your domain to market end to end from the in-water array to dry-end interrogator hardware, edge processing and integration on the host platform. You own the product strategy, roadmap and lifecycle for your domain within the shared towed array roadmap and shape the end-to-end solution together with the Product Manager UxV Solutions and the Senior Product Manager Software Solutions, who owns the software and platform capabilities that support it. You apply and further strengthen our product discovery and delivery ways of working for your domain.

You will be part of the Product team in Underwater Security and work closely with the Product Managers for UxV, Software, OptiBarrier and Deployment Solutions, Product Marketing, System Architecture, R&D, Engineering, Data Science, Sales, Customer Projects and Application Engineering teams.

Within your first 6–12 months, you will have defined a clear, evidence-based SSV strategy and roadmap aligned with the overall towed array roadmap, assumed full Product ownership of SSV-related programs, and aligned hardware, software and commercial teams on the most important capabilities. Your work will expand our capacity to serve customers and programs in parallel, reduce uncertainty and strengthen investment decisions, helping Optics11 bring scalable, commercially strong solutions to customers operating in demanding, high-stakes defense environments.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the SSV domain strategy by defining the direction for towed array solutions in your domain, aligned with the overall towed array product group strategy, identifying customer problems and market opportunities, and balancing near-term opportunities with long-term company goals.

  • Lead customer and market discovery by developing a deep understanding of operational use cases, mission profiles and buying contexts, validating direction with navies, primes, partners and system integrators, and synthesizing feedback from trials and deployed systems.

  • Own the SSV roadmap and end-to-end solution definition within the shared towed array roadmap by defining the capabilities required to address validated needs, balancing improvements, new functionality and technology evolution, and aligning software and platform requirements with the Senior Product Manager Software.

  • Provide product design authority by ensuring hardware concepts, architecture choices and development decisions remain aligned with the Underwater Security product vision and strategy throughout the product lifecycle, together with System Architecture team.

  • Develop business cases and commercial input by defining success measures, commercial objectives and pricing for your domain, providing evidence for portfolio investment decisions, and working with Product Marketing on market insights, positioning, value propositions and launch readiness.

  • Bring solutions to market end to end by driving productization, defining qualification and certification requirements at product and solution level (with Systems Engineering and System Architects defining them at engineering level), integration on host platforms and market introduction, including service and through-life support concepts together with Customer Projects and Application Engineering.

  • Coordinate the product core team by working with Systems Engineering on requirements and feasibility, Product Ownership and Technical Project Managers on executable increments, and Project Management on customer integrations and delivery; align priorities, platform choices and shared components with the Product Manager UxV; and align Sales, Business Development, Customer Projects and Engineering around progress, quality and outcomes to ensure we deliver on our roadmap commitments.


Requirements:

  • Master’s degree in engineering (e.g. electrical, mechanical, physics or acoustics), product development or a related technical field.

  • 5+ years of experience in hardware product management, with a proven track record of bringing hardware-based systems or end-to-end solutions to market in defense or another industrial high-tech / high-compliance environment.

  • Strong understanding of complex systems combining sensors, electronics and software, and of how hardware, edge processing and software platforms come together in one solution.

  • Experience with the full hardware lifecycle: from requirements and development through qualification, production and market introduction to through-life support and ILS.

  • In-depth knowledge of product management and strategy methodologies, with demonstrable experience in defining product strategy and creating complete business cases.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills at operational and management level.

  • Critical thinking, adaptability and a problem-solving mindset to creatively address user and customer pain points.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, capable of conveying product decisions and roadmaps to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Willingness to travel, including to customers and sea trials; driver’s license B (or international equivalent).

  • Ability to pass a background / security screening by the Dutch AIVD/MIVD, as you will be working with clients in the defense industry.

Nice to Have :

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Rivia

Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital.

Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated.

Over the past two years, European and US based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital.

Rivia’s ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end.

 

About the Product Team

You’ll be Rivia's first product hire, reporting to the CTO. Today, everything Product is owned by the Rivia founders and carried out Engineering. Your job is to take it over, build the function, and make shipping high quality products repeatable. As Rivia scales, there is a clear path to leading a PM team.

 

The Role

As Senior Product Manager at Rivia, you own the path from idea to adopted feature. Driving alignment across Engineering, Client Solutions and founders to build products that have relevant impact, from customer discovery, mockups, specs, weekly refinement, launches, and measurement of KPIs.

You’ll own several products across Rivia’s platform. This requires holistic understanding of market and customer needs for complex prioritisation decisions. To do that you’ll need to be deep in the details: talking to customers, experts, writing specs, monitoring usage, keeping delivery moving. You also build the product management function itself, with light processes (PRDs, documentation, releases, prioritization) that a future product team builds on, and you own product coherence: the principles that keep features consistent as the platform grows.

 

What Excites You

  • Shipping products that help bring new therapies to market. Our customers entrust us with their patients, we take that very seriously.

  • Working directly with customers, including clinical research and biotech teams running global clinical trials, to understand problems and turn them into delightful solutions.

  • Defining product management foundation, from first principles, as the first product hire.

  • Joining a team that already works AI-native: agentic features run in production on live trials, customers connect their own agents through the Rivia MCP, and much of the roadmap ahead is AI products. You work the same way, from AI-built mockups to agent-driven analysis.

 

Responsibilities

  • Product Execution: Own the full product lifecycle for your scope: discovery, spec, delivery, and post-launch measurement.

  • Drive Cross-Team Coordination: Align Engineering, Design,w and Clinical stakeholders to hit delivery deadlines. Work closely with GTM to synchronize assets and commercial readiness with each release.

  • Channel Customers need: Run structured feedback loops with customers and internal stakeholders, ensuring their needs are prioritised and our products are usable, reliable and high quality.

  • Oversee a Multi-Product Portfolio: Weigh competing priorities across the product line, deliberately direct your own attention and your teams' bandwidth, and make sure customers experience the products as one coherent whole.

  • Own Product performance: Set KPIs and targets before building, measure feature health after launch, and make kill, iterate, or double-down calls on the data.

  • AI-Powered Product Development: Use AI agents in your daily work, including AI-generated mockups to accelerate discovery, and identify where AI unlocks new value for clinical teams.

  • Product Function Building: Set up light processes (PRDs, documentation, release process, prioritization) that the team actually follows.

 

What Excites Us

  • 7+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS with technical products

  • You have been the first or sole PM at a B2B startup and built the product function around an engineer-led team

  • Has taken at least one product from idea to production with demonstrable adoption

  • Hands-on product analytics: built measurement from zero with Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar

  • Has designed and run product processes (refinement, discovery, launches) that engineering teams actually kept

  • AI-native way of working: uses AI agents in daily product work, with concrete examples

  • Comfortable being the only product person: self-directed, builds the function while running it

  • Clinical trials, drug development, or health data experience is a strong plus. Exceptional PMs without it are welcome.

Bonus

  • Former lead or head of product who wants to build hands-on again

  • Experience shipping for expert or scientific users

 

Our Values

At Rivia, we are committed to excellence, continuous learning, and the success of both our customers and our team. If you are driven to exceed targets, eager to shape the future of clinical trials, and passionate about making a meaningful difference in the biotech industry, Rivia is the place for you.

  • In it to Win it: Approach every challenge with determination, resilience, and a drive, aiming for the best outcomes and solutions.

  • Embrace change: We see change as an opportunity for growth, innovation, and improvement, continuously evolving to stay one step ahead.

  • Why not?: Asking why not, instead of why, allows us to show our curiosity, allowing us to challenge assumptions and explore new possibilities.

  • Find the gap: We are curious and we proactively approach identifying opportunities and solving problems before they arise.

  • Collective accountability: We are one team, on one mission and we are committed to shared responsibilities and mutual support, enabling trust and collaboration.

  • Value add solutions: Know better. Act better. We are dedicated to delivering meaningful and impactful results.
