title: SEO & AI Search Manager (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Über uns



Wir begeistern und inspirieren Millionen von Menschen! Als innovativer Hybrid aus Social Media Publisher und Social Media Agentur vereint das VS Mediahouse einzigartige Expertise in den Bereichen Content-Kreation, Markenaufbau und Performance-Marketing. Mit einem Team von über 50 Experten in Social Media, Design und Videoproduktion betreiben wir die beliebtesten Social-Media-Marken Deutschlands auf Facebook, Instagram und TikTok. Zu unseren Erfolgsmarken zählen unter anderem VS, Lieblingskollegen und Lieblingsmensch®. Unser tiefes Verständnis für die Dynamik von Social Media und unser Publishing-Know-how ermöglichen es uns, Marken wie Samsung, Schwartau, Bayer und Lexware im Bereich Social Media nachhaltig erfolgreich zu machen. Wir schaffen Verbindungen, erzählen Geschichten und setzen Trends – für echte Wirkung und messbaren Erfolg.

Deine Mission



Du hast bereits erste Jahre im SEO hinter dir und kennst die Grundlagen aus der Praxis, nicht nur aus Tutorials. Gleichzeitig hast du gemerkt: Suche verändert sich gerade grundlegend. Immer mehr Menschen fragen ChatGPT, Gemini oder bekommen ihre Antwort direkt in den AI Overviews. Genau diesen Wandel willst du mitgestalten und dich darin weiterentwickeln.

Als SEO & AI Search Manager arbeitest du operativ an der SEO- und AI-Search-Strategie für einige unserer wichtigsten Kunden. Du setzt Maßnahmen eigenständig um, bringst eigene Ideen ein und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung. Dabei stehst du nicht allein da: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Paid Ads Team zusammen und hast jederzeit jemanden für Sparring und Feedback.

KI spielt dabei eine doppelte Rolle. Zum einen ist sie Zielsystem: Du hilfst Kunden, auch in KI-gestützten Suchsystemen sichtbar zu werden. Zum anderen ist sie Arbeitsweise: Du nutzt KI selbst für Recherche, Analysen, Briefings und Reporting. Ein fertiges Technik-Portfolio brauchst du dafür nicht, wichtiger sind Neugier und Lust, dich reinzuhängen. Bei uns wirst du zum KI-Poweruser deines Fachbereichs.

Was erwartet dich

  • AI Search & Sichtbarkeit: Du hilfst dabei, dass Inhalte in Google AI Overviews, AI Mode, ChatGPT, Gemini und Perplexity auffindbar und zitierfähig werden. Du strukturierst Inhalte für generative Systeme, zum Beispiel mit klar beantwortbaren Absätzen, Q&A-Strukturen und sauberem Schema-Markup.
  • Sichtbarkeit messbar machen: Du baust Prompt-Sammlungen und Testsets auf und beobachtest, wann und wie Marken und Inhalte in KI-Antworten auftauchen – idealerweise mit Tools wie Peec, Otterly oder Profound.
  • Operative SEO-Arbeit: Du führst technische Audits durch, erstellst Keyword- und Content-Analysen, schreibst Content-Briefings und begleitest deren Umsetzung.
  • Kundenprojekte mitgestalten: Du arbeitest an der SEO- und GEO-Roadmap für einen unserer wichtigsten Kunden mit und übernimmst eigene Themenpakete, von der Analyse bis zur Erfolgskontrolle.
  • Kundenkontakt: Du stimmst dich mit den Ansprechpersonen auf Kundenseite ab, bereitest Reportings vor und präsentierst Ergebnisse. Mit der Zeit übernimmst du dabei mehr und mehr den Lead.

    Dein Alltag: KI als deine tägliche Arbeitsweise



Hier geht es nicht um die Arbeit für Kunden, sondern um deinen eigenen Alltag: Viele wiederkehrende Aufgaben erledigst du bei uns spürbar schneller, weil du KI dafür einsetzt – kein Kür-Thema, sondern Standard. Zum Beispiel:

  • Keyword-Clustering und Content-Gap-Analysen per KI vorbereiten, statt sie komplett von Hand zu erstellen.
  • Erste Content-Briefings und Gliederungsentwürfe mit KI entwerfen.
  • Crawl- und Search-Console-Daten von KI vorauswerten, bevor du selbst tief einsteigst.
  • Wiederkehrende Reports automatisieren, statt sie jede Woche neu zusammenzuklicken.
  • Die Qualitätskontrolle bleibt trotzdem bei dir: KI-Ergebnisse werden von dir eingeordnet und geprüft, nicht blind übernommen.

Was solltest du mitbringen



Du musst nicht alles können. Wichtig ist uns ein solides SEO oder GEO-Fundament und echte Lust, dazuzulernen. Bei KI brauchst du kein Fachwissen, aber komplett bei null solltest du auch nicht stehen.

  • Erfahrung: Etwa 2–3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im SEO und oder GEO, aus einer Agentur, einem Unternehmen oder einem Publisher. Ein bestimmter Studienabschluss ist für uns nicht entscheidend, wichtiger sind Praxis und Neugier.
  • SEO-Grundlagen: Gute Kenntnisse in Technical SEO, Content SEO sowie Onpage- und Offpage-Optimierung.
  • Tools: Erste Erfahrung mit technischen Audits (Crawling, Indexierung, Core Web Vitals, strukturierte Daten). Du arbeitest sicher mit Google Search Console und GA4 sowie mindestens einem Tool wie Sistrix, Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog oder Sitebulb.
  • Interesse an KI-Suche: GEO, AEO oder AI Visibility sind dir ein Begriff, und du willst dich darin vertiefen. Du hast schon eigene Erfahrung mit KI-Tools wie Claude, ChatGPT oder Perplexity gesammelt, und sei es nur privat.
  • Denken in Wirkung: Du denkst nicht nur in Rankings, sondern auch in Traffic, Conversions und Kundennutzen.
  • Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest strukturiert und selbstständig und fragst nach, wenn etwas unklar ist.
  • Sprache: Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch.

Warum VS Mediahouse



Wir sind auf der Suche nach motivierten Mitarbeitenden, die etwas bewegen möchten, Mut für neue Ideen haben und das Unternehmen aktiv mitgestalten wollen. Wir legen großen Wert auf einen respektvollen Umgang auf Augenhöhe. Neben unserem modernen Büro im Herzen von Freiburg erwarten dich ausgezeichnete Arbeitsbedingungen in einem hoch dynamischen und wachstumsstarken Umfeld. Freue dich auf vielseitige Aufgaben mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und unternehmerischem Gestaltungsspielraum sowie einer modernen, sachorientierten Entscheidungskultur ohne unnötige Hierarchien. Wir bieten dir fachliche und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch Freiraum für Innovationen, kurze Entscheidungswege und individuelles Management-Coaching.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Wähle zwischen einem kostenfreien Jobticket (Deutschlandticket) oder nutze unser attraktives JobRad-Angebot.
  • Um dich fit und gesund zu halten, subventionieren wir deine Epassi-Mitgliedschaft.
  • Du findest bei uns modernste Ausstattung mit höhenverstellbaren Schreibtischen sowie Macbook & iPhone (auch zur privaten Nutzung) und natürlich ist das Arbeiten aus dem Homeoffice auch für uns kein Fremdwort.
  • Für Zwischendurch bedienst du dich an unserem regionalen Obst, Müsli, Kaffee, Getränke und vieles mehr.
  • Neben deinem persönlichen Corporate Benefits Zugang erhältst du 50% Rabatt auf unsere Produkte in unserem Shop.

title: Shared Services Manager
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Shared Services Manager to join our People Team; as we scale up and drive digital and financial inclusion across our markets.

About Us

M-KOPA now serves 10 million customers and has extended $2 billion+ in credit across Kenya, Uganda, Nigeria, Ghana and South Africa. 86% of customers report an improved quality of life, 55% access formal financial services for the first time, and 70% use our products to earn income. It takes 2,300+ employees and 35,000+ field agents to make that happen.

The Role

Reporting to the Head of HR Shared Services, you lead day-to-day service delivery: queue health, SLAs, escalations, quality and business continuity, with functional leadership and coaching for colleagues. You also own UK HR operations, from onboarding and right-to-work to payroll and benefits cover, offboarding and contractors. You partner with People Partners, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Finance, Legal, IT and external partners including the Home Office, our payroll provider, Papaya, brokers, insurers and NEST. Success means healthy queues, SLAs met and 100% audit-ready right-to-work records.

This is a remote role, you would be working with a diverse group of other employees working remotely from locations such as UK, Europe and Africa. You will be reporting to the Head of HR Shared Services.

Why this timing matters

We are not hiring at random. Reaching 10 by 10 means building the people infrastructure behind our growth. A UK team that delivers onboarding, immigration, payroll and benefits to audit-ready standards is part of that foundation, and you would help set it.

What makes this different

Your current role: one process, one market. This role: leading HR Shared Services across global and market client groups, while owning UK HR operations and compliance. Every case you close helps someone who is helping deliver financial inclusion.

What You'll Do

  • Lead HR Shared Services delivery in Freshservice, managing case allocation, prioritisation, SLAs, ageing items and escalations, and coordinating capacity during peaks and absences.

  • Own UK right-to-work checks and immigration records through the Home Office portal, including annual audits, pre-expiry follow-up, Certificates of Sponsorship and sponsor reporting.

  • Run UK onboarding from accepted offer to first-day readiness, creating accurate HiBob profiles with Talent Acquisition, IT and hiring managers.

  • Manage employee lifecycle transactions, contracts, probation, letters and audit-ready HR records, reconciling data across HiBob, Freshservice and payroll files.

  • Act as UK backup for payroll, Group Benefits, NEST pensions, Global Mobility and employee relations, supporting inputs, provider deadlines and compliant case documentation.

  • Coordinate offboarding for UK employees, EOR workers and contractors, and maintain the UK Contractor List as the source of truth.

  • Produce regular reports, close audit findings, maintain SOPs and the knowledge base, and improve processes while protecting data under UK GDPR.

What You'll Need

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Employment Relations or a related field. CIPD qualification or progress toward it is desirable.

  • Proven experience managing end-to-end HR Shared Services across multiple processes, stakeholders and client groups, including queues, SLAs, escalations, controls and continuous improvement.

  • Practical UK experience in right-to-work checks, immigration records, sponsorship administration and Home Office processes.

  • Experience coordinating UK payroll inputs, benefits, pensions, contracts, onboarding, lifecycle changes and offboarding with external providers.

  • Experience with HRIS and service-management platforms. HiBob and Freshservice are preferred.

  • Strong attention to detail, stakeholder management, sound judgement and high standards of confidentiality. Experience working across countries or markets is strongly preferred.

The reality check

This role is demanding. You will run a global service queue and a UK compliance portfolio at the same time, with competing priorities, high-volume requests and confidential cases arriving together. Right-to-work and sponsorship deadlines don’t move, and as payroll backup your accuracy shows up in someone’s payslip. When colleagues are away, you are the cover for payroll, benefits, mobility and employee relations. If you are already the person who tracks every expiry date and closes every loop, you’re probably ready for exactly this.

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com.

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

Important Notice

M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships. 

M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.

Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.

If your application is successful M-KOPA undertakes pre-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.

title: Site Reliability Engineer - Platform Reliability
descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is the role

Platform Infrastructure provides the infrastructure, tooling, processes and services that more than a thousand Elastic engineers depend on. We are about 110 people across ten teams in three groups: Core Infrastructure, Reliability Engineering, and Engineering Productivity & Developer Experience. We run the multi-cloud platform underneath Elastic Cloud Hosted and Serverless, the shared Kubernetes platform other Elastic teams build on, the observability estate that shows Cloud engineers what production is doing, and the release path the whole Elastic Stack ships through.

As an SRE here you take an engineering approach to reliability. You write the Go, Python and Terraform that replaces manual work, you carry the on-call rotation for what your team runs, and you work with Cloud engineering to close the gaps you find.

Elastic is expanding its Serverless offerring, and most of what we build sits underneath it. Current work includes packing hundreds of customer projects onto shared clusters, PrivateLink and static IPs, new regions, a single identity layer across the stack, and new government regions. We are also replacing manually managed services with code-managed systems, which lets the platform grow without the on-call load growing with it.

Why join us

  • The scale is large. We run across multiple cloud providers and many regions, and some teams operate 200+ production deployments of our own product.
  • We are customer zero for Elastic Cloud Hosted, Serverless and the observability and security products, so new features land on our systems first and our feedback goes back to the product teams.
  • The engineers who use what you build are a thousand colleagues you can go and talk to.
  • On-call follows the sun, which keeps the burden outside working hours small.
  • We are fully distributed across EMEA, NASA and APJ and the work happens in writing, so you control how you run your day.

What You Will Be Doing

  • You own systems end to end as the DRI on a project, and you break the work down yourself.
  • Own the outcome of projects on your team’s roadmap as the DRI, breaking the work down and pulling in help when you need it.
  • Operate and harden the infrastructure that other Elastic engineers depend on, managed as code with Terraform, Go and Python.
  • Build tools and services that remove manual work.
  • Carry the on-call rotation for what your team runs, drive incidents to resolution and write RCAs that lead to lasting fixes.
  • Improve observability, runbooks and documentation so the on-call load gets lighter over time.
  • Review code and designs, and act as a second set of eyes on production changes to critical infrastructure.
  • Raise risks and ideas without being asked, and mentor engineers with less experience.
  • Give feedback to the Elastic product teams on the features that reach our systems first.

What You Bring

  • 3+ years in SRE, platform engineering or infrastructure engineering, including real time operating what you built.
  • Experience with Terraform at multi-workspace scale.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals in Go or Python, the languages most of what we build is written in.
  • Extensive experience carrying on-call, resolving incidents under pressure and writing RCAs that hold up under review.

How you work

  • You take an ambiguous project, come back with a plan and own it to the end.
  • You say when an estimate or a sequence is wrong before the team commits to it.
  • You write clearly, because we work across nine time zones and the work happens in tickets and channels.
  • You stay calm when something is broken, communicate while you work and write the follow-up that stops it happening again.

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

  • Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
  • Health coverage for you and your family in many locations

This role combines software development, systems integration, troubleshooting, and developer enablement. You will help turn vehicle signals and hardware capabilities into dependable services, libraries, gateway behaviors, and APIs that partner engineers can discover, integrate, test, and use successfully. The role is well suited to a developer who enjoys working across system boundaries and taking software from design through production support.

This role is based in our Berlin office and requires a minimum of three days per week onsite.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain communication services, client libraries, gateway and routing components, and deployment configurations; implement message publication and subscription, request/reply interactions, service discovery, signal routing, gateway translation, and reliable failure handling.

  • Contribute to software components written in C++, Rust, Go, Kotlin, or other languages used across vehicle and cloud platform layers; evolve interface contracts, schemas, configuration models, and generated APIs while preserving compatibility for existing consumers.

  • Decide whether functionality belongs in a reusable platform abstraction, gateway mapping, vehicle service, application, or vehicle- or brand-specific integration; deploy and validate services across vehicle-oriented compute platforms, virtualized embedded environments, simulators, software-in-the-loop systems, benches, and prototype vehicles.

  • Investigate issues across vehicle interfaces, gateways, message-passing services, vehicle-model APIs, and consuming applications using logs, traces, packet captures, diagnostics, and test tools; improve reliability, performance, observability, security, deployment automation, and test coverage.

  • Support partner developers through integration guidance, examples, troubleshooting, documentation, and technical issue triage; collaborate with hardware, firmware, embedded, cloud, infotainment, security, validation, product, and external partner teams.

  • Participate in design reviews, code reviews, incident follow-up, and continuous improvement of engineering practices.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent experience) plus 3+ years developing software in distributed systems, embedded platforms, or middleware; strong C++, Rust, Go, or Kotlin skills across a multi-language platform.

  • Experience with messaging, gRPC, event-driven architectures, distributed systems, and designing or using Protobuf contracts (or equivalent), APIs, and schemas.

  • Familiarity with CAN/DBC, vehicle gateways, signal integration, and connected devices; physical-input or HMI gateway experience is a plus.

  • Ability to deploy and debug on embedded/virtual platforms (Android Automotive, Linux, test benches, simulators) with experience in CI/CD, Docker, or Bazel.

  • Knowledge of mutual TLS, auth, telemetry (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry), and end-to-end troubleshooting using logs, traces, and packet captures.

  • Strong communication skills to support developer adoption via SDKs and docs; experience with platform abstractions, automotive partners, Clean Architecture, and TDD/DDD.

Total Rewards

We build the exceptional — and we believe the people doing that work should be rewarded accordingly. In addition to a competitive base salary, full-time positions may be is eligible to participate in our annual company performance bonus program.

Payments are discretionary and not guaranteed; actual amounts depend on company results and the terms of the plan in effect, and require active employment at the time of payout. WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead the development of our RaceWatch software for one or more motorsport series.
  • Work with product managers and customers to design features and prioritise tasks.

  • Contribute to code quality, organization, and best practices throughout the development process.
  • Maintain and enhance software reliability.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Degree in computer science, or another scientific or technical subject.
  • A passion for sport.
  • 2+ years working in a fast-paced, technical environment, delivering software to customers.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience developing Windows applications in Visual Studio.
  • Experience developing applications that process video.
  • Experience with ticketing and project management platforms, such as JIRA or Monday.
  • Prior experience working in motorsport is an advantage.

WHY CATAPULT?

  • We have amazing people. We can promise you will work with some of the most ambitious and intelligent people in an exciting industry, and you will do some of the best work of your life.

title: Solutions Engineer
descriptionHtml:
We’re Making Travel Effortless. Join Us.

Travel is essential, whether it’s visiting family, starting a new adventure, or taking a career defining trip. Yet today, over 4 billion airline passengers rely on tech that hasn't changed in decades.

At Duffel, we’re rebuilding the infrastructure underpinning the global travel industry. Backed by top-tier investors (Benchmark, Blossom, Index Ventures, and Kima Ventures) and born out of Y Combinator (S18), we’re simplifying complex systems to build the future of travel.

Customer Success at Duffel

Customer Success owns Duffel's relationship with our customers once the contract is signed. We help them integrate, launch and grow on Duffel across Flights, Stays and more. The team brings together Customer Success Managers, Customer Success Engineers and Technical Support Engineers across London and New York, led by our VP, Customer Success. We're growing the team and building the processes that help customers go live faster and get more from Duffel.

The Role

We're hiring a Solutions Engineer: the technical expert who helps customers design the right Duffel solution during the sales process, then guides them through building it until they go live.

In pre-sales, you'll join our Account Executives on discovery calls and pitches, bringing the technical depth to understand how a customer's product works and design how Duffel fits into it. Once the deal is signed, you'll take that design into implementation as the customer's technical point of contact, making sure they go live smoothly with the best setup for their use case.

This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the VP, Customer Success. You'll be our first Solutions Engineer, so the way you do this job will become how the team works as it grows. That could lead to managing a team of solutions engineers, or to a principal-level technical role shaping how our largest customers build on Duffel. Most of our transaction volume is in the US, so you'll work closely with US-based customer teams from London.

What You’ll be doing:

  • Join Account Executives on discovery calls, pitches and technical deep-dives, running technical discovery on the customer's product, architecture, user journeys and travel use case.

  • Design the solution, build demos and proofs of concept, and write solution designs and implementation scopes so customers know what they're building before they sign. Answer technical questions in RFPs and security reviews.

  • Take what you designed into implementation as the customer's technical point of contact: answer their engineers' questions, review integrations, define test plans and run go-live readiness checks.

  • Debug integration issues hands-on with Postman or curl and our API logs, working alongside the Senior Implementation Project Manager, who owns the project plan and dates.

  • Feed integration friction back to Product and Engineering, build reusable assets such as solution templates, sample code and demo apps, and define how pre-sales and implementation run at Duffel.

What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years in a customer-facing technical role, such as solutions engineer, sales engineer, implementation engineer or technical account manager, at an API-first company.

  • Experience on both sides of the contract: supporting sales with discovery, demos and solution design, then implementing what was sold and taking enterprise customers live on complex integrations.

  • Hands-on API skills (REST, JSON, webhooks, authentication, sandbox vs production) and enough coding in a language such as JavaScript, Python, PHP, Ruby or Java to build a demo and spot what's wrong in a customer's integration.

  • The ability to explain a solution clearly to engineers and commercial decision-makers in the same meeting, and sound judgement on when to push back on a custom request or bring in Product.

  • Willingness to work regular US-overlap hours. Experience in payments, fintech or travel tech, writing statements of work, SQL or AI-assisted development tools is a bonus.

What you'll be working on

  • In your first 30 days: demoing Duffel's core flows end to end, building a test integration yourself, joining live sales calls and taking technical ownership of implementations already in flight.

  • By 90 days: leading technical discovery on new opportunities, with a written solution design before signature on every deal you work on.

  • Shaping how new Duffel products, such as Trains and our AI travel agent, are scoped and implemented for customers.

  • In your first year: customers designed in pre-sales going live faster with fewer surprises, a library of reusable solution templates and demo assets, and an evidence-based view of how the function should scale.

Why You’ll Love Working at Duffel

We believe in true ownership. That’s why every permanent employee gets equity in the business.

Perks That Actually Matter:

✈️ Travel Allowance: We literally pay you to get out of town and explore the world.

🏝️ Work From Anywhere: Flexibility is built in. Work remotely, or take advantage of our Sabbatical Policy.

📚 Growth Tools: Paid study days to level up your skills, plus a solid pension and cycle-to-work scheme.

🏡 Family Leave (maternity, paternity and adoption)

title: Sr. Software Engineer, Cloud Platform
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Senior Engineer in the Infrastructure org, you will help evolve the cloud foundations behind every Samsara product. Your goal will be to reduce systemic production risk and enable continued growth by making infrastructure safer to change, easier to operate, and more resilient and cost-efficient at scale.

You will bring deep expertise in at least one infrastructure domain, such as compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud control planes, and apply it across our multi-account, multi-region AWS environment. You will lead work such as modernizing compute and stateful infrastructure, strengthening capacity and failure isolation, and building standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation.

You will partner with product engineering teams to turn recurring risks and manual operations into durable platforms and paved paths. We do not expect you to be an expert in every infrastructure domain. We are looking for engineers who have built and operated critical systems at significant scale, understand how infrastructure fails, and can use that experience to improve both our platforms and our engineering practices.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.
  • You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.
  • You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we're all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win together.

In this role, you will:

  • Design, build, and operate reliable cloud platforms, bringing depth in one or more areas such as compute, networking, storage, stateful systems, or infrastructure control planes.
  • Improve the scalability, capacity management, isolation, recovery, and cost efficiency of critical production infrastructure.
  • Build standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation that support self-service provisioning, testing, progressive rollout, reconciliation, rollback, and drift prevention.
  • Identify shared failure modes and build safeguards that prevent localized failures from escalating into broad customer impact.
  • Contribute to multi-account, multi-region, and isolated AWS architectures, including regulated environments such as GovCloud.
  • Participate in operational ownership and incident response, using incidents and near misses to drive durable architectural improvements.
  • Mentor engineers, raise the quality of infrastructure design and operational judgment, and establish patterns that can be adopted across the organization.
  • Clearly communicate architecture, trade-offs, risks, and migration plans to technical and organizational stakeholders.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for this role.

  • 6+ years of experience designing and building software, infrastructure, or distributed systems, including operating critical systems in production.
  • Deep expertise in at least one of the following: compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud infrastructure control planes.
  • Strong software-engineering fundamentals in Go, Python, Java, or a similar language.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating infrastructure on a major public cloud platform; AWS experience is preferred.
  • Experience using infrastructure as code, such as Terraform, to safely manage production infrastructure.
  • Strong understanding of capacity management, failure domains, observability, rollout safety, and production recovery.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives across teams and through ambiguous problem spaces.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Designing and operating large-scale compute or container platforms such as ECS, EKS, Kubernetes, or similar orchestration systems.
  • Designing and operating stateful distributed systems such as Kafka, OpenSearch, managed databases, caching, or large-scale storage platforms.
  • Building internal infrastructure platforms, control planes, or self-service developer experiences adopted across multiple teams.
  • Designing multi-account or multi-region cloud architectures with strong workload isolation and disaster recovery.
  • Leading major infrastructure migrations while maintaining availability and controlling operational risk.
  • Delivering measurable improvements in infrastructure capacity, cost efficiency, or developer self-service.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. title: Staff Computer Vision Engineer - Localization
descriptionHtml:
Join SE3 Labs as Staff Computer Vision Engineer - Localization

Solve the hardest estimation and systems problems in our visual localization stack, from core algorithms to deployed software.

About SE3

SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today.

We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our localization technology, help build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands.

Our founding team’s research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field.

About the Role

As a Staff Engineer, you will shape algorithm and architecture decisions, implement critical parts of the system, and help other engineers solve problems across sensors, estimation and onboard compute.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will take ideas from research and recorded data through production code, live sensor testing and flight, working closely with the Team Lead and our robotics software, embedded, hardware and field teams.

What You’ll Work On

  • VIO, SLAM and Sensor Fusion: Build and improve localization algorithms for autonomous systems operating with degraded or unavailable GNSS. Our initial focus is UAVs, with methods that can extend to other robotic platforms.

  • Robustness: Solve difficult failures caused by low light, rain, fog, motion blur, vibration and sensor degradation. Investigate better estimation, learned methods and data where each can improve measured performance.

  • Mapping and Relocalization: Develop mapping, loop closure, relocalization and map-based navigation. Make pose, velocity and uncertainty estimates useful to planning, control and the rest of the autonomy stack.

  • Calibration and Timing: Solve problems in camera and IMU calibration, sensor synchronization, rolling shutter, latency and frame drops. Work across algorithms and integration to find the root cause.

  • Real-Time Deployment: Design and optimize production software for Jetson-class platforms and other constrained CPUs and GPUs. Measure the tradeoffs between accuracy, robustness, latency, memory and power.

  • Evaluation: Build the evaluation and replay tools that let us reproduce failures, compare approaches and detect regressions. Validate improvements on recorded data and deployed systems.

  • Technical Leadership: Lead difficult technical projects, review designs and code, and teach other engineers what you learn. Help the team choose where deeper algorithm work will make the largest difference.

Your Profile

  • You have personally built and deployed VIO, SLAM, localization or sensor-fusion systems. You can explain the parts you implemented, the alternatives you considered, the failures you solved and the measured results.

  • You have solved problems that span algorithms, sensors and runtime constraints, and can show improvements in accuracy, robustness or compute cost.

  • You have strong foundations in 3D geometry, linear algebra, probability, estimation and optimization, with practical experience in methods such as EKFs, factor graphs, nonlinear least squares and bundle adjustment.

  • You write production C++ for Linux systems and use Python for analysis, evaluation and tooling. Rust experience is a plus.

  • You have worked with real cameras and IMUs, calibration and timing. You use logs, reproducible experiments and regression tests to establish why a change works.

  • You have led substantial technical work and helped other engineers improve their designs and implementation. You remain comfortable writing and debugging the critical code yourself.

  • You have a master’s degree, PhD or equivalent practical experience in a relevant technical field.

  • You speak fluent English; German is a plus. Given the nature of SE3’s work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to work on defence-related projects and, where required, obtain the relevant security clearance.

Especially Valued Bonus Skills

  • Experience deploying perception systems on Nvidia Jetson, embedded CPUs/GPUs, writing CUDA kernels, optimizing deep neural networks for edge deployment.

  • Experience with LWIR thermal cameras (for navigation), rolling shutter effects, visual-inertial calibration, multi-camera rigs, fisheye/wide-angle lenses or monocular depth.

  • Experience with GNSS-denied navigation in UAV context, terrain-relative navigation, map-based localization and re-localization.

  • Experience building evaluation datasets, replay systems, perception observability, log tooling, and automated regression pipelines.

  • Publications or open-source contributions in SLAM, VIO, 3D computer vision, state estimation, or robotics are welcome, but not required.

 

Perks & Benefits

  • Real Ownership: Participate in SE3’s growth through our employee participation programme

  • Work Environment to Excel at: Find a high-quality and modern toolset, flat hierarchy and a skilled, driven team which will push the limits together with you

  • AI-boosted workplace: We empower every employee with best-in-class AI tools and agents, giving you unlimited access to the latest advancements and a true productivity edge

  • 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off

  • Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass

  • Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy and Greece

  • Mentorship: Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth

 

Our Process

  1. Intro Call (30 min): Let’s get to know each other

  2. Technical Conversation (45 Mins): High level discussion about your technical experience and what we are working on

  3. Coding / Algorithm Interview: We work through a practical perception, estimation, or robotics software problem together

  4. Technical Interview (90 mins): We dive into your experience with perception, state estimation, SLAM/VIO, robotics, and real-world debugging

  5. Team Dinner / Lunch: Meet the team and see whether it is a good fit on both sides

title: Staff Fullstack Engineer
descriptionHtml:

The company

The company is building an AI native software backbone for specialist manufacturers, initially across mission critical pharmaceutical and chemical supply chains. Many of these businesses still run critical order, planning and procurement processes through ageing ERP systems, spreadsheets and knowledge held by a small number of experienced employees.

The product combines workflow automation, AI agents and human approval to help operational teams respond faster while maintaining accuracy, traceability and compliance. The engineering team works close to customers, including visits to operational environments, to understand how work happens and turn it into dependable software.

You will work directly with the founders, influence architecture and engineering standards, and stay close to the users whose workflows you are improving.

Why consider it

You will have meaningful influence over the architecture, product and early engineering culture.

The technical work combines AI enabled systems, enterprise integration and demanding operational constraints.

The product supports essential European industries where software reliability and human judgement both matter.

The package includes a competitive base salary and meaningful early stage equity through a VSOP.

  • Experience integrating REST APIs and external systems.

  • A hands on approach. You can reason about architecture and still write, test and ship production code.

Useful additional experience

  • Cloud infrastructure, DevOps and connections to on premises or legacy systems.

  • German language skills for direct customer communication.

How the team works

  • High ownership and direct access to the founding team.

  • Fast iteration informed by customer workflows and operational reality.

  • A long term product build with the opportunity to grow into broader technical leadership as the team expands.

The process combines founder & engineering conversations with practical technical assessment. You should expect an architecture discussion and a hands-on coding exercise focused on how you think, communicate and build with modern engineering tools, including AI-assisted development.

Inclusion and accessibility

Our client is committed to an inclusive environment in which people of every gender identity, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, neurotype and disability can belong and contribute. Diverse teams make better decisions, and equity is treated as a condition for innovation.

If you need reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process, including assistive technology, additional time or another format, tell your Deep Tech Recruitment contact and we will support you.

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Ads Foundational Representations
descriptionHtml:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

Location: Reddit has a flexible first workforce. Don't live near our office? No worries: you can work remotely from anywhere in the UK or the Netherlands.

The Ads Foundational Representations (AFR) team develops signals and representations of Reddit’s core entities (ads, posts, users, and so on), capturing the semantic, contextual, and behavioral information that Reddit Ads needs. We work on building embeddings to understand content and users' interests based on the content they engage with. 

Our team has the potential to highlight one of Reddit's biggest differentiators: genuinely curated, high-quality, extremely relevant, and daily updated organic content. We are a Machine Learning/Data heavy team with a focus on the following areas:

  • Multimodal & Content Embeddings - Make sense of organic (posts, comments, subreddits) and promoted (ads, shopping products, their landing pages) text and media content by embedding them into a shared space. 
  • Contextual and Behavioral Relevance - Working with Product & Data Science, establishing definitions of what ads are relevant to users and the content we show them next to, building metrics and fine-tuning embeddings to better reflect relevance.
  • Knowledge Graph Embeddings - Building representations for the Knowledge graph entities, e.g., intellectual properties/brands, to be used for high-precision targeting & business insights. 
  • User Intent Modeling - Leveraging various techniques to introduce user representations based on the content they interact with: batch & real-time sequence modeling, LLM summarization, etc. 
  • LLM-based Representations - Leveraging LLMs, VLMs, and foundational models to build complex representations of Reddit entities that improve ranking outcomes

The signals and features we create become a key piece in the Ads Delivery funnel, from targeting to the auction, as well as the Business Insights product and other advertiser-facing products such as Creative generation and optimization.

As a Staff ML Engineer, you’ll be in charge of setting the technical direction of multiple pillars the team owns. You will lead cross-functional ML projects end to end - from high-level business gap analysis to engineering execution. 

Roughly 50% of your time will be spent on technical leadership and mentorship (driving strategy & designs, cross-functional collaboration, raising the quality bar), another 50% being individual hands-on work (data analysis & engineering, modeling & automation).  

Responsibilities

  • Providing technical leadership and mentorship to MLEs in the team: driving designs & their review, establishing best practices in analysis, modeling and engineering, keeping the bar high. 
  • Working closely with team/org leadership developing technical strategy for content-based embeddings & relevance for Ads.
  • Developing new or iterating on existing embedding models for advertising use cases, ranging from aggregation pipelines to two-tower architectures and sequence models.  
  • Working with local and 3rd-party LLMs/VLMs: extract representations, develop evaluation methodologies, prompt tune and fine-tune large models to build state-of-the-art embeddings. 
  • Building data processing and inference pipelines for the models we develop. 
  • Qualitative and quantitative evaluation of the various features we develop, end-to-end experimentation from internal benchmarks to downstream recommender system offline metrics to online experiments. 
  • Ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of the ML systems by writing automated tests, monitoring performance, and implementing best practices for model management.
  • Participating in modeling and coding reviews: You will review work by other team members and provide feedback to ensure that it meets the team's standards for quality and performance.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.

Required Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience with the full lifecycle of designing, training, evaluating, testing, and deploying industry-level models.
  • Demonstrated Staff-level technical leadership: mentoring engineers, driving standards and bar raising, leading complex cross-functional projects: from requirements, design to cross-team/functional alignment and execution without direct people-management authority. 
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts to different audiences, both verbally and in writing. 
  • Strong track record of working on content rich NLP/CV problems at scale, and using embeddings as a tool to solve them. 
  • Established data-driven approach for ML system development. Excitement about working with data and readiness to look behind the metric numbers. 
  • Familiarity with the Ads domain and/or Search/Recommender systems.
  • Experience with mainstream DL frameworks: PyTorch or TensorFlow.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with our stack (Python, Pytorch, Airflow, BigQuery, Ray, k8s, kafka, GCP)
  • Tech leadership experience: mentoring junior engineers and leading complex projects. 
  • Hands-on experience with using/fine-tuning/building LLMs.

title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer - Sovereign Cloud
descriptionHtml:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

You will join the team building and operating DeepL for Sovereign Markets, our offering for public sector bodies and regulated organisations that need more than data residency. It is hosted and operated entirely within the EU, under EU jurisdiction, and runs alongside DeepL's global infrastructure. The team is designing the platform foundations that make that promise true in practice: how services are built, deployed, secured, observed and operated. The approach favours managed infrastructure and well designed software abstractions over bespoke low level plumbing. You will work closely with product, security and legal colleagues as the offering grows to cover more capabilities and features.

Your responsibilities

  • Build the platform as software: Design and build the platform layer of DeepL for Sovereign Markets as software: reusable services, abstractions and tooling that product engineers build on

  • Own the architecture: Own the architecture of the managed infrastructure the platform runs on, including Kubernetes, networking, storage, identity and secrets, using provider managed services where they meet the requirement

  • Standardise and automate: Define infrastructure as code and delivery standards that hold across teams, and automate operations so that manual work is the exception

  • Make design decisions visible and reviewable: write and review architecture decision records, weigh positions on their merits and commit once a decision is made

  • Build for reliability: Build observability, resilience testing and incident response practices so that the service meets its reliability commitments

  • Adapt the product to the new environment: Make low invasive modifications to existing code in the product with confidence in order to make it run in the new environment

  • Keep the environment auditable: Work with security and compliance colleagues to keep the environment auditable and aligned with the standards our customers require

  • Raise the technical bar: Mentor engineers, raise the technical bar through design reviews, and build consensus across teams without relying on line authority

  • Participation in our on-call rotation: You’ll ensure the reliability and availability of our services by being available to join the team's shared on-call rotation as needed

Qualities we look for

  • Software engineering depth: Strong software engineering skills in at least one major language, C#, Go or Python preferred, shown by tooling, services or platform abstractions that other engineers rely on

  • Production infrastructure: Production experience designing and running managed infrastructure and Kubernetes, with sound judgement on when to use provider managed services and when not to

  • Automation and delivery: Infrastructure as code with Terraform, Crossplane or equivalent, and GitOps delivery, applied to environments you have owned

  • AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like GitHub Copilot or Claude) to accelerate your velocity and eliminate repetitive toil. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving

  • A track record of technical ownership across several teams: you create clarity where a mandate crosses team boundaries, hold clear positions and change them on evidence

  • Reliability discipline: observability, incident response and designing for failure, with experience carrying on-call

  • Security fundamentals: Working knowledge of infrastructure security fundamentals, such as identity, secrets, network segmentation and supply chain hygiene

  • Clear written communication: you can capture a decision so that others can build on it

You’d get bonus points for

  • Experience in regulated or audited environments, for example BSI C5, ISO 27001 or SOC2

  • Experience with EU based or sovereign cloud providers

  • Chaos engineering and game day practice

  • Building platforms for small teams through a high degree of automation

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

title: STAGE - Junior Fullstack Engineer - International Team
descriptionHtml:
Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Contexte du stage

Depuis des années, Doctrine propose une fonctionnalité d’envoi de décision de justice en France à ses clients. Cela est une source précieuse de décisions de justice qui permet à Doctrine d’enrichir sa base de données (c'est-à-dire son legal graph) avec des décisions qui n’ont pas pu être ajoutées par nos processus habituels.

Le but de ce stage est l’internationalisation de cette fonctionnalité de manière à ce qu’elle soit utilisable dans tous les autres pays où Doctrine est actif (Italie, Allemagne).

Les tâches principales seront :
  • Le développement d’une application minimale pour la revue et validation des décisions de justice mises en ligne par nos utilisateurs pour nos juristes avant leur publication.
  • La migration du processus legacy d’upload français actuel pour se conformer au processus commun (internationalisé).
Une fois que le processus de mise en ligne de décisions par nos utilisateurs sera internationalisé, le ou la stagiaire pourra travailler sur des tâches d’amélioration de l’application de revue de décisions dans le but d’aider notre équipe de juristes à mieux traiter le volume de décisions mises en ligne.

Exemples de pistes d’amélioration (non exhaustif)
  • Application de techniques d’OCR sur les documents pour faciliter leur validation.
  • Détection via LLM d’attributs des décisions (niveau de confidentialité, juridiction, domaine du droit, cour, …) pour faciliter leur validation.
  • Aide au retrait de contenu qui n’est pas le texte de la décision (pages blanches, notification à l’avocat, …).
    Le ou la stagiaire devra participer à la définition de la solution et sa réalisation. Il ou elle rejoindra l’équipe Italie et sera amené·e à travailler avec les équipes des autres pays (principalement l’équipe France) et l’équipe légale. Il ou elle participera aussi au chapter web (regroupement de tous les développeurs full stack de l’entreprise).

Les à-côtés du poste 👁️
Le ou la stagiaire participera comme tous les ingénieurs à son chapter (réuni 2 fois par mois) dont le but est de :
  • Partager des connaissances entre ses membres (amélioration continue, bonnes pratiques)
  • Proposer des améliorations (nouveaux outils et processus)
  • Aider ses membres en fonction de leurs besoins

    • Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝

    • Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
    • Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
    • Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
    • Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

    Nos valeurs 🤝

    Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

    • Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
    • Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
    • Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
    • Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.

    Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️

    🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible permettant - selon les équipes - jusqu’à trois jours de télétravail par semaine.

    🌴 Une politique de congés flexibles

    🌱 Des opportunités concrètes de mobilité interne

    🏄‍♂️ Des évènements collectifs réguliers

    📚 Un vrai accent sur la formation individuelle et collective, avec un budget annuel de 750€ pour toute formation en lien avec ton poste - et des formations en équipe ou pour toute l'entreprise

    🏋️‍♀️ Un abonnement Gymlib pour les activités sportives et bien-être

    🧘 Un accès gratuit à la plateforme d'accompagnement à la santé mentale Moka.care et un accompagnement individuel allant jusqu’à 6 séances par an

    👩‍⚕️ Une assurance santé avec Alan

    🍱 🚲 Une carte Swile pour tes tickets restaurants et ton forfait mobilité durable (66,60 euros par mois)

    💡 Des réductions et avantages négociés grâce à notre CSE via la plateforme Happypal

    🍏 Un équipement de travail neuf chez Apple

    Notre processus de recrutement 🚀

    • Un premier échange de 30 min avec l’un.e de nos Talent Acquisition Manager pour bien comprendre ton projet professionnel et te présenter ce qu'on construit chez Doctrine
    • Une rencontre d’1h avec ton/ta futur.e manager, pour détailler le poste et le scope de l’équipe, mais aussi répondre à toutes tes questions.
    • Un ou deux tests techniques pour évaluer concrètement tes compétences
    • Une venue dans nos bureaux pour : un déjeuner avec 3 personnes de différents départements chez Doctrine, pour te donner un aperçu de tes futur.e.s collègues ; un échange sur les valeurs de l’entreprise pour te partager notre vision, et une rencontre avec notre CEO, Guillaume.

Certaines études scientifiques montrent qu'en particulier les femmes ont moins tendance à postuler à une offre d'emploi quand elles n'ont pas toutes les qualifications. Si cela peut vous rassurer, sachez que cette fiche de poste est indicative donc prenez la comme telle : c'est un guide, ni plus ni moins. Si Doctrine vous intéresse, sachez que nous aurons plaisir à recevoir votre candidature ! Diversité & inclusion Toutes nos offres sont ouvertes aux personnes en situation de handicap, n'hésitez pas a nous en parler lors du process de recrutement. descriptionHtml:

Bij WPP Media zijn we het wereldwijde mediacollectief van WPP, volledig gebouwd voor het AI-tijdperk. We bundelen het beste platform, de meest getalenteerde mensen en de sterkste partners om innovatieve oplossingen te creëren. Ons doel? Merken elke dag ongeëvenaarde groei bieden. We’re Extraordinary: We verleggen grenzen, dagen het gewone denken uit en doorbreken de status-quo in ons streven naar innovatie en groei.

We’re Open: We bouwen vertrouwen en begrip door naadloos samen te werken – met onze teams, klanten en partners.

We’re Optimistic: Een 'growth mindset' zit in ons DNA. We omarmen verandering als dé manier om het beste uit onszelf te halen.

Klaar om de social media-wereld te veroveren? Word onze Stagiair Social Media bij StudioM!

Droom jij ervan om te werken voor A-merken als Mentos, Katja en Tempo-Team? Krijg jij energie van het creëren van viral content en het spotten van de nieuwste TikTok-trends? Dan hebben we de perfecte match! Bij StudioM, het creatieve hart van WPP Media, zoeken we een gedreven Stagiair Social Media die ons team komt versterken.

Wie zijn wij?

StudioM is een uniek collectief van creatievelingen die verslaafd zijn aan digital design, contentcreatie en influencer marketing. We zijn onderdeel van WPP Media en werken vanuit die basis voor de gaafste merken. Je komt terecht in ons jonge, dynamische en supergezellige social media team. Jouw missie, mocht je die accepteren:

Als Stagiair Social Media ben jij de motor achter de online aanwezigheid van onze klanten. Je mond dichthouden? Geen optie! We willen jouw frisse ideeën.

  • Content is King (or Queen): Je werkt mee aan ijzersterke contentkalenders en strategieën.
  • Trendspotting: Jij bent onze ogen en oren online. Je weet wat er speelt in de community, welke trends booming zijn en hoe we daarop kunnen inspelen.
  • Community Love: Je helpt mee met het managen van de social communities en bent de stem van het merk.
  • Create & Activate: Je brainstormt mee over de vetste activaties en campagnes die engagement door het dak laten gaan.
  • Data-Driven: Je duikt in de data om insights te vinden die onze strategieën nóg slimmer maken.

Dit ben jij (toch?):

Jij bent allesbehalve een muurbloempje. Social media is jouw natuurlijke habitat en je schermtijd bewijst dat.

  • Je ademt social media, kent alle ins en outs van TikTok en Instagram en wordt wild van het creëren van nieuwe content.
  • Je hebt een proactieve, ‘hands-on’ mentaliteit. Een nieuwe update of trend? Jij ziet kansen en wilt meteen aan de slag.
  • Je bent creatief, zelfstandig en leergierig (HBO-denkniveau).
  • De Nederlandse taal heeft voor jou geen geheimen.
  • Je staat te popelen om te leren en jezelf te ontwikkelen in een high-paced omgeving.

title: Strategic Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Condukt is the next-generation compliance platform for financial services, offering an agentic solution powered by real-time data for business identity.

Always-on and policy-aware, Condukt enables financial institutions and fintechs to gain actionable insights into business verification - unlocking growth, increasing efficiency, and strengthening compliance.

We were founded by former operators and builders with deep experience in banking, payments, and lending. Today, our team spans across London and Porto, bringing together engineers, product owners, and operators from companies like Revolut, Meta, Block (Square), SumUp, American Express, Yandex, and OakNorth.

Trusted by leading regulated entities, including Wise, Tide, Mollie, Shift4, Flatpay, and myPOS, Condukt is backed by top investors, including Lightspeed Venture Partners and MMC Ventures.

  

Position Overview

We are looking for a Strategic Account Manager to join our team and play a critical role in driving growth across our most important customers. You will serve as the strategic bridge between our real-time identity and AI-powered platform and the financial institutions that rely on it, owning the commercial relationship and ensuring customers realize measurable, growing value from Condukt. You’ll work hand-in-hand with our AI Deployment Strategists, who lead rollout and adoption, while you own retention, renewals and expansion across your portfolio.

As an early-stage, fast-growing company, we value people who roll up their sleeves and operate with ownership. In this role, you will manage a portfolio of ~10-15 high-impact enterprise financial services accounts, ranging from high-growth FinTechs to large global financial institutions.

You will own the end-to-end customer journey, from post-sale onboarding through renewal and expansion, while leading complex, high-value engagements at the intersection of customer outcomes, product strategy and commercial growth. You’ll identify expansion opportunities, drive measurable business outcomes, and build trusted, long-term partnerships that grow alongside our platform. You’ll be measured on gross revenue retention, net revenue retention and expansion across your portfolio.

If you thrive in fast-moving environments, enjoy solving complex problems with customers, and want to help shape both a product and a company, this role is for you.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Execute strategic account plans to expand and grow a portfolio of high-value customers, spanning high-growth scaleups to tier-one financial institutions

  • Own renewals end-to-end and lead the hard commercial conversations, such as churn risk, pricing and discount requests, while keeping the relationship strong

  • Identify and develop new use cases with customers, from KYB onboarding to ongoing monitoring and agentic compliance workflows, building the business case alongside our AI Deployment Strategists

  • Run regular value reviews with executive sponsors, quantifying ROI such as manual effort saved, onboarding speed and risk outcomes

  • Build deep, trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across CX, Product, Operations, Risk & Compliance, and C-suite

  • Lead executive-level and technical presentations, tailoring messaging to diverse audiences to drive alignment, adoption, and commercial outcomes

  • Partner with our AI Deployment Strategists through rollout, making sure deployments hit the business outcomes agreed at signature

  • Build the account management, QBR, renewal and expansion playbooks as one of the first members of this function

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Leadership to provide strategic feedback, translating customer needs and market insights into roadmap and go-to-market decisions

  • Represent Condukt externally at industry events and conferences, acting as a trusted advisor, thought leader, and evangelist within the financial services ecosystem

What you bring:

  • 4+ years in account management, customer success or account executive roles at B2B SaaS companies, ideally selling into regulated industries such as financial services, with a track record of running renewals and expansion against a target

  • Strong ability to navigate large, matrixed enterprise organizations, coordinating and influencing internal and customer stakeholders to drive outcomes

  • Analytical, problem-solving mindset, comfortable working with data and translating insights into sound strategic and commercial decisions

  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, building trust and credibility across CX, Product, Operations, Risk & Compliance, and C-suite executives

  • Self-starter with grit and resilience, thriving in ambiguity and fast-paced, execution-driven environments

  • Commercially confident: comfortable negotiating renewals, pricing and churn risk while protecting the relationship

  • Technical fluency: comfortable discussing APIs, data and integrations with engineering teams

 

Bonus:

  • Experience working with Risk & Compliance, KYB or KYC teams at financial institutions or fintechs

  • Domain expertise in banking, payments, and/or lending ecosystems

  • Early-stage startup experience, or a strong appetite for building in fast-moving, high-ambiguity environments

  • Familiarity with API-based and agentic products in an enterprise software setting from a product and/or sales perspective

 

Our offer:

  • Tackle meaningful problems with real-world impact

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Join us in our offices in London (hybrid: 3 days a week)

  • Flat hierarchy with direct access to the founders

  • Top-of-the-line equipment

  • Private health insurance, plus sick and compassionate leave as needed

title: Strategy Intern (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

We are scaling fast and investing heavily in our product, our clients and our international footprint. We are looking for a Strategy Intern to join our Strategy team and help us shape what comes next.

About the role:

As Strategy Intern, you will join our Strategy team, working directly with our Head of Strategy, Tine von Villiez, and our wider leadership team, including our CEO and Founder, Martin Kassing. You will support Upvest's most important strategic work, from high-stakes leadership and board meetings to initiatives such as market expansion and new products. You will own your own work packages, working independently and cross-functionally, with direct exposure to senior leadership. This is a high-impact, highly visible role and a great way to learn how a fast-growing fintech is run, with a deep look into our product, clients, operations and the banking ecosystem.
