title: Strategy & Operations Director
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Strategy & Operations Lead of Doit Lithuania, you will build and run the business in Lithuania and grow it across the European Economic Area.

You will be the first senior hire in Lithuania. You will own the regulatory relationship, the build of the team, the partner network and the launch. You will sit on the management board and lead the business day to day.

We’re looking for a generalist who learns quickly, thinks deeply, and enjoys solving difficult problems in a fast-moving, regulated environment.

What You’ll Own

  • Own the relationship with the Bank of Lithuania and other regulators.

  • Build the Vilnius team, including compliance, operations and control functions.

  • Select and negotiate with execution, custody, fund and banking partners.

  • Own the business plan, financial projections, capital plan and budget.

  • Launch the investment platform in Lithuania and roll it out across the EEA.

  • Set up governance, policies and controls that meet EU and Lithuanian requirements.

  • Work with group leadership on product, engineering and growth.

  • Report to the board and take ownership of business and regulatory outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

  • Generalist background in consulting, investment banking, start-ups, private equity or venture capital.

  • Experience building or scaling a business, ideally in financial services or fintech.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn regulation quickly and work credibly with regulators.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with boards, regulators, partners and teams.

  • Comfortable working across product, operations, finance and compliance.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a senior manager.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania.

  • Experience with MiFID II, brokerage, wealth management or fund distribution.

  • Experience building or running a regulated financial business in the EU.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

  • People who see regulation as someone else’s problem.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

Besonders interessant sind für uns außerdem:

  • Kenntnisse des deutschen Gesundheitswesens oder Erfahrung im Vertrieb an Praxen, MVZ oder Kliniken

title: Tech Director - Mobile (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Tech Director - Mobile (f/m/d)

Job Description

adjoe is a leading mobile ad platform developing cutting-edge advertising and monetization solutions to meet the diverse needs of app publishers. Being part of the applike group ecosystem plus the significant financial backing from Bertelsmann empowers us to do this. At adjoe, we are proud of our advanced tech stack and dynamic and innovative workforce.

Meet Your Team: Rewarded Solutions - Mobile Integrations

The Mobile Integrations Team is part of our Rewarded Solutions Department which develops the technology behind adjoe's innovative rewarded engagement products that serve over 57 million daily mobile users.

 

Mobile Integrations is responsible for the native Android and iOS SDKs written in Java/Kotlin and Swift that handle much of the complex engagement flows. On top of the SDKs are widely customizable web applications built with React TypeScript; and a highly performant Golang backend hosted on AWS that processes millions of events hourly. Our system matches each game with its ideal users, delivering rewards optimized for satisfaction through data processed via AWS Athena, Kafka, Spark, S3, and MySQL.

 

For team members, this means having state-of-the-art resources to build engaging rewarded ad experiences that seamlessly integrate into the world’s top apps while delivering exceptional results for advertisers and monetizers in this industry-leading technology.

What You Will Do:

 

  • Lead & Scale: Take ownership of the Mobile Integrations team from day one, setting the benchmark for engineering excellence across our mobile SDKs before scaling your scope to lead up to 3 cross-functional mobile engineering teams, guiding line managers and tech leads along the way.

  • Architect & Innovate: Drive the holistic mobile architecture, technological direction, and platform scalability, ensuring our SDKs remain robust, performant, and future-proof across millions of daily active devices.

  • Partner Strategically: Collaborate closely with the VP of Engineering, Product leadership, and executive stakeholders to translate high-level business goals into a concrete, high-impact mobile platform roadmap.

  • Foster Engineering Culture: Champion engineering best practices, sustainable code reviews, and architectural alignment across teams while collaborating with tech leads company-wide to push technical standards forward.

  • Build & Mentor: Play a defining role in recruitment and organizational growth; mentoring senior engineers and managers, fostering a high-performance culture, and helping every engineer reach their full potential.

 

Who You Are:

  • An experienced engineering leader with 8+ years of professional experience in software development and technical management.

  • Extensive experience as a Team Lead, Engineering Manager or Tech Director, ideally with a track record or strong readiness for managing large mobile engineering teams.

  • Deep background in mobile ecosystems (iOS/Android, SDK development) with high architectural standards across scaling systems.

  • Proven track record of mentoring tech leads and senior engineers, driving engineering strategy, and organizational scale.

  • Someone who enjoys translating business requirements into pragmatic technical solutions and can also efficiently communicate technical solutions to business stakeholders.

  • Able to balance developer experience, security, and performance when designing interfaces and systems.

  • A strong communicator who can adapt their level of detail when talking to engineers, product, and business stakeholders.

  • Fluent in English.

    What’s in It for You?

    At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

    • Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.

    • Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.

    • Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.

    • Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.

    • Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.

title: Thèse : Développement d'un concept de bâtiment de ligne d'assemblage final d'avion (FAL) écoresponsable - CDD 36 mois
descriptionHtml:
Établissement : IMT Mines Albi, France

École doctorale : Mécanique, Énergétique, Génie civil et Procédés (MEGEP), Université de Toulouse

Laboratoire de recherche : RAPSODEE – IMT Mines Albi – UMR CNRS 5302, France

Encadrant : Yasmine Lalau, Mathieu Milhé, Elsa Weiss-Hortala

Lieu : Albi (RAPSODEE CNRS–IMT Mines Albi)

Financement : DGAC, projet FORCE

Date de début : Mars 2026

Description du poste :

Ce travail s’inscrit dans le projet FORCE, porté par Airbus Opérations et financé par la DGAC. Ce projet vise le développement d’un futur bâtiment de ligne d’assemblage final d’avions (FAL) plus adaptable, connectée et écoresponsable pour servir les objectifs d’Airbus Opérations en matière de productivité et d’impact environnemental (« Net 0 » à l’horizon 2050). Ce projet se divise en plusieurs parties dont l’une est centrée sur l’écoresponsabilité.

Airbus Opérations produit des avions avec une forte variabilité d’aménagements intérieurs, qui impacte directement la typologie et la durée des opérations d’assemblage, et souhaite intégrer une ligne mobile. Ceci modifie l’organisation interne de la FAL, qui doit en outre respecter des objectifs de faible consommation énergétique et développer un bâtiment bas carbone.

Le projet FORCE vise à définir des scénarios de mise en œuvre de la future FAL pour minimiser ses impacts énergétiques et environnementaux et augmenter sa résilience. Il fait suite au projet TAKT mais plusieurs éléments clés de conception et d’organisation restent à étudier. Une FAL est un bâtiment de grandes dimensions soumis à des ouvertures et fermetures de portails fréquents. Ceci déstabilise le confort intérieur, qui doit respecter des plages de température et d’humidité pour éviter par exemple les effets de dilatation ou rétractation des matériaux ou assurer l’adhérence des mastics. Un bâtiment de cette envergure, intégrant une ligne mobile, possède alors peu de cloisons, une hauteur sous plafond élevée, et la dalle de sol doit être renforcée et plane pour assurer le déplacement de la ligne mobile, tout en accueillant les alimentations électriques (câbles électriques ou batteries). Ces contraintes structurales impactent directement la localisation des unités de chauffage et de climatisation et la régulation de l’humidité. Dans ce contexte particulier d’une FAL, la conception du bâtiment est un problème complexe nécessitant d’optimiser simultanément plusieurs paramètres :

  • Les dimensions du bâtiment et le positionnement des cloisons internes et unités de chauffage et climatisation devront être optimisés dans le respect des contraintes techniques d’assemblage et de régulation de la température et de l’humidité. Dans un second temps, la zone bureau sera intégrée, avec un objectif de confort intérieur différent.

  • L’introduction de sas (dimensions à étudier) vise directement à constituer un effet tampon pour faciliter la régulation du confort intérieur (température, humidité) lors des séquences d’ouverture et fermeture des portails. La disposition des sas dépend aussi de la localisation des éléments de chauffage et de climatisation.

  • La consommation énergétique est liée au chauffage, à la climatisation mais aussi à l’éclairage.

    En effet, les opérations d’assemblage nécessitent une luminosité constante sur les différents postes d’assemblage, parfois à des hauteurs différentes. La consommation énergétique liée au confort intérieur (température, humidité) est particulièrement complexe à optimiser et à homogénéiser dans le bâtiment en raison de son envergure et du faible nombre de cloisons disponibles. Une étude d’intégration d’énergies renouvelables est prévue sur les aspects chaleur et électricité, notamment en prenant en compte l’alimentation électrique directe ou indirecte par batteries de la ligne mobile.

  • L’impact énergétique, environnemental et la résilience du bâtiment en fonction de son implantation et de l’évolution des conditions climatiques sera étudié. Les simulations seront alors réalisées pour des localisations correspondant à des conditions météorologiques de plus en plus sévères afin de tester la résilience.

Ces verrous scientifiques et techniques associés directement à la typologie du bâtiment FAL et des matériaux sélectionnés seront supportés par la simulation thermique dynamique (STD) des scénarios d’usage étudiés, par l’analyse de cycle de vie (ACV) du bâtiment et par des analyses d’impacts.

Mots-clés

Bâtiment industriel de grande envergure, indicateurs de performance énergétique et environnementale, confort intérieur, résilience, bâtiment écoresponsable, simulation thermique dynamique (STD)

Compétences :

Il est attendu que le/la candidat(e) soit titulaire d’un bac+5 en génie énergétique ou ingénierie de la performance.

Le/la candidat(e) devra posséder de solides connaissances associées au génie climatique et énergétique (en particulier les solutions d’énergies renouvelables et les systèmes CVC) et au management de la performance (notamment les indicateurs de performance industrielle et les indicateurs énergétiques et environnementaux). Une première expérience en simulation thermique du bâtiment est nécessaire. Une connaissance de l’environnement d’une ligne d’assemblage final d’avions et en particulier les contraintes associées à la typologie du bâtiment est un plus. Une première expérience d’analyse de cycle de vie serait aussi un plus.

title: UX Designer, AI App
descriptionHtml:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 

Role

You will own the UX of ActAI's core app experience. This means designing the end-to-end flows users go through every day - how they start tasks, how they follow along as the AI works, how they stay in control, and how they recover when something goes wrong.

This is a UX role for a HCI product. You need to understand both user needs and AI system behavior well enough to design product flows that feel clear, reliable, and controllable.

 

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own UX for ActAI's core app surfaces across iOS, Android, and web.

  • Design complete user flows for AI-assisted tasks - from intent capture through to task completion, including handoff, progress tracking, and error recovery.

  • Design how the app surfaces what the AI is doing, what decisions it has made, and what the user needs to confirm or adjust.

  • Map and design the full range of AI states a user encounters - loading, thinking, acting, waiting, completing, stalling, failing, and recovering.

  • Work with product, engineering, and ML teams to define user requirements and translate them into concrete design solutions.

  • Conduct usability research to understand where users lose trust, feel uncertain, or disengage.

  • Produce wireframes, user flows, and high-fidelity designs that engineering can build from directly.

  • Contribute to the design system and shared UX patterns for AI app surfaces.

  • Design for both simple everyday interactions and complex multi-step AI workflows within the same product.

 

What You Will Need

  • Experience as a UX designer on consumer mobile or web apps, with a strong portfolio.

  • Solid skills in user flow design, wireframing, and high-fidelity prototyping in Figma.

  • Ability to design for systems that are asynchronous, non-deterministic, and context-dependent.

  • Clear thinking about user trust, control, feedback, and transparency in AI-driven product experiences.

  • Experience conducting user research and turning findings into design decisions.

  • Comfortable working in fast-moving teams with evolving product scope.

  • Ability to balance simple consumer UX with complex AI system behavior.

  • Good judgment on usability, edge cases, failure handling, and recovery flows.

 

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

 

Interview process

For design roles, we expect candidates to submit a portfolio as part of the application process.

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2 rounds of interviews and a design assessment.

Applications are evaluated by our team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

title: Working Student - Flight Log Analysis Software (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We push boundaries, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who are driven by ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in.

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty.

As a Working Student for Flight Log Analysis Software, you will take ownership of the internal desktop app our engineers and flight-test teams use to analyse drone flight logs. The groundwork is already in place, including plans, tests, CI and releases. Your job is to turn what our teams need into working features, using AI coding agents to build fast while keeping quality high.

Your roadmap to make an impact

  • Collect ideas and pain points from engineering, flight test and ops teams, and turn them into clear feature requests

  • Build those features with AI coding agents, and review and test what the AI writes before it ships

  • Test new features with the teams who asked for them, and improve them based on their feedback

  • Own the roadmap: prioritise requests, plan releases and keep the backlog up to date

  • Maintain existing features: fix bugs, handle user reports and ship regular releases

  • Keep the codebase healthy: clean up code, refresh the docs and reduce tech debt


  • You’re enrolled in computer science, engineering, aerospace or a related field

  • You’ve used AI coding tools on real projects, not just tutorials

  • You can read code well enough to tell when the AI got it wrong (Python and/or TypeScript)

  • You know the basics of Git and branching

  • You like talking to users, asking good questions and turning vague wishes into concrete specs

  • You work in a structured way and can manage your own priorities

Nice to have

  • Experience with drones, PX4, ROS 2 or flight data.

  • Experience with React, FastAPI or Electron.

  • An interest in data visualisation and building tools for engineers.

Why TYTAN?

  • Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defense systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security

  • Shape scalable defense capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale

  • Contribute to networked air defense: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defense architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors

  • Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback

  • Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact

  • Define a new generation of defense technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company

  • Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

  • Monthly allowances: €68/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit

  • Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us

  • Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team

  • Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together

  • Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands

  • Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process.

Please note that we currently do not offer visa sponsorship, so we’re only able to consider candidates who already have a valid work permit. All qualified applicants are hereby encouraged to apply.

title: Working Student Global Marketplaces
descriptionHtml:
Lovehoney Group is the world’s leading sexual wellbeing company, with the mission to elevate pleasure through innovative technologies, a data-driven approach, and foster creative and fresh perspectives on intimacy. We offer exciting brands with innovative, high-quality sex toys, lingerie, and accessories in a streamlined online shopping experience. At Lovehoney, we employ over 800 passionate and progressive individuals across 11 global offices, each person contributing a unique blend of talents to our diverse workforce. We are proud to be a company that thrives by doing things differently, challenging expectations and stereotypes while making a positive impact on our customers’ lives. Join us at Lovehoney, where pleasure combines with creativity, data, and innovation!

We are looking for a Working Student to join our Marketplaces team in Berlin. In this role, you will support our Marketplace Managers in driving the success of our global Amazon and marketplace business. Your key responsibilities will include coordinating product testing and research activities, as well as managing and analysing customer reviews to uncover valuable insights. You will help transform customer feedback into actionable recommendations for our Product, Content, and Marketing teams, contributing directly to business improvements. In addition, you will support a variety of operational and executional tasks, including marketplace listing updates and other day-to-day projects. This is an excellent opportunity for a proactive and detail-oriented student to gain hands-on e-commerce experience in a fast-growing international environment, with flexible working hours that fit around your studies.


What you will do
  • Help organise and coordinate our product testing and research activities, working closely with the marketplace managers.
  • Monitor and analyse our customer reviews across marketplaces, spotting recurring themes, issues and opportunities.
  • Turn review insights into clear, actionable suggestions for product improvements and share them with the product team.
  • Use review feedback to help improve our product content and the way we communicate around our products, feeding suggestions to the content team.
  • Flag relevant review themes to the marketing team to help shape messaging and campaigns.
  • Act as a central point for review management, coordinating feedback between the product, content and marketing teams.
  • Support the marketplace managers on execution projects, such as updating and optimising product listings.
  • Help out on a range of smaller tasks and projects across the team wherever an extra hand is needed.
  • Keep samples, records, trackers and documentation well organised and up to date.

    • What you should bring
  • Currently enrolled at a German university in a related discipline with at least 12 months of enrollment remaining.
  • Strong interest in e-commerce, Amazon, and the dynamics of online marketplaces.
  • Proactive and collaborative mindset, with excellent communication skills and a willingness to work closely with cross-functional teams.
  • Reliable, accountable, and self-motivated, with the initiative to take ownership of tasks and drive them to completion.
  • Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel and comfortable learning new tools and systems.
  • Fluency in English is essential; German language skills are a plus.
  • Comfortable working for a brand that communicates openly and confidently about sexual wellness.

    • What we can offer you
  • A welcoming workplace full of drinks, snacks, friendly faces and fun team-building events.
  • Access to unique discounts at high street retailers, hotels, and service providers, in addition to a 50% discount on all Lovehoney products to explore and discover new ways to have fun.
  • Enjoy a hybrid work model that fosters flexibility and work-life balance, with three days per week in-office and the opportunity to work remotely for up to 4 weeks per year, alongside 25 days’ holiday, plus an additional day for each year you are with Lovehoney, providing ample time for relaxation, rejuvenation, and exploration.
  • Access to customized training opportunities to support your unique learning journey, complemented by biannual feedback cycles, offering valuable insights into your performance and growth areas, enhancing your development within the company.
  • Recognising the significance of physical and mental health, we proudly provide gym benefits in addition to a mental wellbeing platform, to ensure our employees thrive both professionally and personally.
  • Stay secure at work and at home with a complimentary 1Password Family account. All Lovehoney Group employees can invite up to five family members to join, offering your household a safe and simple way to manage passwords and sensitive information safely and easily.

  • CV review
  • Interview with one of our Talent Acquisition Team Members
  • Hiring Manager Interview (On-site)

    • Lovehoney Group is an equal opportunities employer. We promise that every qualified person will be evaluated according to skills regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

    If you require accommodations during the interview process due to a disability, please inform your Talent Acquisition Specialist so that we can ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates.

    At Lovehoney Group, we embrace innovative technologies to enhance our recruitment process. We leverage artificial intelligence during screening interviews for CV reviews and note-taking. We prioritize transparency and respect your preferences, so you'll have the option to opt out of recording and AI-driven note-taking while still receiving full and fair consideration for the role.

    We currently have a hybrid work model supporting a blend of in-office and remote work (3 days per week in-office).

title: Working Student
descriptionHtml:
Novaspace is seeking a Working Student to join our Munich office, supporting our team across a diverse range of consulting, innovation advisory and business activities in the space sector.

Our team in Munich advises clients across industry, government and the wider space ecosystem. Our work spans market assessment, strategy and business planning, policy development, due diligence and M&A, innovation advisory, technology strategy & foresight, space solutions enablement, and community outreach and training.

As a Working Student, you will work alongside our consultants and contribute to client projects as well as internal activities. Depending on your interests, skills and project needs, you will gain hands-on exposure to different types of assignments and stakeholders across the European and international space ecosystem.


Your tasks may include

  • Conducting desktop research and qualitative and quantitative analysis on markets, technologies, companies, policies and innovation ecosystems

  • Supporting innovation advisory activities, including research on start-ups and emerging technologies, ecosystem and stakeholder mapping, and analysis of innovation programmes and initiatives

  • Contributing to market assessments, strategy projects, policy studies, technology foresight and due diligence assignments

  • Supporting the preparation and delivery of workshops, stakeholder engagements, training sessions and community activities

  • Preparing presentations, reports, briefing materials and other client deliverables

  • Gathering, structuring and synthesising information and translating findings into clear insights

  • Supporting project coordination and communication with clients, partners and other stakeholders

  • Contributing to internal initiatives and the development of our consulting and innovation activities

  • Supporting selected administrative, organisational and financial processes that help our Munich office run effectively

  • The exact mix of responsibilities will vary depending on ongoing projects and your background, giving you the opportunity to gain exposure to different areas of our business.

    • We offer

  • Hands-on experience in management consulting and innovation advisory within the space sector

  • Exposure to a broad range of topics spanning business, policy, technology and innovation

  • The opportunity to develop your research, analytical, communication and consulting skills alongside experienced colleagues

  • An international and collaborative working environment in an attractive area of downtown Munich

  • Intellectual challenges combined with work-life balance and limited travel

  • Exposure to clients and stakeholders across industry, government, research and the entrepreneurial ecosystem

  • The opportunity to build a unique professional network across the European and international space sector


    • Desired skills & experience

    We are interested in candidates from a broad range of academic backgrounds who are curious about the space sector and eager to learn. You do not need to be a space expert when you join us.

    Ideally, you bring:

  • Current enrolment at a university or higher education institution

  • A strong academic record and intellectual curiosity

  • Fluency in English

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an interest in qualitative and/or quantitative analysis

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to present information in a structured way

  • An interest in business, technology, policy, entrepreneurship and/or innovation

  • The ability to learn quickly, take ownership of tasks and work in a structured and reliable manner

  • The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in an international team

  • Curiosity, initiative and a willingness to contribute across different types of projects and activities


    • Any of the following would be a plus

    We do not expect candidates to bring experience in all of these areas. Relevant interests or experience could include:

  • Space business, Earth observation, satellite navigation, space applications or other areas of the space economy

  • Innovation, entrepreneurship, start-ups, technology transfer or innovation ecosystems

  • Strategy, market research, economics, finance or investment

  • Public policy, government programmes or international organisations

  • Technology strategy, emerging technologies or foresight

  • Engineering, natural sciences, economics, business, public policy or another relevant academic field

  • Experience organising or supporting workshops, events, training or stakeholder engagement

  • Working proficiency in German, French, Spanish, or another European language

    • About Novaspace Novaspace is the global leading consulting firm in the space sector. With a robust 40-year legacy of expertise in guiding private companies and government entities through strategic decisionmaking processes, Novaspace offers end-to-end consulting services, from project strategy definition to implementation, providing data-led perspectives on critical issues. Our mission is to empower clients with strategic and technical insights, enabling them to navigate and seize new opportunities within the rapidly evolving space sector. As a privately owned and fully independent organization, Novaspace presents an expanded portfolio of services, featuring combined expertise in management and technology consulting, top-tier executive summits, and market intelligence. Trusted by 1,200 clients in over 60 countries, Novaspace has offices strategically located in Brussels, Montreal, Munich, Paris, Singapore, Sydney, Tokyo, Toulouse, and Washington D.C. Working at Novaspace will give you the opportunity to boost your career in the space/consulting industry where our role is to support the decision-makers by providing them the highest quality support in everything we do: consulting, market intelligence, training and summits.
